vīraśaivācāra.vedamūrti:
<śake 1827, sana 1905 >
oṃ [atha vīraśaivācārapradīpikāprārambhaḥ] || [prathamo'dhyāyaḥ] || śrīgurubhyo namaḥ || anekajanmotthitaduḥkhabhājāṃ nṛṇāmapīśaḥ karuṇārdradṛṣṭyā || vilokya teṣāṃ svapadaṃ pradātumanugrahaṃ yaḥ kurute namāmi || 1 || puṣpe gaṃdhastile tailaṃ svarṇe kāṃtiryathā tathā || avinābhāvasaṃbaṃdhāṃ śive devīṃ namāmyahaṃ || 2 || mādalāṃbāgarbhasiṃdhau jātaṃ basavadhīmaṇiṃ || dharmasvarūpaṃ sthāṇuṃ ca namāmi śirasā'niśaṃ || 3 || drākṣārāme mahāgrāme koṭipallākhyadeśikaḥ || vedavedāṃtatatvajñaḥ purāṇāgamatatvavit || 4 || natabhaktajanāghaughatimirodajabāṃdhavaḥ || tiṣṭhatyeva śivācārapravartanaparaḥ sadā || 5 || tasyāsīttanayaḥ khyāto bhīmapaṃḍitanāmakaḥ || vṛddhīkṛtasadācāraḥ sarvaśāstrārthakovidaḥ || 6 || tasya patnī gauramāṃbā sarvalakṣaṇasaṃyutā ||
dūrīkṛtāghapaṭalā sarvajñā varavarṇinī || 7 || tasyāsīdātmajaḥ śāṃto mallikārjunapaṃḍitaḥ || śivārcane saktacittaḥ śiṣyāṇāṃ mokṣadāyakaḥ || 8 || bhaṭṭānīkābdhivaḍavo vedāṃtāraṇyapāvakaḥ || mahāpravṛddhacārvākarākācaṃdravidhuṃtudaḥ || 9 || veṃnālacolabhūpasya mahāsthāne'tiśobhite || sarvavādāṃśca jitvā'tha lelihe vijayatrayaṃ || 10 || tasyātmajo yaḥ saṃjātaḥ paṃḍitārādhya eva ca || mūlamaṃtrārthatatvajño muktikāṃtānuraṃjakaḥ || 11 || tasyātmajaśca siddhāṃtavīrārādhyaḥ śivārcakaḥ || sarvāgamajño matimān śiṣyāghadhvāṃtabhāskaraḥ || 12 || tasya pratīke saṃjātaḥ śrīmān sarvaguṇairyutaḥ || gurubasaveśvara iti vikhyāto deśikottamaḥ || 13 || tasyābhūtāṃ sutau gaṃgādharo basavatīrthakaḥ || śivādhiṣṭhitacetaskau sarvaśāstrārthapāragau || 14 || tasya śrībasavarājasya saṃjātau dvau sutau tadā || hiriyāryaḥ paṃḍitāryo viṣayādiguṇānvitau || 15 || paṃḍitārādhyadevasya tasyāsīttanayottamaḥ ||
śivaṃprati pārvatīkṛtapraśnaḥ śivanirūpitapiṃḍotpattikathanam
guruliṃgadevanāmā śivārādhanatatparaḥ || 16 || tasya śrīdeśikeṃdrasya babhūvustanayottamāḥ || prathamo gurudevaśca paṃḍitāryo dvitīyakaḥ || 17 || tṛtīyo basavārādhyo jakkārādhyastataḥ paraḥ || teṣu prathamavikhyāto gurudevo'tibhaktimān || 18 || siddhadevena vijñaptaḥ śivārcanapareṇa saḥ || cāragauravaśeṣaprasādasaṃtuṣṭacetasā || 19 || sarvaśāstrasamāhṛtyā paralokopakāriṇīm || prakurve mokṣadāṃ vīraśaivācārapradīpikāṃ || 20 || (saṃsārapradīpikāyāṃ ||) śāṃtaṃ śuddhasvabhāvaṃ ca sarvadānaṃdavigrahaṃ || varadaṃ viśvabharaṇaṃ bhagavaṃtamumāpatiṃ || 21 || devadevaṃ jagannāthaṃ yoginaṃ cakrināyakaṃ || praṇamya śirasā devī pṛcchatīśaṃ vimuktaye || 22 || dustaraṃ devadeveśa saṃsārāṃbunidhiṃ prabho || sukhopāyena paśavastaraṃti ca yathā vada || 23 ||
śiva uvāca ||
sādhu sādhu mahābhāge śobhanaṃ pṛcchyate tvayā || adhunā saṃpravakṣyāmi dehasthaṃ lakṣaṇaṃ tvidaṃ || 24 || karmaṇāpyatimiśreṇa yaccharīramihātmanaḥ ||
tadbhūtaparimāṇena vijñeyaṃ hi caturvidhaṃ || 25 || udbhidaḥ sthāvarā jñeyāstṛṇagulmādirūpiṇaḥ || krimikīṭapataṃgādyāḥ svedajā nāma dehinaḥ || 26 || aṃḍajāḥ pakṣiṇassarpā nakramatsyādikacchapāḥ || jarāyujāśca vijñeyā mānuṣāśca catuṣpadāḥ || 27 || tatra siktā jale bhūmiraṃtarūṣmaprapācitā || vāyunā vyūhamānā ca bījatvaṃ pratipadyate || 28 || yadatra śālibījāni saṃsiktānyaṃbhasā punaḥ || ucchūnatāṃ mṛdutvaṃ ca mūlabhāvaṃ vrajaṃti ca || 29 || tanmūlādakuṃrotpattiraṃkurātparṇasaṃbhavaḥ || parṇānnālaṃ tataḥ kāṃḍaṃ kāṃḍācca prasumaṃ punaḥ || 30 || prasavācca tuṣakṣīraṃ kṣīrāttaṃḍulasaṃbhavaḥ || taṃḍulācca tataḥ pakvādiyadauṣadhayastathā || 31 || yavādyāḥ śāliparyaṃtāḥ śreṣṭhāḥ saptadaśa smṛtāḥ || auṣadhyaḥ phalapakkāṃtāḥ śeṣāḥ kṣudrāḥ prakīrtitāḥ || 32 || ṣaḍvidhāhārabhedena pariṇāmaṃ vrajaṃti tāḥ || anyonyarasasaṃyogādanekasvādutāṃ gatāḥ || 33 || bhakṣyaṃ bhojyaṃ ca peyaṃ ca lehyaṃ cohyaṃ ca picchilaṃ || iti
piṃḍotpattisvarūpanirūpaṇam
bhedāśca ṣaṭ proktā madhurādyāśca ṣaḍrasāḥ || 34 || tadannaṃ sthūlakabalaiḥ paribhuktaṃ ca dehibhiḥ || aṃtasthamāśaye pūrvaṃ prāṇaḥ sthāpayate kramāt || 35 || apṛthagbhūtamāhāraṃ sa vāyuḥ kurute dvidhā || saṃpraviśyānnamadhye tu pṛthagannaṃ pṛthagjalaṃ || 36 || agnerūrdhvaṃ jalaṃ sthāpya tadannaṃ tu jalopari || jalasyādhaḥ svayaṃ prāṇaḥ sthitvāgniṃ dhamate śanaiḥ || 37 || vāyunā dhamyamānogniratyuṣṇaṃ kurute jalaṃ || tadannamuṣṇatoyena samaṃtātpacyate punaḥ || 38 || dvidhā bhavati tatpakkaṃ pṛthagbhinnaṃ pṛthagrasaḥ || malairdvādaśabhirbhinnaṃ klinnaṃ dehādbahirvrajet || 39 || karṇākṣināsikājihvādantāḥśiśnagudaṃ nakhāḥ || malāśrayau kaphasvedau viṇmūtre dvādaśa smṛtāḥ || 40 || hṛtpadme pratibaddhāśca sarvanāḍyaḥ samaṃtataḥ || tāsāṃ mukheṣu tatsūkṣmaḥ prāṇaḥ sthāpayate rasaṃ || 41 || rasena tena tā nāḍīḥ prāṇaḥ pūrayate punaḥ || pratarpayaṃti saṃpūrṇāstāśca dehaṃ samaṃtataḥ || 42 || tataḥ sa nāḍīmadhyasthaḥ śarīrasyoṣmaṇā rasaḥ || pacyate pacyamānācca bhavetpākadvayaṃ punaḥ || 43 || carmāviṣṭaṃ samaṃtācca rudhiraṃ ca prajāyate ||
raktāllomāni māṃsaṃ ca keśasnāyū ca māṃsataḥ || 44 || snāyoḥ śirāstathāsthīni tebhyo majjā nakhāḥ punaḥ || majjākaraṇakaivalyaṃ śuklaṃ ca prasavātmakaṃ || 45 || iti dvādaśadhānyasya pariṇāmaḥ prakīrtitaḥ || (kṣepaka) (annāccaiva tataḥ śuklaṃ śuklāddehasya saṃbhavaḥ) biṃduḥ śivo rajaḥ śaktiriṃdurbiṃdū rajo raviḥ || 46 || ubhayoḥ saṃgamādeva prāpyate piṃḍasaṃjñakaṃ || mātṛtrīṇi pitṛtrīṇi śivāṃśatrīṇi cocyate || 47 || tattridhā miśrasaṃkhyānāṃ navāṃśaṃ piṃḍasaṃjñakaṃ || rudhiraṃ māṃsakatvaṃ ca mātṛkāṃśā iti smṛtāḥ || 48 || asthināḍyaśca romāṇi pitṛkāṃśāḥ prakīrtitāḥ || agniśca vāyurātmā ca śivāṃśāḥ parikīrtitāḥ || 49 || ṛtukāle yadā śuklaṃ nirdoṣaṃ yonimāśritaṃ || tadā tadvāyunā spṛṣṭaṃ strīraktenaikatāṃ vrajet || 50 || visargakāle śuklasya jīvaḥ karaṇasaṃyutaḥ || prītyā praviśate yoniṃ karmabhiḥ svairniyojitaḥ || 51 || tacchuklaraktayoraikyādekāhnaḥ kalalaṃ bhavet || paṃcarātreṇa kalalaṃ budbudākāratāṃ vrajet || 52 ||
budbudaṃ saptarātreṇa māsapeśī bhavetpunaḥ || dvisaptāhādbhavetpeśī raktamāṃsācitā dṛḍhā || 53 || bījasyevāṃkurotpattiḥ paṃcaviṃśatirātritaḥ || bhavaṃti grāsamātreṇa tadgraṃtheraṃkurāṇi ca || 54 || grīvā śirastathā pṛṣṭhaṃ bhujāvasthīni codaraṃ || pāṇipādau tathā kakṣau kaṭirgātraṃ tathaiva ca || 55 || māsadvayena sarvāṇi kramaśaḥ saṃbhavaṃti ca || tribhirmāsaiḥ prajāyaṃte sarvāṃgāṃkurasaṃdhayaḥ || 56 || māsaiścaturbhiraṃgulyaḥ prajāyaṃte yathākramaṃ || mukhaṃ nāsā ca karṇau ca jāyaṃte paṃcabhistadā || 57 || daṃtapaṃktistathā guptā jāyaṃte ca nakhāḥ punaḥ || karṇayorbhavataśchidre ṣaṇmāsābhyaṃtareṇa tu || 58 || pāyurmeḍhramupasthaṃ ca nābhiścāpyupajāyate || saṃdhayo ye ca gātreṣu jāyaṃte saptabhistadā || 59 || aṃgapratyaṃgasaṃpūrṇaḥ śiraḥkeśasamanvitaḥ || vibhaktāvayavaḥ spaṣṭaḥ punarmāsāṣṭakena tu || 60 || paṃcātmakasamāyuktaḥ paripakvaḥ sa tiṣṭhati || māturāhāravīryeṇa ṣaḍvidhena rasena ca || 61 || nābhisūtranibaṃdhena vardhate sa dine dine || tataḥ smṛtiṃ labhejjīvaḥ saṃpūrṇe'smin śarīrake || 62 || sukhaduḥkhe vijānāti nidrāsvapne purākṛte || mṛtaścāhaṃ punarjāto jātaścāhaṃ punarmṛtaḥ || 63 || nānāyonisahasrāṇi mayā dṛṣṭāni janmataḥ ||
adhunā jātamātro'haṃ prāptasaṃskāra eva ca || 64 || tataḥ śreyaḥ kariṣyāmi yena garbheṇa saṃbhavaḥ || garbhasthaściṃtayatyevamahaṃ garbhādvinirgataḥ || 65 || adyecchāmi śivajñānaṃ saṃsāravinivartakaṃ || evaṃ sa garbhaduḥkhena mahatā paripīḍitaḥ || 66 || jīvaḥ karmavaśādāste mokṣopāyaṃ viciṃtayet || yathā girivarākrāṃtaḥ kaścidduḥkhena tiṣṭhati || 67 || tathā jarā punardehe duḥkhe tiṣṭhati veṣṭitaḥ || patitaḥ sāgare yadvadduḥkhenāste samākulaḥ || 68 || garbhodakena siktāṃgastathā vyākulitaḥ pumān || lohakuṃbhe yathā nyastaḥ pacyate kaścidagninā || 69 || garbhakuṃbhe tathā kṣiptaḥ pacyate jaṭharāgninā || sūcībhiragnivarṇābhirnirbhinnasya niraṃtaram || 70 || yadduḥkhamupajāyeta tadgarbhe'ṣṭaguṇaṃ bhavet || garbhavāsātparo vāsaḥ kaṣṭado nāsti kutracit || 71 || dehināṃ duḥkhabahulaṃ sughoramatisaṃkaṭam || ityevaṃ garbhavāso hi prāṇināṃ parikīrtitaḥ || 72 || carasthirāṇāṃ sarveṣāmātmagarbhānurūpataḥ || garbhātkoṭiguṇaṃ duḥkhaṃ yoniyaṃtraprapīḍanāt || 73 ||
saṃmūrchā jāyate tasya jāyamānasya dehinaḥ || rasavatpīḍyamānasya yaṃtreṇaivāsamaṃtataḥ || 74 || śirasyātāḍyamānasya yathā mudgarakoṭibhiḥ || garbhānniṣkramamāṇasya prabalaiḥ sūtimārutaiḥ || 75 || jāyate sumahadduḥkhaṃ paritrāṇamaviṃdataḥ || yaṃtreṇāpīḍito yadvannissārāḥ syustilekṣavaḥ || tadvaccharīraṃ nissāraṃ yoniyaṃtreṇa pīḍitaṃ || 76 || (tathaiva garbhopaniṣadi) madhurāmlalavaṇatiktakaṭukaṣāyā iti ṣaḍvidho rasaḥ || rasācchoṇitaṃ śoṇitānmāṃsaṃ māṃsānmedo medaso'sthīni || asthibhyo majjā majjāyāḥ śukraṃ śukraśoṇitasaṃyogādāvartate garbhaḥ hṛdi vyavasthāpayati hṛdayābhyaṃtare'gniḥ agnisthāne pittaṃ pittasthāne vāyuḥ vāyusthāne hṛdayaṃ prājāpatyakramādṛtukāle prayogaḥ ekarātroṣitaṃ kalalaṃ bhavati saptarātroṣitaṃ budbudaṃ bhavati ardhamāsāṃtareṇa piṃḍo bhavati māsāṃtareṇa kaṭhiṇo bhavati māsadvayena śiro bhavati māsatrayeṇa pādapradeśo bhavati ṣaṣṭhame māse mukhanāsākṣiśrotrāṇi bhavaṃti
saptame māse jīvena saṃyukto bhavati aṣṭame māse sarvāṃgapūrṇo bhavati pitūreto'dhikena puruṣo bhavati mātūreto'dhikātstriyo bhavaṃti ubhayorbījatulyatvānnapuṃsako bhavati vyākulitamanasoṃ'dhāḥ khaṃjāḥ kubjā vāmanā bhavaṃti anyonyavāyuparipīḍitānmāṃsācchukraṃ dve dve striyo yonyāṃ yugmā yugmāḥ prajāyaṃte atha navame māse sarvalakṣaṇasaṃpūrṇo bhavati pūrvajātiṃ smarati kṛtākṛtaṃ ca karma jānāti śubhāśubhaṃ ca karma viṃdati || 0 || nānāyonisahasrāṇi dṛṣṭānyeva tato mayā || āhārā vividhā bhuktāḥ pītāśca vividhāḥ stanāḥ || 77 || yanmayā svajanasyārthe(parijanasyārthe) kṛtaṃ karma śubhāśubhaṃ || ekākī tena dahyāmi gatāste phalabhāginaḥ || 78 || jātasyaiva mṛtasyaiva mṛtyurjanma punaḥ punaḥ || aho duḥkhodadhau magno na paśyāmi pratikriyāṃ || 79 || yadi yonyāḥ pramuṃcāmi taṃ prapadye maheśvaram || aśubhakṣayakartāraṃ taṃ mokṣaphaladāyakaṃ || 80 || virajānalajaṃ bhasma gṛhītvā cāgnihotrajaṃ || samuddhūlya sadācāryaṃ praṇipatyātmavidyayā || 81 ||
saṃsārasāgaraṃ ghoraṃ laṃghayāmyahamātmanā || (vākyaṃ) yoniśataṃ jaṃtuḥ strīṇāṃ yonidvāre saṃprāpte yaṃtreṇāpīḍyamāno mahatā duḥkhena jāto jātamātreṇa vaiṣṇavena vāyunā saṃspṛṣṭastadā na smarati janma maraṇaṃ na ca karma śubhāśubhaṃ || (graṃthāṃtare) vīraśaivasthitānāṃ ca strīṇāṃ garbhāṣṭame guruḥ || paṃcasūtrakṛtaṃ liṃgaṃ dhārayedvidhivacchubham || 82 || nādo liṃgamiti jñeyaṃ biṃduḥ pīṭhamudāhṛtam || nādabiṃdusamāyukto liṃgākāra ihocyate || 83 || līyate gamyate yatra yena sarvaṃ carācaram || tadetalliṃgamityuktaṃ liṃgatattvaparāyaṇaiḥ || 84 || ākāśaṃ liṃgamityāhuḥ pṛthvī tasyādhipīṭhikā || ālayaṃ sarvabhūtānāṃ layānāṃ liṃgamucyate || 85 || (yajurvede śatarudrīye) yā te rudra śivā tanūraghorā pāpakāśinī || (śrīrudrabhāṣye) śakalaśrutismṛtipurāṇāgametihāsasārabhūtamahānto'pi apāpakāśīti vapuḥ śrutaṃ te śiṣṭāḥ prasiddhāḥ| bhagavannapāpāḥ atastvadīyānapahāya bhaktānanyānaśiṣṭāniti niścinomi || (ṛgvede) ayaṃ me
hasto bhagavān || ayaṃ me bhagavattaraḥ || ayaṃ me viśvabheṣajo'yaṃ śivābhimarśanaḥ || ayaṃ mātā ayaṃ pitā ayaṃ jīvāturāgamat || idaṃ tava prasarpaṇaṃ subaṃdhavehi nirahi || aiśvaryasya samagrasya vīryasya yaśasaḥ śriyaḥ || jñānavairāgyayoścaiva ṣaṇṇāṃ bhaga itīritam || 86 || (vākyaṃ) uttamavedavibhūṣitaṃ devottamābhyāṃ prajananamalaṃkṛtam jagatkāraṇatvena janayāmāseti lakṣaṇāt || (yajurvede) rudra yatte janima cāru citraṃ || sphāṭikaṃ śailajaṃ vāpi caṃdrakāṃtamayaṃ tu vā || bāṇaṃ tu sūryakāṃtaṃ vā liṃgamekaṃ samāharet || 87 || (kāmikāgame) śvetaṃ raktaṃ tathā pītaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ ceti caturvidham || viprādīnāṃ tu varṇānāṃ kramāddhāraṇamucyate || 88 ||
paṃcasūtrakṛtaliṃgapramāṇasvarūpanirūpaṇam
sapīṭhasya tu liṃgasya lakṣaṇaṃ tvadhunocyate || ekāditryaṃtamaṃgulyāścaraliṃgasya dairghyakam || 89 || liṃgena ca samaṃ pīṭhaṃ pīṭhārdhaṃ gomukhaṃ bhavet || liṃgadīrghaṃ caturbhāgaṃ dvibhāgaṃ śaktisaṃyutaṃ || 90 || dvibhāgaṃ ca caturbhāgamekabhāgaṃ tu baṃdhakam || atulānāṃ tridhā kṛtvā tanmānaṃ vā samācaret || 91 || liṃgamastakavistāraṃ liṃgocchrāyasamanvitam ||
vedabhāgavaśānmānaṃ vistāro mastakasya tu || 92 || triguṇaṃ pariṇāhaṃ syāttadvatpīṭhasya vistṛtiḥ || tribhāgaṃ pariṇāhasya tadvatpīṭhaṃ vyavasthitam || 93 || (graṃthāṃtare) liṃgavṛttasamaṃ pīṭhaṃ dīrghaṃ vistārameva ca || 94 || tadardhaṃ gomukhaṃ viṃdyādityetalliṃgalakṣaṇam || liṃgādhikye bhavenmṛtyuḥ śaktyādhikye dhanakṣayaḥ || 95 || liṃgaśaktisamāyuktaṃ bhogamokṣaphalapradam || sūtramūle tu yatpādaṃ sūtrāgre mukhamucyate || sūtrapārśve ca bāhū ca sūtrasaṃdhau tu pṛṣṭhakaṃ || 96 || ṣaḍbhāgaḥ kāṃtaraśmiśca netrabhāgamayaḥ smṛtaṃ || sīsakaṃ cāgnibhāgaṃ tu kuraviṃdaṃ vedabhāgakam || 97 || ṭaṃkaṇaṃ caikabhāgaṃ tu vajreśaṃ raṃdhrabhāgakam || lohaṃ caiveṣubhāgaṃ tu pāṣāṇaṃ netrabhāgakam || 98 || lākṣāgarū sarjarasaḥ pāṣāṇaṃ tu tathaiva ca || mahiṣīnavanītena mardayeddṛḍhamādarāt || 99 || guggulaṃ vedabhāgaṃ ca mahiṣīnavanītake || mardayetsitabaṃdho'yamākhyātaḥ śāstravedibhiḥ || 100 || caturbaṃdhaḥ sitaścāyaṃ sarvasiddhiprado nṛṇām ||
liṃgasaṃskāranirūpaṇam
lākṣāsarjarasaṃ caiva śubhrapāṣāṇameva ca || 101 || kuraviṃdaṃ guggulaṃ ca gairikaṃ guḍameva ca || tailamevāṣṭabhāgaṃ syādaṃtyabhāgādibhāgataḥ || 102 || vṛddhiṃ kuryātprayatnena pākaṃ cikkaṇavadbhavet || śilpidoṣanivṛttyarthaṃ liṃgaṃ sthāpya hṛdā tathā || 103 || prasādena tu gṛhṇīyāddakṣahastena deśikaḥ || svahastapīṭhe talliṃgamādāya paramo guruḥ || 104 || ṅamo vaḥ kirikebhyo devānā(?) hṛdayebhyo namo vikṣīṇakebhyo devānā(?) hṛdayebhyo namo vicinvatkebhyo devānā(?) hṛdayebhyaḥ || oṃ hrāṃ hrīṃ hrūṃ hrauṃ namaḥ śivāya || anenābhimaṃtrayet|| talliṃgaṃ kṣālayettoyairajanyāmalakādibhiḥ || 105 || paṃcagavyena saṃsnāpya bilvapatreṇa gharṣayet || paṃcāmṛtena saṃsnāpya gaṃdhādyairnārikelakaiḥ || 106 || gaṃdhapuṣpādibhiścaiva naivedyāntaṃ samarcayet || 107 || (vātulatantre) gṛhasyeśānadigbhāge sthaṃḍilaṃ tu samācaret || navahastapramāṇena vastraṃ kuryādvicakṣaṇaḥ || 108 || (iti vātulataṃtre) tatraiva navadhānyānāṃ sthaṃḍilaṃ tu samācaret || paṃcāḍhakapramāṇena sthaṃḍilaṃ tu pṛthak pṛthak || 109 || śyāmākaśca priyaṃguśca mudgagodhūmavrīhikaṃ ||
yavaṃ ca māṣacaṇakatilāścaiva krameṇa tu || 110 || uparyupari saṃsthāpya tadvastropari vinyaset || likhedaṣṭadalaṃ padmaṃ madhye karṇikayā saha || 111 || dhānyopari nyaselliṃgaṃ yāme dhānyādhivāsanam || navavastreṇa saṃveṣṭya gaṃdhapuṣpākṣatādibhiḥ || 112 || naivedyaṃ dāpayeddhīmāṃstāṃbūlaṃ dāpayettataḥ || jalādhivāsaṃ yāmaṃ ca tadarthaṃ sthaṃḍilaṃ caret || 113 || vrīhipaṃcāḍhakaṃ nyasyettaṃḍulaṃ tu tadardhakam || tadardhaṃ tu tilānnyasyetpadmaṃ tvaṣṭadalaṃ likhet || 114 || kalaśaikaṃ tu vinyasya phalapallavasaṃyutaṃ || gaṃdhodakaṃ samāpūrya suvarṇaṃ tatra nikṣipet || 115 || gaṃdhapuṣpādibhiścaiva pūjayettadyathākramam || mama paṃcākṣaraṃ maṃtraṃ kuṃbhaṃ spṛṣṭvā japedguruḥ || 116 || kāṃsyapātre vinikṣipya jaladhārābhiṣecanaṃ || yāmaṃ vāpi tadardhaṃ vā kārayedvidhipūrvakaṃ || 117 || sādhitaṃ kalaśaṃ caikaṃ liṃgamūrdhnyabhiṣecayet || paṃcāmṛtena saṃsnāpya hyudakenābhiṣecayet || 118 || gaṃdhapuṣpādinābhyarcya naivedyaṃ dāpayettataḥ || śayanaṃ kalpayettasmiṃstadarthaṃ gurusattamaḥ || 119 || vedyūrdhvaṃ sthaṃḍilaṃ kuryādbrīhipaṃcāḍhakaṃ tathā || tadardhaṃ taṃḍulānnyasya tadardhaṃ tu tilānnyaset || 120 ||
piṃḍotpattisvarūpanirūpaṇam
tanmadhye vilikhetpadmaṃ sāṣṭapatraṃ sakarṇikam || tanmadhye vinyasetkuṃbhaṃ sahiraṇyaṃ savastrakam || 121 || nārikelasamāyuktaṃ pallavairupaśobhitam || tasyaiva pūrvadigbhāge liṃgaṃ tu sthāpayetsudhīḥ || 122 || raktavastreṇa saṃveṣṭya gaṃdhapuṣpādinārcayet || ācāryo manasā dhyātvā śayanaṃ kalpayecchivam || 123 || kuṃbhe hastaṃ nidhāyāśu paṃcākṣaramanuṃ smaret || sahasraṃ vā tadardhaṃ vā śatamaṣṭottaraṃ japet || 124 || kṛtāṃjalipuṭo bhūtvā namaskṛtya maheśvaram (śayanamaṃtraḥ) namaste parameśāya namaste pārvatīpate || 125 || namaḥ kailāsavāsāya namaḥ saṃsāratāriṇe || etalliṃgasthale śaṃbho śayanaṃ kriyatāṃ prabho || 126 || tāvadeva sukhenaiva yāvaddīkṣāvasānakam || evaṃ stutvā mahādevaṃ śayanaṃ kārayetsudhīḥ || 127 || (svāyaṃbhuvāgame) ardhodaye vāpyatha sa patane caiva deśikaḥ || pūrvasaṃskāritaṃ liṃgaṃ śiśoḥ kaṃṭhe ca dhārayet || 128 ||
[iti śrīmadvedāgamopaniṣatpurāṇādimārgapravartanapravīṇapaṃḍitārādhyadevan āmācāryatanayaguruliṃgadevanāmadheyadeśikeṃdrapratīkodbhūtagurudevākhyena siddhadevena prabodhanāya samāhṛtau vīraśaivācārapradīpikāyāṃ dīkṣāprakaraṇe piṃḍotpattiliṃgadhāraṇavidhirnāma prathamopadeśaḥ] ||
[iti śrīvīraśaivācārapradīpikāyām prathamo'dhyāyaḥ] || 1 ||
vīraśaivācārapradīpikā
[atha dvitīyo'dhyāyaḥ] |
devyuvāca(-) kaleḥ kaluṣite kāle durjaye duratikrame || kṣīṇe varṇāśramācāre saṃkare samupāgate || 1 || kenopāyena mucyaṃte bhaktāstava maheśvara || 2 ||
īśvara uvāca || saṃsāraduḥkhakāṃtāre nimagnaśca mahātape || cakravadbhramate devi liṃgārcanavivarjitaḥ || 3 || yo jātu nārcayelliṃgaṃ na smarenna ca kīrtayet || kiṃ tena jātamātreṇa bhūbhāreṇānnaśatruṇā || 4 || apūjayitvā ceśānaṃ yo hi bhuṃkte narādhamaḥ || pāpānāmannarūpāṇāṃ tasya bhojanamucyate || 5 || nāsti liṃgārcanaṃ yasya mleṃchayonau prajāyate || na śivārcanasāmyo'sti dharmo'nyo bhuvanatraye || 6 || iti jñātvā prayatnena pūjanīyaḥ sadāśivaḥ || satyaṃ vacmi hitaṃ vacmi sāraṃ vacmi punaḥ punaḥ || 7 || liṃgamadhye mahādevaḥ sākṣāddevo vyavasthitaḥ || anugrahāya lokānāṃ tasmālliṃgaṃ prapūjayet || 8 || upadeśaṃ vinā liṃgaṃ prapūjayati yo naraḥ ||
dīkṣāhīnakṛtaliṃgapūjanasya phalam
narake pacyate devi sūpadeśo hyataḥ smṛtaḥ || 9 || yathā mṛgapatiṃ dṛṣṭvā bhavedbhīto vane gajaḥ || adīkṣito'rcayelliṃgaṃ tathā bhīto maheśvaraḥ (?) || 10 || tripuṃḍraṃ caiva rudrākṣaṃ nityārcanajapaṃ tathā || homadhyānādikaṃ sarvaṃ dīkṣāhīnasya niṣphalaṃ || 11 || adīkṣitaścaturvedī na viśedgarbhagehakaṃ || pramādādgarbhagehaṃ tu prāyaścittaṃ tu kārayet || 12 || adīkṣitaśca yo vipraḥ kuryālliṃgasya pūjanaṃ || araṇye nirjane devi bhavati brahmarākṣasaḥ || 13 || caturvedī tvahaṃkārī śivaliṃgaṃ tu pūjayet || rājarāṣṭravināśaśca tasya grāmo'pi naśyati || 14 || dīyate jñānasaṃbaṃdhaḥ kṣīyate ca malatrayam || dīyate kṣīyate yena sā dīkṣeti nigadyate || 15 || upadeśaṃ copadiśa vīraśaivīyadīkṣayā || guruṃ vicārayecchiṣyo mahādevaṃ prapūjayet || 16 || nityānityavicāravāniha paratrāpekṣitārthāratiḥ śāṃtyādyaṃgasamanvitaḥ sucarito mokṣābhilāṣī sukhī || satyānaṃdaparaṃ prakāśaparipūrṇātmāvabodhānvitaṃ kṛtyākṛtyavivekinaṃ guruvaraṃ preyānnaro bhaktimān || 17 || sadvaṃśajaḥ samāpūrṇaḥ praśāṃtaḥ priyabhāṣaṇaḥ || gaṃbhīraḥ satyavāgvāgmī saṃtuṣṭaḥ karuṇāspadaḥ || 18 ||
snigdhaḥ smitamukho rāgī pragalbho nirahaṃkṛtiḥ || śuciḥ suśīlo dharmiṣṭhaḥ sadākṣiṇyo bṛhaddhvaniḥ || 19 || nirmatsaro guṇagrāhī praśāṃto vijiteṃdriyaḥ || vedāṃgeṣu kṛtābhyāsaḥ purāṇaśrutivittamaḥ || 20 || sarvāgameṣu kuśalaḥ kulīnaśca mahāmatiḥ || maṃtroddhārapravīṇaśca maṃtrārthapratipādakaḥ || 21 || (suprabodhāgame) padavākyapramāṇajño vedavedāṃtapāragaḥ || tithinakṣatrayogajño bhūparigrahakarmavit || 22 || śaivasiddhāṃtatatvajñaḥ pratiṣṭhāmaṃtrapāragaḥ || mokṣadaḥ karuṇopeto vītarāgo vimatsaraḥ || 23 || kriyāpāde tu nipuṇaścaryāpāde tu raṃjakaḥ || yogapāde kṛtābhyāso jñānapāde viśeṣavit || 24 || kriyādijñānaparyaṃtaṃ śivatatvaviniścayaḥ || saṃpradāyāgatajñāno lobhadaṃbhavivarjitaḥ || 25 || liṃgāṃgasthalabhedajñaḥ ṣaṭsthalajñānatatparaḥ || śivasiddhāṃtatatvajñaḥ ṣaḍadhvajñānavatsalaḥ || 26 ||
gurulakṣaṇam
nityakarmādikuśalo naimittikavicakṣaṇaḥ || kāmyādikarmacaturo dīkṣākarmādikarmaṭhaḥ || 27 || maṃḍale maṃḍape kuṃḍe prāsāde pratimāsu ca || liṃgapīṭhe śilāyāṃ ca parīkṣānipuṇāgraṇīḥ || 28 || śivasya ca gurorbhaktaḥ śivaikāhitamānasaḥ || śivārcanāsaktacittaḥ śivadhyānaikatatparaḥ || 29 || gukāraṃ ca guṇātītaṃ rukāraṃ rūpavarjitaṃ || guṇātītamarūpaṃ ca yo dadyātsa guruḥ smṛtaḥ || 30 || nirākāraṃ nirālaṃbaṃ nirmalaṃ nirvikalpakaṃ || nirguṇaṃ niṣkalaṃ nityaṃ parātparapadaṃ guruṃ || 31 || (vīrāgame) lalāṭalocanaṃ cāṃdrīṃ kalāmapi ca dordvayaṃ || aṃtarnidhāya varte'haṃ gururūpo maheśvari || 32 || vasate pādayugme tu trailokyaṃ sacarācaram || aṃguṣṭhāgre cāṣṭaṣaṣṭitīrthānyasminvasaṃti vai || 33 || saptābdhayastu pādādhastadūrdhvaṃ cāṣṭa te nagāḥ || jaṃghayorvasate nityaṃ ṣaṭtriṃśattatvasaṃcayaḥ || 34 || smartavyaḥ paṭhanīyaśca guruḥ paramakāraṇaḥ || gurudevaṃ mahādevaṃ caikabhāvena bhāvitāḥ || 35 || triṣulokeṣu pūjyaṃte te narā gurubhaktitaḥ ||
gururgṛhastha eva syānna kadācidyatirguruḥ || 36 || yathāhaṃ sarvalokānāṃ gururaṃbikayā saha || 37 || (kriyāsāre) īśvara uvāca || gṛhasthaḥ sarvavarṇeṣu śreṣṭho gururudāhṛtaḥ || naiṣṭhikastvadhamo jñeyo bhāṃtikastu tato'dhamaḥ || 38 || vānaprasthayatīnāṃ tu gurutvaṃ niṣphalaṃ sadā || śiṣyasya śikṣaṇīyatvādgururgauravabhāvataḥ || 39 || tasmātsarvaprayatnena gururgauravamācaret || vayaḥ ṣoḍaśakādūrdhvamiṣyate saptateradhaḥ || 40 || śivajñānāmṛtasvādaparisaṃtuṣṭamānasaḥ || tatvavicchivasaṃyukto muktido na tu cāparaḥ || 41 || guravo bahavaḥ saṃti śiṣyavittāpahārakāḥ || durlabho'yaṃ gururdevi śiṣyahṛttāpahārakaḥ || 42 || (siddhāṃta śikhāmaṇau) jñānahīnaṃ guruṃ prāpya kuto muktimavāpnuyāt || bhinnanaukāgataḥ(bhinnanāvaṃ gataḥ) siṃdhoryathā pāraṃ na gacchati || 43 || tasmājjñānādhikaṃ śiṣyo gurumeva samāśrayet || itthaṃ guruḥ samākhyāto varjanīyo'dhunocyate || 44 ||
varjanīyagurulakṣaṇam
vyasanī vāmanaḥ kubjaḥ kopī ca kulaṭaḥ śaṭhaḥ || capalo'dhikahīnāṃgaḥ pāpīyānsūcako'nyajaḥ || 45 || vyādhigastārkikaḥ śūraḥ kākanādo vakravatī || gurudevadvijātīnāṃ niṃdako vṛṣalīpatiḥ || 46 || apūjyakulasaṃbhūtastrīkarmī śivavarjitaḥ(sevyavarjitaḥ) || laṃboṣṭho vakranāsaśca gavīnaḥ kalahapriyaḥ || 47 || parāpavādaśīlaśca paragraṃthopajīvakaḥ || bālā bahuguṇairyuktā vṛddhāḥ khaṃjāstathaiva ca || 48 || evamādiguṇairyuktā varjanīyāḥ prayatnataḥ || pūrvaṃ guruṃ parityajya yo'nyaṃ gurumupāśrayet || 49 || sapunarbhūriti jñeyaḥ sarvakarmasu garhitaḥ || dvijātirvā tataḥ śūdraḥ svasvoktācāravān śuciḥ || 50 || satyavāggurubhaktaśca daṃbhāhaṃkāravarjitaḥ || rāgadveṣavinirmuktaḥ śāṃtaḥ sarvajanapriyaḥ || 51 || ahiṃsako dayāvāṃśca nityamadyuktacetanaḥ(nityavidhyuktacetanaḥ) || guruśuśrūṣaṇarato manovākkāyakarmabhiḥ || 52 || bahiraṃtaścaraiḥ prāṇairgurubhaktiyuto naraḥ || gururevaṃvidhaṃ śiṣyaṃ varṣamekaṃ parīkṣayet || 53 ||
gurvājñācakitaḥ saumyaḥ śiṣya ityabhidhīyate || jñānena kriyayā cātha guruḥ śiṣyaṃ viśodhayet || 54 || yo'nyathā kurute mohātsa vinaśyati durmatiḥ || tasmātsarvaprayatnena guruḥ śiṣyaṃ parīkṣayet || 55 || bhaktiśca śivabhakteṣu śraddhā tacchāsanāvidhau || dehapātastathā kaṃpaḥ paramānaṃdaharṣaṇe || svedoromāṃca ityetacchaktipātasya lakṣaṇaṃ || 56 || (iti śaktipātalakṣaṇam) uktalakṣaṇasaṃpanno yasmin deśe guruḥ sthitaḥ || tatra śiṣyaḥ svayaṃ gatvā praṇameddaṃḍavadguruṃ || 57 || svaguruṃ vā maheśaṃ vā praṇamedekapāṇinā || yadi pūrvārjitaṃ puṇyaṃ tatsarvaṃ ca vinaśyati || 58 || aṣṭāṃgairatha paṃcāṃgaistribhiraṃgairnamastridhā || urasā śirasā dṛṣṭyā manasā śraddhayā girā || 59 || padbhyāṃ karābhyāṃ jānubhyāṃ praṇāmo'ṣṭāṃga ucyate || śiraḥ karābhyāṃ jānubhyāṃ paṃcāṃgaiḥ praṇamecchivaṃ || 60 || brahmāviṣṇuśca rudraśca īśvaraśca sadāśivaḥ || ete garbhagatā yasya tasmai śrīgurave namaḥ || 61 || ajñānatimirāṃdhasya jñānāṃjanaśalakayā || cakṣurunmīlitaṃ yena tasmai śrīgurave namaḥ || 62 || anaṃtajanmasaṃprāptakarmeṃdhanavidāhine ||
gurunamaskārakaraṇavarṇanam
jñānānalaprabhāvena tasmai śrīgurave namaḥ || 63 || bhavāraṇyapraviṣṭasya diṅmohabhrāṃtacetasaḥ || yena me darśitaḥ paṃthā tasmai śrīgurave namaḥ || 64 || deśikasya mukhaṃ dṛṣṭvā praṇamedaṃḍavadbhuvi || pataṃti sarvapāpāni nottiṣṭhaṃti punaḥ saha || 65 || guruṃ didṛkṣuryaḥ śiṣyaḥ sadbhaktyānudinaṃ sa tu || riktapāṇirna taṃ paśyedyathā rājā tathā guruḥ || 66 || svāmin bhaṭṭārakācārya mayyevaṃ tvaṃ kṛpāṃ kuru || ityuktaṃ pravadecchiṣyamupadeśaṃ karomyaham || 67 || anugrahakaraṇārthe jape viniyogaḥ niṣkalo devatā sujñāna ṛṣiḥ || anuṣṭupchaṃdaḥ nādarūpe praṇavaṃ bījam || mūlamaṃtreṇa paṃcatatvānāṃ sādākhyānāṃ samārabhet ||
[iti śrīvīraśaivācārapradīpikāyāṃ dīkṣāprakaraṇe guruśiṣyalakṣaṇaṃ nāma dvitīyo'dhyāyaḥ] ||
śrīsāṃbasadāśivāya namaḥ
[atha tṛtīyo'dhyāyaḥ] atha kālaṃ ca deśaṃ ca pravakṣyāmi ca tadyathā || guruśiṣyo samākhyātau tataḥ kālo'bhidhīyate || 1 || śubhakāle śubhe māse śubhatithyāṃ śubhe'hani || śubhapradeśe nakṣatre hyupadeśaṃ ca kārayet || 2 || śaratkālaśca vaiśākhaḥ uttamaḥ parikīrtitaḥ || phālguno mārgaśīrṣaśca jeṣṭhamāsaśca madhyamaḥ || 3 || āṣāḍhamāghamāsau ca kaniṣṭhau samudāhṛtau || caitraśca śrāvaṇaścaiva puṣyo bhādrapadastathā || 4 || catvāro gaditā māsā dīkṣāyāṃ śivaśāsane || 5 || (graṃthāṃtare) maṃtrāraṃbhastu caitre ca bahuduḥkhaphalapradaḥ || vaiśākhe ratnalābhaḥsyājjyeṣṭhe tu maraṇaṃ dhruvam || 6 || āṣāḍhe baṃdhunāśaḥ syātpūrṇāyuḥ śrāvaṇe bhavet || prajānāśo bhādrapade sarvataḥ śubhamāśvine || 7 || kārtike maṃtrasiddhiḥ syānmārgaśīrṣe śubhāvahaṃ || puṣye tu maṃtrahāniḥ syānmāghe medhāvivardhanam || 8 || phālgune sarvasiddhiḥ syāditi maṃtravido viduḥ || śuklapakṣe śubhā dīkṣā kṛṣṇe vā paṃcamīdine || 9 || (tithiniścayaḥ) caturthīṃ navamīṃ ṣaṣṭhīṃ cāṣṭamīṃ ca caturdaśīṃ ||
dīkṣāyai śubhanakṣatrakaraṇarāśikathanam
paurṇimāsīṃ vinā śeṣā hitāstviti priyā matāḥ || 10 || caturdaśī caturthī ca ṣaṣṭhī caivāṣṭamī tathā || navamī dvādaśī caiva pakṣatithyaḥ prakīrtitāḥ || 11 || ravimaṃgalasaurāstu tyājyā anye śubhāvahāḥ || 12 || (nakṣatrāṇi) rohiṇī mṛgaśīrṣaṃ ca maghā puṣyapunarvasū || hastaḥ svātyanurādhe ca śravaṇaṃ revatī tathā || trīṇyuttarāṇi mūlā ca nakṣatrāṇi caturdaśa || 13 || (atha yogāḥ) vyāghātaṃ parighaṃ vajraṃ vyatīpātaṃ ca vaidhṛtiṃ || gaṃḍātigaṃḍau śūlaṃ ca viṣkaṃbhaṃ varjayecchubhe || 14 || (karaṇāni) bavādivaṇijāṃtāni śubhāni karaṇāni ṣaṭ || anyāni viparītāni viṣṭernaṣṭāni maṃgale || 15 || sutithyā śriyamāpnoti vārādāyuṣyavardhanam || nakṣatrāddharate pāpaṃ yogādroganivāraṇam || 16 || karaṇātkāryasiddhiśca paṃcāṃgaṃ phalamuttamaṃ || 17 || (rāśayaḥ) vṛṣabho'pyatha kuṃbho vā vṛścikaḥ siṃha eva vā || mithunaṃ vāpi kanyā vā dhanurvā mīna eva vā || 18 || carau makarameṣau ca tulā karkaṭakaṃ tathā || dīkṣāyāṃ varjayedanyalagneṣu ca samācaret || 19 || ete hi rāśayaḥ proktā hyanyarāśīṃśca varjayet || budhodaye vā kurvīta somodaya athāpi vā || 20 || gurūdaye vā kurvīta tyajedāsanasaṃyutān ||
aṣṭamasthā grahāḥ sarve naivāṣṭadvādaśasthitāḥ || 21 || śukre lagnagate vāsti keṃdrasthāne sthite ravau || naśyaṃti sakalā doṣāḥśaṃbhunaivamudāhṛtam || 22 || dīkṣākālaḥ samākhyāto deśaścāpyadhunocyate || gaṃgāyāṃ yamunāyāṃ ca sarasvatyāstaṭe tathā || 23 || dṛṣadvatyāstathā tīre godāvaryāmapāṃ nidhau || kāverīgautamītīre vāpyāstīre mahāvaṭe || 24 || puṇyāyatanatīrtheṣu nadīnāṃ saṃgameṣu ca || bhavaneṣu ca ramyeṣu vaneṣūpavaneṣu ca || 25 || śivakṣetraśivārāmasamīpe vā śubhe gṛhe || śivālayasamīpe vā deśikasya gṛhe'pi vā || 26 || saṃsāraduḥkharogasya bheṣajaṃ muktisādhanam || sthāneṣveteṣu he gauri śivadīkṣāṃ tu kārayet || 27 ||
[iti śrīvīraśaivācārapradīpikāyāṃ dīkṣāprakaraṇe kāladeśanirṇayo nāma tṛtīyo'dhyāyaḥ] ||
|| śrīgurubhyo namaḥ || [caturtho'dhyāyaḥ]
bhūśuddhiṃ maṃḍapaṃ cātha saṃmārjanavidhiṃ tathā || raṃgavallīvidhiṃ vakṣye tadyathā śṛṇu yatnataḥ || 1 || brāhmaṇasya mahī śvetā raktā vai kṣatriyasya tu || vaiśyasya vasudhā pītā kṛṣṇā śūdrasya saṃsmṛtā || 2 || hastamātraṃ khaned bhūmiṃ pūrayettena pāṃsunā || adhikaṃ ceduttamā syānmadhyamā samapāṃsunā || 3 || adhamā hīnapāṃsvī syādadhamāmiha varjayet || bhasmāgāratuṣānkeśānasthīni parivarjayet || 4 || paṃcagavyena saṃprokṣya śivamaṃtreṇa deśikaḥ || paṃcaratnaṃ kṣipettatra bhūśuddhiṃ ca prakalpayet || 5 || maṃṭapaṃ ca tataḥ kuryādvedikāṃ ca prakalpayet || kaniṣṭhaṃ cāṣṭahastaṃ vā navahastaṃ tu madhyamaṃ || 6 || daśaikādaśahastaṃ vā dvādaśaṃ cottamottamaṃ || ṣoḍaśastaṃbhaparyataṃ dvādaśastaṃbhameva vā || 7 || khadiraḥ kramukaścaiva śākhāveṇustathaiva ca || caturastraṃ caturdvāraṃ toraṇaiśca vibhūṣitam || 8 || vitānaṃ cordhvamācchādya ghaṃṭācāmarabhūṣitam || darbhamālāparikṣiptaṃ puṣpamālāvalaṃbitam || 9 || phalapallavagaṃdhāḍhyadhūpadīpasamanvitam ||
arghyapuṣpaiśca saṃkīrṇaṃ svastikāsanasaṃyutam || 10 || śaṃkhaduṃdubhinirghoṣaṃ brahmaghoṣasamanvitam || aṣṭamaṃgalasaṃyuktaṃ maṃgalāṃkuraśobhitam || 11 || sabhāstaṃbheṣu kusumaiḥ patākairvṛṣabhadhvajaiḥ || darpaṇaistoraṇairvastraissapūgaiḥ piṣṭakaistathā || 12 || phalaiśca cailaiḥ śṛṃgārairnānārūpairvijṛṃbhitam || evaṃ maṃṭapamāsādya saṃbhāraṃ sarvamāharet || 13 || darpaṇaṃ pūrṇakuṃbhaṃ ca vṛṣabhaṃ yugmacāmaraṃ || śrīmatsarasvatī śaṃkhaṃ dīpamaṣṭāṃgamaṃgalam || 14 || gomayaṃ rocanaṃ mūtraṃ dadhi kṣīraṃ ghṛtaṃ gavām || ṣaḍaṃgāni pavitrāṇi sarvasiddhikarāṇi ca || 15 || (bhūśuddhimaṃtraḥ ||) jalena śīlamutpannaṃ śīlena sthalasaṃsthitiḥ || sthalena medinī sarvā mūlastaṃbhāya śaṃbhave || 16 || tato maṃṭapamadhyaṃ ca lepayedgomayāṃbunā || upalipya yathāsūtraṃ paṃcavarṇena pātayet || 17 || śubhāṃ hi śobhāsaṃyuktāṃ karṇikāṃ kesarānvitām || vicitrakusumākīrṇāṃ madhye paṃkajabhūṣitām || 18 || vallījātisamopetāṃ paṃcavarṇena kārayet || athavā raṃgavallībhiḥ kuryātpaṃcakavarṇakam || 19 || taṃḍulairvāpi kurvīta suśuddhairdeśikaistilaiḥ ||
dīkṣākāle paṃcadhānyānāṃ nāmāni
taṃḍulaiścitravarṇaiśca tathā kuryāttilaiḥ śubhaiḥ || 20 || tilataṃḍulagodhūmajīrakā māṣakā ime || paṃca dhānyāni kathyaṃte dīkṣākāle tu śobhane || 21 || pratyekaṃ paṃcakuḍavānyekaikakuḍavaṃ tu vā || dhānyapramāṇamityuktaṃ kalaśādiṣu nikṣipet || 22 || madhye taṃḍulakairyuktamāsanaṃ ca prakalpayet || 23 ||
[iti śrīmadvīraśaivācārapradīpikāyāṃ dīkṣāprakaraṇe bhūśuddhimaṃḍapasaṃmārjanaraṃgavallīnirṇayo nāma caturtho'dhyāyaḥ] ||
|| śrīgurubhyo namaḥ|| [paṃcamo'dhyāyaḥ] | kalaśānāṃ lakṣaṇaṃ ca sthāpanaṃ cārcanāvidhim || tadyathetyāha śrotṛrṇāmāścaryaṃ maṃgalapradaṃ || 1 || haimānvibhavataḥ kuṃbhānraupyāṃstāmrāṃśca lohakāna || alābhe mṛṇmayāṃścaiva kalaśāṃśca prakalpayet || 2 || kṛṣṇaṃ bhinnaṃ ca durgaṃdhaṃ purāṇaṃ ca parityajet || abhinnāṃśca śubhānsnigdhānakalmaṣamanoharān || 3 || etāṃśca yuktānkalaśāṃścchuddhatoyena kṣālayet || 4 || (kriyāsāre) pratyekaṃ paṃcakuḍavamitaiḥ svarṇādipaṃcabhiḥ || kalaśaiḥ pūrayettoyamomāpo vā ida (?) smaret || 5 || graṃthāṃtare || nadyāstaḍāgasaraso maṃtraistoyena pūrayet || smaretpaṃcākṣaraṃ cātha prokṣayetkalaśānguruḥ || 6 || (atha maṃtraḥ ||) oṃ hrūṃ hreṃ hroṃ hrauṃ tataḥ bījena (oṃ) kārapūrvakaiḥ || īśānāya namoṃ'tastu prokṣayetkalaśānkramāt || 7 || sadyojāte nakārastu vāmadeve makārakaḥ || aghore tu śikārastu tatpuruṣe tu vakārakaḥ || 8 || īśāne tu yakāraśca paṃca varṇāḥ krameṇa tu || nakāraḥ pītavarṇaḥ syānmakāro raktavarṇakaḥ || 9 ||
maṃtranāmāni
śikāraḥ kṛṣṇavarṇaḥ syādvakāro hemavarṇakaḥ || viśveśaṃ sadguruṃ caiva ceśānaṃ madhyameva ca || 10 || yakāramīśavaktraṃ ca sphāṭikaṃ saṃsmarettathā || mūlaṃ ṣaḍakṣaraṃ caiva māyākhyāṣṭākṣaraṃ smaret || 11 || prasādaṃ daśabījaṃ ca sūkṣmaṃ saptākṣaraṃ smaret || 12 || (mūlaṣaḍakṣaramaṃtraḥ) || oṃ namaḥ śivāya iti || (māyākhyāṣṭākṣaramaṃtraḥ) || oṃ hrīṃ hrūṃ namaḥ śivāya || iti aṣṭākṣaraḥ || (atha daśākṣaraḥ) || oṃ hrāṃ hrīṃ hrūṃ hrauṃ namaḥ śivāya || (atha saptākṣaraḥ) || oṃ hrīṃ namaḥ śivāya || (atha navākṣaraḥ) || oṃ hrāṃ hrīṃ hrūṃ namaḥ śivāya || anena prakāreṇa paṃcasu kalaśeṣu nyāsaṃ samācaret || atha vīrataṃtre || sadyojātādreṇukāryo marulo vāmadevataḥ || aghorādekarāmākhyastatpuruṣātpaṃḍitāryakaḥ || 13 || īśānādviśvārādhyastu ācāryāḥ paṃca te kramāt || evaṃ hi deśikānāṃ tu jananaṃ viddhi pārvati || 14 || vapurbhasitasaṃyuktaṃ sthūlapaṃcākṣarātmakam || caraliṃgadhyānarataṃ revaṇācāryanāmakam || 15 || paścimaṃ vaktramevoktaṃ ṛgvedasvara ucyate ||
navākṣarasusaṃyukto hyaṃgaśuddhiḥ sadā bhavet || 16 || navākṣaramaṃtraḥ || oṃ hrāṃ hrīṃ hrūṃ namaḥ śivāya || (atha āsanamaṃtraḥ) || vṛttaṃ || caṃcatsaudāminīva sphuritamatiśayaṃ yatsadā sūkṣmarūpaṃ jyotirvālātmakaṃ yadyatipatihṛdaye dīpavadvedasāram || tadbodhotpattibījaṃ śivamaśivaharaṃ sarvato vaktranetraṃ dhyāyettaṃ dhyānagamyaṃ śubhadamabhayadaṃ karmasādākhyatatvam || 17 ||
atha kalaśasthāpanamaṃtraḥ || prāleyāmalamiṃdukuṃdadhavalaṃ gokṣīraphenaprabhaṃ bhasmābhyaṃgamanaṃgadehadahanaṃ jvālāvalīlocanam || brahmeṃdrādimarudgaṇaiḥ stutapadaṃ ṛgvedaśākhāmayaṃ sadyojātamidaṃ kalaṃkarahitaṃ sthāṇormukhaṃ paścimam || 18 || sadyojātaṃ prapadyāmi sadyojātāya vai namo namaḥ || bhave bhavenātibhave bhavasva māṃ bhavodbhavāya namaḥ (graṃthāṃtare) bhasmasnānarataproktaṃ sūkṣmapaṃcākṣarātmakaṃ || guruliṃgadhyānarataṃ maru(?)siddhābhidhānakam || 19 || uttarābhimukhaṃ caiva yajurvedasvarātmakam || prakṛṣṭaraktavarṇaṃ ca deśikaṃ cāpi saṃsmaret || saptākṣarasamāyukto jihvāśuddhiḥ sadā bhavet || 20 || (saptākṣaramaṃtraḥ) || oṃ hrīṃ namaḥ śivāya || iti vāmadeve (athāsanamaṃtraḥ) || vṛttam || jyotistaṃbhāyamānaṃ sphuṭataradinakṛtkoṭikāṃtiprakāśaṃ
kalaśasthāpanamaṃtraḥ
mūlastaṃbhābhidhānaṃ munibhiranudinaṃ dṛśyate'narghyakāyaṃ || aṣṭābhirmūrtībhiryadvilasati sukhadaṃ bhuktimuktipradaṃ yaddhyāyettaddhyānagamyaṃ śubhadamabhayadaṃ kartṛsādākhyatatvaṃ || 21 || (atha kalaśasthāpanamaṃtraḥ) || vṛttam || gauraṃ kuṃkumapiṃjarāṃśutilakaṃ vyāpāṃḍugaṃḍasthalaṃ bhrūvikṣiptakaṭākṣavīkṣaṇalasatkarṇotpalaṃ suṃdaraṃ || yājurvedamidaṃ sudhāprahasitaṃ nīlālakālaṃkṛtaṃ vāmaṃ siddhasurāsurendranamitaṃ vaktraṃ harasyottaraṃ || 22 || oṃ vāmadevāya namo jyeṣṭhāya namaḥ śreṣṭhāya namaḥ kālāya namaḥ kalavikaraṇāya namo balāya namo balavikaraṇāya namo balapramathanāya namaḥ sarvabhūtadamanāya namo manonmanāya namaḥ || iti maṃtreṇa vāmadevātmakakalaśe (graṃthāṃtare) śrotrarakṣā ca sā proktā prasādo maṃtra eva ca || prasādaliṃgaṃ taddhyānaṃ paṃḍitārādhyayoginaḥ || 23 || dakṣiṇaṃ sumukhaṃ caiva hyatharvaṇaśrutissadā || daśabījākṣaro maṃtraḥ śrotraśuddhiḥ sadā bhavet || 24 || daśabījākṣaramaṃtraḥ || oṃ hrāṃ hrīṃ hrūṃ hrauṃ namaḥ śivāya || aghoravakkre | āsanamaṃtraḥ || vṛttam || dhāmnā brahmāṃḍapūrṇairdaśabhujaparighaiḥ paṃcavaktraistrinetrairnānālaṃkārayuktairaviśaśimahasāṃ koṭisāraprakāśaiḥ || caṃcanmūrtākhyatatvaṃ varadamabhayadaṃ dhyāyate divyanādaṃ
dhyāyettaddhyānagamyaṃ śubhadamabhayadaṃ mūrtasādākhyatatvam || 25 || (kalaśasthāpanamaṃtraḥ) kālābhrabhramarāṃjanadyutinibhaṃ vyāvṛttapiṃgekṣaṇaṃ bāleṃdudyutikoṭidaṃṣṭrayugalaṃ prodbhāsitātharvaṇaṃ || sarpottuṃgaphaṇāsahasramaṇibhiḥ kāpālamālādharaṃ ghoraṃ dakṣiṇamīśvarasya vadanaṃ bhrūbhaṃgaraudraṃ paraṃ || 26 || oṃ aghorebhyotha ghorebhyo ghoraghoratarebhyaḥ sarvebhyaḥ sarvaśarvebhyo namaste astu rudrarūpebhyaḥ iti aghorakalaśe || rakṣā ca netrayoḥ proktā māyākhyo maṃtra eva ca || svaliṃgadhyānasaṃyuktaḥ śivarāmagurustathā || 27 || pūrvānanasamāyuktaḥ sāmavedaṃ smaranbhavet || aṣṭākṣaramayo mantro netraśuddhistadā bhavet || 28 || (aṣṭākṣaramaṃtraḥ) || oṃ hrīṃ hrūṃ namaḥ śivāya || tatpuruṣamukhe (athāsanamaṃtraḥ) || liṃgākāraṃ supiṃgaṃ jvaladanalaśikhābhāsuraṃ bhāsamānaṃ tasyārdhordhvaikabhāge mukhakamalamalaṃ śobhitaṃ śobhamānaṃ || yuktaṃ netratrayeṇāvayavasunirataṃ mūrtiliṃgābhidhānaṃ dhyāyettaddhyānagamyaṃ śubhadamabhayadaṃ mūrtisādākhyatatvam || 29 || (kalaśasthāpanamaṃtraḥ||) saṃvartāgnitaḍitpradīptakanakapraspardhitejo'ruṇaṃ gaṃbhīrasvarasāmavedaviditaṃ prodbhāsitāmrādharam || gāṃgottuṃgataraṃgapiṃgalajaṭābāleṃdunetratrayaṃ vaktraṃ(-)
tatpuruṣaṃ surendranamitaṃ pūrvaṃ mukhaṃ śūlinaḥ || 30 || (tatpuruṣamaṃtraḥ) oṃ tatpuruṣāya vidmahe mahādevāya dhīmahi tanno rudraḥ pracodayāt || maṃtraṃ tadbhūtidaṃ proktaṃ pāṇisparśanasaṃyutaṃ || jyotirliṃgānutaddhyānaṃ mūlapaṃcākṣaraṃ smaret || 31 || viśveśaṃ sadguruṃ caiva ceśānasya ca vaktrakaṃ || yakāraṃ bījavarṇa ca saṃsmaretsarvadā prabhuṃ || 32 || mūlaṃ paṃcākṣaraścaiva sparśaśuddhiḥ sadā bhavet || (ṣaḍakṣaramaṃtraḥ) || oṃ namaḥ śivāya || īśāne || (atha āsanamaṃtraḥ) drāgiṣṭaṃ divyāliṃgaṃ sphaṭikamaṇinibhaṃ sthūlapaṃcākṣare'smin śāntātmā hīśvaro'yaṃ kamalasamamukhaiḥ paṃcamūrdhā vasan yaḥ || divyaṃ kalpāṃbaraṃ śrīcaraṇayugalayukkāṣṭhabāhupradaṃḍaṃ dhyāyettaddhyānagamyaṃ śubhadamabhayadaṃ śaivasādākhyatatvaṃ || 33 || (kalaśasthāpanamaṃtraḥ) || vyaktāvyaktaguṇottaraṃ ca vimalaṃ ṣaṭtriṃśatatvādhikaṃ vedādyakṣaramaṃtraśāstranilayaṃ dhyeyaṃ sadā yogibhiḥ || sarvajñatvamadhīśvaratvamacalaṃ sūkṣmātisūkṣmātparaṃ śāṃtaṃ paṃcamamīśvarasya
vadanaṃ sevyaṃ hi tejomayaṃ || 34 || ityūrdhvamukhe yakāravarṇaṃ sthāpayet (maṃtraḥ) īśānaḥ sarvavidyānāmīśvaraḥ sarvabhūtānāṃ brahmādhipatirbrahmaṇo'dhipatirbrahmā śivo me astu sadāśivo(?)|| iti maṃtraḥ (tataḥ kalaśodakaśuddhiḥ ||) oṃ āpo vā idamā(?) sarvaviśvābhūtānyāpaḥ prāṇā āpaḥ paśava āpo'nnamāpomṛtamāpaḥ samrāḍāpo virāḍāpaḥ svarāḍāpaḥ chaṃdā(?) syāpo jyoti(?) ṣyāpo yaju(?) ṣyāpaḥ satyamāpaḥ sarvā devatā āpaḥ oṃ bhūrbhuvaḥ svaḥ sadyādipaṃcabrahmamantraiḥ kalaśodakamabhimantrya tataḥ || teṣu kalaśeṣu ratnāni sthāpayet || mauktikaṃ māṇikaṃ caiva ceṃdranīlaṃ pravālakaṃ || vajraṃ ca paṃcakaṃ caiva sadyojātādiṣu kṣipet || 35 || paṃcāmṛtaṃ ca gavyaṃ ca prokṣayetkalaśānguruḥ || ekaikaṃ navavastreṇa veṣṭayeddeśikottamaḥ || navadarbhasamāyuktakūrcān teṣu vinikṣipet || 36 || anantaraṃ hi sūtrasya paṃcabhistaṃtubhistathā || gavākṣasadṛśaiḥsūtraiḥpaṃcānāṃ pariveṣṭayet || 37 || dūrvāṃkurān sapūgāni nāgavallīdalāni vai || bilvapatraṃ tvapāmārgapatrāṇi dhātrireva ca (tvapāmārgaṃ tulasīdhātrireva ca) || 38 || paṃcapatraṃ tu dīkṣāyāṃ paṃcaitāni śubhāni ca || karavīrādipuṣpāṇi kalaśeṣu vinikṣipet || 39 || snātvālaṃkārakaṃ kṛtvā vāsobhīṛtvijastathā || puṣpākṣatavibhūtyādyaiścaturastān prapūjayet || 40 || ācāryo madhyamasyārcāṃ kuryātpuṣpākṣatādibhiḥ || ṛtvijaḥ prītimanaso vidhyuritarārcanam || 41 || gaṃdhapuṣpākṣatādyaiśca dhūpadīpaiśca pūjayet || paṃcabhakṣānphalādīni kadalīṃnārikelakaṃ || 42 ||
śivakuṃbhapūjanam
guḍamiśraṃ ca piṣṭaṃ ca tilaṃ ca caṇakaṃ tathā || tāṃbūlaṃ ca yathānyāyamevamabhyarcayetkramāt || suvarṇaratnatārāṇi kalaśeṣu nidhāpayet || 43 || gururīśānadigbhāge sthaṃḍile dhānyataṃḍulaiḥ || tilaiḥ śāstroktasaṃkhyātairvidadhyācca praśobhitaiḥ || 44 || paṃcaratnauṣadhīrgaṃdhatoyakūrcādisaṃyutaṃ || trisūtrasūtritagrīvaṃ jaṭharaṃ caṃdanārpitaṃ || 45 || sitavastrayugacchannaṃ puṣpagaṃdhākṣatānvitaṃ || śivakuṃbhaṃ phalopetaṃ sapidhānaṃ salakṣaṇaṃ || 46 || tatkuṃbhe ca vṛṣārūḍhaṃ sāṃgaṃ saṃpūjayecchivam || 47 ||
[iti śrīvīraśaivācārapradīpikāyāṃ dīkṣāprakaraṇe kalaśalakṣaṇasthāpanārcanavidhinirṇayo nāma paṃcamo'dhyāyaḥ] || 5 ||
|| śrīgurubhyo namaḥ ||
[atha ṣaṣṭho'dhyāyaḥ]|
atha śiṣyalakṣaṇam(-) śiṣyasnānādyalaṃkāravidhiṃ caiva yathākramam || svastikārohaṇaṃ caiva bhūtipadaṃ vidhānataḥ || 1 || paṃcabrahmādinyāsaṃ ca rudrākṣāṇāṃ ca dhāraṇam || tadyathā śṛṇu vakṣyāmi śṛṇvatāṃ pāpanāśanam || 2 || pūrvarātrau copavāsī kṣīrāhāraṃ ca sevayet || paredyuḥ prātarutthāya gurupādāṃbujaṃ smaret || 3 || snānaṃ śaucaṃ ca kṛtvātha dhautavastraṃ ca dhārayet || bhūṣaṇaṃ ca yathāśaktyā mālyaṃ lepaṃ ca dhārayet || 4 || vibhūtiṃ śivabhaktebhyo datvā tāṃbūlapūrvakam || vṛddhānukramato datvā puṣpādyaiḥ samyagarcayet || 5 || atha tebhyaḥ samastebhyo deśikeṃdrapuraḥsaram || yathā pradakṣiṇaṃ kṛtvā bhaktyā tāṃbūlamarpayet || 6 || upetyācāryapādau ca praṇamya tadanaṃtaram || pūjayetsvarṇapuṣpādyairbhaktyā vittānusārataḥ || 7 || svayaṃ ca prāṅmukho bhūtvā gomayenopalepayet || maṃḍale sthāpayecchiṣyamuttarābhimukhaṃ guruḥ || 8 || śiṣyaṃ ca svastikārohaṃ kuryānmaṃtreṇa caiva hi || guruḥ śiṣyaṃ samālokya tatvaṃ devi viciṃtayet || 9 ||
bhasmadhāraṇavidhānam
(svastikārohaṇamaṃtraḥ) paṃkodbhavaṃ paṃkajakāṣṭhasaṃbhavaṃ bahiḥṣṭhapāśacchidahemajātam || 10 || paścādguruḥ samādhāya padmāsanaparo bhavet || ādhārabaṃdhanaṃ kṛtvā recakaṃ pūrakaṃ tathā || 11 || kuṃbhakaṃ ca tathā kṛtvā svagurudhyānapūrvakam || dhyātvā praṇamya svahṛdi svaguruṃ manasā saha || 12 || svayaṃ ca liṃgamudraśca praṇavena yutaṃ japet || paṃcākṣaraṃ ca taṃ dhyātvā tatrāhvānaṃ viciṃtayet || 13 || (kāraṇataṃtre) || vāmahastatale bhasma kṣiptvācchādyānyapāṇinā || śiṣyasya bhūtipaṭṭaṃ ca kuryānmaṃtreṇa deśikaḥ || agnirityādibhirmaṃtrairgṛhītvāṃgeṣu prokṣayet || 14 || bhūtimaṃtraḥ || oṃ agniriti bhasma vāyuriti bhasma jalamiti bhasma sthalamiti bhasma vyometi bhasma sarvaṃ havā idaṃ bhasma mana etāni cakṣūṃṣi bhasmāni || dhāraṇamaṃtraḥ || mānastoke tanayemāna āyuṣi māno goṣu māno aśveṣu rīriṣaḥ || vīrānmāno rudra bhāmito vadhīrhaviṣmaṃto manasā vidhema te || iti || oṃ hrūṃ śiṃ aghorāya namaḥ iti hṛdaye || oṃ hrīṃ maṃ vāmadevāya namaḥ || guhye || oṃ hrāṃ naṃ sadyojātāya namaḥ || pādayoḥ ||
īśāne paṃcadhā bhasma vikirenmūrdhni yatnataḥ || mukhe caturdhā vāmenāghoreṇaivāṣṭadhā hṛdi || 15 || vāmena guhyadeśe tu trayodaśaprakārataḥ || aṣṭadhā tena sadyena pādāvuddhūlya yatnataḥ || 16 || sarvāṃgoddhūlanaṃ kuryātsadyojātena tatvataḥ || 17 || (mardanamaṃtraḥ) (pārameśvarataṃtre ) namo bhavāya rudrāya śarvāyogrāya śaṃbhave || namo vibhūtirūpāya siddharūpāya te namaḥ iti jalamiśravibhūtiṃ saṃmardya || 18 || śiro lalāṭaṃ śravaṇadvayaṃ grīvā bhujadvayaṃ || vakṣo nābhiḥpṛṣṭhabhāgaḥ kakudekādaśeṣu ca || tripuṃḍradhāraṇaṃ kuryāt tryaṃbakena triyāyuṣā || 19 || oṃ triyaṃbakaṃ yajāmahe sugaṃdhiṃ puṣṭivardhanaṃ || urvārukamivabaṃdhanānmṛtyormukṣīya māmṛtāt | triyāyuṣaṃ jamadagneḥ kaśyapasya triyāyuṣaṃ agastyasya triyāyuṣaṃ yaddevānāṃ triyāyuṣaṃ tanme astu triyāyuṣaṃ iti || 19 || anena maṃtreṇa śirasi lalāṭe śravaṇadvaye kaṃṭhe bhujadvaye vakṣasi nābhau pṛṣṭhabhāge tripuṃḍradhāraṇaṃ (tataḥ karanyāsaḥ) oṃ oṃ oṃ aṃguṣṭhābhyāṃ namaḥ oṃ naṃ oṃ tarjanībhyāṃ namaḥ || oṃ maṃ oṃ madhyamābhyāṃ namaḥ || oṃ śiṃ oṃ anāmikābhyāṃ namaḥ || oṃ vāṃ oṃ kaniṣṭhikābhyāṃ namaḥ || oṃ yaṃ oṃ kara(-)
aṃganyāsavidhānam
talakarapṛṣṭhābhyāṃ namaḥ || iti karanyāsaḥ ||
(atha ṣaḍaṃganyāsaḥ) oṃ hrāṃ oṃ sarvaśaktidhāmne hṛdayāya namaḥ || oṃ hrauṃ naṃ tṛptiśaktidhāmne śirase svāhā || oṃ hrūṃ maṃ anādibodhaśaktidhāmne śikhāyai vaṣaṭ || oṃ hraiṃ śiṃ svatantraśaktidhāmne kavacāya huṃ || oṃ hroṃ vaṃ aluptaśaktidhāmne netratrayāya vauṣaṭ || oṃ hraḥ yaṃ anaṃtaśaktidhāmne astrāyaphaṭ || iti ṣaḍaṃganyāsaṃ kṛtvā(,) oṃ yaṃ hraḥ oṃ phaṭ īśānāya namaḥ śirasi(,) oṃ vāṃ rauṃ ai vauṣaṭ tatpuruṣāya namaḥ mukhe(,) oṃ śiṃ haiṃ uṃ huṃ aghorāya namaḥ hṛdaye(,) oṃ maḥ hrūṃ iṃ vaṣaṭ vāmadevāya namaḥ guhye(,) oṃ naṃ hiṃ oṃ svāhā sadyojātāya namaḥ pādayoḥ iti paṃcabrahmanyāsaṃ kṛtvā || tataḥ mūrdhni lalāṭe kaṃṭhe hṛdaye nābhau yakārādinakārāntaṃ paṃcākṣaranyāsaṃ kṛtvā || tataḥ kalānyāsaḥ || oṃ īśānaḥ sarvavidyānāṃ patistasmai śaśinyai ca namaḥ mūrdhni || oṃ īśvaraḥ sarvabhūtānāṃ tasmai aṃgadāyai ca namaḥ || pūrvamūrdhni(,) oṃ brahmādhipatirbrahmaṇo'dhipatistasmai jyeṣṭhāyai ca namaḥ dakṣiṇamūrdhni || oṃ brahmā śivo me astu tasmai marīcaye ca namaḥ || vāmamūrdhni || oṃ sadāśivoṃ tasmai jvalinyai ca namaḥ || paścimamūrdhni || oṃ tatpuruṣāya vidmahe tasmai śāṃtyai ca namaḥ pūrvavaktre || oṃ mahādevāya dhīmahi tasmai vidyāyai ca namaḥ dakṣiṇavaktre ||
oṃ tanno rudrastasmai pratiṣṭhāyai ca namaḥ vāmavaktre || oṃ pracodayāt tasmai nivṛtyai ca namaḥ paścimavaktre || oṃ īśānavaktrāya namaḥ ūrdhvavaktre || oṃ aghorebhyaḥ tamasyai(?) namaḥ hṛdaye || oṃ atha ghorebhyo mohinyai namaḥ kaṃṭhe || oṃ ghora akṣayāyai namaḥ dakṣiṇāṃse || oṃ ghoraghoratarebhyaḥ kaniṣṭhāyai namaḥ vāmāṃse || oṃ sarvebhyaḥ sarvataḥ sarvamṛtyave namaḥ nābhau || oṃ sarvasarvebhyo māyāyai namaḥ jaṭhare || oṃ namaste astu rudra abhayāyai namaḥ pṛṣṭhe || oṃ rūpebhyaḥ śivebhyaḥ jvarāyai namaḥ vakṣasi(,) oṃ vāmadevāya namo rajāyai namaḥ guhye || oṃ jyeṣṭhāya namo rakṣāyai namaḥ liṃge || oṃ śreṣṭhāya namo janyai namaḥ muṣke || oṃ rudrāya namo ratyai namo dakṣiṇorau || oṃ kālāya namaḥ pālyāyai namaḥ vāmorau || oṃ kalavikaraṇāya namo buddhyai namaḥ dakṣiṇajānuni || oṃ balāya namaḥ kārayitryai namaḥ vāmajānuni || oṃ balavikaraṇāya namaḥ buddhyai namaḥ dakṣiṇajaṃghāyāṃ || oṃ balapramathanāya namo dhātryai namaḥ vāmajaṃghāyāṃ || oṃ balavikaraṇāyai namaḥ dakṣiṇasphije || oṃ pramathanāthāya namo dhātryai namaḥ vāmasphije || oṃ sarvabhūtadamanāya namo grāmaṇyai namaḥ kaṭyāṃ || oṃ manamohinyai namaḥ dakṣiṇapārśve || oṃ unmanāya namaḥ tamomohāyai namaḥ || vāmapārśve || oṃ sadyojātaṃ prapadyāmi sidhyai namaḥ dakṣiṇapāde || oṃ sadyojātāya vai namo namo buddhyai namaḥ vāmapāde || oṃ bhave dūtyai namaḥ dakṣiṇakare ||
aṃganyāsavidhānam
oṃ abhave lakṣmyai namaḥ vāmakare || oṃ anātibhave medhāyai namaḥ ghrāṇe || oṃ bhajasva māṃ kāṃtyai namaḥ śirasi || oṃ bhava svadhāyai namaḥ dakṣiṇabāhau || oṃ udbhavāya namo dhṛtyai namaḥ bāmabāhau || iti kalānyāsaṃ vistārya || tataḥ|| śiṣyasya tatkalāhvānaṃ sa kuryāddeśikottamaḥ || māṃsapiṃḍaṃ varjayitvā maṃtrapiṃḍaṃ ca kārayet || 20 || ācāryastataḥ dhautavastre rudrākṣapuṃjaṃ vinyasya(,) oṃ hrūṃ srūṃ rūṃ jrūṃ prāṃ rūmapi śrīṃ maṃ kṣāṃ kṣamapi krāṃ kṣāṃ hūṃ namaḥ ityanena maṃtreṇābhimantryāṣṭavidhārcanapūjāṃ kṛtvā tataḥ || rudrākṣavṛkṣabījāya bhūtisaṃbhūtihetave || netratrayāya rudrāya namo lokahitārthine || 21 || iti namaskṛtya tataḥ tattatsthāneṣu tattanmaṃtreṇa dhārayet || oṃ śrīsadāśivāya namaḥ || śikhāyāṃ ekamekavaktraṃ || oṃ vahnisūryasomādhipāya śrīśivāya namaḥ iti dvitridvādaśavaktrāṇi trīṇi trīṇi śirasi || oṃ ṣaṭtriṃśattatvātmakāya śrīparaśivāya namaḥ iti ekādaśavaktramekaikaṃ mūrdhni || oṃ somāya namaḥ iti paṃcadaśa vaktrāṇi pratyekaṃ ṣaṭ karṇadvaye || oṃ triyaṃbakāya kālātmane śrīkaṃṭhāya namaḥ ṣaḍaṣṭavaktrāṇi dvātriṃśat || kaṃṭhe || oṃ śrīkaṃṭhādi mūrtyātmakāya śrīsarvajñāya namaḥ || caturvaktrāṇāṃ paṃcāśanmālikā vakṣasi ||
oṃ sukhāsanādiṣoḍaśamūrtyātmakāya śrīkaṃṭhāya namaḥ trayodaśavaktrāṇi ṣoḍaśa ṣoḍaśa bāhvauḥ || oṃ somakalātmakāya śrīsomanāthāya namaḥ navavaktrāṇi dvādaśa dvādaśa maṇibaṃdhayoḥ || oṃ dvādaśādityādhiṣṭhānāya śrīmahādevāya namaḥ kakṣe || oṃ keśavādimūrtyadhiṣṭhānāya śrīumāpataye namaḥ aṣṭottaraśataṃ caturdaśavaktrāṇi upavītasthāne || oṃ śatarudravidyeśvarātmakāya śrīviśveśvarāya namaḥ catuḥ paṃcāśadudarabaṃdhe kuryāt || oṃ catuḥṣaṣṭhikalādhipāya namaḥ oṃ hīṃ jananasthānabhūtāya sarvātmane sarvakalārūpāya śrīumāpataye namaḥ iti rudrākṣadhāraṇam kuryāt ||
[iti śrīvīraśaivācārapradīpikāyāṃ dīkṣāprakaraṇe śiṣyasnānādyalaṃkāravidhisvastikārohaṇavibhūtidhāraṇapaṃcabrahmanyāsā di tallakṣaṇarudrākṣadhāraṇavidhirnāma ṣaṣṭho'dhyāyaḥ] ||
|| śrīgurubhyo namaḥ ||
[atha saptamo'dhyāyaḥ]
pūjanāpekṣitadravyanirṇayaṃ cārcanākramam || nyāsasya lakṣaṇaṃ vakṣye śṛṇu bhaktiparāyaṇe || 1 || gavāṃ ca gomayaṃ mūtraṃ dadhi kṣīraṃ ghṛtaṃ tathā || paṃcagavyaṃ ca saṃsthāpya pātreṣu ca pṛthak pṛthak || 2 || kṣīraṃ tu madhyamīśāni tatpūrve dadhi cocyate || dakṣiṇe tu ghṛtaṃ sthāpya cottare gomayaṃ tathā || paścime mūtrakaṃ caiva paṃcagavyaṃ ca vinyaset || 3 || (kriyāsāre) pratyekaṃ paṃcaprasthāṃśca tathā kuḍavapaṃcakam || ekaikakuḍavaṃ caiva tadalābhe nikuṃjanam || 4 || evaṃ hi caraliṃgasya kārayeddeśikottamaḥ || 5 || kṣīraṃ dadhi ghṛtaṃ caiva madhu śarkarayā saha || paścime śarkarāṃ caiva paṃcabrahmādhidevatāḥ || 6 || ghaṃṭāpaṃcamahāvādyairyathāśobhanamācaret || aśūnyamastakaṃ liṃgaṃ sadā kurvīta pūjakaḥ || 7 || oṃ hraiṃ tatpuruṣāya namaḥ hauṃ haṃ khaṃ maṃ kṣaṃ taṃ yaṃ maṃ paścācchivāya namaḥ || iti maṃtreṇa śiṣyāṃge sa kuryāddeśakottamaḥ || (arghyadravyaṃ) kuśāgratilasiddhārthayavavrīhipayāṃsi ca || dravyāṇyamūni ṣaṭprāhurarghyasya munipuṃgavāḥ || 8 ||
siddhārthaṃ kuṃkumaṃ dūrvā koṣṭhaṃ lāmañjakaṃ śasi || amūni cātra dravyāṇi pādyasya kathayaṃti ṣaṭ || 9 || phalaṃ kacoraṃ karpūraṃ koṣṭhaṃ kāśmīramelakā || amūnyācamanīyasya dravyāṇi pravadaṃti ṣaṭ || 10 || arghyaṃ pādyaṃ cācamanaṃ prokṣaṇaṃ tu caturvidhaṃ || 11 || (maṃtrāḥ pṛthak pṛthak) (arghyamaṃtraḥ) oṃ devādevebhyo arghayaṃte viśvāya devāya svathāgneti || viśvāya devāya sahagata viśvato hasta uta (atha pādyamantraḥ) pādo'sya viśvābhūtāni tripādasyāmṛtaṃ divi || tripādūrdhva udaitpuruṣaḥ pādosyehābhavatpunaḥ || iti pādyaṃ svāhā || arghyaṃ svāhā || (atha ācamanīyaṃ) oṃ viśvataśca kṣuruta viśvatomukho viśvādhiko rudro maharṣiḥ || sadyojātavāmadevāghoratatpuruṣīśānāya namaḥ ācamanīyaṃ svāhā || tailābhyaṃgaṃ tataḥ kṛtvā liṃgapīṭhe viśeṣataḥ || 12 || (atha paṃcagavyaṃ) sadyojātena gomūtraṃ vāmadevena gomayaṃ || kṣīraṃ cāghoramaṃtreṇa dadhi tatpuruṣeṇa ca || 13 || ghṛtaṃ tvīśānamaṃtreṇa dadyātsadyādi maṃtrataḥ || 14 || iti paṃcagavyasnānaṃ || maṃtraḥ || oṃ hrāṃ sadyojātāya namaḥ || gomūtraṃ svāhā || oṃ hrīṃ vāmadevāya namaḥ gomayaṃ svāhā ||
paṃcāmṛtasnānavidhiḥ
oṃ hrūṃ aghorāya namaḥ goghṛtaṃ svāhā || oṃ hraiṃ tatpuruṣāya namaḥ dadhi svāhā || oṃ hrauṃ īśānāya namaḥ gokṣīraṃ svāhā || iti paṃcagavyaṃ || tataḥ || paṃcāmṛtamatho vakṣye sarvasaṃpatkaraṃ nṛṇāṃ || śivāgre sthaṃḍilaṃ kṛtvā taṃḍulairdroṇasaṃmitaiḥ || 15 || madhye padmaṃ samālikhya sāṣṭapatraṃ sakarṇikam || madhyādipaṃcakoṣṭheṣu sthāpayetpaṃcapātrakaṃ || 16 || kṣīraṃ dadhi ghṛtaṃ kṣaudraṃ śarkarā ceti paṃcakam || paṃcāmṛtamidaṃ proktaṃ pratipātraṃ nyasetpṛthak || 17 || koṣṭhādhidevatāścaiva pratipātraṃ tu pūjayet || aṃbikā ca gaṇāṃbā ca gaṃgā gaurī manonmanā || kṣīrādiśarkarāṃteṣu pūjanīyā dvijottamaiḥ || 18 || kṣīrādiśarkarāṃtānāṃ madhye madhye pṛthak pṛthak || sadyojātādibhirmaṃtraiḥ paṃcabhiḥ snānamācaret || evaṃ karoti yo martyaḥ sa puṇyāṃ gatimāpnuyāt || 19 || maṃtrī rudrapadaṃ vidhāya vidhivaddugdhaṃ vidhau pūrayeddeveṃdre dadhi bhānuje navaghṛtaṃ saumye madhu proddhṛtam || paścāccoditaśarkarāṃ ca varuṇe vahnau ca dhātrīṃ tathā rākṣasyāṃ diśi vai supiṣṭamaniśaṃ
rudre kuśaṃ bho nyaset || 20 ||
atha kṣīramaṃtraḥ || āpyāyasva sa me tu te viśvataḥ somavṛṣṇyaṃ || bhavā vājasya saṃgathe || oṃ sāṃgāya sāyudhāya saparivārāya savāhanāya sarvālaṃkaraṇāya saśaktāya namaḥ iti oṃ kṣīreṇa snāpayāmi || tataḥ īśānenaiva maṃtreṇa jalasnānaṃ samācaret || tataḥ īśānamaṃtraḥ || oṃ īśānaḥ sarvavidyānāmīśvaraḥ sarvabhūtānāṃ brahmādhipatirbrahmaṇo'dhipatirbrahmā śivo me astu sadāśivoṃ || anena maṃtreṇa śuddhodakasnānam || pratyekaṃ gaṃdhapuṣpādyairakṣatādyaiḥ samarcayet || oṃ hraiṃ tatpuruṣāya namaḥ iti bhasma || oṃ hrāṃ hrūṃ īśānāya namaḥ vastraṃ || oṃ hreṃ kavacāya huṃ upavītaṃ || oṃ hrīṃ vāmadevāya namaḥ gaṃdhaṃ || oṃ hrūṃ astrāya phaṭ akṣatān || oṃ namaḥ śivāya puṣpaṃ | oṃ hraṃ netratrayāya vauṣaṭ dhūpaṃ | oṃ hreṃ kavacāya huṃ dīpaṃ oṃ namaḥ śivāya naivedyaṃ | oṃ namaḥ śivāya pānīyaṃ | oṃ hruṃ hṛdayāya namaḥ sugaṃdhadravyayuktaśītodakaṃ svāhā || oṃ namaḥ śivāya anulepanaṃ svāhā|| oṃ hraiṃ tatpuruṣāya namaḥ tāṃbūlaṃ || oṃ hrau haṃ hauṃ haṃ saṃ ābharaṇaṃ svāhā || oṃ namaḥ śivāya darpaṇaṃ || oṃ namaḥ śivāya ghaṃṭānādaṃ || evaṃ tattanmaṃtreṇa pūjāṃ samācaret || atha dadhisnānamaṃtraḥ ||
paṃcāmṛtasnānavidhiḥ
oṃ dadhikrāvṇo akāriṣaṃ jiṣṇoraśvasya vājinaḥ || surabhino mukhā karatpraṇa āyū (?) ṣi tāriṣat oṃ sāṃgāya sāyudhāya saparivārāya savāhanāya sarvālaṃkārabhūṣitāya saśaktāya namaḥ iti dadhnā snāpayāmi || tatpuruṣeṇaiva mantreṇa jalasnānaṃ samācaret || oṃ tatpuruṣāya vidmahe mahādevāya dhīmahi | tanno rudraḥ pracodayāt iti jalasnānaṃ || tataḥ pūrvoktaprakāreṇa pūjāṃ kuryāt || atha ghṛtasnānaṃ || oṃ śuklamasi jyotirasi tejosi devo vaḥ savitā punā || tvacchidreṇa pavitreṇa vasoḥ sūryasya raśmibhiḥ || oṃ sāṃgāya sāyudhāya saparivārāya savāhanāya sarvālaṃkārabhūṣitāya saśaktāya namaḥ iti oṃ ghṛtena snāpayāmi || aghoreṇaiva mantreṇa jalasnānaṃ samācaret oṃ aghorebhyotha ghorebhyo ghoraghoratarebhyaḥ namaste astu rudrarūpebhyaḥ iti jalasnānaṃ || pūrvoktarītyā pūjāṃ samācaret || atha madhusnānamaṃtraḥ || oṃ madhuvātā ṛtāyate madhu kṣaraṃti siṃdhavaḥ || mādhvīrnaḥ saṃtvoṣadhīrmadhu naktamutoṣasi madhumatpārthivaṃ (?) rajaḥ || madhu dyaurastu naḥ pitā madhumānno vanaspatirmadhumā (?) astu sūryaḥ mādhvīrgāvo bhavaṃtu naḥ || oṃ sāṃgāya sāyudhāya saparivārāya savāhanāya sarvālaṃkārabhūṣitāya saśaktāya namaḥ iti madhunā snāpayāmi || vāmadevena mantreṇa jalasnānaṃ samācaret || oṃ vāmadevāya namo jeṣṭhāya namaḥ śreṣṭhāya namo
rūdrāya namaḥ kālāya namaḥ kalavikaraṇāya namo balāya namo balavikaraṇāya namo balapramathanāya namaḥ sarvabhūtadamanāya namo manonmanāya namaḥ iti jalasnānaṃ || tataḥ pūrvoktarītyā pūjāṃ kuryāt || atha śarkarāsnānamaṃtraḥ || oṃ bhūrbhuvaḥsvaḥ tatsaviturvareṇyaṃ bhargo devasya dhīmahi || dhiyo yo naḥ pracodayāt || oṃ sāṃgāya sāyudhāya saparivārāya savāhanāya sarvālaṃkārabhūṣitāya saśaktāya namaḥ iti śarkarāsnānaṃ samarpayet || sadyojātena maṃtreṇa jalasnānaṃ samācaret || oṃ sadyojātaṃ prapadyāmi sadyojātāya vai namo namaḥ || bhave bhavenātibhave bhavasva māṃ bhavodbhavāya namaḥ iti śuddhodakasnānamācaret || tataḥ pūrvoktarītyā pūjāṃ kuryāt || oṃ yāḥ phalinīryā'aphalā apuṣpāyāśca puṣpiṇīḥ || bṛhaspatiprasūtāstā no muṃcantvaṃ (?) hasaḥ || oṃ sāṃgāya sāyudhāya saparivārāya savāhanāya sarvālaṃkārabhūṣitāya saśaktaye namaḥ iti phalodakena snāpayāmi || triyaṃbakena maṃtreṇa jalasnānaṃ samācaret || triyaṃbakaṃ yajāmahe sugaṃdhiṃ puṣṭivardhanam || urvārukamiva baṃdhanānmṛtyormukṣīyamāmṛtāt iti śuddhodakasnānaṃ || tataḥ pūrvoktarītyā pūjāṃ kuryāt || yavagodhūmacūrṇena mudgacūrṇena gharṣayet || mayi medhāmiti maṃtreṇa koṣṇenaiva ca vāriṇā || liṃgaṃ saṃsnāpya sadbhaktyā viśeṣeṇa śivārcakaḥ || atha maṃdoṣṇodakamaṃtraḥ|| mayi medhāṃ mayi prajāṃ mayyagnistejo dadhātu iti maṃtreṇa maṃdoṣṇodakasnānamācaret || tataḥ oṃ hroṃ īśānāya namaḥ gaṃdhodakena snāpayāmi || oṃ hraiṃ tatpuruṣāya
kalaśapūjana vidhiḥ
namaḥ iti puṣpodakaṃ svāhā || oṃ hrūṃ aghorāya namaḥ iti svarṇodakena snāpayāmi(,) oṃ hrīṃ vāmadevāya namaḥ ratnodakena snāpayāmi(,) oṃ hrāṃ sadyojātāya namaḥ mūlamaṃtrodakena snāpayāmi || oṃ hrāṃ hrīṃ hrūṃ hraiṃ hrauṃ hraḥ iti nārikelodakena snāpayāmi || tatastīrthodakābhiṣekavidhiḥ || (atha kalaśadhyānamantraḥ) kalaśasya mukhe rudraḥ kaṃṭhe viṣṇuḥ samāśritaḥ || mūle tasya sthito brahmā madhye mātṛgaṇāḥ smṛtāḥ || 1 || kukṣau tu sāgarāḥ sarve saptadvīpā vasuṃdharā || śeṣāstu devatāḥ sarvāḥ kalaśaṃ tu samāśritāḥ || 2 || sarvābdhisalilaṃ sarvatīrthāni śubhadāni ca iti dhyānaṃ || tataḥ (āvāhanamantraḥ) gaṃge ca yamune caiva godāvari sarasvati | narmade sindhu kāveri jale'smin sannidhiṃ kuru || tataḥ pūrvoktamomāpa iti mantreṇa jalamabhimantrya bhasmagaṃdhādinā kalaśamarcayet || (kalaśapramāṇam) (kāraṇāgame) snapane caraliṃgasya paṃcāḍhakamitaṃ jalaṃ || paṃcaprasthamitenāpi snāpayedgurusattamaḥ || 21 || ātmārthaṃ caraliṃgaṃ ca sthiraliṃgaṃ parārthakam || tiryagyavodarāṇyaṣṭāvūrdhvā vā vrīhayastrayaḥ || 22 || pramāṇamaṃgulaṃ proktametadaṃgulalakṣaṇam ||
ṣaḍaṃgulaṃ tu vistīrṇaṃ dvādaśāṃgulamāyatam || 23 || prasthapramāṇamityuktaṃ vedaśāstraviśāradaiḥ || kuṃbhaṃ tu gaṃdhapuṣpādyairdeśikaḥ samyagarcayet || 24 || śivakuṃbhasthatoyena cābhiṣiṃcecchivaṃ guruḥ || prāṇaprakṛtiyogaṃ tu jñātvā sthāpanamācaret || 25 || prāṇo maṃtra iti proktaḥ prakṛtirmūrtirucyate || prāṇaṃ prakṛtimūrtiṃ ca jñātvā sthāpanamācaret || 26 || maṃtramūrtyośca saṃyoge śivasāṃnidhyakāraṇam || prāṇapratiṣṭhāmaṃtrāṃśca kalāvarṇān tathā nyaset || 27 || yā kalā paramā sūkṣmā maṃtrāṇāṃ bodhinī parā || tāmākṛṣya yathānyāyaṃ liṃge samupavinyaset || 28 || mūlena śivahastaṃ taṃ nidadyācchivamastake || oṃ ayaṃ me hasto bhagavāniti nādabiṃdukalāvidvān tattatsthāneṣu vinyaset || 29 || nādaṃ liṃgamiti proktaṃ biṃdu śaktirudāhṛtā || kalā tu gomukhaṃ caiva sthānamityabhidhīyate || 30 || atha ṣaḍaṃganyāsaḥ || oṃ hrāṃ hṛdayāya namaḥ || oṃ naṃ hrīṃ śirase svāhā || oṃ maṃ hrūṃ śikhāyai vauṣaṭ || oṃ śiṃ hraiṃ kavacāya huṃ(,) oṃ vāṃ hrauṃ netratrayāya vauṣaṭ ||
paṃcākṣaramaṃtrasvarūpam
oṃ yaṃ hraḥ astrāya phaṭ iti ṣaḍaṃgamaṃtraḥ || oṃ hrāṃ hrīṃ hrūṃ hraiṃ hrauṃ hraḥ iti śivāṃgamaṃtraḥ || oṃ hraṃ hrauṃ haṃ saṃ iti paṃcaprasāramaṃtraḥ || namaḥ śivāyeti paṃcākṣaramaṃtraḥ || oṃ namaḥ śivāyeti mūlapaṃcākṣaramaṃtraḥ || oṃ hrāṃ hrīṃ hrūṃ namaḥ śivāyeti sthūlapaṃcākṣaramaṃtraḥ || oṃ hrīṃ namaḥ śivāyeti sūkṣmapaṃcākṣaramaṃtraḥ || oṃ hrīṃ hrūṃ namaḥ śivāyeti māyākhyapaṃcākṣaramaṃtraḥ || oṃ hrāṃ hrīṃ hrūṃ hraiṃ namaḥ śivāyeti prasādapaṃcākṣaramaṃtraḥ || oṃ hraḥ anaṃtaśaktidhāmne jyotīrūpāya śivāstrāya phaṭ iti śivāstramaṃtraḥ || oṃ āṃ īṃ ūṃ vyomavyāpine vyomāstrāya phaḍiti vyomāstramaṃtraḥ || oṃ paśu haṃ phaḍiti pāśupatāstramaṃtraḥ pūrvoktakalānyāsena saha liṃgamadhye'nusaṃdadhya || saptakoṭimahāmaṃtrairmaṃtritaṃ liṃgamucyate || maṃtrastu devatārūpaṃ maṃtrarūpamayaḥ śivaḥ || 31 || karṣaṇādikriyāḥ sarvā maṃtreṇaiva prakīrtitāḥ || jñātvā samarcayenmaṃtrī cānyathā niṣphalaṃ bhavet || 32 || tataḥ prāṇapratiṣṭhāpanamaṃtraḥ || oṃ prāṇapratiṣṭhāmaṃtrasya ṛgyajuḥsāmātharvaṇāni chaṃdāṃsi sakalajagatsṛṣṭikarī prāṇaśaktirdevatā aṃ bījaṃ
hrīṃ śaktiḥ krauṃ kīlakaṃ sakalamaṃtrapratiṣṭhārthe asmin deśe viniyogaḥ || oṃ iṃ īṃ jhaṃ jaṃ chaṃ caṃ śaṃ ūrdhvakeśinī śirase svāhā(,) śrotranetraghrāṇatvakjihvātmane aṃ ṇaṃ ḍhaṃ ḍaṃ ṭhaṃ ṭaṃ uṃ jaṃṭinī śikhinī padmāṃtarvartinī śikhāyai vauṣaṭ(,) vākpāṇipādapāyūpasthātmane oṃ aiṃ naṃ dhaṃ daṃ thaṃ taṃ trailokyavartinī māyākavacāya huṃ vacanāgamanādānavisargānaṃda oṃ pṛthivyaptejovāyvā kāśātmane oṃ aṃ jiṃ ghaṃ khaṃ kaṃ āṃ saṃjīvanīhṛdayāya namaḥ śabdasparśarūparasagaṃdhātmane oṃ oṃ maṃ bhaṃ baṃ phaṃ paṃ oṃ aṃtarikṣāṇi netratrayāya vauṣaṭ(,) manobuddhyahaṃkāracittātmane oṃ kṣaṃ (?)ṃ haṃ saṃ ṣaṃ śaṃ vaṃ laṃ raṃ yaṃ māraṇī astrāya phaṭ(,) aṃ hrīṃ kroṃ yaralavaśaṣasa ho haṃ kṣaṃ sahottīrṇaḥ iha prāṇaḥ amuṣya jīvaḥ iha jīvaḥ amuṣya sthitiḥ amuṣya sarveṃdriyāṇi amuṣya manaścakṣujihvāghrāṇatvakprāṇāgnirvāyustiṣṭhaṃtu svāhā anena maṃtreṇa prāṇapratiṣṭhāṃ kṛtvā (tato mātṛkākṣaranyāsaḥ) akārākārau mūrdhni lalāṭe | ikārekārau dakṣiṇavāmanetrayoḥ | ukārokārau dakṣiṇavāmaśrotayoḥ | ṛkārṛkārau dakṣiṇavāmakapolayoḥ | ḷkāraḷlkārau dakṣiṇavāmanāsāpuṭayoḥ ekāraikārau ūrdhvādharoṣṭhayoḥ | okāraukārau ūrdhvādho daṃtapaṃktyoḥ | aṃ aḥ tālunoḥ | kādipaṃcākṣarāṇi dakṣiṇahastapaṃcāṃguliṣu | cādipaṃcākṣarāṇi vāmakarāṃguliṣu tādi paṃcākṣarāṇi dakṣiṇavāmapādāṃguliṣu |
harāvayavapūjanavidhānam
pakāra udare | phakārabakārau dakṣiṇavāmapārśvayoḥ | bhakāraḥ skaṃdhe | makāro hṛdi | yakārādisakārāṃtāni akṣarāṇi tvagādisaptadhātuṣu | hakāra ātmani | kṣakāraḥ pūjakānāṃ janmādiripuviṣayakakrodhe | anena prakāreṇa liṃgamadhye imāni mātṛkākṣarāṇi smaret | tataḥ snānam || oṃ hrāṃ hṛdayāya namaḥ anena maṃtreṇa arghyaṃ pādyamācamanīyaṃ dadyāt || tataḥ pūrvoktarītyā pūjāṃ kṛtvā tattanmaṃtreṇa pūjādravyāṇi samarpayet || tataḥ avayavapūjanaṃ || oṃ harāya namaḥ pādau pūjayāmi || śaṃbhave namaḥ gulphau pūjayāmi || śubhāya namaḥ jānunī pūjayāmi || sarvanivāsāya namaḥ ūrū pūjayāmi || sarvāśrayāya namaḥ kaṭiṃ pūjayāmi || sarvarakṣāya namaḥ jaghanaṃ pūjayāmi || digvāsase namaḥ madhyaṃ pūjayāmi || nakṣatramāline namaḥ nābhiṃ pūjayāmi || sarveśvarāya namaḥ kukṣiṃ pūjayāmi || umākāṃtāya namaḥ vakṣaḥsthalaṃ pūjayāmi || nīlakaṃṭhāya namaḥ kaṃṭhaṃ pūjayāmi || tripurasaṃhārāya namaḥ bāhūn pūjayāmi || śaṃkarāya namaḥ karān pūjayāmi || vṛṣāya namaḥ bahiḥ kaṃṭhaṃ pūjayāmi ||
kratuphaladāyine namaḥ mukhaṃ pūjayāmi || nāgahārāya namaḥ nāsikāṃ pūjayāmi || iṃdvarkavahninetrāya namaḥ netrāṇi pūjayāmi || kapāline namaḥ lalāṭaṃ pūjayāmi || phaṇikuṃḍalāya namaḥ karṇau pūjayāmi || gaṃgādharāya namaḥ jaṭāḥ pūjayāmi || somabhūṣaṇāya namaḥ kapardaṃ pūjayāmi || śubhadāya namaḥ sarvāṃgaṃ pūjayāmi || iti pūjanaṃ (tataḥ puṣpasamarpaṇaṃ) bhavāya devāya namaḥ(,) śarvāya devāya namaḥ(,) rudrāya devāya namaḥ(,) paśupataye devāya namaḥ(,) ugrāya devāya namaḥ(,) mahate devāya namaḥ(,) bhīmāya devāya namaḥ(,) īśānāya devāya namaḥ(,) anena maṃtreṇa śivāṣṭottaranāmabhirvā sahasranāmabhirvā puṣpāṇi samarpayet || (atha daśāṃgalakṣaṇaṃ) kālāgarurgaṃdhasāro guggulaśca sitāgaruḥ || lākṣābilvaphalaṃ sarpirmadhusarjarasaḥ śaśī || 33 || sādhanāni daśāṃgāni dhūpasya caturānana iti || oṃ hrāṃ netratrayāya vauṣaṭ iti dhūpaṃ svāhā(,) oṃ hraiṃ kavacāya huṃ iti dīpaṃ svāhā(,) oṃ namaḥ śivāya iti maṃtreṇa svāhāntayā patākamudrayā ca naivedyaṃ svāhā(,) oṃ namaḥ śivāya iti pānīyaṃ svāhā(,) oṃ hṛdayāya namaḥ iti ācamanīyaṃ svāhā(,) oṃ namaḥ śivāya iti anulepanaṃ svāhā(,) oṃ hraiṃ tatpuruṣāya namaḥ iti tāṃbūlaṃ svāhā(,)
śivaprārthanāprakāravarṇanam
oṃ hraṃ hrauṃ hraṃ hrauṃ haṃ saṃ iti maṃtreṇa ābharaṇaṃ svāhā(,) oṃ namaḥ śivāya iti maṃtreṇa darpaṇaṃ darśayet(,) cāmarānvījayet(,) (śaṃkarasaṃhitāyāṃ) laukikairvaidikaiḥ stotraiśśivaṃ stūyātsvaśaktitaḥ || śaṃkhamudrāṃ pradarśyātha cāvayoḥ siddhirastviti || prārthayetprāṃjalirdevaṃ nityamatra sthiro bhava || 34 || evaṃ vijñāpya deveśaṃ dadyātpuṣpāṃjaliṃ tathā || aparādhasahasrāṇi kriyaṃte'harniśaṃ mayā || 35 || pāhi māmaparādhebhyaḥ pitā putramiva priyaṃ || iti maṃtrapuṣpāṇi datvā || tataḥ || pūjāphalaṃ ca yatsarvamudakena pradāpayet || 36 || aṃjaliṃ dakṣiṇaṃ hastamākuṃcaccaturaṃguliṃ || puṣpaṃ vāri gṛhitvā kaniṣṭhāyāḥ srāvayedbhuvi || 37 || culakodakametatsyātsvātmanaḥ pādamūlataḥ || 38 ||
[iti śrīvīraśaivācārapradīpikāyāṃ dīkṣāprakaraṇaṃ nāma saptamo'dhyāyaḥ] ||
|| śrīgurubhyo namaḥ ||
[atha aṣṭamo'dhyāyaḥ]|
śiṣyasya hastapūjāṃ ca hastamastakayostathā || saṃyogameva ṣaṭcakrasthāpanaṃ tu tathaiva ca || 1 || kramaṃ maṃtropadeśasya pravakṣyāmi ca tadyathā || liṃgadhāraṇasthānāni snānaṃ caivāghamarṣaṇaṃ || 2 || vāmāṃguṣṭhena gaṃdhena maṃḍalaṃ dakṣiṇe kare || kṛtvā tatrārcayedīśamāsanāṃgādi saṃyutam || 3 || śivatejomayaṃ pāṇiṃ śivamaṃtramudīrayet || ayaṃ me hasto bhagavānayaṃ me bhagavattaraḥ || ayaṃ me viśvabheṣaja ayaṃ śivābhimarśanaḥ || ayaṃ mātā ayaṃ pitā ayaṃ jīvāturāgamat || idaṃ tava prasarpaṇaṃ subaṃdhavehi nirahi || ādau paṃcākṣaraṇaiva maṃtreṇa tvabhiṣecayet || puṣpagaṃdhākṣatādhūpadīpanaivedyamaṃtrakaiḥ || 4 || hastamastakasaṃyogacchalādvedeti gīyate || śivahastaṃ vidhāyātha śiṣyasya śirasi nyaset || 5 || karātmadeśe tanmaṃtramaṃguṣṭhenaiva mūrdhani || kartṛnāma samāṃgulyaḥ karmanāma karadvayaṃ || 6 || gaṃdhapuṣpadhūpadīpanaivedyatāṃbūlādi samarpayet || tataḥ ādhārādiṣaṭcakradaleṣvakṣarāṇi sthāpayet || sadyojātaṃ pṛthivītatvaṃ nakārabījaṃ caturdalaṃ brahmādhidaivataṃ ācāraliṃgaṃ ādhāracakraṃ gude sthāpayet ||
ādhāracakrasthānādivarṇanam
vāmadevaṃ āptatvaṃ makārabījaṃ viṣṇvadhidaivataṃ ṣaḍdalaṃ guruliṃgaṃ svādhiṣṭhānacakraṃ liṃgasthāne bhamayaralava ityakṣarāṇi sthāpayet || aghoraṃ tejastatvaṃ śikārabījaṃ śivaliṃgaṃ daśadalaṃ rudrādhidaivataṃ maṇipūrakaṃ nābhisthāne sthāpayet || tatpuruṣaṃ vāyutatvaṃ vakārabījaṃ īśvarādhidaivataṃ dvādaśadalaṃ caraliṃgaṃ kādiṭhāṃtaṃ anāhatacakraṃ hṛdaye sthāpayet || īśānaṃ ākāśatatvaṃ yakārabījaṃ sadāśivādhidaivataṃ ṣoḍaśadalaṃ prasādaliṃgaṃ ādi ṣoḍaśasvara viśuddhicakraṃ kaṃṭe sthāpayet || ājñācakraṃ dvidalaṃ praṇavabījaṃ mahāliṃgaṃ manastatvaṃ śrīguruhaṃkṣamātmakaṃ bhrūmadhye sthāpayet || guruṇodīritaḥ karṇe yo'sau maṃtraśca kathyate || bījaṃ varṇaṃ svaraṃ śaktiṃ kramādupadiśedguruḥ || 7 || nakāraḥ pṛthivī jñeyā makārastvāpa iṣyate || śikāro'gniriti prokto vakāro vāyurucyate || ākāśo hi yakāraḥsyātpaṃcākṣara iti smṛtaḥ || 8 || sa tu baddhāṃjaliḥ śiṣyo maṃtre tatparamānasaḥ || śanairvyavaharecchiṣyaḥ śivācāryasya śāsanāt || 9 || maṃtraiśca paripūtasya liṃgaṃ darśayate guruḥ || tasmācchiṣyo'tha bho devi liṃgāyita iti smṛtaḥ || 10 ||
yasya pāśānsukartaryā chitvā liṃgaṃ samādiśet || kartarī jñānaśaktiḥ syādyayā pāśāṃśchinatyasau || 11 || jñānena pūtadehe vai śiṣye liṃgaṃ niyojayet || pīṭhasthe śivaliṃge tu śiṣyaprāṇān nidhāpayet || 12 || liṃgaṃ saṃsthāpya tatprāṇe prāṇaliṃgaṃ bhavettataḥ || prāṇe liṃgaṃ samāhṛtya caikībhāvaṃ samācaret || 13 || triliṃgaṃ sthāpayecchiṣya prāṇaliṃgamidaṃ tava || evamuktvā sadā liṃgaṃ na kadācidviyojaya || 14 || uttamāṃge gale vāpi kakṣe vakṣaḥsthale'pi vā || tathā hastasthale vāpi prāṇaliṃgaṃ dharetsudhīḥ || 15 || na tyajaitatsadā vatsa yāvajjīvamidaṃ vratam || yajasva devadeveśaṃ parayā nijaniṣṭhayā || pāśabaṃdhavimokṣāya muktidaṃ sarvakāraṇam || 16 || kalaśodaiśca tīrthaiśca ṛtvigbhiḥ snāpayedguruḥ || uddhṛtya paṃca kalaśānsthāpayecca punaḥ punaḥ || 17 || athavā kalaśasthāni tīrthāni ca svayaṃ guruḥ || dūrvāṃkuraiścāmūrdhapādaṃ śiṣyasya siṃcayet || 18 || itthaṃ trivāramācāryaḥ kṛtvā tasyāghamarṣaṇam || tatkāle sa gurustasya mūlamaṃtraṃ samādiśet || 19 || gurorālokamātreṇa sparśātsaṃbhāṣaṇādapi ||
guruprasādaphalavarṇanam
śivatatvaṃ samāyāti na punarbhavatāṃ brajet || 20 || yathā śuktigataṃ toyaṃ mauktikaṃ jāyate dhruvam || na punastoyatāṃ yāti mauktikatvaṃ na muṃcati || evaṃ sa śivatāṃ yāti na punaḥ paśutāṃ brajet || 21 ||
[iti śrīvīraśaivācārapradīpikāyāṃ dīkṣāprakaraṇe hastapūjāhastamastakasaṃyogaṣaṭcakrasthāpanamantropadeśaliṃgadhāraṇasthā nāghamarṣaṇasnānalakṣaṇaṃ nāmāṣṭamo'dhyāyaḥ] ||
|| śrīgurubhyo namaḥ ||
[atha navamo'dhyāyaḥ] |
gurubodhakramaṃ cātha gurudakṣiṇalakṣaṇam || vakṣyāmi tadyathā samyak śṛṇu yatnapuraḥsaram || 1 || vīramāheśvaraṃ dharmaṃ kramādupadiśedguruḥ || 2 || śhivarāghavasaṃvāde gacchaṃstiṣṭhaṃnsvapanjāgrannunmiṣannimiṣannapi || śucirvāpyaśucirvāpi liṃgaṃ sarvatra dhārayet || 3 || sarveṣāṃ śivacihnānāṃ śivaliṃgaṃ praśasyate || tasmāttadeva dhāryaṃ hi pūjanīyaṃ viśeṣataḥ || 4 || nābhau ca hṛdaye mūrdhni sarvāvasthāsu sarvadā || śrīliṃgadhāraṇaṃ kuryāddevi nityaṃ mama priyaḥ || 5 || dhārayedyastu hastena liṃgākāraṃ śivaṃ sadā || vaktre vā dhārayennityaṃ matprabhāvaṃ vibhāvayet || 6 || mastake dhārayecchiṣyo brahmādyairmastake dhṛtaṃ || vinyasenmukuṭasyāṃte dhāraṇaṃ śubhamucyate || 7 || nābheradhastātsatataṃ pramādānnaiva dhārayet || kadāciddhārayedyastu pāpātmeti sa ucyate || 8 || nābherūrdhvaṃ liṃgadhārī jñānasaubhāgyavardhanaḥ || kaṃṭheṣu harakaṃṭhādimunayo manavastathā || sarvadā śivaliṃgaṃ tu dhārayaṃtyarcayaṃti ca || 9 ||
liṃgadhāraṇasthānaviśeṣakathanam
(pārameśvarataṃtre dīkṣāprakaraṇe paṃcamapaṭale) mokṣārthinaḥ śikhādeśe bāhumadhye tu dharmiṇaḥ || kāmārthinaḥ kaṭīdeśe kaṃṭhe sarvārthinaḥ priye || 10 || aṣṭottaraśataṃ japtvā mama mūlamahāmanuṃ || ābadhnīta gurūrliṃgaṃ dehe śiṣyasya yatnataḥ || 11 || na paiśūnyaṃ na mātsaryaṃ na drohaṃ nāpi pīḍanam || na spṛśedaśubhaṃ kvāpi prāṇaiḥ kaṃṭhagatairapi || 12 || brahmā viṣṇustathā śakraḥ lokapālāśca devatāḥ || dhārayaṃtyalikāgreṣu śivaliṃgamaharniśam || 13 || akṣapādādayassarve śaktayassarvadā mudā || dhārayantyalikāgreṣu śivaliṃgamaharniśaṃ || 14 || vinirbhidya tathā gātraṃ vivare lohapātrake || śivaliṃgaṃ vinikṣipya pūjayaṃti hi rākṣasāḥ || 15 || atidhīreṇa manasā yāvajjīvaṃ jagadguroḥ || śivasya liṃgaṃ yo dhatte tadeva paramaṃ vratam || 16 || puṣpasya surabhiryadvattadvaddehasya liṃgakaṃ || liṃgabhedānmahāpāpaṃ tasmātpīṭhārcanaṃ nahi || 17 || dīkṣākāle tu guruṇā dattaṃ liṃgaṃ gataṃ yadi || pramādādeva sa pumāṃstyajeddehaṃ ca tatkṣaṇāt || 18 || punardīkṣā na kartavyā yathā kanyā dṛḍhavratā || 19 || (vīrataṃtre) satī sutaśca bhṛtyaśca dāsī gopastathaiva ca ||
ete liṃgāṃginaḥ śreṣṭhāścānye cāṃḍālavanmatāḥ || 20 || viśabdo'tra vikalpārtho raśabdo rahitārthakaḥ || vikalparahitaṃ śaivaṃ vīraśaivamiti smṛtam || 21 || ekamevādvitīyaṃ yadavikalpaṃ paraṃ padaṃ || tadvīraśaivamityuktamitaratsavikalpakam || 22 || yo hastapīṭhe nijaliṃgamiṣṭaṃ vinyasya tallīnamanaḥpracāraḥ || bāhyakriyāsaṃkulanispṛhātmā saṃpūjayatyaṃga sa vīraśaivaḥ || 23 || (ādityapurāṇe) (śivaṣaṇmukhasaṃvāde) bhaktiraṣṭavidhā skaṃda sarvaśāstreṣu paṭhyate || tāmahaṃ kathayiṣyāmi bhaktiṃ bhavavināśinīm || 24 || madbhaktajanavātsalyaṃ pūjāyāṃ cānumodanam || svayamabhyarcanaṃ bhaktyā madarthe cāṃgaceṣṭanam || 25 || matkathāśravaṇe bhaktiḥ svaranetrāṃgavikriyā || madanusmaraṇaṃ nityaṃ sarvadā mayyakaitavam || 26 || bhaktiraṣṭavidhā hyeṣā yasminmleṃche'pi vartate || sa vipreṃdro muniḥ śrīmānsa yatiḥ sa ca paṃḍitaḥ || 27 || tasmai dānaṃ sadā deyaṃ sa naro mādṛśaḥ smṛtaḥ (sa naro'haṃ yathā smṛtaḥ) || madbhaktaḥ sarvadā skaṃda śvapaco'pi mama priyaḥ || 28 || na tasmādadhikaḥ kaścidvidyate pātramuttamam ||
śivabhaktamāhātmyātiśayakathanam
smṛtyācāravihīno'pi varṇāśramavivarjitaḥ || 29 || bhaktileśayutaḥ skaṃda mleṃcchaḥ sa ca guṇādhikaḥ || mārgastho vāpyamārgastho mūrkhoṃ vā paṃḍito'pi vā || 30 || mama bhakto yadi bhavetsarvasmādadhikaśca saḥ (sarvasmādīdhako bhavet ||)|| madbhaktānāṃ ca māhātmyaṃ ko vā jānāti tattvataḥ || jāne'haṃ tvaṃ ca jānāsi naṃdī jānāti vā na vā || 31 || śrutiḥ || api vā yaścāṃḍālaḥ śiveti vācaṃ vadettena saha saṃvadettena saha saṃvasettena saha bhuṃjīta iti || (pārāśarapurāṇe) śiveti vācaṃ yo nityaṃ cāṃḍālo'pi vadenmudā || tena sākaṃ vadedvācaṃ tena sākaṃ vasetsadā || 32 || (padmapurāṇe śivarāghavasaṃvāde) śiveti maṃgalaṃ nāma yasya vāci pravartate || saptajanmakṛtaṃ pāpaṃ tatkṣaṇādeva naśyati || 33 || vadettena vasettena viśettena punaḥ punaḥ || tena sākaṃ ca bhuṃjītetyāha sāmaśrutiḥ khalu || 34 || devāḥ ṣoḍaśa lakṣāṇi nava lakṣāṇi mānuṣāḥ || daśabhirdaśabhistadvajjalajā vihagā mṛgāḥ || 35 || sarīsṛpāstu lakṣāṇi caikādaśa caretare || aṣṭau ca daśa lakṣāṇi saptajanmānyamūni vai || 36 ||
(ādityapurāṇe nāradabrahmasaṃvāde) brāhmaṇaḥ kṣatriyo vaiśyaḥ śūdro vāpyaṃtyajātijaḥ || śivabhaktassadā pūjyaḥ sarvāvasthāṃ gato'pi vā || 37 || karmaṇā manasā vācā yastu bhaktānviniṃdati || nirayānniṣkṛtirnāsti tasya mūḍhātmano mune || 38 || darśanācchivabhaktānāṃ sakṛtsaṃbhāṣaṇādapi || atirātrasya yajñasya phalaṃ bhavati nārada || 39 || (liṃgasāre) liṃgārcanaratā nārī rajassūtakasaṃyutā || raviragniryathā vāyustebhyaḥ koṭiśucirbhavet || 40 || yathā viśveśanikaṭādgaṃgā sūtakavarjitā || tathā liṃgāṃkitā bhaktāḥ paṃcasūtakavarjitāḥ || 41 || śivaṃ guruṃ sadākālaṃ pūjayejjīvitāvadhi || śivaṃ guruṃ ca tacchāstraṃ na niṃdetsādhakastathā || 42 || gurorliṃgasya harmyasya praticchāyaṃ na laṃghayet || ekāsane nopaviśedguruṇā saha jātucit || 43 || prāyaścittaṃ na tasyāsti pāpaṃ gurutaraṃ hi tat || vinodojvalaveṣaṃ ca paryaṃkaṃ daṃtadhāvanam || 44 || kiṃcicceṣṭāvikāraṃ ca pādaprakṣālanaṃ tathā || tadvākyapratikūlaṃ ca na kuryādgurusaṃnidhau || 45 || (śivarahasye) putrakarmavivāhādi tatsarvaṃ ca svakarmabhiḥ ||
anyadevatāpūjāniṣedhakathanam
kartavyaṃ śivabhaktaiśca yathā loke svajātibhiḥ || 46 || yā tu kanyā svapitryādyaiḥ śivakarmaṇi yojitā (śivadharme niyojitā)|| sā bhaktāya pradātavyā nābhaktāya (nāparāya) virodhine || 47 || dattā cetpratikūlāya pramādādbodhayetpatiṃ || aśaktyā taṃ parityajya manasā dharmamācaret || 48 || bhavinā śayanādyānāt saṃparkātsahabhojanāt || saṃcaraṃti mahāghore narake kālamakṣayaṃ || 49 || paṃcākṣaropadeśī ca narastutikaro yadi || so'liṃgī sa durācārī kukaviḥ sa tu viśrutaḥ || 50 || uttamāṃ vṛttimāśritya nīcāṃ vṛttiṃ samāśrayet || ārūḍhapatito jñeyaḥ sarvakarmabahiṣkṛtaḥ || 51 || (brahmagītāyāṃ) śivapūjāparo bhūtvā yo'nyaṃ devamanusmaret || aṣṭāviṃśatikoṭyantanarakaṃ yāti sa dhruvaṃ || 52 || (liṃgasāre) liṃgārcanaikaśaraṇo yo'nyaṃ devaṃ tu baṃdate || nāyakaṃ narakaṃ gatvā tiryagyoniṣu jāyate (śunāṃ garbheṣu jāyate)|| 53 || śivabhaktaṃ samālokya dūrādevātra bhaktitaḥ || prāṃjaliḥ praṇato bhūtvā toṣayeddānabhojanaiḥ || 54 ||
śaṃbhornaivedyakaṃ śuddhamanyocchiṣṭaṃ tu miśritam || tadgṛhaṃ śivabhaktānāṃ varjanīyaṃ prayatnataḥ || 55 || yadgṛheṣvanyadevo'sti tadgṛhāṇi parityajet || yadgṛheṣu bhaviprāptistadgṛhāṇi parityajet || 56 || sthāvaraṃ jaṃgamaṃ cetidvividhaṃ liṃgamucyate || jaṃgamasyāvamānena sthāvaraṃ niṣphalaṃ bhavet || 57 || samyagguruṃ śivaṃ jñātvā nityaṃ tatpūjanaṃ budhaḥ || yaḥ karotyubhayaḥ kāyaḥ śivaikā śraya eva saḥ || 58 || mānuṣaṃ lokamāśritya tridhā bhavati śaṃkaraḥ || ācāryo liṃganāmā ca caradevo maheśvaraḥ || 59 || gurau liṃge jaṃgame ca bhaktibhāvanapūjanaiḥ || samatābhājanaṃ yasya tadbhavet trividhaṃ sthalam || 60 || sarvadā ca gurau bhaktirliṃgajaṃgamapūjanam || ekapatnīvrataṃ vīramāheśvaramahāvratam || 61 || (śivasūtre) kaniṣṭhā madgatā pūjā madhyamaṃ gurupūjanam || uttamaṃ jaṃgamasyeti viśiṣṭaṃ samayārcanam || 62 || (śaivaratnākare) śivo yathā tathā bhakto yathā bhaktastathā śivaḥ || tasmātsarvaprayatnena dīkṣitānyājayedbudhaḥ || 63 || evaṃ susaṃmataḥ śiṣyo gurupūjāṃ samācaret || vastrālaṃkāraratnādidakṣiṇābhirviśeṣataḥ || 64 || putradārādisaṃyuktamātmānaṃ saparigraham ||
gurudakṣiṇākramakathanam
puṣpākṣatajalopetaṃ gurave svaṃ samarpayet || 65 || śiṣyastu dakṣiṇāṃ dadyādācāryāya svaśaktitaḥ || yathopadiṣṭamārgeṇa kuryātsanmānamṛtvijām || 66 || ityādyā bahavo jñeyāḥ saṃti ye ca śivāgame || āyurārogyatāṃ yāti kīrtiṃ ca vimalāṃ bhuvi || 67 || śrīkaṃṭhasya tayā prāptiṃ samavāpnoti dīkṣitaḥ || 68 ||
[iti śrīvīraśaivācārapradīpikāyāṃ dīkṣāprakaraṇe gurubodhagurudakṣiṇālakṣaṇaṃ nāma navamo'dhyāyaḥ] ||
|| śrīgurubhyo namaḥ||
[atha daśamo'dhyāyaḥ] |
guruśuśrūṣaṇaṃ vakṣye tadyathā śṛṇu yatnataḥ || tataḥ kurvīta śuśrūṣāṃ sadbhaktyā'haraharguroḥ || 1 || śuśrūṣāyāḥ kramaṃ cātha śṛṇuṣva caturānana || manasyavirataṃ samyaggurorākāraciṃtanam || 2 || śuśrūṣopāyatā kācit hṛcchuśrūṣetyudāhṛtā || deva kiṃ karma kartavyaṃ tadevetyuttaraṃ punaḥ || 3 || evamādipriyoktiśca sā vāk śuśrūṣikā smṛtā || samīpe vāpi dūre vā svaśarīranivedanam || 4 || gamanāgamanāyāsaiḥ svabhāvānaṃdanaistathā || pradakṣiṇanamaskārānsamyak pādāvanejanam || 5 || payasājyena dadhnā vā labdhenāṃghriprapūjanam || tataḥ sūkṣmairmudgacūrṇairuṣṇena salilena ca || 6 || prakṣālya śuddhavastreṇa tadūrdhvodakamārjanam || 7 || śayyāsaṃstaraṇaṃ kṛtvā keśānsaṃmārjayennakhaiḥ || tailābhyaṃgakriyāścātha snānakarma yathā śubham || 8 || śrīkhaṃḍalepanaṃ puṣpamālikā cārubaṃdhanam || śaucārthaṃ mṛjjalādīni daṃtakāṣṭhapradāpanam || 9 || pūjāsthānānulepaṃ ca gomayena savāriṇā || pūjāyai jalapuṣpāṇi tatra yogyāni vinyaset || 10 ||
guruśuśrūṣālakṣaṇam
evamādīni cānyāni gṛhakarmāṇi yāni vai || etaiḥ kṛtā ca sā sevā kāyiketyabhidhīyate || 11 || dhānyasvarṇapaśukṣetradāsīdāsāṃbarāṇi ca || paryaṃkabhūṣaṇānyatra tripādacaṣakāni ca || 12 || caṃdanānyanulepoktadravyāṇi surabhīṇi ca || keśānulepadravyāṇi kastūryādīni yāni ca || 13 || turaṃgamagajāṃdolasyaṃdanāni śubhāni ca || teṣāṃ pradānaṃ sadbhaktyā ghanaśuśrūṣikā smṛtā || 14 || dravyasāmarthyasaṃpanno yaḥ kaścicchiṣyakassadā || sarvaśuśrūṣikāṃ kuryātsa gurorevabhaktitaḥ || 15 || nyāyārjitaṃ sthitaṃ svarṇamukhyaṃ yadvyāvahārataḥ || tadeva dravyaṃ gurave dadyāddāne hi tadvaraṃ || 16 || anyāyena yadānītaṃ puruṣeṇa tu kena cit || na dadyādgurave tattu ratnaṃ svarṇamapi kvacit || 17 || nūtanaṃ sadṛḍhaṃ snigdhaṃ dhavalaṃ netravallabham || dadyādācchādanaṃ bhaktyā gurave sarvadā budhaḥ || 18 || + viśīrṇaṃ sphuṭitaṃ dagdhaṃ prāktanaṃ svadhṛtaṃ purā || + daṣṭaṃ kīṭādibhirvastraṃ na dadyādgurave budhaḥ || 19 || paruṣaṃ duṣkriyāyuktaṃ nīlasūtravinirmitam || paṭṭavastretaraṃ vastraṃ sujīrṇaṃ na pradāpayet || 20 || paṭṭadevāṃgacīnāni vāsāṃsyanyāni yāni ca || citrāṇi dadyānnṛpatiritaro vā dhanādhipaḥ || 21 ||
guroḥ priyāṇi dravyāṇi yāni kāni cidanvahaṃ || tāni bhaktyā pradeyāni śiṣyeṇa sulabhāni vai || 22 || daridraśca svayaṃ śiṣyaḥ pratisaṃvatsaraṃ yajet || vāsaḥ prāvaraṇārthāya dadyāttannetravallabham || 23 || guruṃ svagṛhamāyāṃtaṃ dṛṣṭvā bhaktiyuto nṛpaḥ || tasmai datvāsanaṃ natvā cāgre tiṣṭhedanujñayā || 24 || ācāryacaraṇadvaṃdvaprakṣālitajalaṃ sadā || yaḥ pibeddhārayedbhaktyā sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate || 25 || caṃdanaṃ cākṣataṃ puṣpaṃ svarṇaṃ tāṃbūlamaṃbaram || pātre vidhāya gurave śiṣyo dadyātsvapāṇinā || 26 || saṃbhojayitvā svaguruṃ paścādbhuṃjīta buddhimān || guroḥ purastādyo bhuṃkte gurudrohī na saṃśayaḥ || 27 || yāni bhaktyā ca nūtnāni kaṃdamūlaphalāni ca || apūpānyapi cānyāni guroḥ pūrvaṃ na bhakṣayet || 28 || śiṣyeṇa bhojanātpūrvaṃ na bhoktavyaṃ kadācana || bhojanānaṃtare'śnīyātsvaguroryaḥ sa puṇyabhāk || 29 || yo bhaktyā guruṇā bhuktaṃ pātrasthaṃ na ca muṃcati || sa bhoktā sarvaduritairmucyate nātra saṃśayaḥ || 30 || tāṃbūlamuttamaṃ tasmai tataḥ pātreṇa dāpayet || paścādiṣṭāni vastūni datvā natvā samāpayet || 31 ||
gurupūjālakṣaṇam
pradattaṃ ca svaguruṇā tāṃbūlaṃ paricarvitam || śiṣyastadbhakṣayedbhaktyā śuddhāṃtaḥkaraṇo bhavet || 32 || śubhakāryeṣu sarveṣu vivāhādiṣu bhaktitaḥ || gurumabhyarcayecchiṣyo vastrahemādibhistadā || 33 || tatrāpi ca sabhāpūjāvidheḥ pūrvaṃ guruṃ yajet || tataḥ sabhāṃ yajedyogyaḥ krameṇaiva yathā śubham || 34 || sabhāṃtare guruṃ dhīmān kadācidapi nārcayet || āsanasthāṃ viśodhyāṃghrī gaṃdhapuṣpākṣatairyajet || 35 || tatorpayetsvagurave vastrahemāṃgulīyakān || daridraścoditeṣveṣu yathāśaktitvavaṃcayan || 36 || evamevārcayecchiṣyo guruṃ labdhadhanena vā || guruyātrā devayātrā tīrthayātreti ca tridhā || 37 || āsāṃ trividhayātrāṇāṃ guruyātrā phalādhikā || guroḥ saṃdarśanārthaṃ tu bhaktyā yātrāṃ karoti yaḥ || 38 || puṇyadehī sa vijñeyaḥ sa mastāmaravallabhaḥ || śiṣyo gurusthitaṃ grāmaṃ na viśedvāhanena ca || 39 || varjayedgṛhasāmīpye tathā vai pādukāni ca || gurordidṛkṣuryaḥ śiṣyaḥ sadbhaktyānudinaṃ tadā || 40 || riktapāṇirna taṃ paśyedyathā rājā tathā guruḥ || phalaṃ prasūnaṃ tāṃbūlamanyatkimapi vastu ca || 41 || eṣvekaṃ gurave datvā namaskuryāttatto gurum ||
śrīmāṃścāpi tapasvī ca śāstrajñaḥ kulaśīlavān || 42 || kuryāddaṃḍanamaskāraṃ nirlajjo gurusaṃnidhau || upacāreṣu sarveṣu dvāvevāṃtyaṃtaśobhanau || 43 || priyavāṇī praṇāmaśca tauvinānye vṛthā smṛtāḥ || agre dṛṣṭvā namaskṛtvā pradakṣiṇamanusmaran || 44 || pradakṣiṇaṃ ca kurvīta yathāśaktyanusārataḥ || pradakṣiṇajño yo dhīmānnatu dīrghapadaṃ nyaset || 45 || na gacchetvarito dhīmānnajalpeditaraiḥ saha || pade padāntaraṃ nyasya karau calanavarjitau || 46 || stutiṃ vācā hṛdā dhyānamevaṃ kuryātpradakṣiṇaṃ || evaṃ śiṣyaḥ śuciḥ kuryādbhaktyā saha parikramam || svaguroḥ purataḥ śiṣyo netarānkīrtayejjanān || 47 || asahyabhāṣaṇaṃ caiva na vadeditaretaram || nānṛtaṃ nāpriyaṃ vākyaṃ na guhyaṃ cāpi bhāṣayet || 48 || nāpracchannamukho brūyādguroragre kadācana || svāmibhaṭṭārakācāryadevaśrīgurunāmabhiḥ || 49 || vācyaḥ sadā guruḥ śiṣyairjātucinnānu nāmabhiḥ || tvaṃ śabdaṃ na prayuṃjīta gurau śiṣyaḥ kadācana || 50 || ājñāṃ na laṃghayettasya samaṃ nopaviśettathā || āsanaṃ vāhanaṃ vastraṃ bhūṣaṇaṃ śayanaṃ tathā || 51 || na kuryādgurusādṛśyaṃ gatisiddhihitecchukaḥ ||
gurusatkāralakṣaṇam
gurugehe samīpe vā na yatheṣṭāsano bhavet || 52 || gururdevo yataḥ sākṣāttadgṛhaṃ śivamaṃdiram || gurusthitasthalāduccaiḥsthale vā connatāsane || 53 || udagravedikāyāṃ tu śiṣyo nāsīta jātucit || 54 || nolbaṇaṃ dhārayedveṣaṃ nālaṃkārāṃśca jātucit || nānābhogādikānkuryānna vilāsaparo bhavet || 55 || na cottiṣṭhedviśennaiva na vṛthākāryamācaret || dīkṣāṃ vyākhyāṃ pramattatvaṃ guroragre vivarjayet || 56 || atihāsamavaṣṭaṃbhaṃ līlāmaṃghriprasāraṇam || vinodojvalaveṣaṃ ca paryaṃkaṃ daṃtadhāvanam || 57 || parvasphoṭavikāraṃ ca pādaprakṣālanaṃ tathā || tadvākyapratikūlaṃ ca na kuryādgurusaṃnidhau || 58 || pātraṃ snānajalaṃ chāyāṃ mālyopakaraṇāni ca || bhaktihīno'pi pādābhyāṃ na spṛśennaiva laṃghayet || 59 || pādukāsanaśayyādi guruṇā yadyadīhitaṃ || namaskurvīta tatsarvaṃ pādābhyāṃ naspṛśetkvacit || 60 || na gurorāśrame kuryādupānaṭparisarpaṇam || gacchataḥ pṛṣṭhato gacchedgurośchāyāṃ na laṃghayet || 61 || nopaviṣṭe bhavedūrdhvaṃ noccāsanagate viśet || paścātpādena nirgacchennamaskṛtvāgrato guroḥ || 62 ||
svagurormanasābhīṣṭaṃ yattadevācaretsudhīḥ || kāryavijñāpanārthaṃ tu gurūṇāṃ dūravāsināṃ || 63 || yā trirekhāvṛtā saṃkhyā ṣaḍityabhihitā budhaiḥ || tāḍapatraṃ dṛḍhaṃ saumyamṛjuṃ sāgraṃ dvidhā kṛtam || 64 || mṛdulaṃ yatpraśastaṃ tanmataṃ lekhāvilekhane || karkaśaṃ kalmaṣaṃ vakraṃ hīnāgraṃ sphuṭitaṃ yugam || 65 || tālapatraṃ na tacchreṣṭhaṃ mataṃ lekhāvilekhane || visargamātrānusvārairvarṇaspaṣṭa yathā bhavet || 66 || tathaiva vilikhetpatre chiṃdyādvarṇaṃ na jātucit || saṃdigdhaṃ chinnavarṇaṃ cāpraśastaṃ gūḍhabhāṣaṇam || 67 || na kadācillikhetpatre svācāryāya sadā sudhīḥ || praśastabhāṣāsaṃyuktaṃ vinayastutipūrvakam || 68 || vijñāpanīyaṃ gurave yatkāryaṃ tatsamālikhet || patraṃ cālpamiti jñeyaṃ pravilikhya prayojanam || 69 || gurorvijñāpanārthāya preṣayedaṃtikaṃ guroḥ || gacchaṃstiṣṭhansvapanjāgran yadyatkarma samācaret || 70 || samakṣaṃ tvaparokṣaṃ vā kartavyaṃ gurvanujñayā || gurorgurustasya gurustadguroragrajā api || 71 || tadbhāryāśca namaskuryātsadā vai prītivatsalaiḥ || tathāpi svaguroḥ putraṃ paśyedgurumivāparam || 72 ||
guruniṃdāniṣedhakathanam
ātmā vai putranāmāsīdāgamoktinidarśanāt || 73 || kadācidapi śiṣyo vai na niṃdedīśvaraṃ guruṃ || śivasya ca gurorniṃdāṃ tathā na śṛṇuyātsadā || 74 || svamātṛpitṛbhāryādibhrātṛbaṃdhusuteṣu ca || ye gurudveṣiṇastān hi natvā śiṣyaḥ parityajet || 75 || guruṃ niṃdati yaḥ śiṣyo dravyaṃ harati tasya ca || karoti dveṣibhiḥ snehaṃ sa cāṃḍālo na saṃśayaḥ (sa cāṃḍālasamaḥ smṛtaḥ) || 76 || sanmānaṃ gurubhāṣāyāṃ guroḥ śiṣyo ya icchati || sa mahāpātakī jñeyaḥ patatyeva sa durgatau || 77 || yaḥ paśyati guruṃ śiṣyaḥ sādhāraṇamanuṣyavat || tasya bhaktirvṛthā brahmannevāstyatra na saṃśayaḥ || 78 || yaḥ paśyati guruṃ śiṣyaḥ udāsīnamanīṣayā || sa pāpātmā mahā ghore narake parivartate || 79 || dūrato yo guruṃ dṛṣṭvā codāsīnatayā vrajet || śvānayoniśataṃ gatvā bhaveccāṃḍālaveśmani || 80 || samastadevatāvāsaṃ sarvamaṃtrāspadaṃ gurum || upekṣate yaḥ pāpātmā rauravaṃ narakaṃ vrajet || 81 || hṛdi nāyaṃ mamācārya ityupekṣāṃ karoti cet || mayi bhaktirvṛthā tasya tathaiva ca samarcanam || 82 ||
yogyamādyaṃ guruṃ tyaktvā śiṣyaḥ kṣudrakriyānvitam || guruṃ samāśrayedanyaṃ yaḥ sa yāti sudurgatiṃ || 83 || guroratyaṃtabhaktasya śiṣyasyeha paratra ca || na kiṃciddurlabhaṃ brahman samastaṃ sulabhaṃ sadā || 84 || atha kiṃ bahunoktena gurudevo maheśvaraḥ || pratyakṣe vā parokṣe vā guroḥprītiṃ samācaret || 85 || guruprītikaraḥ śiṣyo yaḥ sa prītikaro mama || tasya priyakaraḥ śiṣyo mama priyakaro bhṛśaṃ || 86 || tasmātsarvaprayatnena guroḥ prītikaro bhavet || gurubhaktiṃ vinā tasya mayi bhaktirvṛthā bhavet || 87 || śiṣyastasmātprayatnena gurau bhaktiṃ samācaret || yaḥ kaścidgurubhaktaḥ syātsa yāti paramāṃ gatim || 88 ||
[iti śrīvīraśaivācārapradīpikāyāṃ guruśuśrūṣālakṣaṇaṃ nāma daśamodhyāyaḥ] ||
|| śrīgurubhyo namaḥ ||
[atha ekādaśo'dhyāyaḥ] |
