viṣṇvādidevaiḥ paripūjitaṃ sadā svayaṃbhuvādyairmunibhiḥ supūjitam || namāmyahaṃ tvāmapavargasidhyai sadvidyayā kalpitajñānavigrahaṃ || 1 || lakṣmyādiśaktibhiścaiva pūjitāṃ tāṃ sadā mudā || maṃtrarūpāṃ mahādevīmannapūrṇāṃ namāmyahaṃ || 2 || (śiva eko dhyeyaḥ kathaṃ tarhītyāha atharvaṇavede) īśānaḥ śiva eko dhyeyaḥ śivaṃkaraḥ sarvamanyatparityajyeti || īśavānityatra chaṃdasi kvanibiti kvanippratyayaḥ || eka iti eka eva rudro na dvitīyāya tasthe iti || dyāvābhūmī janayandeva eka iti || sa śiva eka iti pratyahaṃ deva eka iti tamekaṃ puruṣaṃ rudramiti eko rudra ucyata iti ekatvamāha || śhrutiḥ paśūnāṃ rudraṃ yajeteti || brahmādayaḥ paśava iti rudraḥ paśūnāmadhipatiriti | brahmarudraśabdayoḥ paryāyatā eka eva rudro na dvitīyo'vatasthe ekamevādvitīyaṃ brahmeti parasparaṃ samānābhyāṃ śrutibhyāṃ madevasyāma iti(,) ghoraśivalakṣaṇayoḥ śrutisiddhayorīśvaratanvoḥ kāryabhedo'sti(,) (brahmagītāyāṃ)
aliṃgamekamavyaktaṃ liṃgaṃ brahmeti niścitamiti(,) paramāya namaḥ paramaliṃgāya namastasmātkāraṇātsakalaniṣkalātmakaśiva eko dhyeyaḥ pūjanīyaśca(,) (haṃsopaniṣadi) arūpe bhāvanā nāsti yadṛrśyaṃ tadvinaśyati || dṛśyādṛśyasvarūpatve tathā sevā sadābhyaset || (śivasaṃkalpopaniṣadi) yo'sau sarveṣu vedeṣu paṭhyate hyaja īśvaraḥ || akāyo nirguṇo hyātmā tanme manaḥ śivasaṃkalpamastu || (sūtasaṃhitāyāṃ) || ghṛtakāṭhiṇyasanmūrtiḥ saccidānaṃdalakṣaṇaḥ || śivādanyaśca naivāste śiva eva na cāparaḥ || 3 || devāḥ sarve muniśreṣṭhāḥ śivasyāmitatejasaḥ || aṃbikāyāḥ pateḥ śaṃbhoḥ pratyakṣaṃ karabilvavat || 4 || sarvopaniṣadāmarthaḥ śiva eva na cāparaḥ || ekamevaṃ hi tatjñānaṃ tathā jñānasya śāsanaṃ || 5 || ādityapurāṇe || tattatvaṃ yadbhagavato rūpamīśasya śūlinaḥ || akṣaraṃ paramaṃ vyoma śaivaṃ jyotirumāpatiḥ || 6 || yajurvede || śiva eva pūjyo bhavati || yajurvedarūpaḥ ekaḥ sa itaramahimānaṃ
śivasyopāsyatvakathanam
vyācaṣṭe (caturvedatātparyasaṃgrahe) ekaṃ mukhaṃ tritayamīśvaralocanānāṃ catvāri doṃṣi viśadaṃ vapuradbhutaṃ te || atyaṃtameva bhavatāmupakārahetornānā bhavaṃti tanavastava divyarūpāḥ || anaśvaratvādeva śarīramīśvarasya varṇakamātramityāhuḥ || aṃgaiḥsthirebhiriti rūpamanaśvaraṃ te bhūrīṇi tāni ca bhujaṃgamamālabhārin || 7 || sthirairaṃgaistuṣṭuvāṃsastanūbhiḥ (pradeśāntare) sthirairaṃgaiḥ pururūpa ugra iti || ajāta ityevamādiśruterviṣayavigrahatāṃ nītamityuktaṃ || (tathā yajurvede) ajāta ityeva kaścidbhīruḥ prapadya rudra yatte dakṣiṇaṃ mukhaṃ tena māṃ pāhi nityaṃ tathā ca jābālaśākhāyāṃ || pratyaṃjanastiṣṭhati sa yugasyāṃtakāle eka eva rudro na dvitīyāya tasthe || na brahmā na viṣṇurna sūryo nāgnirna caṃdratārakāḥ iti || asminnarthe skāṃde || viṣṇusaṃjñā hyasaṃkhyātā hyasaṃkhyātāḥ pitāmahāḥ || asaṃkhyātāḥ sureṃdrāśca nitya eko maheśvaraḥ || 8 || ādityapurāṇe || asaṃkhyātāśca kālāśca hyasaṃkhyātāḥ pitāmahāḥ || asaṃkhyātāśca harayo nitya eko maheśvaraḥ || 9 || tvaṃ viśvakartā tava nāsti kartā tvaṃ viśvabhartā tava nāsti bhartā || tvaṃ viśvahartā tava nāsti hartā tvaṃ viśvanāthastava nāsti nāthaḥ || 10 || brahmādikaṃ saka(-)
lamanyamapohya puṃsāṃ dhyātavyamevamabhidhāya śivaṃkaraṃ tvāṃ || vaktavyamanyamanapekṣya vimokṣahetumātharvaṇaḥ parisamāptimuvāca vedaḥ || 11 || ata eva anīśvaraḥ sakalaniṣkalātmakaḥ saccidānaṃdarūpaḥ sadāśivaḥ śivaṃkaraḥ śiva eva muktipradaḥ sa eva mumukṣubhiḥ pūjanīyaḥ sa eko dhyeyaḥ sarvamanyaṃ parityajya || mānavapurāṇe || atho mumukṣubhiḥ sarvaiḥ sāṃbaḥ sarveśvarāhvayaḥ || paratatvaviśeṣeṇa dhyeya eva sadā hṛdi || 12 || tasya śeṣatayā dhyeyā brahmaviṣṇvādi devatāḥ || kadācidapi mohādvai svapradhānatayā nahi || 13 || sarvamanyaṃ parityajedityāha cātharvaṇī śrutiḥ || dhyeyabhedena so'pyevamuttamādhamabhedataḥ || dvividhastatra devānāṃ śivasya dhyānamuttamam || 14 || viṣṇvādīnāṃ tu devānāṃ dhyānaṃ cādhamamiṣyate || atho mumukṣubhiḥ prājñaiḥ śiva eva śivaṃkaraḥ || 15 || dhyeyaḥ sarvānparityajya śivādanyattu daivatam || asminnarthe śrutiḥ sādhvī samāptā vedavittamāḥ || 16 || kvacitkadācidvedeṣu tadanyāḥ sarvadevatāḥ || jñeyatve cāṃga cocyaṃte dhyeyatve'pi tathaiva ca || 17 ||
śivasyopāsyatvakathanam
bahunoktena kiṃ viprāḥ śivo dhyeyaḥ śivaṃkaraḥ || śivādanyat parityajya daivataṃ bhuktimuktaye || 18 || (skāṃde vyāsaviṣṇusaṃvāde) jagāma śaraṇaṃ devaṃ sarvabhāvena śaṃkaram || saṃtyajya tṛṇavatsarvānbrahmaviṣṇvādikāṃstathā || 19 || (saurasaṃhitāyām) sarvāndevānparityajya yajetpaṃcāsyamīśvaram || sarvānmaṃtrānparityajya japetpaṃcākṣaraṃ sadā || 20 || brahmagītāyāṃ || viṣṇubhaktyā ca madbhaktyā nāsti nāsti parā gatiḥ || śaṃbhubhaktyaiva sarveṣāṃ satyameva mayoditam || 21 || kālikākhaṃḍe || śukavaddeva viśveśa krīḍāyai kevalaṃ vayaṃ || tavonmeṣanimeṣābhyāmasmākaṃ pralayodayau || 22 || (sūtasaṃhitāyām ) atho mahādevaśivādiśabdaṃ paraṃ mudā nityamataṃdritaśca || vihāya nārāyaṇanāmapūrvakaṃ japedaśeṣāśubhanāśanāya || 23 || śāṃbhavapurāṇe || nārāyaṇādināmāni na pratyakṣakarāṇi vai || nāmānīti parijñānamalpasya tapasaḥ phalaṃ || 24 || parāśarapurāṇe || nārāyaṇo harirviṣṇurmukuṃdaḥ keśavocyutaḥ || evamādīni nāmāni naiva tatvaparāṇi vai || 25 ||
paratattvopadeśasya saṃnidhau paṭhitā api || śabdāḥ kathaṃcidyogena pravartaṃte na mukhyatā || 26 || viṣṇunārāyaṇādyaistu nāmabhiḥ sakalairapi || śrutismṛtipurāṇoktairnocyate paramaṃ padaṃ || 27 || mānavapurāṇe || nārāyaṇādināmāni visṛjya suvicārataḥ || japecchivādināmāni sadyo muktiṃ ya icchati || 28 || nārāyaṇādināmnaḥ nirvacanaṃ kāraṇāgame || āpo nārāyaṇo rudraḥ puruṣaḥ kṛṣṇapiṃgalaḥ || tasmādbhavaṃti vai hyāpo nārāyaṇa iti smṛtaḥ || 29 || skāṃde || āpo nārā iti proktā nārā vai narasūnavaḥ || tā yadasyāyanaṃ tena proktonārāyaṇaḥ svayam || 30 || tathā ca liṃgapurāṇe || āpo narasya tanayetyapāṃ nāmāni śuśrumaḥ || āpūrya tābhirayanaṃ kṛtavānātmano yataḥ || apsu śete yatastasmādvāsudeveti viśrutaḥ || 31 || śivarahasye || divyavarṣasahasrāṃte jaṭharāttasya dhīmataḥ || adhodvārāddhi niṣkrāṃto bhavāmyahamadhokṣajaḥ || 32 || evamādīni nāmāni paratattvaparāṇi vai || na bhavaṃti tasmāttāni mumukṣubhirna smartavyāni || vāyavyasaṃhitāyāṃ ||
śivamyopāsyatvakathanam
alpāndevānparityajya karmaṇā manasā girā || tameva sāṃbamīśānaṃ bhaja bhāvapuraḥsaram || 33 || parāśarapurāṇe || vihāya śaṃkaraṃ devaṃ (vihāya sāṃbamīśānaṃ) bhajaṃte devatāṃtaram || te mahāghorasaṃsāre pataṃti parimohitāḥ || 34 || vihāya sāṃbamīśānaṃ ye bhajaṃti vimuktaye || te mahātamasākrāṃtā na teṣāṃ paramā gatiḥ || 35 || devanikāye devasyaiva brāhmaṇyaṃ brahmaṇopāsyatvaṃ ca prapadamaṃtrasiddhamiti || (tātparyasaṃgrahe ) || tvaṃ brāhmaṇastvadupadhāvanameva kāryaṃ tadbrāhmaṇaistvaditare na bhavaṃtyupāsyāḥ || abrāhmaṇo dvijavarasya ca sevanena saṃbhāvya eva khalu naḥ prapadaṃ pramāṇam || 36 || prapadākhyo hi maṃtraśca sāmavedaprasiddhaḥ sa yathā || śrutiḥ || tvaṃ vedeṣu brāhmaṇosyahaṃ manuṣyeṣu brāhmaṇo brāhmaṇo vai brāhmaṇamupadhāvatyupadhāvati || asminnarthe parāśarapurāṇe || tato viprasya saṃbaṃdho śivenaiva hi pūjyate || saṃkarāḥ sarvadevāśca vṛṣalastu puraṃdaraḥ || 37 || pitāmahastu vaiśyaḥ syātkṣatriyaḥ paramo hariḥ || brāhmaṇo bhagavānrudraḥ sarveṣāmuttamottamaḥ || 38 ||
brahmabhāvo hi rudrasya brāhmaṇyaṃ naiva hetujam || brāhmaṇo vai sadā loke brāhmaṇaṃ copadhāvati || 39 || mahābrāhmaṇamīśānamupadhāveta netarān || sadā mahāṃtamātmānaṃ virūpākṣaṃ dvijottamaḥ || 40 || (asminnarthe vātulataṃtre) || rudra eva sadā sākṣādbrāhmaṇo brahmabhāvataḥ || brāhmaṇaiḥ paṭhitastasmādbrāhmaṇo rudra eva hi || 42 || prajānāṃ pālako rājā viṣṇuḥ sarvasya pālakaḥ || tena rājā haristasya brāhmaṇyaṃ tvaupacārikam || 42 || jagadvistaraṇe caiva kāryavān bhagavānajaḥ || kevalaṃ vaiśya eva syānna rājā na dvijottamaḥ || 43 || rājādhirājaḥ sarveṣāṃ tryaṃbakastripurāṃtakaḥ || tasyaivānucarāḥ sarve brahmaviṣṇupurogamāḥ || tasmādbrāhmaṇānāṃ svakīyadevatā mahābrāhmaṇo rudra eva samupāsyaḥ || 44 || yajurvede || yo vai svāṃ devatāṃ atikramya yajate || prasvāyai devatāyai cyavate na parāṃ prāpnoti pāpīyān bhavati || (śivasaṃkalpopaniṣadi) parātparataro brahmā yatparātparato hariḥ || tatparātparatastvīśastanme manaḥ śivasaṃkalpamastu || purāṇāṃtare || prajāpaterapi brahmā brahmaṇo viṣṇurāstikāḥ || viṣṇorapi harastasmānmahān sākṣānmaheśvaraḥ || 45 ||
śivasyopāsyatvakathanam
ityādivākyaiḥ anekaśrutipurāṇāgamavākyapramāṇaiḥ pratipādyamānasya parātparasya śrīmahādevasya divyaśrīpādapadmayugayornamaskāraḥ kārya itareṣāṃ na kāryaḥ || tatkathamityukte || (yajurāraṇyake taittarīye) yasmai namaḥ || tacchirodharmo mūrdhā brahmottarā hanuryajñodo viṣṇurayaṃ saṃvatsaraḥ || prajananamaśvinau pūrvapādāvatrimadhyamitrāvaruṇāvaparapādāvagniḥ pucchasya prathamakāṃḍaṃ || tata indrastataḥ prajāpatirabhayaṃ caturthaṃ samavāye divyaśākvaraḥ śiṃśumāraḥ || (ṛgvede) stuhi śrutaṃ gartasadaṃ yuvānaṃ mṛgannabhīmamupahatnumugraṃ mṛḍājaritre rudrastavāno anyante asminnivapantu senāḥ || (asminnarthe skāṃde) || citte dhyātvā prāṇaliṃgaṃ pūjāṃ tāṃ kurute svayam || tasmāttrikaraṇānāṃ tu śuddhā pūjā vidhīyate || 46 || ityādiśrutyāgamādibhiḥ śiva eka eva dhyeyaḥ pūjanīyaḥ || viṣṇvādipūjakā adhamā na darśanīyāḥ na saṃbhāṣyā iti || kiṃca jananamaraṇasaṃsārānalasaṃdagdhā harimukhyadevatā vihāya śiva eka eva nityaḥ akhilabaṃdhavimokṣaka iti jñātvā karuṇāsamudraṃ parameśvaraṃ śrutiḥ śaraṇaṃ jagāma || tatkathamityukte || iyaṃ śrutiḥ || oṃ ajāta ityeva kaścidbhīruḥ prapadyate rudra yatte dakṣiṇaṃ mukhaṃ tena māṃ pāhi nityaṃ || ādityapurāṇe || yasya pādarajasparśādbrahmatvaṃ prāptavānahaṃ ||
śārṅiṇāpi tato mūrdhnā dhṛtvā viṣṇutvamāptavān || 47 || sūtasaṃhitāyām || yastu liṃgārcanaṃ tyaktvā devānanyāṃśca pūjayet || ratnaṃ vihāya muḍhātmā yathā kācamapekṣate || 48 || brahmaviṣṇvorna vaktavyaṃ brāhmaṇaiḥ pūjanaṃ kvacit || satataṃ pūjayedrudraṃ brahmaviṣṇū parityajet || 49 ||
[iti śrīvīraśaivācārapradīpikāyāṃ pūjāprakaraṇe itaradevatāparityāgo nāma ekādaśo'dhyāyaḥ] ||
[atha dvādaśo'dhyāyaḥ] |
|| śrīgurubhyo namaḥ ||
atha sarvadevatārādhyatvaṃ tatphalaṃ vakṣyāmi || ṛgvede || tava śriyo maruto'rcayaṃtaḥ rudra yatte janima cāru citram || padaṃ yadviṣṇoḥ paramaṃ nyadhāyi iti || asminnarthe (parāśarapurāṇe) rudraliṃgaṃ mahāviṣṇurgopyāgopyaṃ śilāmayaṃ || cāru citraṃ samabhyarcya prāptavān paramaṃ padam || 1 || sā ca lakṣmīḥ samākhyātā mahāviṣṇostu vallabhā || yasya liṃgaṃ samabhyarcya sā pūjyā sarvacetanaiḥ || 2 || brahmā sarvajagatkartā yasya liṃgārcanena vai || bhāratīmāptavānāśu sa pūjyaḥ sarvacetanaiḥ || 3 || yasya liṃgārcanenaiva vallabhāśca svabhartṛṣu || śacī devī striyaścānyāḥ saṃpūjyā sarvacetanaiḥ || 4 || (puruṣasūkte) || yajñena yajñamayajaṃta devāstāni dharmāṇi prathamānyāsan || te ha nākaṃ mahimānaḥ sacaṃta yatra pūrve sādhyāḥ saṃti devāḥ || (śivadharme)||
yasya liṃgaṃ samabhyarcya marutaḥ sakalā api || prapedire śriyaḥ pūrṇāste pūjyāḥ sarvacetanaiḥ || 5 || iṃdranīlamayaṃ liṃgaṃ viṣṇuḥ pūjayate sadā || viṣṇutvaṃ prāpa caitena sarvadaikaṃ sanātanam || 6 || (tathā ca vāyavyasaṃhitāyām) || tato janārdanastuṣṭo padaṃ prāpya maheśvarāt || jagāma bhāsvaraṃ ramyaṃ vaikuṃṭhaṃ sthānamuttamam || 7 || (liṃgapurāṇe) || padmapuṣpasahasraiśca pādāvabhyarcya bhaktitaḥ || arcayitvā pareśaṃ tu stutavānmadhusūdanaḥ || 8 || ekaṃ nyūnaṃ sahastrāṇāṃ puṣkarāṇāṃ ca puṣkaram || apūjayatsvayaṃ netramekamuddhṛtya mādhavaḥ || 9 || tadāprabhṛti taṃ prāhuḥ padmākṣamiti suvratāḥ || tadarthaṃ nayanaṃ cakraṃ viṣṇave nīlalohitaḥ || 10 || (skāṃde vyāsajaiminisaṃvāde) || brahmā pūjayate nityaṃ liṃgaṃ śailamayaṃ śubhaṃ || tasya saṃpūjanāttena brahmatvaṃ prāptamuttamam || 11 || śakro'pi devarājeṃdro liṃgaṃ maṇimayaṃ śubham || bhaktyā pūjayate tena nityaṃ śakratvamāptavān || 12 || talliṃgaṃ mṛṇmayaṃ puṇyamagniryajati bhāvataḥ || agnitvaṃ prāpa caitena tejobhūtamaniṃditam || 13 || liṃgaṃ ratnamayaṃ cāru varuṇo'rcayate sadā || tena tadvaruṇatvaṃ hi prāpa tadvṛddhisattamam || 14 ||
śivapūjāphalanirūpaṇam
vāyuḥ pūjayate nityaṃ liṃgaṃ paittalakaṃ śubham || vāyutvaṃ tena saṃprāptamanaupamyaguṇānvitam || 15 || liṃgaṃ hemamayaṃ bhaktyā dhanado'rcayate sadā || tenāsau dhanado devo dhanadatvamavāptavān sadā || 16 || tāmraliṃgaṃ sarvadā vai bhaktyā pūjayate raviḥ || trikālaṃ yajatā tena prāptaṃ sūryatvamuttamam || 17 || muktāphalamayaṃ liṃgaṃ somaḥ pūjayate sadā || tena somena saṃprāptaṃ somatvaṃ satatojvalam || 18 || kaṃdarpo'rcayate nityaṃ liṃgaṃ puṣpamayaṃ śubham || tena kāmatvamāpnoti trailokyavijayaṃ sadā || 19 || viśvedevā mahātmāno raupyaliṃgaṃ manoharam || yajaṃte vidhivadbhaktyā tena viśvatvamāpnuyuḥ || 20 || vasavaḥ kāṃsyakaṃ liṃgaṃ pūjayaṃti vidhānataḥ || prāpnuyuste mahātmāno vasutvaṃ sumanoharam || 21 || aśvinau pārthivaṃ liṃgaṃ pūjayaṃtau vidhānataḥ || tena tāvaśvinau devau divyadehadharāvubhau || 22 || sarvalohamayaṃ liṃgaṃ yajaṃte mātaraḥ sadā || mātṛtvaṃ prāpnuyustena sarvalokeṣu durlabham || 23 || ayomayaṃ paraṃ liṃgaṃ pūjayaṃte'surottamāḥ || rākṣasāśca mahātmānaḥ prāpnuyustena vikramam || 24 || divyaṃ trapumayaṃ liṃgaṃ piśācāḥ pūjayaṃti te || divyaiśvaryasamāyuktāḥ prayāṃti paramaṃ padam || 25 || trailohikamayaṃ liṃgaṃ yajaṃte guhyakādayaḥ || tena bhogaphalopetāḥ prayāṃti paramaṃ padam || 26 ||
supravālamayaṃ liṃgaṃ yajaṃte pannagottamāḥ || tena nāgāḥ subhogāḍhyāḥ prāpnuyuste paraṃ padaṃ || 27 || evaṃ devāśca gaṃdharvāḥ sayakṣoragarākṣasāḥ || pūjayaṃti sadā kālamīśānaṃ suranāyakam || 28 ||
[iti vīraśaivācārapradīpikāyāṃ pūjāprakaraṇe sarvadevatārādhanaṃ nāma dvādaśo'dhyāyaḥ] ||
[atha trayodaśo'dhyāyaḥ] |
|| śrīgurubhyo namaḥ ||
atha śivaliṃgapūjāmāhātmyaṃ vakṣyāmi || (ekapādapurāṇe) kailāsaśikharāsīnaṃ devadevaṃ jagadgurum || kamalodarasaṃkāśaṃ kamalākṣaśubhānanam || 1 || kālapāśanibaddhānāṃ kālanirṇāśakaṃ paraṃ || kalādharaṃ kalātītaṃ kālarūpaṃ paraṃ śivam || 2 || kālī kalā svayaṃ gaurī kāṃtā kamalalocanā || caraṇe patitā devī sānaṃdovāca pārvatī || 3 || (pārvatyuvāca) bhagavan devadeveśa sarvajña parameśvara || pṛcchāmi saṃśayaṃ deva maheśvara hitāya vai || 4 || liṃgasya darśanādeva sparśanenāpi kiṃ phalam || arcite saṃstute liṃge phalamākhyāhi śaṃkara || 5 || īśvara uvāca || sādhu sādhu mahābhāge bhaktānāṃ bhaktavatsale || liṃgasya darśanātpāpaṃ kṣayaṃ gacchati vai priye || 6 || (laiṃge) liṃgasya darśanātprātarniśi pāpaṃ vyapohati || ājanma jantormādhyāhne saptajanmakṛtaṃ niśi || 7 || (kūrmapurāṇe) trayodaśyāṃ tathā rātrau sopahāraṃ trilocanaṃ ||
dṛṣṭveśaṃ prathame yāme mucyate sarvapātakaiḥ || 8 || koṭijanmakṛtaṃ pāpaṃ virūpākṣasya darśanāt || tatsarvaṃ naśyati kṣipraṃ vahninā tūlabhāravat || 9 || (graṃthāṃtare) abhakṣyabhakṣako vāpi brahmahā yadi mātṛhā || pitṛhā bālaghātī ca goghnaḥ strīśūdraghātakaḥ || 10 || vaktā ca paradoṣāṇāṃ parasya guṇadūṣakaḥ || kṛpaṇo'nṛtavādī ca maṇiratnāpahārakaḥ || 11 || sarvapāpayutaḥ putra mucyate liṃgadarśanāt || jātismaratvamaiśvaryaṃ vidyājñānaṃ prajāsukham || 12 || ajñānādvā bhayādvāpi dṛṣṭvā prāpnoti śaṃkaram || liṃgasya darśanaṃ puṇyaṃ darśanāt sparśanaṃ śubham || 13 || (śivadharme) śivaliṃgaṃ mahāpuṇyaṃ sarvadevanamaskṛtam || yaḥ spṛśedapi pāṇibhyāṃ na pāpaiḥ parilipyate || 14 || (umāmaheśvarasaṃvāde) karāṃganyāsaśuddhiśca dehaśuddhistathaiva ca || sarvaśuddhirbhavennityaṃ liṃgasparśanadarśanāt || 15 || mātṛhā pitṛhā caiva vīrahā bhrūṇahāpi vā || amaṃtrī vā śivaṃ spṛṣṭvā sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate || 16 ||
śivārādhanaphalam
sarvadā sparśanenāpi gāṇapatyaṃ bhavettataḥ || arcitaṃ bhaktibhāvena dadyānmokṣaṃ na saṃśayaḥ || 17 || śṛṇu devi pravakṣyāmi liṃgārādhanataḥ phalaṃ || sarvadānaphalaṃ devi sarvatīrthaphalaṃ ca yat || 18 || sarvayāgaphalaṃ yacca yacca puṇyaṃ tapoditam || tatsarvaṃ samavāpnoti paratra sukhamedhate || 19 || liṃgasyābhyarcanenaiva sarvapāpakṣayo bhavet || sarvadānaphalāvāptirbhavatīti na saṃśayaḥ || 20 || tīrthakoṭisahasreṣu kṛtasnānasya yatphalam || tatphalaṃ samavāpnoti liṃgasyābhyarcane kṛte || 21 || yāni kāni ca tīrthāni samudrādisarāṃsi ca || teṣāṃ snānena yatpuṇyaṃ liṃgasyābhyarcanena tat || 22 || merupṛṣṭhe prayāge ca gaṃgāsāgarasaṃgame || himālaye tapastaptaṃ tatphalaṃ liṃgapūjane || 23 || cāṃdrāyaṇasahasrāṇi taptakṛchraśatāni ca || sarvavratāni cīrṇāni liṃgasyābhyarcane kṛte || 24 || gavāṃ koṭisahasrasya yajñakoṭiśatasya ca || dāne tatphalamāpnoti sakṛdabhyarcane kṛte || 25 || sakṛdabhyarcite liṃge divaṃ gacchaṃti mānuṣāḥ || siddhāḥ śivapuraṃ yāṃti krīḍaṃte kālamakṣayam || 26 || bhūlokaśca bhuvarlokaḥ svarlokaśca mahastathā ||
janastapastataḥ satyaṃ sapta lokāḥ prakīrtitāḥ || 27 || sakṛdabhyarcite liṃge teṣu vāso'bhidhīyate || janmakoṭisahasraiśca saṃcaradbhiśca yoniṣu || 28 || sakṛdabhyarcite liṃge muktāḥ saṃsārabaṃdhanāt || truṭīkalānimeṣāśca kāṣṭārdhapraharāṇi vai || 29 || arcayaṃti mahādevaṃ te yāṃti paramāṃ gatim || na pūjayaṃti ye liṃgamiṣṭāpūrtyai tu mohitāḥ || yonikoṭisahasreṣu nirgacchaṃti viśaṃti te || 30 || svarge yajñaphalaṃ bhuktvā dātā dharmasya yatphalaṃ || garbhavāseṣu jāyeta liṃgārcanavivarjitaḥ || 31 || gāṇapatyena ca tathā mokṣo na bhavati dhruvam || liṃgārcanaratānāṃ ca garbhajanma na vidyate || 32 || garbhavāsabhayādbhītā liṃgārcanaparāyaṇāḥ || ete mama gaṇā devi bhavaṃti ca suśobhane || 33 || yastu pūjayate nityaṃ liṃgaṃ tribhuvaneśvaram || sa svargamokṣarājyasya kṣipraṃ bhavati bhājanam || 34 || ye'pekṣaṃte mahābhogānbhojyānvā tridaśālayam || te'rcayaṃti sadā bhaktyā harasya caraṇāṃbujaṃ || 35 || (vyāsa uvāca) bhavanāni manojñāni vibhramābharaṇāḥ striyaḥ || dhanaṃ vai tṛptiparyantaṃ śivapūjāvidheḥ phalam || 36 || saubhāgyaṃ kāṃtimadrūpaṃ satyaṃ tyāgaṃ pravaktṛtā ||
śauryaṃ jagadviśṛtiśca śivapūjāvidheḥ phalaṃ || 37 || vyāsasya kapilasyāpi vidyābhogo bhavetsadā || bhaveddānaprabhāvaśca śivapūjāvidheḥ phalam || 38 || vidyālābho dhanaṃ saukhyaṃ kulīnatvaṃ manogatam || rājyaṃ mokṣaṃ ca nāko vā śivapūjāvidheḥ phalaṃ || 39 || brahmāṃḍe siddhiyogaṃ ca pātāle ca mahītale || aprāpyaṃ labhate yasya śivapūjāvidheḥ phalam || 40 || dvāre vai mattamātaṃgā vāyuvegāsturaṃgamāḥ || pūrṇeṃduvadanā nāryaḥ śivapūjāvidheḥ phalam || 41 || brahmaṇaḥ sṛṣṭikartṛtvaṃ viṣṇordānavamardanam || svargādhipatyamiṃdrasya śivapūjāvidheḥ phalam || 42 || surāsuranarā ye ca pūjayaṃti maheśvaram || bhuktvā tu vipulānbhogāṃste yāṃti paramāṃ gatim || 43 || pūjāṣṭakamidaṃ puṇyaṃ yaḥ paṭhecchivasaṃnidhau || śivalokamavāpnoti śivena saha modate || 44 || yo na pūjayate mohālliṃgaṃ tribhuvaneśvaram || na ca svargasya mokṣasya na rājyasyāpi bhājanam || 45 || agnihotrāśca vedāśca yajñāśca bahudakṣiṇāḥ || śivaliṃgārcanasyaite koṭyaṃśenāpi no samāḥ || 46 || yo dadāti gavāṃ lakṣaṃ dogdhrīṇāṃ vedapārage ||
ekāhamarcayelliṃgaṃ tasya puṇyaṃ tatodhikam || 47 || sarvavedeṣu yatpuṇyaṃ sarvayajñeṣu yatphalam || tatphalāt koṭiguṇitaṃ labhate nātra saṃśayaḥ || 48 || apyekadivasaṃ bhaktyā yaḥ pūjayati śaṃkaram || sopi yāti śivasthānaṃ kiṃ punarbahuśo'rcanāt || 49 || satataṃ pūjayedyo hi mānavastu dine dine || na tasya punarāvṛttiḥ saṃsāre bhavati kvacit || 50 || ye'rcayaṃti sadā rudraṃ na te prakṛtimānuṣāḥ || rudralokātparibhraṣṭāste rudrā nātra saṃśayaḥ || 51 || yaḥ sarvadā'rcayelliṃgaṃ sa rudra iva bhūtale || pāpahā sarvabhūtānāṃ darśanātsparśanādapi || 52 || liṃgārcanarato nityaṃ mahāpātakasaṃbhavaiḥ || doṣaiḥ kṛtairna lipyaṃte padmapatramivāṃbhasā || 53 || chitvā bhitvā ca bhūtāni hatvā sarvamidaṃ jagat || yajedekaṃ virūpākṣaṃ sa pāpairna ca lipyate || 54 || merumaṃdāratulyopi rāśiḥ pāpasya karmaṇaḥ || īśvaraṃ vaidyamāsādya naśyate duṣṭarogavat || 55 || na tatra deśe durbhikṣaṃ na ca mārīpravartanam || nākāle pīḍyate rājā pūjyate yatra śaṃkaraḥ || 56 || krīḍālobhādbhayādvāpi mohāddaṃbhena vā kvacit || yena kena prakāreṇa dhanyaḥ pūjayate śivam || 57 ||
pṛthivyāṃ yāni tīrthāṇi puṇyānyāyatanāni ca || līyaṃte liṃgamūle tu tasmālliṃgaṃ prapūjayet || 58 || tvaritaṃ jīvitaṃ yāti tvaritaṃ yāti yauvanam || naśyatyāyustvareṇaiva tasmātpūjaya śaṃkaram || 59 || yāvanna yāti maraṇaṃ yāvannākramate jarā || yāvanneṃdriyaśaithilyaṃ tāvatpūjaya śaṃkaram || 60 || ye narāḥ sakṛdapyatra pūjayaṃti trilocanam || te dhanyāste mahātmānaste kṛtārthāśca paṃḍitāḥ || 61 || vṛttaṃ || ye vāmadevaṃ hi yajaṃti nityaṃ sadbhaktiśīlāḥ śivaliṃgamūrtiṃ || te dhvastaduḥkhā hi bhavaṃti martyā bhavāṃburāśiṃ viṣamaṃ taraṃti || 62 || tasmātsarveṣaṇāṃ tyaktvā śivaikagatamānasaḥ || dharmārthakāmamokṣārthaṃ pūjanīyaśca śaṃkaraḥ || 63 || yajanaṃ dvividhaṃ jñeyaṃ bāhyābhyaṃtarabhedataḥ || sarveṣāṃ bāhyapūjā ca yatīnāmaṃtarārcanam || 64 || tairaṃtaryajanaṃ kāryaṃ bahiryajanapūrvakam || bahiryajanahīnaḥ syādaṃtayāgo na sidhyati || 65 || sarveṣāṃ ca bahiryāgastatvarūpo nirūpyate || svārthaṃ parārthakaṃ ceti yajanaṃ dvividhaṃ bhavet || svārthaṃ dīkṣottare kāle gurau datte svaliṃgake || 66 || yajanaṃ svārthasiddhyarthamevaṃ svārthamudāhṛtaṃ || grāmādau sthāpite liṃge yadvā devādinirmite ||
parārthamiti vijñeyaṃ sarvaprāṇihitāya vai || 67 ||
[iti śrīvīraśaivācārapradīpikāyāṃ pūjāprakaraṇe śivaliṃgapūjāmāhātmyakathanaṃ nāma trayodaśo'dhyāyaḥ] ||
[atha caturdaśo'dhyāyaḥ] |
śrīgurubhyo namaḥ ||
atha śivapūjāyāḥ kālaṃ dinācārakramaṃ ca vakṣyāmi || kartṛkālakriyābhedā iti proktāḥ śivārcane || uttamā dṛṣṭanakṣatrā madhyamā luptatārakāḥ || 1 || ardhoditāruṇā hīnā prātaḥsaṃdhyā tridhā matā || ardhārkamaṃḍalā śreṣṭhā madhyamāstamite ravau || 2 || kaniṣṭhā dṛṣṭanakṣatrā sāyaṃsaṃdhyā tridhā matā || madhyamāṃ madhyame cārke tāṃ ca saṃdhyāṃ samabhyaset || 3 || vidhānaṃ śivapūjāyāḥ kathyate ca yathākramam || divā kāle'rcanaṃ neṣṭaṃ niśi kāle'rcanaṃ tathā || 4 || divārātrau parityajya deśikaḥ samyagarcayet || sarvabhūtamanaścakṣurvṛttisthau śaśibhāskarau || 5 || manasā bhidyate dṛṣṭirdṛṣṭyā bhidyeta mānasaṃ || yāvatpūjāsamāptiḥ syāttāvaccakṣurmanogatam || nānyekṣaṇo nānyamanāḥ kuryālliṃgārcanaṃ sadā || 6 || śaṃkarasaṃhitāyāṃ || dinācārayutaṃ deva liṃgārcanavidhiṃ mama || vaktumarhasi deveśa kṛpayā bhaktavatsala || 7 ||
īśvara uvāca ||
vadāmi saṃgraheṇāhaṃ pṛcchatastava ṣaṇmukha || saṃsāraduḥkhapāśaghnaṃ vatsa mokṣaikasādhanaṃ || 8 ||
amaṃgalaścāpi mṛtyuḥ sarveṣāṃ dehināṃ bhavet || taddoṣaparihārārthaṃ dinācāraḥ prakathyate || 9 || dakṣiṇāyāṃ diśi śiro nyasyedyaḥ paścime mukhaṃ || kuryātsavyena śayanamutthānamapasavyataḥ || 10 || brāhme muhūrte cotthāya dhyāyettaṃ śaṃkaraṃ śuciḥ || umāṃ dharmaṃ dhanaṃ doṣavarjitaṃ dinakarma ca || 11 || dhanāddharmapravṛttiḥ syānnarāṇāṃ dharmacāriṇām || dharmātprasīdati śivaściṃtanāddhi dhanāgamaḥ (ciṃtayeddhi dhanāgamam ||) || 12 || viśiṣṭe ca same biṃdormūrdhni nirvāṇadīkṣitaḥ || ācāryaṃ sādhakaścaivaṃ dvādaśāṃte viciṃtayet || 13 ||
prātarutthitasya kartavyakathanam
nāmāni cāsya hṛdyāni caritrāṇi ca kīrtayet || 14 || graṃthāṃtare || atho maṃgalavādyānāṃ śṛṇvangītaṃ mṛdudhvaniṃ || śaṃkhadvayasunādaṃ ca nidrāṃ caṃdrasvarāttyajet || 15 || puṇyakṣetraṃ puṇyatīrthaṃ puṇyaratnaṃ ca sajjanam || prāgeva dakṣiṇaṃ pāṇitalamālokayennijaṃ || 16 || vāmabhāgasthitāṃ nārīṃ nijapuṇyaprakāśinīṃ || darpaṇaṃ pūrṇakuṃbhaṃ ca vṛṣabhaṃ yugmacāmaram || śrīvatsaṃ svastikaṃ śaṃkhamevamaṣṭāṃgamaṃgalam || 17 || vṛ0 || kubjaṃ niṣṭhuramaṃdhamūkarajakān kaivartakaṃ nāpitaṃ nārīṃ cāpi rajasvalāṃ prarudatīṃ nirbhartṛkāṃ bhikṣukīṃ || śūrpaṃ pāśamulūkhalaṃ tuṣakaṇān kāṣṭhaṃ tṛṇaṃ mārjanīṃ mārjāroragagau(?)(?)yajādimahiṣānniṃdyānna paśyedbudhaḥ || 18 || pathi goṣṭhe nadītīre chāyāyāṃ kūpasaṃnidhau || tuṣāṃgārakapāleṣu kṛṣikṣetre catuṣpathe || 19 || nodyāne ca smaśāne ca na paśyaṃstārakādikān || na caivābhimukhaṃ strīṇāṃ guruśāṃbhavayorgavāṃ || agnerabhimukhaṃ tiṣṭhan viṣṭhāṃ mūtraṃ na cotsṛjet || 20 || tato gṛhādvinirgatya bahirgacchedataṃdritaḥ || vāgyataḥ pṛthivībhāgamiṣuvikṣepamātrakaṃ || 21 || tatrāstīrya tṛṇairbhūmiṃ malamūtraṃ samutsṛjet || dakṣiṇābhimukho rātrau divā kuryādudaṅmukhaḥ || 22 ||
niṣṭhīvenna vadedvākyaṃ (niṣṭhīvedvisṛjedvākyaṃ) vastreṇāvṛtamastakaḥ || maunī nāsāgradṛgyukto malamūtraṃ visarjayet || 23 || graṃthāṃtare || viṇmūtrotsarjanaṃ kuryādgatvā deśaṃ yathocitam || evaṃ śaucavidhiṃ kuryādgaṃdhalepakṣayāvadhi || 24 || śaucācāravihīnasya samastā niṣphalāḥ kriyāḥ || śaucaṃ tu dvividhaṃ proktaṃ bāhyābhyaṃtarabhedataḥ || 25 || mṛjjalābhyāṃ bhavedbāhyaṃ bhāvaśuddhistathāṃtaraṃ || atyaṃtamalino deho dehī cātyaṃtanirmalaḥ || 26 || ubhayoraṃtarajñāne tasya śaucaṃ vidhīyate || mārgamadhye devagehe valmīke mūṣakasthale || 27 || aśuddhadeśe śaucārthaṃ na grāhyā paṃca mṛttikāḥ || (pāṭhāntare 2 śuddhāmaśakalāṃ mṛdvīṃ mṛdaṃ śaucārthamāharet) śuddhadeśasthitāṃ caiva mṛdaṃ śaucārthamāharet || 28 || śuklā tu brāhmaṇasyoktā raktā tu kṣatriyasya ca || vaiśyasya pītavarṇā syātkṛṣṇā śūdrasya mṛttikā || 29 || prakṣālayedgudaṃ śiśnaṃ mṛdbhirapyuddhṛtairjalaiḥ || ekaṃ liṃge gude paṃca tathaiva karapallave || 30 || caryāyogoditaṃ śaucaṃ mṛdgṛhītvā malatrayam || etacchaucaṃ gṛhasthānāṃ dviguṇaṃ brahmacāriṇāṃ || 31 ||
śaucādividhānakathanam
triguṇaṃ syādvanasthānāṃ yatīnāṃ ca caturguṇaṃ || śaucametaddivā proktaṃ rātrāvuktārdhamācaret || 32 || gaṃdhalepanivṛttyarthaṃ śaucaṃ kuryādvicakṣaṇaḥ || yāvanmātraṃ manaḥśuddhistāvanmātraṃ samācaret || 33 || ācamya vidhivadvatsa kṛtvā maṃtreṇa mārjanam || śrīmatpaṃcākṣareṇaiva gāyitryā śaivayā tathā || 34 || snāyādviśuddhabhāvena naraḥ saṃkalpapūrvakam || nadyāṃ taṭāke vāpyāṃ vā giriprasravaṇe hrade || 35 || uddhṛtairudakaiḥ kūpāddakṣaḥ snānaṃ samācaret || saraḥsu devakhāteṣu snānamuttamamucyate || 36 || śivālayasamīpasthaṃ svalpaṃ vā bahulaṃ jalam || śivagaṃgeti vikhyātaṃ mahāpātakanāśanaṃ || asnātvā nācaretkarma japapūjādikaṃ tathā || 37 || atyaṃtamalino deho navachidrasamanvitaḥ || sravatyeva divārātrau tasmātsnānaṃ samācaret || 38 || prātaḥ snāne'pyaśaktaścenmādhyāhne snānamācaret || aśaktaḥ kaṃṭhamātraṃ vā kaṭimātramathāpi vā || 39 || atha daṃtadhāvanavidhiḥ || parāśarapurāṇe || mukhaprakṣālanaṃ kṛtvā gaṃḍūṣamudakena ca || punarācamanaṃ kāryaṃ prāṅmukhodaṅmukhopi vā || 40 || svadaṃtaśodhanaṃ kuryātkāṣṭhenaiva yathāvidhi ||
daṃtaśuddhiṃ prakurvāṇaḥ prāpnotyeva śriyaṃ sadā || 41 || madhyamāṃgulinā sāmyaṃ sthaulyena brahmavittama || dantakāṣṭhaṃ pragṛhṇīyāddīrgheṇa dvādaśāṃgulaṃ || 42 || gṛhṇīyātsatvacaṃ saumyaṃ kṣīravṛkṣasamudbhavaṃ || mālatīsaṃbhavaṃ vāpi karavīramathāpi vā || apāmārgaṃ tu vā nityaṃ śuṣkaṃ sarvaṃ parityajet|| 43 || manusmṛtiḥ || arkanyagrodhakhadirakaraṃjakuṭajādikam || kaṃṭakakṣīravṛkṣaṃ ca dvādaśāṃgulasaṃyutam || kaniṣṭhāgrasamaṃ sthūlaṃ śubhaṃ syāddaṃtadhāvane || 44 || daṃtadhāvanamaṃtraḥ || manuruvāca || āyurbalaṃ yaśovṛddhiḥ prajāpaśuvasūni ca || brahmajñānaṃ ca medhāṃ ca tvaṃ no dehi vanaspate || 45 || tṛṇaparṇaiḥ sadā kuryāddaṃtadhāvanamuttamam || kārpāsato daṃtaśuddhiḥ śakrasyāpi śriyaṃ haret || 46 || manusmṛtau || yadnaṃḍūṣasamopetaṃ tarjanyā dantaśodhanam || karoti yadi mūḍhātmā rauravaṃ narakaṃ vrajet || 47 || kṣīraṃ lavaṇasaṃmiśraṃ tarjanyā daṃtadhāvanaṃ || nārikelapayaḥ kāṃsye tāmre gavyaṃ surāmayam || 48 || gṛhītvā jalapātreṇa viṇmūtraṃ yadi saṃtyajet || tajjalaṃ mūtrasadṛśaṃ pītvā cāṃdrāyaṇaṃ caret || 49 || jihvāśuddhiṃ prakurvīta daṃtakāṣṭhāṃtareṇa ca ||
dantadhāvanavidhānakathanam
so'cirācchriyamāpnoti nātra kāryā vicāraṇā || 50 || bhojanācchādane dāne hyupahāre pratigrahe || saṃdhyātrayeṃ'bupāne ca pūrvaṃ paścādvirācamet || 51 ||
[iti śrīvīraśaivācārapradīpikāyāṃ pūjāprakaraṇe pūjākālasadācāranirṇayaṃ nāma caturdaśo'dhyāyaḥ] ||
[atha paṃcadaśo'dhyāyaḥ] |
|| śrīgurubhyo namaḥ ||
atha śrīśivārcanasthānāni pūjāgṛhanirmāṇaṃ tanmāhātmyaṃ tadalaṃkāraṃ maṃṭapalakṣaṇamāsanam tanmāhātmyaṃ vakṣyāmi || tadyathā || svagṛhaṃ vā śivāvāsaṃ sarittīragṛhaṃ vanaṃ || maṭhastaṭākaśca saro maṃṭapo gahvaro guhā || 1 || ārāmaḥ parvataścānyaguhāsthānaṃ manoramaṃ || carārcanasya sthānāni praśastāni caturdaśa || 2 || (kriyāsāre) || gṛhasyeśānadigbhāge pūjāgāraṃ prakalpayet || (lokottare) īśānyāṃ diśi saṃsthāpya pūjāgāraṃ manoramam || 3 || dvātriṃśaddhastamātraṃ tu viṃśaddhastamathāpi vā || hastamātraṃ khanedbhūmiṃ pūrayitvā tu pāṃsunā || 4 || (graṃthāntare) khananaṃ dahanaṃ caiva śodhanaṃ prokṣaṇaṃ tathā || mardanaṃ lepanaṃ caiva saṃskārāḥ ṣaḍvidhāḥ smṛtāḥ || 5 || asthīni mūrdhajādīni tuṣāpāṣāṇaloṣṭhakaṃ || kāṣṭhaṃ tṛṇāni bahudhā cāvaśyaṃ tāni varjayet || 6 || paṃcaratnaṃ kṣipedbhūmau paṃcākṣarayutena ca || pāṃsunācchādayitvā tu vedikāṃ ca prakalpayet || 7 || bahustaṃbhasamāyuktaṃ caturdvāraṃ satoraṇaṃ ||
śivārcanasthānaracanānirūpaṇam
suguptaṃ nūtanaṃ ramyaṃ prakīrṇakusumaṃ śubhaṃ || 8 || suvicitrapatākāḍhyaṃ sitavastradhvajochritaṃ || kuṃkumākṣatasaṃyuktaṃ karpūrakṣodasaṃyutaṃ || 9 || sudhūpāmodagaṃdhāḍhyaṃ carcitaṃ caṃdanādibhiḥ || vitānoparisaṃchannaṃ muktādāmāvalaṃbitaṃ || 10 || niṣkaṃpābhiḥ pradīpābhirdarpaṇādibhiranvitaṃ || iti nityārcane śastaṃ maṃdiraṃ bhuktimuktidaṃ || 11 || (kriyāsāre) svarṇena vātha raupyeṇa śuddhasaurāṣṭrakeṇa ca || kṛtvā budbudavatsūkṣmān caṣakākārasaṃmitān || 12 || tānaṃghridvitayānkuryātpṛthak ca sakalānapi || sūtreṇa protya mālāṃ tāṃ dvārasyopari baṃdhayet || 13 || (śivadharme) śivasyāyatanaṃ kuryānnavavastropaśobhitaṃ || dukūlapaṭṭadevāṃgairvastraiścitravicitritaiḥ || 14 || paṭṭādivastrataṃtūnāṃ parisaṃkhyā ca yāvatā || tāvadyugasahasrāṇi rudraloke mahīyate || 15 || dhvajamālākulaṃ kuryādyaḥ prāṃte tu śivālaye || kalpāyutaśataṃ divyaṃ modate divi rudravat || 16 || (kriyāsāre) paṭṭadevāṃgacīnaiśca vitānānyuttamāni vai || kārpāsadhavalaṃ vastraṃ madhye kamalabhūṣitaṃ
etanmauktikamālāḍhyaṃ vitānamapi bhāvayet || 17 || (śivadharme) || vitānaṃ śaśipadmābhaṃ madhye kamalabhūṣitaṃ || muktāmālāvalaṃbaṃ ca ghaṃṭācāmarabhūṣitaṃ || 18 || śivasyopari yo dadyātpurato vāpi kalpayet || yaḥ kuryātkaṭhiṇāṃ bhūmiṃ darpaṇodarasaṃnibhāṃ || 19 || nānāvarṇavicitrāṃ vā vicitrakusumojvalām || kvacitkanakavinyāsāṃ paṃkajādyupaśobhitām || mano'bhirāmāṃ susamāṃ śivāyatanasaṃsthitām || 20 || yāvaddaṃḍaṃ bhavedbhūmiḥ samaṃtādyupaśobhitā || tāvadyugasahasrāṇi sa śaivaṃ padamaśnute || 21 || catuṣkoṇapramāṇaṃ ca gaṇitāṃgulilakṣaṇaṃ || pradakṣiṇaṃ samākhyātaṃ catuḥṣaṣṭhikalādibhiḥ || ghātaṃ tadguṇitaṃ caivetyetallakṣaṇasaṃyutaṃ || 22 || svarṇādipaṃcaratnāni dhānyānyaṣṭadaśānyapi || pūjāsthale ca sthāpyāni sarvasiddhirna saṃśayaḥ || 23 || ṣoḍaśastaṃbhasaṃyuktaṃ kalpayenmaṃṭapaṃ sadā || darpaṇodarasaṃkāśaṃ caturastraṃ samaṃ tathā || 24 || aṃkitaṃ puṣpamālādyaiścitravastrairalaṃkṛtaṃ || cāmarairdivyagaṃdhaiśca patākairvṛṣabhadhvajaiḥ || 25 || vitānoparisaṃchannamuktādāmopaśobhite || śivapūjāsthale tatra cāsanaṃ parikalpayet || 26 || (vīrāgame) ||
āsananirṇayaḥ
vaṃśāsane daridratvaṃ pāṣāṇe vyādhipīḍanaṃ || dharaṇyāṃ duḥkhasaṃbhūtirdaurbhāgyaṃ dārukāsane || 27 || tṛṇāsane yaśohāniḥ pallave cittavibhramaḥ || yathociteṣvāsaneṣu niṣiddhāni parityajet || 28 || kṛṣṇājine jñānasiddhirmokṣaśrīrvyāghracarmaṇi || syātpuṣṭiśca sukauśeye śāṃtiṃ vai vetraviṣṭare || 29 || vastrāsane vyādhināśaḥ kaṃbale duḥkhamocanam || abhicārādikaṃ nīle rakte vaśyādikaṃ bhavet || dhavale śāṃtikaṃ proktaṃ sarvārthaścitrakaṃbale || 30 ||
[iti śrīmadvīraśaivācārapradīpikāyāṃ pūjāprakaraṇe śivārcanasthānagṛhanirmāṇatanmāhātmyatadalaṃkāranirṇayaṃ nāma paṃcadaśo'dhyāyaḥ] ||
[atha ṣoḍaśo'dhyāyaḥ] |
|| śrīgurubhyo namaḥ ||
atha saṃmārjanaṃ tanmāhātmyakathanaṃ || saṃmārjanācchataṃ puṇyaṃ sahasramanulepanāt || rekhādaśasahastraṃ tu cānaṃtaṃ padmalekhanāt || 1 || baṃdho bhavaharaścaiva svastikaṃ śatrunāśanam || patrapuṣpaphalānyeva mudrā vai mokṣasādhanam || 2 || devāyatanabhūmeśca mārjanyā mṛdusūkṣmayā || śanaiḥ saṃmārjanaṃ kṛtvā mahatpuṇyamavāpnuyāt || 3 || pāṃsūnāṃ yāvatī saṃkhyā vibhormārjanakarmaṇi || tāvadabdasahasrāṇi śivaloke mahīyate || 4 || yo rudrāyatane bhaktyā kurute mārjanakriyāṃ || tena puṇyaprabhāvena sarvapāpaṃ vyapohati || 5 || yāvaṃtyaḥ pāṃsukaṇikā mārjitāstu śivālaye || dināni divi tāvanti tiṣṭhatyastamitonaraḥ || 6 || ahanyahani yatpāpaṃ kurute munisattama || gocarmamātrasaṃmārjānnihantyeva śivālaye || 7 || (śivarahasye) durvāsā uvāca || saṃmārjanaṃ tu yaḥ kuryāddevatāyatanasya ca || cāṃdrāyaṇasahasrāṇāṃ phalaṃ māsena labhyate || 8 ||
śivālayasaṃmārjanavidhiḥ
nairaṃtaryeṇa yaḥ kuryātpakṣaṃ saṃmārjanādikam || yugakoṭiśataṃ so'pi rudraloke mahīyate || 9 ||
bhūśuddhyarthaṃ lepanamaṃtraḥ || jalena śīlamutpannaṃ śīlena sthalasaṃsthitiḥ || sthalena medinī sarvā mūlastaṃbhāya śaṃbhave || 10 || anulepavidhiṃ vakṣye sarvapāpapraṇāśanaṃ || gocarmamātraṃ kurvīta ṣaṭsaṃmārjanameva ca || 11 || gomayaṃ rocanaṃ mūtraṃ dadhi kṣīraṃ ghṛtaṃ gavāṃ || ṣaḍaṃgāni pavitrāṇi sarvasiddhikarāṇi ca || 12 || khasaṃsthaṃ gomayaṃ grāhya sthāne vā patitaṃ śubhe || uparyadhaśca saṃtyajya pratyagraṃ jaṃtuvarjitam || 13 || nāharenmṛtavatsāyā na vaṃdhyāyāstu gomayaṃ || ārtāyā navasūtāyā rogiṇyā nānayeddhruvam || 14 || gomayena satoyena yaḥ kuryādanulepanam || paśyanpariharanjaṃtūṃścāṃdrāyaṇaphalaṃ labhet || 15 || kṣaranti sarvadānāni yajñahomabalikriyāḥ || na kṣīyeta mahādānamabhayaṃ sarvadehinām || 16 || vastrapūtena toyena kāryaṃ caivānulepanam || śivakṣetre muniśreṣṭhā nātra kāryā vicāraṇā || 17 || āpaḥ pūtā bhavantyeva vastrapūtāḥ samuddhṛtāḥ || āphenā muniśārdūlā nadeyāśca viśeṣataḥ || 18 || tasmādvai sarvakāryāṇi daivikāni dvijottamāḥ ||
adbhiḥ kāryāṇi satataṃ pūtābhiḥ sarvasiddhaye || 19 || saṃmārjane tu martyānāṃ maṃḍale ca viśeṣataḥ || agnau khaṃḍanake caiva peṣaṇe toyasaṃgrahe || 20 || hiṃsā yathā ca na bhavettathā yatnaṃ samācaret || ahiṃseyaṃ paro dharmaḥ sarveṣāṃ prāṇināṃ bhuvi || yaddānamabhayaṃ puṇyaṃ sarvadānottamaṃ śubhaṃ || 21 || tasmāttu parihartavyā hiṃsā sarvatra sarvadā manasā karmaṇā || vācā sarvadā'hiṃsakaṃ naram || rakṣante jaṃtavaḥ sarve hiṃsakaṃ bādhayanti ca || 22 || trailokyamakhilaṃ hatvā yatpāpaṃ parikīrtitam || śivālaye nihatyaikaṃ tatpāpaṃ prāpnuyāddhruvam || 23 || trailokyamakhilaṃ datvā yatphalaṃ vedapārage || tatphalaṃ koṭiguṇitaṃ labhate'hiṃsako naraḥ || 24 || tasmātsarvaprayatnena vastrapūtena vāriṇā || kāryamabhyukṣaṇaṃ caiva parihṛtyopalepanam || 25 || graṃthāṃtare || yaḥ kuryādvastrapūtena gaṃdhagomayavāriṇā || ālepanaṃ yathānyāyaṃ cāṃdrāyaṇaphalaṃ labhet || 26 || nityaṃ saṃmārjitaṃ gehaṃ puṇyaṃ ca śivamaṃdiram || saṃmārjanena rahitaṃ gehaṃ cāṃḍālaveśmavat || 27 || varṇaṃ vakṣyāmi viprendrāḥ sarvakāmārthasādhakam || ṣaḍbhirdravyaiḥ samālipya maṃḍalaṃ gomayena ca || 28 || caturasraṃ vidhānena cādbhirabhyukṣya maṃtravit ||
raṃgavallīvidhānam
muktāphalamayaiścūrṇairiṃdranīlamayaistathā || 29 || padmarāgamayaiścaiva sphāṭikaiśca suśobhanaiḥ || tathā mārakataiścaiva sauvarṇai rājataistathā || 30 || śālipiṣṭhādibhirvāpi padmānyālikhya nirdhanaḥ || nivedayecca devāya kṣitidānaphalaṃ labhet || 31 || śvetapāṣāṇapiṣṭena śālipiṣṭena vācaret || kācapāṣāṇavajrāṇāṃ cūrṇaiḥ prāvālamauktikaiḥ || 32 || haridvarṇayutaiḥ kuryātkṛtrimaiśca viśeṣataḥ || 33 || (matsyapurāṇe) śaṃkhacakraiśca kaṭakaiḥ svastikāṃkuśacāmaraiḥ || padmotpalānāṃ rajasā nānāvarṇaiśca kārayet || 34 || vicitrakusumākīrṇaṃ madhye paṃkajabhūṣitam || vallījātisamopetaṃ paṃcavarṇaiśca kārayet || 35 || svastikaṃ vā triśūlaṃ vā padmabaṃdhaṃ tu kārayet || yavagodhūmacūrṇena śālipiṣṭena cāṃbike || 36 || īśvarasyāgrabhāge tu caturvarṇaiśca saṃlikhet || gomayenopaliptāyāṃ śuddhāyāṃ bhaktimānnaraḥ || lekhayetprītaye tatra śivaloke mahīyate || 37 || nūtanaṃ śālipiṣṭaṃ tatphalake saṃviśodhitam || gavyena payasā sārdhaṃ peṣaṇīyaṃ prayatnataḥ || 38 || tasminsaṃmiśrayeccūrṇaṃ haridrāyāścanirmalam || haritālaṃ miśrayitvā kāṃsye kāṃsyenamardayet || 39 || etatpaṃcakasaṃyoge paṃcavarṇaṃ bhavettataḥ ||
paṃcavarṇātmakaṃ piṣṭaṃ munīnāṃ saṃmataṃ tvidam || 40 || śuklakṛṣṇāruṇaśyāmapītavarṇā mahātmanaḥ || paṃcavarṇā maheśasya kīrtitāḥ paṃcamūrtayaḥ || 41 || etaiḥ śivasya purataḥpadmānyaṣṭadalāni tu || satataṃ vinyasedbhaktyā niyamasthaḥ samāhitaḥ || 42 || kācapāṣāṇavajraiśca dāruṇā caiva kārayet || kadācidvarṇakaiḥ kuryātkṛtrimaiśca viśeṣataḥ || sa tu sarvaprado nṛrṇāṃ śivasāyujyakārakaḥ || 43 || gajavājirathāṃdolachatracāmaramaṃkuśaṃ || patākāśaṃkhacakrādīṃstathā kalpalatāvalīm || 44 || āsthānamaṃḍapaṃ pūrṇaṃ kalaśaṃ pītavarṇakam || nāṭyakramaṃ toraṇaṃ ca hemaratnavibhūṣitam || 45 || dolāṃ ca sarvatobhadraṃ caṃdraṃ kusumabaṃdhanam || puṣpāstradahanaṃ puṣpamaṃḍapaṃ puṣpamālikām || 46 || devālayaṃ manoramyaṃ devasiṃhāsanaṃ tathā || nāgabaṃdhaṃ nāgavallīṃ kulaparvatasaṃhatim || 47 || tathā kuvalayākāramaṣṭakoṇaṃ viśeṣataḥ || ṣaṭkoṇaṃ paṃcakoṇaṃ vā caturaṣṭadalānvitam || 48 || tathā ṣoḍaśapatraṃ ca nyasetpadmasahasrakaṃ || caṃdrārkamaṃḍalaṃ padmabaṃdhaṃ padmāsanaṃ tathā || 49 || ityevamādivividhaṃ varṇakaṃ sumanoharam || bhaktyā viracayetprītyā devadevasya saṃnidhau || 50 || phalaṃ tasya viśālākṣi brahmādibhirapi dhruvam || śrotuṃ varṇayituṃ nāpi śakyaṃ girivarātmaje || 51 ||
raṃgavallīphalakathanam
tathāpi kathyate'smābhiryathāśakti yathāmati || yajñānāṃ koṭayaścaiva tathā niyamakoṭayaḥ || tīrthānāṃ koṭayaścaiva koṭyaṃśenāpi no samāḥ || 52 || ayutābdasahasreṇa sādhitasya mahīyasaḥ || paṃcāgnimadhyatapasaḥ phalaṃ yatsamudāhṛtaṃ || 53 || tatphalaṃ labhate martyo māsatrayamataṃdritaḥ || vidhāya varṇakaṃ bhaktyā devadevasya śūlinaḥ || 54 || yāvaṃtaḥ pāṃsavastatra rajasaḥ patitā bhuvi || tāvadvarṣasahasrāṇi śivaloke mahīyate || 55 || lomaśa uvāca || koṭiśo japyamānādijapādatha ca vaidikāt || adhikaṃ varṇakaṃ prāhuraśeṣaphaladāyakam || 56 || purā citraratho nāma rājā varṇakamuttamam || citraṃ vinyasya devāya śivasāyujyamāptavān || 57 || tasmāttvamapi gaurīhavarṇakaṃ ruciraṃ vibhoḥ || vinyasya patimīśānaṃ labhasva varavarṇini || 58 || naṃdyuvāca || iti proktaṃ vacaḥ śrutvā lomaśena mahātmanā || gaurī bhaktyā hi vinyasya varṇakaṃ rucirākṛtim || 59 || citraṃ vicitraṃ vikhyātaṃ padmaṃ ca sumanoharam || mudā saṃtoṣya deveśaṃ tatkṣaṇāttu maheśvaram || kṛtvā prasannaṃ sā gaurī patimenamavāpa hi || 60 || iti śrutaṃ mayāpūrvamṛṣayaḥ śaṃsitavratāḥ || varṇakasya vidhānaṃ tatsakalaṃ sarvakāmadam || 61 ||
itaḥ paraṃ karacaraṇamukhaprakṣālanavidhau udakābhimaṃtraṇaṃ vidhīyate || oṃ āpo vā ida (?) sarvaṃ viśvābhūtānyāpaḥ prāṇā vā āpaḥ paśavastvāpo'nnamāpo'mṛtamāpaḥ || samrāḍāpo virāḍāpaḥ svarāḍāpo yajū (?) ṣyāpaśchaṃdāṃ (?) syāpo jyotiṃ (?) ṣyāpaḥ satyamāpaḥ sarvā devatā āpo brahmabhūrbhuvaḥ svaroṃ || iti maṃtreṇa jalamabhimaṃtrya tenodakena karacaraṇamukhaprakṣālanaṃ kṛtvā(,) tataḥ sarvajñāya nama iti mantramuccārayan pūjāgṛhamāviśet || gomukhaṃ svastikaṃ caiva padmaṃ caivārdhacaṃdrakam || vīraṃ yogāsanaṃ ceti ṣaḍvidhaṃ proktamāsanaṃ || 62 || vāmapādopari nyasya dakṣiṇaṃ jānumaṃḍalam || ūrupādatale nyasyedetatsvastikamāsanaṃ || 63 || gulphadvayasamāyuktaṃ jaṃghādvaṃdva tale nyaset || ardhacaṃdraṃ samākhyātaṃ vīrāsanamatho śṛṇu || 64 || vāmaṃ dakṣiṇato nyasya bhujayoḥ saṃnyasetpunaḥ || etadvīrāsanaṃ proktaṃ yogāsanamatho śṛṇu || 65 || yogabaddhaśarīraṃ tu jānubhyāṃ militaṃ bhavet || jānvorupari saṃnyasya siddhaṃ yogāsanaṃ smṛtam || 66 || ūrudvayopariṣṭhācca sanyastaṃ caraṇadvayam || ūrdhvaṃ dakṣiṇapādaṃ tu nyasetpadmāsanaṃ smṛtam || 67 || oṃ hrūṃ pṛthivyātmane namaḥ nivṛtti kalātmane namaḥ ||
sthānaśuddhyādividhānam
iti maṃtreṇa sthānaśuddhiṃ kārayet || pūrvābhimukho bhūtvā cottarābhimukho'thavā || evamāsanabaddhastu viṃśatpaṃcākṣaraṃ smaret || 68 || oṃ hrāṃḥ anaṃtaśaktidhāmne jyotīrūpāya śivāyāstrāya phaṭ || iti maṃtreṇa manaḥśuddhiṃ kārayet ||
[iti śrīvīraśaivācārapradīpikāyāṃ śivapūjāprakaraṇe raṃgavallyādyāsanavidhirnāma ṣoḍaśodhyāyaḥ] || 16 ||
[atha saptadaśo'dhyāyaḥ] |
|| śrīgurubhyo namaḥ||
atha pūjāyāṃ javanikāpaṭasya kāraṇaṃ vibhūtyutpattiṃ tatkalpavidhiṃ taddhāraṇaṃ tanmāhātmyaṃ ca vakṣyāmi tadyathā || pāpī ko'pi paribhraṣṭo nāstikaḥ śivaniṃdakaḥ || durmukhaśca durācārī mūrkhaḥ svaguruniṃdakaḥ || 1 || eteṣāṃ darśane jāte sā pūjā niṣphalā bhavet || dūṣakānarcanākāle sarvathā na vilokayet || 2 || pramādādarcanākāle paśyedyadi bahirnaram || prāyaścittena mahatā śuddhimāpnoti mānavaḥ || 3 || eteṣāṃ darśane prāyaścittamaṣṭottaraṃ śatam || śrīmatpaṃcākṣaraṃ maṃtraṃ japeddhyātvā śivaṃ naraḥ || 4 || spṛṣṭvā bahirnaraṃ snāyātsacailaṃ śivaniṃdakam || datvā tu bhasma tāṃbūlaṃ madbhaktāṃścaiva bhojayet || 5 || bhaviśabdaḥ kuśabdaśca hiṃsāśabdaśca niṃditaḥ || śvapacādikaśabdaśca bhrāṃtikaḥ karkaśastathā || 6 || bībhatsako mahādevītyaṣṭau śabdānvivarjayet || prāraṃbhādyavasānāntaṃ sarvaṃ maunena kārayet || 7 || bhāṣaṇaṃ yadi cettatra vadetsaṃskṛtayā girā || arcanādau yavanikāṃ kṛtveśārcanamācaret || 8 || sevakānyācakāṃścopakaraṇadravyasādhakān ||
bhasmasvarūpanirūpaṇam
śivabhaktāṃśca kurvīta bhasmarudrākṣadhāriṇaḥ || 9 || namaḥ śivāya somāya ṣaṭtriṃśattattvarūpiṇe || agniṣṭomātmane bhasmajyotiṣe śāṃtatejase || 10 || sarvāṇyapi ca śāstrāṇi purāṇāni viśeṣataḥ || śrutismṛtītihāsāni cānyānyālokya kṛtsnaśaḥ || 11 || bhasmatattvasya vistāraṃ vidhānaṃ ca savistaram || māhātmyavistaraṃ kṛtsnaṃ tataḥ śāstroktamārgataḥ || 12 || tattaduktaprakāreṇa sāraṃ saṃgṛhya sādaram || vibhūtimahimākalparatnasārasamuccayam || 13 || apavargapadaṃ netu kriyate bhasmapaddhatiḥ || (pārvatyuvāca) || bhagavan sarvadharmajña lokeśa śaśibhūṣaṇa || 14 || darśanātsparśanāddhyānāddhāraṇācchravaṇādapi || śuddhiṃ dadāti satataṃ kaḥ padārtho maheśvara || 15 || īśvara uvāca || śaṃkarasya pavitraṃ yat harasyābharaṇaṃ tathā || lokavaśyakaraṃ puṇyaṃ pāpanāśaṃ dine dine || 16 || rakṣārthaṃ maṃgalārthaṃ ca śuddhyarthaṃ cāpi bhāmini || bhūṣārthaṃ sarvalokānāṃ bhasma dattaṃ mayā purā || 17 || vibhūtirbhasitaṃ bhasma kṣāraṃ rakṣeti bhasmanaḥ || etāni paṃca nāmāni hetubhiḥ paṃcabhirbhṛśaṃ || 18 || vibhūtirbhūtihetutvādbhasitaṃ tattvabhāsanāt || pāpānāṃ bhartsanādbhasma kṣaraṇātkṣāramāpadām || rakṣaṇātsarvabhūtebhyo rakṣeti parigīyate || 19 ||
naṃdā bhadrā ca surabhiḥ suśīlā sumanāstathā || paṃca gāvo vibhorjātāssadyojātādivaktrataḥ || 20 || kapilaḥ kṛṣṇadhavalau dhūmro raktastathaiva ca || naṃdādīnāṃ gavāṃ varṇāḥ krameṇa parikīrtitāḥ || 21 || sadyojātādvibhūtiśca vāmādbhasitameva ca || aghorādbhasma saṃjātaṃ puruṣātkṣāranāma ca || 22 || rakṣā ceśānavaktrācca naṃdādidvārato'bhavan || dhārayennityakāryeṣu vibhūtiṃ ca prayatnataḥ || 23 || naimittikeṣu bhasitaṃ kṣāraṃ kāryeṣu sarvadā || prāyaścitteṣu sarveṣu bhasma nāma yathāvidhi || rakṣā ca mokṣakāryeṣu prayoktavyā sadā budhaiḥ || 24 || bhasma jyotirbhavatyeva śivākhyaṃ na hi saṃśayaḥ || jābālopaniṣatsarvaṃ prāhedaṃ parayā mudā || 25 || (jābālopaniṣadi) sadyojātātpṛthvī jātā tasyā nivṛttiḥ kalā tasyāḥ kapilo varṇaḥ sā naṃdā tasyāḥ gomayena vibhūtirjātā || vāmadevādudakaṃ tasmātpratiṣṭhā tasyāḥ kṛṣṇavarṇā bhadrā tasyāḥ gomayena bhasitaṃ jātam || aghorādvahnistasmādvidyā tasyā raktavarṇā surabhistasyā
bhasmavidhānam
gomayena bhasma saṃjātam || tatpuruṣādvāyustasmācchāṃtiḥ tasyāḥ śvetavarṇā suśīlā tasyāḥ gomayena kṣāraṃ jātam || īśānādākāśastasmācchāṃtyatītā tasyāścitravarṇā sumanāḥ tasyāḥ gomayena rakṣā jātā || 26 || aiśvaryakāraṇādbhūtirbhāsanādbhasitaṃ mataṃ || sarvāghabhartsanādbhasma cāpadāṃ kṣaraṇātkṣaraṃ || 27 || bhūtapretapiśācādibrahmarākṣasāpasmārabhavabhītibhyo'bhirakṣaṇādrakṣet i teṣāṃ rudrānalajatvaṃ vakṣye || 28 || agnau jvālāvṛtaṃ rudraṃ vahnimaṃḍalamadhyagaṃ || dhyāyetkalādaśayutaṃ śaktisvastikadhāriṇaṃ iti || 29 || (atha śrutiḥ) ādau rudrāgniṃ saṃcitya rudrāgnau bhūtyādipaṃcātmakaṃ bhasma saṃpādayāmīti saṃkalpya || (atha upaśrutiḥ) vikalāṃgāṃ unmattāṃ mahāśanāṃ khalāmalasāmaśivacihnāṃ kṛśāṃgāṃ vatsahīnāṃ vaṃdhyāṃ aṃgahīnāṃ aśāṃtāṃ adugdhadohinīṃ chinneṃdriyāmajagdhatṛṇāṃ keśacailāsthibhakṣiṇīṃ saṃdhinīṃ navasūtāṃ rogānvitāṃ dhenuṃ vihāya apraśastabhūmyādipatitaṃ klinnaṃ durgandhaṃ paryuṣitādi gomayaṃ ca vihāya praśastaṃ
gomayaṃ saṃgṛhya īśānatatpuruṣāghoravāmadevasadyojātādyairutpattisthitisaṃhārabhedairgraha ṇakavalanaśoṣaṇadahanaplāvanaśodhanādimaṃtrānukrameṇa paṃcabījaiḥ saha paṃcamaṃtrairvibhūtyādīn saṃpādya sudṛḍharamyakṣālitaprokṣitacūtabilvāśokadārumṛṇmayapātre śailamayapātre vā dhanamiva sthāpayet || 30 || bhasmotpādanamuddiṣṭaṃ caturdhā taṃtravedibhiḥ || kalpaṃ caivānukalpaṃ yadupakalpamakalpakam || eṣāmādimamutkṛṣṭamanyatsarvamabhāvataḥ || 31 || vāyusaṃhitāyāṃ || kapilāgomayaṃ svasthaṃ gṛhītvā gagane'patat || na klinnaṃ nātikaṭhiṇaṃ na durgaṃdhaṃ na coṣitaṃ || 32 || uparyadhaḥ parityajya gṛhṇīyātpatitaṃ bhuvi || sadyena gomayaṃ grāhyaṃ piṃḍaṃ vāmena kārayet || 33 || tatpuruṣeṇa tu saṃśoṣya daheccāghoravahninā || sikatāṃgārapāṣāṇānīśāmena viśodhayet || 34 || apakkamatipakkaṃ ca saṃtyajya bhasitaṃ śivam || ādāya vāsasāloḍya bhasmapātre (bhasmādhāre) vinikṣipet || 35 || sukṛte sudṛḍhe śuddhe kṣālite prokṣite śubhe ||
vinyasya maṃtrī maṃtreṇa pātre bhasma vinikṣipet || 36 || (vīrataṃtre) sauvarṇamuttamaṃ pātraṃ madhyamaṃ rājataṃ smṛtam || adhamaṃ tāmrapātraṃ syādalābhe mṛṇmayaṃ bhavet || taijasaṃ dāravaṃ vāpi mṛṇmayaṃ cailameva vā || 37 || anyadvā śodhitaṃ śuddhaṃ bhasmādhāraṃ prakalpayet || kṣemasthāne śubhe śuddhe dhanavadbhasma nikṣipet || 38 || prasthito bhasma gṛhṇīyātsvayaṃ vānucaro'pi vā || na cāyuktakare dadyānna cāśucitale kṣipet || 39 || na saṃspṛśennīcahastairnopekṣeta na laṃghayet || śuciḥ san bhasma cādāya kuryāccaivābhimaṃtritam || 40 || bhuktimuktidamāgneyaṃ viśuddhaṃ bhasitaṃ tathā || snānaṃ caturvidhaṃ bhasmajanyaṃ kalpādibhedataḥ || 41 || kalpaṃ caivānukalpaṃ yadupakalpamakalpakam || teṣvādyatamamutkṛṣṭatamamanyadabhāvataḥ || 42 || rogādirahitā gauśca kṛṣṇā vā kapilā'pi vā || tasyā gomayamādāya svasthaṃ padmadale'pi vā || 43 || kalpaṃ tadbhasma vijñeyamanukalpamathocyate || vaneṣu gomayaṃ yacca śuṣkaṃ cūrṇīkṛtaṃ tathā || 44 || dagdhaṃ caivānukalpākhyamāpaṇādigataṃ tu yat ||
vastreṇottāritaṃ bhasma gomūtrābaddhapiṃḍitam || 45 || dagdhaṃ prāguktavidhinā bhavedbhasmopakalpakam || anyairāpāditaṃ bhasmāpyakalpamiti niścitam || 46 || eṣvekatamamādāya pātreṣu kalaśādiṣu || trisaṃdhyamācaretsnānaṃ yathāsaṃbhavameva vā || 47 || (kriyāsāre) evaṃ vidhikṛtenaiva bhasmanā snānamācaret || snapanopakrame pādau karau prakṣālya vāgyataḥ || 48 || tato mūlena bhasitamaṣṭakṛtvo'bhimaṃtrya ca || īśānena śirodeśaṃ mukhaṃ tatpuruṣeṇa tu || 49 || ūrudeśaṃ hyaghoreṇa guhyaṃ vāmena caiva hi || sadyena pādau sarvāṃgaṃ praṇavenaiva secayet || 50 || (vāsiṣṭhalaiṃge) āgneyaṃ bhasmanā snānaṃ munīnāṃ tu vidhīyate || bhasmasnānātparaṃ śuddhaṃ nāsti na śrūyate'pi ca || 51 || māyikaṃ tu jalasnānaṃ martyānāṃ baṃdhanaṃ viduḥ || tadbaṃdhachedanārthāya bhasmasnānamihocyate || 52 || (śivadharme) bhasmasnānaṃ jalasnānādasaṃkhyeyaguṇādhikaṃ || tasmādvāruṇamutsṛjya snānamāgneyamācaret || 53 || (devikālottare) vāruṇaṃ vāriṇā snānamāgneyaṃ bhasmanā bhavet || vṛṣṭyā sātapayā divyaṃ vāyavyaṃ rajasā gavāṃ || 54 || mānasaṃ brahmatādātmyaṃ snānānyetāni vai viduḥ ||
bhasmadhāraṇamāhātmyam
divyavāruṇavāyavyamānasebhyo'pi cottamam || 55 || iti matvā śivo bhasmasnānamādau hyapūrayat || viṣṇvādidevā ṛṣayo gaṃdharvā yakṣakiṃnarāḥ || 56 || marudgaṇāḥ pitṛgaṇāḥ sarve bhūtagaṇā api || bhaktyā nityaṃ prakurvaṃte bhasmasnānaṃ prayatnataḥ || 57 || tasmādeva hi tatsnānamāgneyaṃ yaḥ samācaret || bhavapāśairvinirmuktaḥ śivaloke mahīyate || 58 || jvaro yakṣmā piśācāśca hyasurā yātudhānakāḥ || kumāragrahabhūtāśca kṛṣmāṃḍā ḍākinī tathā || brahmarākṣasamukhyāśca pūtanākuṣṭhagulmakāḥ|| 59 || bhagaṃdarāṇi cāśītivātarogāḥ kṣayādikāḥ || te catuḥ ṣaṣṭhipittāśca śleṣmāḥ saptatripaṃcakāḥ || 60 || vyāghrāḥ sarpāḥ hiṃsrakāstu te'nye duṣṭamṛgā api || bhasmasnānena naśyaṃti siṃhenaiva gajā yathā || 61 || yadyakāryasahasrāṇi kṛtvā yaḥ snāti bhasmanā || tatsarvaṃ dahate bhasma yathāgnistejasā vanaṃ || 62 || (skāṃde) kṛtvā tu cātulaṃ pāpaṃ mṛtyukāle ca yo janaḥ || bhasmasnānī bhavetkiṃcitkṣipraṃ prāṇī pramucyate || 63 || (śivadharme) mahāpātakasaṃyukto yukto vā sarvapātakaiḥ || bhasmasnānena sarvasmānmucyate sa tu pātakāt || 64 || yaḥ snānamācarennityamāgneyaṃ pāvanaṃ paraṃ ||
kulaikaviṃśamuttārya sa gacchecchivamaṃdiraṃ || 65 || bhasmasnānaṃ tu yogī vai kuryādāpādamastakam || trisaṃdhyamācarennityaṃ yogasya phalamāpnuyāt || 66 || (bhīmāgame) sarvatīrtheṣu yatpuṇyaṃ sarvayajñeṣu yatphalaṃ || tatphalātkoṭiguṇitaṃ bhasmasnānāllabhennaraḥ || 67 || (laiṃge) bhasmasnānādviśuddhātmā jitakrodho jiteṃdriyaḥ || matsamīpamupāgatya na bhūyo vinivartate || 68 || (skāṃde) bhasmasnānātparaṃ snānaṃ pavitraṃ naiva vidyate || ityuktvā munidevebhyaḥ snāto yaḥ sa śivaḥ svayam || 69 || (gāruḍe) paṃcākṣarajapaṃ bhasmasnānaṃ liṃgārcanaṃ trayaṃ || kadācidapi na tyājyaṃ yathāśakti samācaret || 70 || (kriyāsāre) caṃdanaṃ kuṃkumaṃ caiva mṛganābhyādikāni ca || gaṃdhādyalpaphalaṃ tyaktvā bhasmasnānaparo bhavet || evaṃ snānakramaḥ prokto bhuktimuktipradāyakaḥ || 71 || (vāsiṣṭhalaiṃge) vasiṣṭhoktavacanāni || paṃcākṣareṇa maṃtreṇa praṇavena yutena ca || uddhūlanaṃ tripuṃḍraṃ ca nityaṃ bhaktyā samācaret || 72 || (ekapādapurāṇe) namaḥ śivāyeti bhasma kṛtvā saptābhimaṃtritam || uddhūlayeccharīre tu tripuṃḍraṃ cāpi dhārayet || 73 || suprabhedāgame || sthānabhedaṃ pravakṣyāmi mūrdhā bhālaṃ tathaiva ca || karṇau ca cakṣuṣī caiva nāsikā cāsyameva ca || 74 ||
grīvā skaṃdhau ca bāhū ca kūrpare ca tathā maṇī || hṛnnābhimeḍhraṃ pāyuśca ūrū jānū ca jaṃghake || 75 || gulphau pādadvayaṃ caiva pṛṣṭhabhāgadvayaṃ tathā || triṃśatsthānamiti proktaṃ bhasmalepanasaṃjñakam || 76 || graṃthāṃtare || rudrādhyāyī sadā bhasmaliptāṃgo mucyate gadāt || kuṣṭhayakṣmādirogebhyastejorāśī bhavetpunaḥ || 77 || skāṃde || śivena viṣṇunā caiva brahmaṇā vajriṇā tathā || devatābhirdhṛtaṃ bhasma tripuṃḍroddhūlanādikam || 78 || yakṣarākṣasagaṃdharvasiddhavidyādharādibhiḥ || munibhiśca dhṛtaṃ bhasma tripuṃḍraṃ cāpi sarvadā || 79 || mānavapurāṇe || tripuṃḍralepanaṃ nityaṃ yaḥ karoti sadā mudā || sa eva dhanyo vidvāṃśca netaro munipuṃgavāḥ || 80 || || skāṃde || umādevyā ca lakṣmyā ca vāgdevyā mātṛkādibhiḥ || sarvastrībhirdhṛtaṃ bhasma tripuṃḍroddhūlanādikam || 81 || naiva pramāditavyaṃ ca bhramādapi kadācana || bhūtyai coddhūlanaṃ tiryaktripuṃḍrasya ca dhāraṇam || 82 || tripuṃḍradhāraṇaṃ bhaktyā tathā dehāvaguṃṭhanam || yo na kuryātsamaṃtreṇa sa martyaḥ patito bhavet || 83 || mahāpātakayuktānāṃ pūrvajanmādijanmasu || tripuṃḍroddhūlane dveṣo jāyate sudṛḍhaṃ bhuvi || 84 ||
uddhūlanaṃ tripuṃḍraṃ ca śraddhayā nācaraṃti ye || teṣāṃ nāsti samācāro varṇāśramasamanvitaḥ || 85 || uddhūlanaṃ tripuṃḍraṃ ca śraddhayā nācaraṃti ye || teṣāṃ nāsti śivajñānaṃ kalpakoṭiśatairapi || 86 || uddhūlanaṃ tripuṃḍraṃ ca śraddhayā nācaraṃti ye || teṣāṃ nāsti vinirmokṣaḥ saṃsārājjanmakoṭibhiḥ || 87 || tripuṃḍroddhūlane śraddhā yeṣāṃ naivābhijāyate || mahāpātakadoṣeṇa juṣṭāste nātra saṃśayaḥ || 88 || bhūtyaivoddhūlanaṃ tiryaktripuṃḍrasya ca dhāraṇaṃ || variṣṭhaṃ sarvadharmebhyastatastannityamācaret || 89 || bhasmanoddhūlanaṃ yacca tathā tiryaktripuṃḍrakam || mokṣārthinā pramādena na tyajediti hi śrutiḥ || 90 || skāṃde śaṃkarasaṃhitāyāṃ || bhasmasaṃcchannasarvāṃgo yatra gacchati yaḥ pumān || sarvapātakayukto'pi tatra saṃnihitaḥ śivaḥ || 91 || bhasmasaṃchannasarvāṃgo yaḥ stauti śraddhayā śivam || sarvapātakayukto'pi śuddho bhavati mānavaḥ || 92 || bhasmasaṃchannadehaḥ san yaḥ praṇāmaṃ karoti vai || sa pātakavinirmuktaḥ sadyo bhavati mānavaḥ || 93 || śivadharme || bhasmaniṣṭhaṃ samāhūya bhaktyā pūjayate ca yaḥ || tattulyaṃ labhyate nātra sāṃgaiḥ kratuśatairapi || 94 ||
gāruḍapurāṇe || bhūtapretapiśācādyā rogāścātīvaduḥsahāḥ || bhasmaniṣṭhasya sāṃnidhyādvidravaṃti na saṃśayaḥ || 95 || vāsiṣṭhalaiṃge || bhasmasaṃchannasarvāṃgaṃ dṛṣṭvottiṣṭhati yaḥ pumān || taṃ dṛṣṭvā devarājo'pi namaskāra karoti vai || 96 || śaivasaṃhitāyām || yatra bhuṃjīta bhasmāṃgī mūrkhaḥ paṃḍita eva vā || tatra bhuṃkte mahādevaḥ sapatnīko vṛṣadhvajaḥ || 97 || atha ūrdhvapuṃḍranirasanamanekavacanairāha || skāṃde || ūrdhvapuṃḍraṃ dvijaḥ kuryāllīlayāpi kadācana || tadākāreṇa śastreṇa bhidyate yamakiṃkaraiḥ || 98 || parāśarapurāṇe || ūrdhvapuṃḍraṃ ca śūlaṃ ca vartulaṃ cāpi sarvadā || lalāṭe dhārayiṣyaṃti manuṣyāḥ pāpakarmiṇaḥ || 99 || śāṃbhavapurāṇe || aśuddhamiti saṃproktaṃ vartulaṃ tūrdhvapuṃḍrakam || tadākāreṇa śastreṇa ghnaṃti te yamakiṃkarāḥ || 10 || sūtasaṃhitāyāṃ || aśrautamūrdhvapuṃḍraṃ vai lalāṭe śraddhayā saha || dhārayiṣyaṃti mohena pāṣaṃḍāḥ pāpakṛjjanāḥ || 101 || mānavapurāṇe || ūrdhvapuṃḍraṃ ca śūlaṃ ca vartulaṃ cāṃkuśākṛtiṃ || tatra niṣṭhā na kartavyā kadācidvedavittamaiḥ || 102 || manusmṛtau || ūrdhvapuṃḍramukhaṃ dṛṣṭvā vrataṃ cāṃdrāyaṇaṃ caret || 103 || atha bhasmapuṃḍratiryaglakṣaṇaṃ tanmāhātmyaṃ vakṣyāmi ||
kālāgnirudropaniṣadi || atha rudraṃ bhagavaṃtaṃ sanatkumāraḥ papraccha abhidhehi bhagavan tripuṃḍravidhiṃ satatvaṃ || kiṃ dravyaṃ kiyatsthānaṃ kiṃ pramāṇaṃ kati rekhāḥ kiṃ daivataṃ || kā śaktiḥ kiṃ phalaṃ iti ca || śiva uvāca || dravyaṃ tadāgneyaṃ bhasma sadyādipaṃcabrahmamaṃtraiḥ parigṛhya mānastoketi samuddhṛtya triyāyuṣaṃ jamadagnirāha || śirolalāṭaskaṃdheṣu triyāyuṣatryaṃbakaistiyaktisro rekhāḥ prakurvīta vṛttametacchāṃbhavaṃ sarvavedeṣu vedavādibhiruktaṃ tatsamācarenmumukṣubhirapunarbhavāya || ālalāṭāt bhruvoḥ sāṃnidhyavartinī yā prathamā rekhā āhavanīyāgniḥ akāro varṇaḥ rajo guṇaḥ lokastu bhūrlokaścātmā kriyāśaktiḥ ṛgvedaḥ || prātaḥsavanaṃ rudro devatā || iti prathamā rekhā || yā cāsya bhasmanaḥ dvitīyā rekhā tasyāḥ prakāramāha || gārhapatyāgniḥ ukāraḥ satvaguṇaḥ aṃtarikṣalokaḥ ātmā icchāśaktiḥ yajurvedaḥ madhyaṃdinasavanaṃ maheśvaro devatā || atha tṛtīyā rekhā sā dakṣiṇāgniḥ makārastamoguṇaḥ dyauḥ paramātmā
bhasmadhāraṇavidhānam
jñānaśaktiḥ sāmavedaḥ sāyaṃ savanaṃ sadāśivo devatā || 104 || bhasmatripuṃḍraṃ yaḥ kuryādbrahmacārī ca buddhimān || gṛhastho vanavāsī vā yatirvā mucyate bhayāt || 105 || tenetihāsāgamapurāṇānāṃ śatasahasrāṇi japtāni bhavaṃti || prāṇāyāmānāmayutaṃ japtaṃ bhavati || rūpe rūpe daśapūrvān punāti deśottarāṇāṃ paṃktiṃ punāti || sa samastatīrtheṣu snāto bhavati || sa sarvakarmasu sarvadā yogyo bhavati || dehaṃ tyaktvā śivasāyujyameti || na sa punarāvartatena sa punarāvartata ityāha bhagavān kālāgnirudraḥ || 106 || (garuḍapurāṇe) maṃtrasaṃskārasaṃyuktaṃ pavitramatipāṃḍuram || susnigdhaṃ bhasitaṃ martyairbhaktyā dhāryaṃ niraṃtaraṃ || 107 || madhyamānāmikāṃguṣṭhaistisṛbhirmūlamaṃtrataḥ || gṛhītvā ca vibhūtiṃ tu prokṣayetsthānabhedataḥ || 108 || vāmahastatale bhasma kṣiptvācchādyānyapāṇinā || agnirityādibhirmaṃtraiḥ samyak kṛtvā'bhimaṃtrita || 109 || tato mūlena maṃtreṇa kuryāddehāvaguṃṭhanaṃ || sthāne paṃcadaśe caiva dhārayecca tripuṃḍrakam || 110 || śirasīśānamaṃtreṇa puruṣeṇa mukhe tathā || hṛtpradeśe tvaghoreṇa vāmadevena guhyake || 111 || pādau sadyena sarvāṃge praṇavena ca secayet || īśena paṃcadhā bhasma vikirenmūrdhni yatnataḥ || 112 || mukhe caturdhā puruṣeṇāghoreṇāṣṭadhā hṛdi ||
vāmena guhyadeśe tu sthāne paṃcadaśe tathā || aṣṭāvaṃtena sadyena pādayoḥ kramaśaḥ kṣipet || 113 || agnirityādibhirmaṃtraiḥ sadyojātādimaṃtrataḥ || sarvāṃgoddhūlanaṃ kuryādāpādatalamastakaṃ || 114 || dvātriṃśatsthānake vāpi ṣoḍaśasthānake tathā || aṣṭasthāne'pi vā kuryātpaṃcasthāne'thavā smṛtaṃ || 115 || sthānabhedaṃ pravakṣyāmi cātaḥparamidaṃ śṛṇu || mūrdhā bhālaṃ tataḥ karṇau cakṣuṣī caiva nāsikā || 116 || āsyaṃ grīvā skaṃdabāhū kūrpare ca tathā maṇī || hṛnnābhirmeḍhrapāyū ca hyūrū jānū ca jaṃghake || 117 || gulphau pādadvayaṃ caiva pṛṣṭhabhāgastathaiva ca || dvātriṃśatsthānametaddhi bhasmanā lepayettataḥ || 118 || lalāṭakaṃṭhaskaṃdhāśca bāhū kūrparake'pi ca || hṛdayaṃ jaṭharaṃ caiva nābhiḥ pārśve ca pṛṣṭhakaṃ || 119 || pādadvayaṃ ca vipreṃdrāḥ ṣoḍaśasthānamucyate || mūrdhā caiva lalāṭaṃ ca kaṃṭho bāhū tathaiva ca || 120 || hṛdayaṃ caiva nābhiśca pṛṣṭhaṃ cāpi viśeṣataḥ || aṣṭasthānamiti proktaṃ viśeṣādbhasma dhārayet || 121 || atha bhālaṃ ca bāhū ca hṛdayaṃ nābhireva ca || paṃcasthānānyamūnyāhuḥ śivaśāstraviśāradāḥ || 122 || ekādaśa tripuṃḍrasya sthānānyāhurmanīṣiṇaḥ|| śirolalāṭaśravaṇadvayaṃ grīvā bhujadvayaṃ || 123 || vakṣo nābhiḥ pṛṣṭhabhāgaḥ kakudekādaśāni tu ||
sthānāni ca tripuṃḍrasya vijñeyāni manīṣibhiḥ || 124 || śivo maheśvaro rudraḥ śrīkaṃṭhaḥ śaṃbhurīśvaraḥ || mahādevaḥ paśupatiḥ śaṃkaro vṛṣabhadhvajaḥ || 125 || paramātmetyamī rudrasthānāścaiva yathākramaṃ || tripuṃḍramuktasthāneṣu sadyātsajalabhasmanā || 126 || śuddhaśītajalenaiva bhasmanā ca tripuṃḍrakaṃ || yo dhārayedatiprītyā sa śivo nātra saṃśayaḥ || 127 || akāro'nāmikaḥ prokto hyukāro madhyamāṃguliḥ || makārastarjanī proktā tribhiḥ kuryāttripuṃḍrakam || 128 || madhyāṃgulitrayeṇaiva svadakṣiṇakarasya ca || ṣaḍaṃgulāyataṃ mānamapi vā'likamānakam || 129 || netrayugmapramāṇena bhāle dadhyāttripuṃḍrakam || madhyamānāmikāṃguṣṭhairanulomavilomataḥ || 130 || dhārayedyastripuḍraṃ vai sa rudro nātra saṃśayaḥ || ṛju śvetamanuvyāptaṃ snigdhaṃ śrotrapramāṇakaṃ || evaṃ salakṣaṇopetaṃ tripuṃḍraṃ sarvasiddhidam || 131 || mānavīyasaṃhitāyām || prātaḥkāle ca mādhyāhne sāyāhne ca tripuṃḍrakam || kadācidbhasmanā kuryātsa rudro nātra saṃśayaḥ || 132 || atha śrutiḥ || evaṃvidhavibhūtyā ca kurute yastripuṃḍrakaṃ || sa rudro dharmasaṃyuktastrayīmaya iti śrutiḥ || 133 || śivarahasye || vṛttaṃ ||
samastatīrthopacayā ca kāśī viśveśvaraḥ sarvasurātmako yaḥ || samastatatvaikarasā vibhūtistathā ca puṇyaughamidaṃ tripuṃḍraṃ || 134 || skāṃde || yathā sarvapurāṇeṣu kāśīkṣetraṃ prakīrtitaṃ || tathā bhasmatripuṃḍraṃ tu sarvaśāstreṣu kathyate || 135 || yathā viśvādhiko rudraḥ sarvavedeṣu gīyate || tathā vedapurāṇeṣu tripuṃḍramapi gīyate || 136 || vāsiṣṭhalaiṃge || smaraṇādeva rudrasya yathā pāpaṃ praṇaśyati || tathāsya dhāraṇādeva sarvapāpaṃ praṇaśyati || 137 || bhasmanā vedamaṃtreṇa tripuṃḍrasya ca dhāraṇaṃ || mahāpātakasaṃghātatamasaścaṃḍabhāskaraḥ || 138 || kūrmapurāṇe || vṛtta || etāni tāni śivamaṃtrapavitritāni bhasmāni kāmadahanāṃgavibhūṣitāni || traipuṃḍrakāni racitāni lalāṭapaṭṭe luṃpaṃti daivalikhitāni durakṣarāṇi || 139 || brahmāṃḍapurāṇe || na dānena na yajñena na tapobhiḥ suduṣkaraiḥ || na tīrthayātrayā puṇyaṃ yattripuṃḍreṇa labhyate || 140 || dānayajñāśca dharmāśca tīrthayātrāśca nārada || jñānaṃ tapastripuṃḍrasya kalāṃ nārhaṃti ṣoḍaśīṃ || 141 || yathā rājā svacihnāṃkaṃ svajanaṃ manyate sadā || tripuṃḍradhārakaṃ tadvanmanyate sa śivaḥ svayaṃ || 142 || dvijātirvāṃtyajātirvā sitaśuddhena bhasmanā ||
bhasmadhāraṇamāhātmyam
dhārayedyastripuṃḍrāṃkaṃ rudrastena vaśīkṛtaḥ || 143 || tyaktavarṇāśramācāro luptasarvakriyo'pi vā || sakṛttiryaktripuṃḍrasya dhāraṇātso'pi mucyate || 144 || śaivasaṃhitāyāṃ || tasmin jñānaṃ parīkṣeta na kulaṃ na vrataṃ tathā || tripuṃḍrāṃkitabhālastu pūjya eva hi nārada || 145 || mānavapurāṇe || tripuṃḍradhārakaṃ dṛṣṭvā bhūtapretapuraḥsarāḥ || bhītāḥ prakaṃpitāḥ śīghraṃ gacchaṃtyeva na saṃśayaḥ || 146 || tripuṃḍradhāriṇaḥ pādau prakṣālayati yaḥ pumān || sarvapāpavinirmuktaḥ sadyo bhavati mānavaḥ || 147 || tripuṃḍradhāriṇo bhikṣāpradānena hi kevalaṃ || sarvapāpavinirmuktaḥ śuddho bhavati mānavaḥ || 148 || bhīmāgame || tenādhītaṃ śrutaṃ tena tena sarvamanuṣṭhitam || yena vipreṇa śirasi tripuṃḍraṃ bhasmanā dhṛtaṃ || 149 || kṛtaṃ tenākṛtaṃ sarvaṃ śrutaṃ vāpyaśrutaṃ bhavet || adhītamanadhītaṃ vai tripuṃḍraṃ yo na dhārayet || 150 || bodhāyanasmṛtau || vṛthā vedā vṛthā yajñā vṛthā dānaṃ vṛthā tapaḥ || vṛthā vratopavāsāni tripuḍraṃ yo na dhārayet || 151 || graṃthāṃtare || satyaṃ śaucaṃ tapo yajñaṃ tīrthaṃ devāgnipūjanaṃ || aśvamedhādikaṃ vyarthaṃ tripuṃḍraṃ yo na dhārayet || 152 || kaurme || na taddhyānaṃ na taddānaṃ na tadjñānaṃ na tattapaḥ || vinā tiryaktripuṃḍrāṃkaṃ vipreṇa yadanuṣṭhitam || 153 ||
tripuṃḍradhāraṇaṃ tyaktvā muktimicchaṃti ye narāḥ || viṣapānena nityatvaṃ vāṃcchamānā ivāpyamī || 154 || vedasyādhyayane śūdro nādhikārī yathā bhavet || tripuṃḍreṇa vinā vipro nādhikārī kadācana || 155 || gāruḍapurāṇe || gopīmalena yuktaḥ san śivaṃ spṛśati yo dvijaḥ || sa ekaviṃśatikulairnarake pacyate naraḥ || 156 || abhāve bhasmano vipro laukikāgnerathāharet || bhasmatripuṃḍraṃ kuryādvai na kuryānmṛttikādibhiḥ || 157 || sraṣṭā sṛṣṭichalenāha tripuṃḍrasya praśastatāṃ || sasarja sa lalāṭaṃ hi tiryagūrdhvaṃ na vartulaṃ || 158 || skāṃde || tiryagbhālaṃ dṛśyate vai sarveṣāṃ prāṇināmapi || tadā mānavamūrkhāśca na kurvaṃti tripuṃḍrakaṃ || 159 || aho mohasya māhātmyaṃ kiṃ vaktavyaṃ punaḥ punaḥ || śrautabhasmaparityāgātpataṃte narake sadā || 160 || kaurme || sarvairdvijaistripuṃḍraṃ vai manasā'pi na laṃghayet || śrutyā vidhīyate yasmāttattyāgī patito bhavet || 161 || kriyāsāre || yeṣāṃ vapurmanuṣyāṇāṃ tripuṃḍreṇa vinā sthitam || śmaśānasadṛśaṃ tasmādaspṛśyaṃ puṇyakṛjjanaiḥ || 162 || gāruḍapurāṇe || dhigbhasmarahitaṃ bhālaṃ dhiggrāmamaśivālayaṃ ||
dhigdhiṅneśārcanaṃ janma dhigvidyāmaśivāśrayāma || 163 || vāsiṣṭhalaiṃge || yeṣāṃ krodhasya saṃprāptirbhavet dṛṣṭvā tripuṃḍrakam || te tu saṃkarajātīyā hyanumeyā vipaścitā || 164 || brahmāṃḍapurāṇe || kimatra bahunoktena bhāṣaṇena punaḥ punaḥ || bhaktyā tripuṃḍraṃ dhṛtvā tu mokṣamāpnotyasaṃśayam || 165 || mātsye || vṛttaṃ || kiṃ yajñaiḥ kimanekatīrthagamanaiḥ kiṃ vedapāṭhaśramaiḥ kiṃ ghorairvividhaistapobhiradhunā kiṃ maṃtrataṃtrairjapaiḥ || kiṃ dhyānaiḥ kimanekadānanikaraiḥ kiṃ sāṃkhyayogabhramairmokṣārthī sitabhasmanā ca nipuṇaḥ kuryāttripuṃḍraṃ budhaḥ || 166 || kriyāsāre || tasmātsarvaprayatnena yuktaḥ sadbhasmanā budhaḥ || svāṃge tripuṃḍraṃ saṃdhārya sarvadā śivamarcayet || 167 || vibhūtimātramāhātmyaṃ vaktuṃ brahmā na śaknuyāt || kaḥ pumān saṃskṛtāgnyutthāṃ bhūtiṃ vaktuṃ samutsahet || 168 || śaivasaṃhitāyāṃ || śivamaṃtrātparo maṃtrastatvaṃ cāpi śivātparaṃ || śivārcanātparaṃ puṇyaṃ na hi tīrthaṃ ca bhasmanaḥ || 169 || śivadharme || rudrāgneryatparaṃ vīryaṃ tadbhasma parikīrtitaṃ || dhvaṃsanaṃ sarvaduḥkhānāṃ sarvapāpaviśodhanaṃ || 170 || laiṃge || aṃtyajo vā'dhamo vāpi mūrkho vā paṃḍito'pi vā ||
yasmin deśe vasennityaṃ bhasmaśāsanasaṃyutaḥ || 171 || tasmin sadāśivaḥ somaḥ sarvairbhūtagaṇairvṛtaḥ || sarvatīrthairyuto vāsaṃ sarvajñaḥ kurute sadā || 172 || yasmin deśe vasennityaṃ bhūtiśāsanasaṃyutaḥ || so'pi deśo bhavetpūtaḥ kiṃ punastasya maṃdiraṃ || 173 || kīkaṭeṣvapi deśeṣu yatra bhūtivibhūṣaṇaḥ || tatra kāśīsamaṃ kṣetraṃ so'pi viśveśvaraḥ svayaṃ || 174 || śivadharme || duḥśīlaśca suśīlo vā yo vā ko vāpyalakṣaṇaḥ || bhūtiśāsanasaṃyuktaḥ sa pūjyo rājaputravat || 175 || chadmanāpi ca yo dhatte bhūtiśāsanamaiśvaram || so'pi yāṃ gatimāpnoti na tāṃ yajñaśatairapi || 176 || mānavīyasaṃhitāyām || saṃparkāllīlayā vāpi bhayādvā dhārayecca yaḥ || vidhiyuktāṃ vibhūtiṃ tu sa ca pūjyo yathā hyahaṃ || 177 || śātātapasmṛtau || vṛttaṃ || surāṃ pītvā gurudārāṃśca gatvā steyaṃ kṛtvā brahmahatyāṃ ca kṛtvā || bhasmachanno bhasmaśāyī bhaveccedrudrādhyāyī mucyate sarvapāpaiḥ || 178 || yayā kayā kutra ca yatra saṃbhavaṃ kṣāraṃ dhṛtaṃ syādiha yena kena vā || na tena tulyo bhagavānajo'pi vibhūtidhārī sa śivaśca mānyaḥ || 179 ||
jābālopaniṣadi || traivarṇikānāmagnihotrāgnijaṃ(,) gṛhasthānāṃ tadeva(,) vivāhāgnijaṃ vā(,) brahmacāriṇāṃ samidagnijaṃ(,) viraktānāmativarṇāśramiṇāṃ virajānalajaṃ(,) śūdrāṇāṃ śrotriyāgārapacanāgnijaṃ(,) anyeṣāṃ dāvānalasamudbhavaṃ || yatīnāṃ sarvatrasthitamativarṇāśramiṇāṃ tadeva tatrāpi viraktānāṃ sarvatrasthitaṃ sarveṣāṃ devālaye sthitaṃ || śivayogināṃ śivāgnijā bhūtiḥ śivālaye sthitaṃ liṃgamaṃtrasaṃskāradagdhaṃ vā || bhūtyai na pramāditavyaṃ || 180 || śivarahasye || kaścitkaṃṭhagataprāṇaḥ kālaprāpto mṛtopamaḥ || śete śmaśāne vivaśo dasyuśastraniṣūditaḥ || 181 ||(?) atha senā puliṃdānāṃ śvā'nugaḥ kaścideva hi || dhāvan vegāttadaṃtastho bhasmapuṃḍra itastataḥ || 182 || tacchayānalalāṭāgranyastāṃghriśca tato yayau || etasminnaṃtare netuṃ kālamṛtyuṃ yamānugāḥ || 183 || tāvatā mucyamānāsuṃ pratyasarpannamuṃ yadā || tadānīmeva gaṇapā nānāpraharaṇodyatāḥ || 184 || vimāne'psarasāṃ vṛṃdaistatra taṃ paryavārayan || tatastaṃ dharmarāṭpreṣyāḥ dṛṣṭvā bhasmāṃkakāraṇaṃ || 185 ||
śaṃbhośca śāsana smṛtvā hitvā trastāśca liṃginaṃ || pradadravurdiśaste taṃ ninyuḥ śivapuraṃ gaṇāḥ || 186 || gāruḍapurāṇe || smṛtayaḥ śrutayaḥ sarvāḥ purāṇānyakhilānyapi || vadaṃti bhūtimāhātmyaṃ tatastāṃ dhārayedbudhaḥ || 187 || vāsiṣṭharāmāyaṇe || yāvaṃtaḥ patitā bhūmau bhasmanaḥ paramāṇavaḥ || tāvadvarṣasahasrāṇi naraḥ patati kilbiṣe || 188 || kriyāsāre || yathā kṛśānurahitastvadhvaro na virājate || aśeṣasādhanopetaṃ bhasmahīnaṃ śivārcanam || 189 || vāsiṣṭhalaiṃge || yena bhasmoktamārgeṇa na dhṛtaṃ munipuṃgava || tasya viddhi mune janma niṣphalaṃ sūkaro yathā || 190 || ye bhasmadhāraṇaṃ tyaktvā śrautasmārtānuvartinaḥ || taiḥ samācaritaṃ sarvaṃ viparītaphalapradam || 191 || yeṣāṃ nāsti mune śraddhā śraute bhasmani sarvadā || garbhādhānādisaṃskārasteṣāṃ nāstīti niścayaḥ || 192 || yeṣāṃ bhasmani viśvāso vartate hṛdaye sadā || teṣāmaiśvaryamatulaṃ viddhi vaṃśaparaṃparaṃ || 193 || ye bhasmadhāriṇaṃ dṛṣṭvā parituṣṭā bhavaṃti te || devāsuramunīṃdraiśca pūjyā nityaṃ na saṃśayaḥ || 194 ||
aṃganyāsādividhānam
dānaṃ dharmaśca yajñaśca śrutiścāpi vratāni vai || ete sarve'pi phaladāḥ kṛtaṃ cedbhasmadhāraṇaṃ || 195 || bahunoktena kiṃ bhasmadhāraṇaṃ mokṣasādhanam || bhasmanā sadṛśaṃ puṇyaṃ nāsti lokatraye'pi ca || 196 || brahmaṇā viṣṇunā cāpi rudreṇa ca munīśvarāḥ || bhasmadhāraṇamāhātmyaṃ na śakyaṃ paribhāṣituṃ || 197 || evaṃ sarvo vidhiḥ proktaḥ premṇā tava mayā tataḥ || kṛtvaivaṃ bhasma yo nityaṃ dhārayetsa śivaṃ vrajeta || 198 || mānavapurāṇe || ataḥ sarvaprayatnena pumānnityamataṃdritaḥ || tripuṃḍradhāraṇaṃ kuryādbhasmadehāvaguṃṭhanam || 199 || atha karanyāsaḥ || naṃ kaniṣṭhikābhyāṃ namaḥ || maṃ anāmikābhyāṃ namaḥ || śiṃ madhyamābhyāṃ namaḥ || vāṃ tarjanībhyāṃ namaḥ || yaṃ aṃguṣṭhābhyāṃ namaḥ || oṃ karatalakarapṛṣṭhābhyāṃ namaḥ || atha ṣaḍaṃganyāsaḥ || oṃ naṃ hrāṃ hṛdayāya namaḥ || maṃ hrīṃ śirase svāhā || śiṃ hrūṃ śikhāyai vauṣaṭ || vāṃ hraiṃ kavacāya huṃ || yaṃ hrauṃ netratrayāya vauṣaṭ oṃ hraḥ astrāya phaṭ ||
atha paṃcabrahmanyāsamaṃtraḥ || naṃ pādasthitāya sadyojātāya namaḥ || maṃ madhyasthitāya vāmadevāya namaḥ || śiṃ hṛdayasthitāya aghorāya namaḥ ||
vāṃ vaktrasthitāya tatpuruṣāya namaḥ || yaṃ śirasi sthitāya īśānāya namaḥ || oṃ sarvāvasthāya paraśivāya namaḥ || 200 || rudrākṣaṃ ca viśeṣeṇa dhārayedvedapāragaḥ || itaḥparaṃ na vaktavyaṃ śeṣo'nyo graṃthavistaraḥ || 201 || tiryaktripuṃḍramāhātmyaṃ yaḥ paṭhetsatataṃ naraḥ || iheṣṭānsakalān prāpya yātyaṃte paramaṃ padam || 202 || vṛttam || atirahasyamidaṃ munipuṃgavāḥ kathitameva samastajagaddhitam || yadi samācaritaṃ manujairmudā saphalameva hi janma na saṃśayaḥ || 203 ||
[iti śrīvīraśaivācārapradīpikāyāṃ pūjāprakaraṇe vibhūtyutpattitaddhāraṇamāhātmyaṃ tripuṃḍravidhimāhātmyaṃ karanyāsādinirṇayaṃ nāma saptadaśo'dhyāyaḥ] ||
[athāṣṭādaśo'dhyāyaḥ] |
|| śrīgurubhyo namaḥ ||
atha śrīrudrākṣotpattiḥ taddhāraṇakramaphalāni vakṣyāmi || bhasmanā vihitasnānastripuṃḍrāṃkitamastakaḥ || śivārcanaparo nityaṃ rudrākṣamapi dhārayet || 1 || kātyāyanaśākhāyāṃ bṛhajjābālopaniṣadi || ādau hyenaṃ bhagavaṃtaṃ rudraṃ kumāraḥ papraccha(,) bhagavan(,) rudrākṣotpattiḥ kathaṃ jātā taddhāraṇakramaḥ kīdṛśaḥ tatphalaṃ ca kimiti || śrībhagavān śaṃbhurāha || purā tripuravadhāya unmīlitākṣo'haṃ tebhyo jalabiṃdavo bhūmāvapatan ta eva rudrākṣā jātāḥ sarvānugrahārthāya teṣāṃ nāmoccāraṇamātreṇa daśaśatagodānaphalaṃ labhet darśanasparśanābhyāṃ dviguṇaṃ triguṇaṃ phalaṃ prāpnoti || ataḥparaṃ vaktuṃ tanmāhātmyaṃ na śaknomi kumāra itaḥ maṃtrapūrvakaṃ vidhiṃ kathayāmi || ādau snānādinā śucirbhūtvā bhasmanā tripuṃḍraṃ kṛtvā tato rudrākṣadhāraṇaṃ kuryāt || oṃ śrīsadāśivāya namaḥ iti maṃtreṇa dhāraṇaṃ || 2 || skāṃde || babhūvuste tu rudrākṣā hyaṣṭatriṃśatprabhedataḥ || sūryanetrasamutpannāḥ kapilā dvādaśa smṛtāḥ || 3 || somanetrasamutpannāḥ śvetāste ṣoḍaśa kramāt || vahninetrotthitāḥ kṛṣṇā daśabhedāḥ prakīrtitāḥ || 4 ||
padmapurāṇe || brāhmaṇāḥ kṣatriyā vaiśyāḥ śudrāśceti śivājñayā || śvetāstu brāhmaṇā jñeyāḥ kṣatriyā raktavarṇakāḥ || 5 || pītā vaiśyāstu vijñeyāḥ kṛṣṇāḥ śūdrā itīritāḥ || etānsarvavidhāṃścaiva dhārayadhvaṃ mamājñayā || 6 || krimidaṣṭaṃ ca vichinnaṃ bhinnaṃ kaṃṭakasaṃyutam || chidrayuktamavṛttaṃ ca ṣaḍimānnaiva dhārayet || 7 || achidraṃ kanakaprakhyamananyadhṛtamuttamam || rudrākṣaṃ dhārayet prājñaḥ śivapūjāparāyaṇaḥ || 8 || śṛṇu ṣaṇmukha tattvajña prativaktrasya yatphalaṃ || ekaṃ śikhāyāmekāsyaṃ dhārayet sarvasiddhidam || 9 || śirasā dhārayetskaṃda dvivaktraṃ bhuktimuktidam || dvitridvādaśavaktraṃ ca dhārayenmūrdhni bhāgyadam || 10 || ṣaṭsaptapaṃcavaktrāṃśca karṇayorjñānamokṣadān || kaṃṭhe ca dhārayennityamaṣṭavaktrānbhayāpahān || 11 || bāhvostrayodaśāsyaṃ ca dhārayecchāṃtidaṃ param || navavaktraṃ tu rakṣārthaṃ dhārayenmaṇibaṃdhayoḥ || 12 || daśavaktraṃ caturvaktraṃ dhārayetkaṃṭhamūlake || eteṣāṃ mālikā dhāryā bhuktimuktiphalapradāḥ || 13 || caturdaśamukhāṃścaiva dhārayedupavītinā ||
rudrākṣadhāraṇavidhānam
śivajñānakarāṃcchaśvadiṣṭasiddhikarānparān || 14 || śikhāmekaṃ trīṇi śiraḥ ṣaṭtriṃśanmastake'pi ca || dvātriṃśatkaṃṭhadeśe tu paṃcāśanmālikāṃ hṛdi || 15 || ṣoḍaśān bāhudeśe vā dvādaśānmaṇibaṃdhayoḥ || karṇayoḥ ṣaṭkamekaṃ vā aṣṭottaraśatādhikam || 16 || upavītena rudrākṣāndhārayetsarvadā budhaḥ || nābheradho na badhnīyānrudrākṣāṃścaraṇāvadhi || 17 || śirasā dhārayetkoṭiṃ karābhyāṃ daśakoṭayaḥ || evaṃ sarvasthale caiva dhāraṇātphalamāpnuyāt || 18 || gale dhāryaṃ koṭiśataṃ mūrdhni koṭisahasrakam || ayutaṃ copavītena lakṣakoṭirbhujadvaye || 19 || aprameyaphalāste tu rudrākṣā mokṣasādhanāḥ || avadhyaḥ sarvabhūtānāṃ rudravadvicaredbhuvi || 20 || paṃcaratnairmilitvā tu rudrākṣāndhārayedbudhaḥ || vajraṃ marakataṃ caiva vaiḍūryaṃ ca pravālakam || mauktikaṃ paṃcamaṃ jñeyamevaṃ tadratnapaṃcakam || 21 || brahmottarakhaṃḍe || muktāpravālavaiḍūryaraupyasphaṭikakāṃcanaiḥ || sametāndhārayedyastu rudrākṣānsa śivo bhavet || 22 || mukuṭaṃ kuṃḍale caiva kaṃṭhikāhārameva ca ||
keyūrakaṭake kuryātkukṣibaṃdhaṃ viśeṣataḥ || 23 || ekavaktraṃ trivaktraṃ vā caturvaktraṃ ca paṃcakaṃ || ṣaṇmukhaṃ saptakaṃ cāṣṭamukhaṃ navamukhaṃ tathā || 24 || lakṣaṇairyuktamekaṃ vā rudrākṣaṃ dhārayetsudhīḥ || ekasya dhāraṇādeva gopradānaphalaṃ labhet || 25 || dhārayedyāgakāle tu vedasyādhyayane tathā || sarvakāle viśeṣeṇa dhārayecchuddhabhāvataḥ || 26 || arcane homakāle tu svajanmadivase'pi vā || rudrākṣadhāraṇānnityaṃ sarvapāpakṣayo bhavet || 27 || tasmācchivārcako nityaṃ rudrākṣān dhārayetsadā || rudrākṣāṇāṃ phalaṃ vatsa triṣu lokeṣu viśrutaṃ || 28 || liṃgasya darśane puṇyaṃ bhavedrudrākṣadarśanāt || sparśādrātrau divā pāpaṃ divā rātrikṛtaṃ haret || 29 || darśanāllakṣagodānasadṛśaṃ phalamaśnute || sparśanātkoṭigodānasadṛśaṃ phalamaśnute || 30 || saptakoṭiśataṃ puṇyaṃ dhāraṇāllabhate naraḥ || lakṣakoṭisahasrāṇi lakṣakoṭiśatāni ca || 31 || tajjapāllabhate puṇyaṃ nātra kāryā vicāraṇā || sarvayajñatapodānavedābhyāsaiśca yatphalam || 32 || tatphalaṃ labhate sadyo rudrākṣasya tu dhāraṇāt || vedaiścaturbhiryatpuṇyaṃ purāṇapaṭhanena ca || 33 || yattīrthayātrayā puṇyaṃ sarvavidyādibhistathā ||
rudrākṣadhāraṇamāhātmyam
tatphalaṃ labhate sadyo rudrākṣasya ca dhāraṇāt || 34 || aṃtakāle tu rudrākṣaṃ bhakṣayitvā mṛto yadi || sa rudratvamavāpnoti punarjanma na vidyate || 35 || vimalāgame || nātaḥ parataraṃ tīrthaṃ nātaḥ parataraṃ tapaḥ || nātaḥ parataraṃ dānaṃ nātaḥ paratarā gatiḥ || 36 || rudrākṣāndhārayetkaṃṭhe bāhvorvā dhārayeddhruvam || kulaikaviṃśamuttārya rudraloke mahīyate || 37 || vāsiṣṭhalaiṃge || paśyannapi niṣiddhāṃśca tathā śṛṇvan smarannapi || jighrannapi tathā cāśnan pralapannapi saṃtatam || 38 || sthitaścāpi tathā gacchan visṛjannapi mānavaḥ || rudrākṣadhāraṇādeva mucyate sarvapātakaiḥ || 39 || amaṃtreṇa samaṃtreṇa yukto vā bhāvavarjitaḥ || yo vā ko vā naro nityaṃ dhārayellajjayā vinā || 40 || sarvapāpavinirmuktaḥ samyagjñānamavāpnuyāt || brāhmaṇo vāpi cāṃḍālo durguṇaḥ saguṇo'pi vā || bhasmarudrākṣayuktassan dehāṃte sa śivaṃ vrajet || 41 || (śivadharmaśāstre) rudrākṣeṇa svayaṃ rudro bhavedrudrākṣadhārakaḥ || rudrākṣāndhārayennityaṃ śivaloke mahīyate || 42 || rudro rudrākṣadānena bhavatīti kimadbhutam || rudrākṣamālayā yuktaḥ sa rudraścarati dhruvam || 43 ||
surāṇāṃ cāsurāṇāṃ ca vaṃdanīyo yathā śivaḥ || rudrākṣadhāraṇānnityaṃ vaṃdanīyo narairiha || 44 || rudrākṣamālikāṃ kaṃṭhe dhārayedbhaktivarjitaḥ || pāpakarmāpi yo martyo rudraloke mahīyate || 45 || ucchiṣṭī vā vikarmastho yukto vā sarvapātakaiḥ || mucyate sarvapāpebhyo naro rudrākṣadhāraṇāt || 46 || dhyānadhāraṇahīno'pi rudrākṣaṃ yadi dhārayet || sarvapāpavinirmuktaḥ sa yāti paramāṃ gatim || 47 || śucirvāpyaśucirvāpi cābhakṣyasyāpi bhakṣakaḥ || mleṃccho vāpyatha cāṃḍālo yukto vā sarvapātakaiḥ || rudrākṣadhāraṇādeva sa rudro nātra saṃśayaḥ || 48 || mānavapurāṇe || rudrākṣaṃ dhārayan pāpaṃ kurvanna'pi ca mānavaḥ || sarvaṃ tarati pāpaṃ ca jābālaśrutirāha hi || 49 || mṛnmayaṃ vāpi rudrākṣaṃ kṛtvā yatnena dhārayet || api duṣkṛtakarmāpi sa yāti paramāṃ gatim || 50 || paśavo'pi hi rudrākṣadhāraṇādyāṃti rudratām || rudrākṣadhāraṇaṃ kṛtvā naraḥ kiṃ nottariṣyati(?) || 51 || kaṃṭhe rudrākṣamāśritya śvāpi vā mriyate yadi || so'pi rudratvamāpnoti kiṃ punarmānuṣādayaḥ || 52 || vāsiṣṭhalaiṃge || kaścitpurā mune jātyā cāṃḍālo'tīva durjanaḥ ||
rudrākṣamāhātmyavarṇanam
ājanmanaḥ kṛtaṃ pāpaṃ brahmahatyāsahasrakam || 53 || gavāṃ sahastraṃ nihataṃ brāhmaṇānāṃ dhanaṃ hṛtam || anyāni yāni karmāṇi ghorāṇi caritāni vai || 54 || tathāpi tasya pāpāni mune rudrākṣadhāraṇāt || dagdhāni śālmalītūlaṃ yathā dāvāgninā yutam || 55 || kālena maraṇaṃ prāptaḥ sa punaryamamāgataḥ || so'pi taṃ prāha puruṣaṃ yamaḥ sarvārthavittamaḥ || 56 || aho pāpaṃ kṛtaṃ pūrvaṃ bhūloke cāvicārataḥ || tatphalaṃ tvāṃ mayā budhvā śakyaṃ bhogayituṃ nahi || 57 || mahātman sakalaṃ dagdhaṃ tava rudrākṣadhāraṇāt || gaccha gaccha vimānena śivalokaṃ sukhāvahaṃ || 58 || so'pi sūryanibhaṃ ramyaṃ vimānaṃ sarvakāmikaṃ || āruhya nṛtyagītādyairyuktaḥ śivapuraṃ gataḥ || 59 || tatra dattaṃ mayā tasmai skaṃda rudratvamuttamam || devaiśca munibhiścānyaiḥ pūjitaśca sadāpyasau || 60 || tasmātsarvaiḥ sadā kāryaṃ rudrākṣāṇāṃ ca dhāraṇaṃ || bhogamokṣapradaṃ puṃsāṃ mayā caiva dhṛtaḥ sadā || 61 || rudrākṣadhāraṇādeva brahmā brahmatvamāptavān || rudrākṣadhāraṇācchreṣṭhaṃ na kiṃcidiha vidyate || 62 || amaṃtradhāraṇādeva guṇā ete prakīrtitāḥ || yaḥ punarmaṃtrasaṃyuktaṃ dhārayedyadi mānavaḥ || 63 || rudrākṣadhāraṇāttasmātsarvapāpairna lipyate ||
śivasāyujyamāpnoti cāṃte jñānena saṃyutaḥ || 64 || rudrākṣāśritakaṃṭho yo gṛhe yasya vaseddhṛvam || kulaikaviṃśamuddhṛtya śivaloke mahīyate || 65 || vāsiṣṭhalaiṃge || rudrākṣadhāriṇaḥ pādau prakṣālyāpaḥ pibennaraḥ || sarvapāpavinirmuktaḥ śivasāyujyamāpnuyāt || 66 || rudrākṣadhāriṇe bhaktyā vastraṃ dhānyaṃ dadāti yaḥ || sarvapāpavinirmuktaḥ śivalokaṃ sa gacchati || 67 || mūrdhni hastopavīte vā dhṛtvā rudrākṣamālikām || yastu bhuṃkte na tadbhuktaṃ rudro bhuṃkte na saṃśayaḥ || 68 || anena bhuktaṃ rudreṇa bhuktaṃ yattattathaiva hi || pītaṃ rudreṇa pītaṃ syādghrātaṃ ghrātaṃ śivena tat || 69 || vṛttam || nityāni kāmyāni nimittajāni karmāṇi sarvāṇi sadāpi kurvan || abhasmarudrākṣadharo yadi syādvidvanna tasyāsti phalopapattiḥ || 70 || sarveṣu varṇāśramasaṃgateṣu nityaṃ sadācāraparāyaṇeṣu || śrutismṛtibhyāmiha codyamāno vibhūtirudrākṣadharaḥ samānaḥ || 71 || rudrākṣadhāriṇaṃ dṛṣṭvā parivādaṃ karoti yaḥ || utpattau tasya sāṃkaryamanumeyaṃ vipaścitā || 72 || skāṃde || kulīnamakulīnaṃ vā bhūtirudrākṣadhāriṇam || dṛṣṭvāpyuccāsanastho hi sa naro narakaṃ vrajet || 73 ||
vāsiṣṭhalaiṃge || rudrākṣadhāraṇe lajjā caiṣāmasti mahāmune || sā lajjā na tyajedbrahman teṣāṃ vaṃśaparaṃparāṃ || 74 || rudrākṣadhāraṇaṃ caiṣāṃ nāsti nityaṃ mahāmune || teṣāṃ nāsti vinirmokṣaḥ saṃsāre janmakoṭiṣu || 75 || śātātapasmṛtau || arudrākṣadharo bhūtvā yatkiṃcitkarma vaidikam || kuryādviprastu yo mohānnāsau prāpnoti tatphalaṃ || 76 || satataṃ karmakāle tu prāyaścitte surārcane || home maṃtre jape dīkṣākāle sarvatra dhārayet || 77 || rudrākṣaṃ dhārayedvipraḥ saṃdhyādiṣu ca karmasu || tatsarvaṃ samavāpnoti koṭikoṭiguṇaṃ sadā || 78 || aho rudrākṣamāhātmyaṃ mayā vaktuṃ na śakya te || tasmātsarvaprayatnena kuryādrudrākṣadhāraṇam || 79 ||
atha rudrākṣapūjanaṃ || vastre rudrākṣānsaṃsthāpya anaṃtaraṃ śivaṃ dhyātvā tadaṣṭavidhārcanaṃ kuryāt || 80 || atha guruśivadhyānaṃ || vṛttam || viviktadeśe ca sukhāsanasthaḥ(-)śuciḥ samagrīvaśiraḥśarīraḥ || atyāśramasthaḥ sakaleṃdriyāṇi nirudhya bhaktyā svaguruṃ praṇamya || 81 || hṛtpuṃḍarīke virajaṃ viśuddhamaciṃtyamādyaṃtavihīnamekam || anaṃtamavyaktamanekarūpaṃ śivaṃ praśāṃtaṃ girijādhinātham || 82 || surāsurādyairabhivaṃditaṃ prabhu śivādhavaṃ viśvavimokṣahetum ||
maheśvaraṃ sāṃbamumāsahāyaṃ sadāśivaṃ bhūtagaṇādhipaṃ vibhuṃ || 83 || nīlakaṃṭhaṃ bhasmaliptaṃ virūpākṣaṃ maheśvaram || namāmyahaṃ sadā bhaktyā trilokeśamumāpatim || 84 || iti dhyātvā rudrākṣāndhārayet || oṃ hrūṃ srūṃ brūṃ ruṃ jruṃ prāṃtarūtamapi śrīṃ māṃ kṣāṃ kṣamapi kṣauṃ hraṃ namaḥ anena maṃtreṇa rudrākṣānsaṃmaṃtrya || 85 || atha namaskāraḥ || rudrākṣavṛkṣabījāya bhūtisaṃbhūtihetave || netratrayāya rudrāya namo lokahitārthine || iti namaskāraḥ || anaṃtaram dhārayet || 86 ||
[iti śrīvīraśaivācārapradīpikāyāṃ pūjāprakaraṇe rudrākṣotpattirudrākṣadhāraṇakramatatphalavarṇanaṃ nāma aṣṭādaśo'dhyāyaḥ] || 18 ||
[atha ekonaviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ] |
|| śrīgurubhyo namaḥ ||
atha bahiryajanaṃ aṃtaryajanaṃ aṣṭavidhārcanaṃ tatphalaṃ ca vakṣyāmi || svayaṃ svameva dhyāyaṃtaṃ śivabhaktahite ratam || jñānaśāstraṃ munīṃdrāṇāṃ vyākurvaṃtaṃ vimuktidam || 1 || bhaktyā praṇamya deveśaṃ papraccha śikhivāhanaḥ || sarvalokopakārāya bhagavaṃtaṃ trilocanam || 2 ||
skaṃda uvāca || bhagavan śrotumicchāmi sarvaprāṇihitaṃ param || kecilliṃgārcanaṃ pīṭhe praśastaṃ tu pracakṣate || 3 || kecicchivāgamābhijñāḥ prāṇaliṃgārcanāparāḥ || liṃge prāṇaṃ samādāya karapīṭhe śivārcanaṃ || 4 ||
śaṃkara uvāca ||
sādhu pṛṣṭaṃ tvayā vatsa vakṣyāmyadya viśeṣataḥ || vedāgamapurāṇānāṃ sāraṃ gaupyaṃ manoharam || 5 || bhaktiḥ sthirīkṛtā yena mleṃcchenāpi sa me priyaḥ || na me priyaścaturvedī mayi yo bhaktivarjitaḥ || 6 || sā bhaktirdvividhā jñeyā bāhyābhyaṃtarabhedataḥ || bāhyā sthūlāṃtarā sūkṣmā vīramāheśvarādṛtā || 7 || siṃhāsane śuddhadeśe śubharatnavicitrite ||
śivaliṃgasya pūjāyā sā bāhyā bhaktirucyate || 8 || liṃge prāṇaṃ samādhāya prāṇe liṃgaṃ tu śāṃbhavam || ekāgraṃ tu manaḥ kṛtvā na kiṃcicciṃtayeddhṛdi || 9 || sābhyaṃtarā bhaktireva procyate śivayogibhiḥ || sā yasmin vartate tasya jīvanaṃ bhraṣṭabījavat || 10 || jīvanmuktaḥ sa vijñeyo vīramāheśvaraḥ pumān || tasya vakṣyāmi he vatsa śivaliṃgārcanakramam || 11 || saṃsārarogaduḥkhasya bheṣajaṃ muktisādhanam || vatsa liṃgārcanaṃ nityaṃ trikālaṃ kuru bhaktitaḥ || pūjādravyāṇi saṃśodhya śucistadgatamānasaḥ || 12 || vṛttam || snānaṃ samatvasalilena hi pūrṇabhāvaṃ vastraṃ triśaktiguṇasaṃyutayajñasūtraṃ || vidyāsugaṃdhamiha bhūtadayākṣatāṃśca śabdādi puṣyacayamarpaya nityamaṃga || 13 || prajñāmanohaṃkṛticittadhūpaṃ śrotrādipaṃceṃdriyadīpamaṃga || tadvāsanātailayutaṃ ca dehi jīvopahāraṃ sukhaduḥkhabāhyaṃ || 14 || guṇatrayākhyatāṃbūlaṃ prāṇārpaṇanamaskṛtiṃ || śāṃtipuṣpāṃjaliṃ dehi caikabhāvavisarjanam || 15 || vṛttam || tadeva hastāṃjalipīṭhamadhye nidhāya liṃgaṃ paramātmacihnam ||
śivapūjopakaraṇaphalam
samarcayedekadhiyopacārairnaraḥ sa bāhyāṃtarabhedabhinnaiḥ || 16 || vṛttaṃ || guruprasādādhigateṣṭaliṃgaṃ samarcayaṃtaṃ svakarābjapīṭhe || ṣaḍāsya bhaktyā vividhopacārairnarastamālokya vimuktimeti || 17 || karapīṭhe vinikṣipya cāṃguṣṭhāgre ca gomukham || kaniṣṭhānāmikābhyāṃ tu dhṛtvā taṃ pūjayecchivam || 18 || madhyamānāmikāmadhye puṣpaṃ saṃgṛhya pūjakaḥ || aṃguṣṭhatarjanyagrābhyāṃ nirmālyamapanodayet || 19 || devadevasya śirasi puṣpamekaṃ vinikṣipet || jalagaṃdhākṣataiḥ puṣpairdhūpadīpaistathaiva ca || naivedyairapi tāṃbūlairbhavedaṣṭavidhārcanam || 20 || jalaṃ śāṃtikaraṃ caiva gaṃdhamāyuṣyavardhanam || akṣataiḥ śatrunāśaṃ ca puṣpairaiśvaryavardhanam || 21 || dhūpo dahati pāpāni dīpo mṛtyuvināśakaḥ || naivedyāllabhate rājyaṃ tāṃbūlānmokṣasaṃpadaḥ || 22 || pādyārghyācamanaṃ snānaṃ punarācamanaṃ tathā || vastraṃ bhasmādikaṃ caiva kirīṭaṃ gaṃdhamakṣatān || 23 || puṣpāṇi phalayogyāni patrāṇi vividhāni ca || dhūpaṃ dīpaṃ ghṛtayutaṃ copahāraṃ tathaiva ca || 24 || tāṃbūlaṃ mukhavāsaṃ ca dīpaṃ karpūrakaṃ tathā || vyajanaṃ cāmaraṃ chatraṃ darpaṇaṃ ca suśobhitam || 25 ||
puṣpāṃjaliṃ tataḥ stotraṃ namaskāraṃ pradakṣiṇān || śrīmatpaṃcākṣareṇaiva hyupacārān samācaret || 26 || upacārāstrayaḥ proktāḥ paṃcāṣṭau ṣoḍaśaiva hi || caturviṃśacca dvātriṃśadupacārā ihoditāḥ || 27 || snānaṃ pūjā ca naivedyamupacārāstrayaḥ kramāt || pradakṣiṇanamaskārau paṃcaite parikīrtitāḥ || saṃgītanṛtyavādyaistairupacārāṣṭakaṃ mune || 28 || arghyaṃ pādyācame caiva puṣpaṃ gaṃdhopavītakau || akṣatāścāmaraṃ chatraṃ vyajanaṃ caiva sarvadā || 29 || gītaṃ vādyaṃ tathā nṛtyaṃ namaskāraḥ stutistathā || pradakṣiṇaṃ krameṇoktā hyupacārāśca ṣoḍaśa || 30 || āvāhanāsane pādyaṃ cārghyamācamanaṃ tathā || gaṃdhapuṣpākṣatāścaiva vastraṃ snānopavītake || 31 || dhūpaṃ dīpaṃ ca naivedyaṃ phalaṃ tāṃbūladarpaṇe || pradakṣiṇanamaskārāḥ stotraṃ saṃgītavādyakam || 32 || nṛtyaṃ cātmārpaṇaṃ caiva caturviṃśopacārakāḥ || āvāhanāsane pādyaṃ cārghyamācamanīyakam || 33 || snānaṃ vastraṃ copavītaṃ bhūṣaṇaṃ cānulepanam || tilākṣatāpuṣpadhūpadīpanaivedyakāni ca || 34 || nīrājanaṃ vaktravāsaṃ darpaṇaṃ ca phalāni ca || pradakṣiṇaṃ ca tāṃbūlaṃ namaskāraḥ stutistathā || 35 || purāṇapaṭhanaṃ chatraṃ cāmaraṃ vyajanaṃ tathā || śayyāsaṃgītanṛtyāni vādyāni ca tathaiva ca ||
ātmanyāropaṇaṃ caiva dvātriṃśadupacārakāḥ || 36 ||
[iti śrīvīraśaivācārapradīpikāyāṃ pūjāprakaraṇe pūjopacāraphalanirūpaṇaṃ nāma ekonaviṃśodhyāyaḥ] ||
[atha viṃśo'dhyāyaḥ] |
|| śrīgurubhyo namaḥ ||
