atha ghaṃṭālakṣaṇaṃ darpaṇaśaṃkhalakṣaṇaṃ ca vakṣyāmi || kriyāsāre || daṃḍāgre sthitaśūlā ca dhattūrakusumopamā || yā saurāṣṭrī kāṃsyamayī ghaṃṭā ca kvaṇasaṃyutā || 1 || āyāmaṃ ghaṃṭikāyāstu proktamaṃgulapaṃcakam || tadvanmuṣṭipramāṇaṃ syātkaṭakadvayasaṃpuṭaṃ || 2 || tadūrdhve tryaṃgulayutaṃ vidadhīta triśūlakam || tasyā vadanavistāraṃ ṣaḍaṃgulamiti smṛtaṃ || 3 || ghaṃṭāyāḥ sakalaṃ dairghyamaṃgulānāṃ trayodaśa || evaṃ netrapriyāṃ ghaṃṭāmasmin māne ca kārayet || 4 || śaivapurāṇe || darpaṇaṃ cāpi susnigdhaṃ divyagaṃdhānulepanam || samaṃtādratnasaṃchannaṃ sragvaraiścāpi śobhitam || 5 || śivasya purataścāru darpaṇaṃ caṃdravacchubham || nityaṃ nivedayedbhaktyā sa yāti paramāṃ gatim || 6 || darpaṇaṃ devadevāya pūjāṃte bhaktipūrvakam || darśayitvā sakṛdyāti śivalokaṃ na saṃśayaḥ || 7 || gokṣīradhavalasnigdho dīrghanālo bṛhattamaḥ || vṛtto yo dakṣiṇāvartaḥ so'bdhijaḥ śaṃkhasaṃjñakaḥ || 8 || pūrvoktalakṣaṇopeto vāmāvartotha vābdhijaḥ || śaṃkho'yaṃ so'tisulabhaḥ pūrvokto'tīvadurlabhaḥ || 9 ||
śaṃkhajayaghaṃṭādisvarūpavarṇanam
śaṃkhasya nālaṃ yāvatsyāttāvatsyādāyataṃ smṛtam || tasyārdhaṃ nāsikā yasya sa śaṃkhaḥ śreṣṭha ucyate || 10 || tadardhanāsiko yo'sau śaṃkho bhavati madhyamaḥ || śaṃkho'yamitaro labdhaḥ sa kaniṣṭhaḥ prakīrtitaḥ || 19 || bhinnaḥ krimihato raktaḥ saraṃdhraḥ kalmaṣacchaviḥ || hrasvanālaḥ sa śaṃkho yo na yogyo nādakarmaṇi || 12 || mahāmeghasvaraṃ datvā śaṃkhayugmaṃ śivālaye || yugakoṭiśataṃ tāvacchivaloke mahīyate || 13 || kriyāsāre || śuddhasaurāṣṭrakā caiva caṃdramaṃḍalavaddṛḍhā || dvitālavistṛtāyāmā jayaghaṃṭāhvayā matā || 14 ||
[iti śrīvīraśaivācārapradīpikāyāṃ pūjāprakaraṇe ghaṃṭādarpaṇaśaṃkhalakṣaṇaṃ nāma viṃśo'dhyāyaḥ] ||
[athaikaviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ] |
śrīgurubhyo namaḥ ||
atha kāhalālakṣaṇaṃ ḍhakvālakṣaṇaṃ carasthiraduṃdubhilakṣaṇaṃ mṛdaṃgādivādyalakṣaṇaṃ ca vakṣyāmi || kāhalā paṭahaḥ śaṃkho bherī ca jayaghaṃṭikā || ete paṃca mahāśabdā maṃgaladhvanayaḥ smṛtāḥ || 1 || suvarṇena ca raupyena tāmreṇāpi vinirmitāḥ || īṣadunmīlitenātha dhattūreṇa samāṃ śubhāṃ || 2 || kāhalāṃ dvyaṃgulāṃ kuryāccaturaṃgulavistṛtām || caturaṃgulavistāraṃ mukhaṃ tasyāśca kārayet || 3 || tryaṃgulaṃ daṃḍamānaṃ syādanusthūlaṃ tathāditaḥ || tathaiva vistṛtāṃ kuryātsallakṣaṇayutāṃ vibho || 4 || paṃcāṃgulāṃ dvitālāṃ ca kuryādbhaktaḥ sthirāṃ śubhām || sārdhadvayāṃgulamukhāṃ kāhalāṃ lakṣaṇānvitām || 5 || anyatsarvaṃ yathāpūrvaṃ vistārāyāmapūrvakam || evaṃ lakṣaṇamākhyātaṃ kāhalāyāḥ śubhānana || 6 || (śaivapurāṇe) kāhalādīni ramyāṇi nānānādakarāṇi vai || sauvarṇāni suramyāṇi sthāpayecchivasaṃnidhau || 7 || (kriyāsāre) āsanaḥ khadiraḥ śreṣṭhaścāpi vā raktacaṃdanaḥ || trayo'mī paṭahasyoktāstaravo vādyavedibhiḥ || 8 || paṃcatālapramāṇena vistāraṃ paṭahasya vai ||
carasthiraduṃdubhilakṣaṇam
dvitālamadhyamaṃ sthūlaṃ tālamātraṃ mukhaṃ smṛtam || 9 || carmaṇācchādya vadanadvayaṃ kuryāddṛḍhaṃ śubham || koṇe vinyasya pūjāyāḥ kāle saṃtāḍayecca vai || 10 || (kriyāsāre) duṃdubhirdvividhaḥ proktaḥ sthirajaṃgamabhedataḥ || koṇanyastā sthirā proktā saiva laghvī carā matā || 11 || khadiraḥ pītasāraśca śirīṣo raktacaṃdanaḥ || madhūkoriṣṭakaścaiva ṣaḍvṛkṣā duṃdubheḥ smṛtāḥ || 12 || āyāmaṃ saptatālaṃ syātpaṃcatālaṃ tu vistṛtam || mukhaṃ tritālavistāraṃ mukhaṃ sannādasaṃyutam || 13 || anyatsarvaṃ yathāpūrvaṃ kārayedduṃdubhiṃ śubham || suvṛttaṃ lohabaddhaṃ vai mukhaṃ lohayutaṃ ca vai || 14 || mukhasya paritaḥ sapta nyasetkīlānayomayān || mukhaṃ tu carmaṇācchādya tathā sūtreṇa veṣṭayet || 15 || etatsarvaṃ samākhyātaṃ lakṣaṇaṃ sthiraduṃdubheḥ || ṣaṭtālamatha cāyāmaṃ cāṣṭatālaṃ tritālakam || 16 || catustālaṃ tu vistāraṃ mukhaṃ sārdhadvitālakam || yathāpūrvaṃ ca vidhinā kuryādvai caturānana || 17 || catustālapramāṇoccaṃ tannālaṃ tālapaṃcakam || vadanadvayavistāraṃ samaṃ taddvādaśāṃgulam || 18 || suvartulaṃ samaṃtācca ghanamardhāṃgulaṃ smṛtam ||
mukhayorubhayormadhye carmasūtreṇa veṣṭayet || 19 || mukhasya paritaḥ kīlān sthāpayetparitastathā || evaṃ yathāvatkathitaṃ lakṣaṇaṃ caraduṃdubheḥ || 20 || asya sthānaṃ sthalaṃ nānyadaṃgaṃ dauṃdubhikasya tu || dhṛtvā dauṃdubhikaḥ svāṃge vādayedduṃdubhiṃ tathā || 21 || ayaṃ duṃdubhinirghoṣaḥ śaṃbhoḥ prītikaraḥ sadā || 22 || kriyāsāre || sthūlonnatābhyāṃ sadṛśī mahāvṛkṣavinirmitā || tvagbaddhobhayapārśvā sā bherī syādduṃdubhidhvaniḥ || 23 || dvau śaṃkhau kāhale dve ca catasro jayaghaṃṭikāḥ || ekā bherī ca paṭahaścaikaḥ saṃkhyaivamīritā || 24 || kecidetānpaṃca vādyānvadaṃti sudhiyo'khilāḥ || gītavādyaiśca vividhaiḥ kuryācchaṃkhādiniḥsvanān || 25 || atroktasaṃkhyayādhikyaṃ vādyānāṃ tanuyātsudhīḥ || alābhe ca yathālabdhaiḥ pūjākāle tu vādayet || 26 || snāne dhūpe pradīpa vai naivedye'pi prabodhayet || ghaṃṭādīnāṃ tu vividhaiḥ śabdairdevaṃ prabhuṃ śivaṃ || 27 || snānakāle trisaṃdhyāyāṃ yaḥ kuryādbherivādanam || nāṭyaṃ vā mukhavādyaṃ vā tasya puṇyaphalaṃ śṛṇu || 28 || yāvaṃtyahāni kurute stutinartanavādanam ||
śivārcākāle taṃtrīsvanādikathanam
tāvadyugasahasrāṇi rudraloke mahīyate || 29 || śivadharme || taṃtrīsvanaṃ mṛdaṃgaṃ tamānakaṃ murajādikam || vaṃśādikaṃ tu suṣiraṃ kāṃsyatālādikaṃ tathā || 30 || gamakāhālatimilāḥ sutālāḥ sulabhāḥ smṛtāḥ || etādṛśāni vādyāni śivāya vinivedayet || 31 ||
[iti śrīvīraśaivācārapradīpikāyāṃ vādyalakṣaṇaṃ nāmaikaviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ] ||
[atha dvāviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ] |
śrīgurubhyo namaḥ | atha liṃgasya tailābhyaṃgaṃ arghyaṃ ācamanīyaṃ kathaṃ kāryaṃ uta ca gaṃdhādyupacāralakṣaṇāni vakṣyāmi || tailābhyaṃgaṃ tataḥ kṛtvā liṃgapīṭhe viśeṣataḥ || sauvarṇaṃ rājataṃ tāmraṃ ceti pātraṃ tridhā smṛtam || 1 || kāṃsyapātramathodraumamalāme mṛṇmayaṃ tu vā || arghyādīnāṃ na yogyāni bhinnapātrāṇi jātucit || 2 || abhinnāni ca śuddhāni pātrāṇi ca sadānayet || tāmrasphaṭikaśaṃkheṣu suvarṇakaladhautayoḥ || 3 || na vidyate bhinnadoṣaḥ pātreṣvanyeṣu vidyate || raupyaśaṃkhasuvarṇānāṃ spṛṣṭadoṣo na vidyate || 4 || dārumṛtpātrayorasti spṛṣṭadoṣo'ntyajātibhiḥ || śaṃkhaḥ śuddho bhavettatra tuṣasaṃgharṣaṇena vai || 5 || āmlena tāmraṃ bhūtyā tatkāṃsyaṃ cūrṇena pittalam || saṃgharṣayedviśuddhyarthaṃ kāṃtiprasaraṇāya vai || 6 || haimaṃ raupyaṃ viśuddhaṃ syātkevalaṃ kṣālanājjalaiḥ || pātraṃ gokarṇavatkuryādyathoktaṃ ca vidhānataḥ || 7 || eṣāmalābhe pātrāṇāṃ nārikelasya pātrakam || arghyādipātraṃ prasthārdhaṃ kuryādvai vidhipūrvakam || 8 ||
arghyapātraphalavarṇanam
haimaṃ vā rājataṃ vāpi muktāmayamathāpi vā || tāmraṃ vā nārikelaṃ vā prakṣālyādbhiḥ prapūrayet || 9 || aṣṭāṃgamarghyamāpūrya liṃgamūrtyāṃ nivedayet || daśavarṣasahasrāṇi rudraloke mahīyate || 10 || guha kṣīraṃ kuśāgraṃ ca dadhyājyayavataṃdulam || tilasiddhārthakaṃ caivamarghyamaṣṭāṃgamucyate || pātrottaraṃ viśeṣeṇa tatphalaṃ ca prakīrtitam || 11 || dārujenārghyapātreṇa datvārghyaṃ yatphalaṃ labhet || tasmāddaśaguṇaṃ puṇyaṃ mṛtpātreṇa prakīrtitam || 12 || tāmrapātrārghyadānena puṇyaṃ daśaguṇottaram || sphāṭikena supātreṇa dadyādarghyaṃ vidhānataḥ || 13 || raupyapātreṇa vijñeyamarghyaṃ lakṣaguṇottaram || soṃ'te pāpavinirmuktaḥ śivasāyujyamāpnuyāt || 14 || padmarāgamaye pātre yo'rghyaṃ dadyācchivāya vai || tejolokamavāpnoti tejomaṃḍalamaṃḍitaḥ || 15 || vaiḍūryasyeṃdranīlasya pātre marakatasya ca || arghyaṃ dadyācchivāyaivaṃ sa śivo nātra saṃśayaḥ || 16 || raupyapātrapradānena yatphalaṃ vedapārage || tasmācchataguṇaṃ puṇyaṃ śive mṛtpātradānataḥ || 17 || hemapātraṃ tu yaddatvā puṇyaṃ syādvedapārage || tāmrapātrapradānena tasmācchataguṇaṃ bhavet || 18 ||
hemapātraṃ tu yo bhaktyā śivāya vinivedayet || na tasya śakyate vaktuṃ puṇyānaṃtyaṃ viśeṣataḥ || 19 || padmarāgamayaṃ pātraṃ sphāṭikaṃ caiṃdranīlakam || vaiḍūryajaṃ mārakataṃ dattaṃ puṇyamavāpnuyāt || 20 || tulyameva phalaṃ proktaṃ śive cāḍhyadaridrayoḥ || tayorapyadhikaṃ puṇyaṃ śive bhāvayutasya vai || 21 || vibhave sati yo mūrkho na kuryādvidhivattaram || naitatphalamavāpnoti pralobhākrāṃtamānasaḥ || 22 || tasmātpavitraiḥ phaladaistoyaiḥ kuryādvidhānataḥ || tadānaṃtyaphalaṃ jñeyaṃ bhaktirevātra kāraṇaṃ || 23 || śivadharmasaṃhitāyām || sanatkumāra uvāca || śrutametattvayā khyātaṃ bhagavannaṃdikeśvara || arghyadānasya yatpuṇyaṃ vaktumarhasi sadguro || 24 || naṃdikeśvara uvāca || vṛttam || jīrṇārkaparṇapuṭasaṃsthitamarghyamāryo vyāsassamastaguṇabuddhimavāpya cābhūt || sarvaissamarcitapadābjayugo munīndrairdatvā śivāya vidhivatsa piturniyogāt || 25 || adyāpi cākṣayaṃ tasya kulaṃ jñānasamaṃ bhuvi || jīvopi nityatāṃ prāpto viprasya munisattama || 26 || || vṛttam || tasmādvadāmi śṛṇu saṃprati sarvayatnādbhaktyā bhavāṃghriyugalaṃ prati dattamaṃbhaḥ || yatkiṃcidartharahitena nareṇa tatsyādarghyaṃ bhavārṇavaharaṃ sakalaṃ dadāti || 27 ||
arghyādisvarūpakathanam
kuśāgratilasiddhārthayavabrīhipayāṃsi ca || dravyāṇyamūni ṣaṭ prāhurarghyasya munipuṃgavāḥ || 28 || siddhārthaḥ kusumaṃ dūrvā koṣṭhaṃ lāmajjakaṃ śaśī || amūni cātra dravyāṇi pādyasya kathayaṃti ṣaṭ || 29 || phalaṃ kacorakarpūrakoṣṭelośīrakāni ca || amūnyācamanīyasya dravyāṇi pravadaṃti ṣaṭ || 30 || kaurme || arghyapātre kṣipetpuṣpaṃ yavakṣīrakuśākṣatān || tilasarṣapagaṃdhāṃśca puṣpaṃ vā kevalaṃ kṣipet || 31 || uśīraṃ caṃdanaṃ caiva pādye saṃmiśrayetsudhīḥ || jātīkaṃkolakarpūrasuvāsitatamālakān || 32 || kṣipedācamanīyaṃ ca pūrṇaṃ kṛtvā viśeṣataḥ || elāṃ sarveṣu pātreṣu karpūraṃ caṃdanaṃ tathā || 33 || arghyaṃ haste tu devasya gaṃdhapuṣpākṣatādibhiḥ || pādyaṃ pādāṃbuje deyaṃ vaktre cācamanīyakam || 34 || tailābhyaṃgaṃ tataḥ kṛtvā liṃgapīṭhe viśeṣataḥ || oṃ devādevebhya iti maṃtreṇa arghyaṃ samarpayet || oṃ pādosya viśvābhūtāni iti maṃtreṇa pādyaṃ samarpayet || oṃ viśvataścakṣuruta iti maṃtreṇa ācamanam || skāṃde || liṃgodakaṃ ca pādāṃbu prasādodamiti tridhā || namaskṛtvātha śirasi dhāryaṃ peyaṃ śivārthibhiḥ || 35 || gaṃdhodakaiḥ snāpayitvā puṣpodaiḥ snāpayedatha ||
hemodaiḥ snāpayitvā tu ratnodaiḥ snāpayedatha || 36 || sitena bhasmanā snāpya sakṛlliṃgaṃ pramodate || caṃdravannirmalaḥ śrīmān śivaloke mahīyate || 37 || kuśatoyena yo liṃgaṃ snāpayedbhaktito naraḥ || kāṃcanena vimānena brahmaloke mahīyate || 38 || atha ratnodakādimaṃtraḥ || oṃ hrauṃ īśānāya namaḥ gaṃdhodakaṃ svāhā || oṃ hreṃ tatpuruṣāyanamaḥ puṣpodakaṃ svāhā || oṃ hrāṃ aghorāya namaḥ || suvarṇodakaṃ svāhā || oṃ hrīṃ vāmadevāya namaḥ ratnodakaṃ svāhā || oṃ hraṃ sadyojātāya namaḥ maṃtrodakaṃ svāhā || oṃ śivāya namaḥ bhasmodakaṃ svāhā || śivāya namaḥ kuśodakaṃ svāhāṃ || śivāya namaḥ darbhodakaṃ svāhā || naṃdā bhadrā ca surabhiḥ suśīlā sumanasvinī || gāvaḥ śivapurātpaṃca kṣitiṃ yātāḥ śivājñayā || 39 || gomūtraṃ gomayaṃ caiva kṣīraṃ dadhi ghṛtaṃ tathā || sadyojātena gomūtraṃ vāmadevena gomayam || 40 || kṣīraṃ cāghoramaṃtreṇa dadhi tatpuruṣeṇa vai || īśānena ghṛtaṃ paṃcagavyaṃ sadyādimaṃtrataḥ || 41 || gavyaṃ ca gomayaṃ cātra dadhi kṣīraṃ ghṛtaṃ tathā || paṃcagavyaṃ ca saṃsthāpya pātreṣu ca pṛthak pṛthak || 42 || kṣīraṃ tvīśānamadhye ca tatpūrve dadhi cocyate ||
śivaliṃgābhiṣekavidhivarṇanam
dakṣiṇe tu ghṛtaṃ sthāpya cottare gomayaṃ tathā || 43 || oṃ hrāṃ sadyojātāya namaḥ gomūtraṃ svāhā || oṃ hrī vāmadevāya namaḥ gomayaṃ svāhā || oṃ hrūṃ aghorāya namaḥ || gokṣīraṃ svāhā || oṃ hreṃ tatpuruṣāya namaḥ dadhi svāhā || oṃ hroṃ īśānāya namaḥ ghṛtaṃ svāhā|| etairmaṃtraiḥ pṛthak pṛthak snānaṃ kārayet ||
atha paṃcāmṛtasnānaṃ ||
kriyāsāre || pratyekaṃ paṃcaprasthāśca tathā kuḍavapaṃcakam || ekaikakuḍavaṃ caiva tadalābhe nikūjakam || 44 || evaṃ hi caraliṃgasya kārayeddeśikottamaḥ || kṣīraṃ dadhi ghṛtaṃ caiva śarkarā madhu caiva hi || 45 || kṣīraṃ tu madhye tvīśānye tatpūrve dadhi cocyate || dakṣiṇe tu ghṛtaṃ sthāpya cottare kṣaudrameva hi || paścime śarkarāṃ caiva paṃca brahmādidevatāḥ || 46 || oṃ āpyāyasveti maṃtreṇa kṣīreṇa snāpayet || īśānamaṃtreṇa śuddhodakena snāpayet || oṃ hraiṃ tatpuruṣāya namaḥ bhasma samarpayet || oṃ hrīṃ vāmadevāya namaḥ akṣatān || oṃ namaḥ śivāyeti maṃtreṇa bilvaṃ || oṃ hrauṃ netratrayāya vauṣaṭ dhūpaṃ svāhā ||
oṃ hraiṃ kavacāya huṃ dīpaṃ || oṃ namaḥ śivāyetyanena naivedyaṃ || pānīyaṃ tābūlaṃ darpaṇaṃ ghaṃṭānādaṃ samarpayet || oṃ dadhi krāvṇo iti maṃtreṇa dadhisnānaṃ || punaḥ pūrvoktapūjāṃ samāpya || oṃ madhuvātetyanena madhusnānaṃ || punaḥ pūrvoktapūjāṃ || oṃ yāḥ phalinī iti maṃtreṇa phalaṃ || punaḥ pūrvoktapūjāṃ || oṃ bhūrbhuvaḥ svaḥ tatsavituriti maṃtreṇa śarkarāṃ || pūrvoktapūjāṃ || tato godhūmacūrṇena gharṣayet || tataḥ koṣṇena vāriṇā snāpayet || tato mudgacūrṇena gharṣayet || tato haridrayā devamālipya snānamācaret || daśa dhenusahasrāṇi datvā yallabhate phalaṃ || tatphalaṃ labhate sarvaṃ liṃgasyodvartane kṛte || 47 ||
[iti śrīvīraśaivācārapradīpikāyāṃ paṃcāmṛtalakṣaṇaṃ nāma dvāviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ] ||
[atha trayoviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ] |
śrīgurubhyo namaḥ |
uttamaṃ tu nadītoyaṃ taṭākāṃbhastu madhyamam || kaniṣṭhaṃ kūpasalilaṃ cābhiṣeke yathākramam || 1 || tatra svādu payaḥ śreṣṭhaṃ kaniṣṭhaṃ lavaṇodakam || madhyamaṃ miśrasalilamiti vāri tridhā smṛtam || 2 || abhāve svādupayaso miśrairapi ca kārayet || abhiṣekādikarmāṇi na kuryāllavaṇāṃbhasā || 3 || durjātyadhīnaṃ durgandhaṃ krimimiśraṃ śavānvitaṃ || sakardamaṃ saśaivālaṃ vāryavaśyaṃ parityajet || 4 || yatra naivedyanirmālyaiḥ saṃkīrṇaṃ kalaśodakam || abhiṣekaṃ ca kuryādvai na tadgṛhṇāti śaṃkaraḥ || 5 || yāni kāryāṇi karmāṇi vastrapūtena vāriṇā || tāni sarvāṇi kurvīta devatārādhane sadā || 6 || snapane caraliṃgasya paṃcāḍhakamitaṃ jalam || etacca tāmrakuṃbheṣu nyasetpaṃcāḍhakeṣu ca || 7 || (pārameśvarataṃtre) dṛḍhaṃ ca susthiraṃ snigdhaṃ navaṃ sthūlaṃ manoharam || mṛṇmayaṃ kāṣṭhajaṃ tāmraṃ rājataṃ haimameva vā || 8 || śivasya majjanārthaṃ hi kalaśaṃ saṃprakalpayet || mṛdādīnāṃ phalaṃ proktaṃ koṭikoṭiguṇottaram || 9 ||
śataṣaṣṭhipramāṇaṃ tu vrīhīṇāṃ niṣkamucyate || aṣṭaniṣkaṃ palaṃ proktaṃ teṣāṃ śatapalaṃ tulā || 10 || niṣkaṃ pāṇitalaṃ muṣṭiḥ kuḍavaṃ prasthamāḍhakam || droṇaṃ vahaṃ ca kramaśo vijñeyāśca caturguṇaiḥ || 11 || mānāṃgulapramāṇaṃ || tiryagyavodarāṇyaṣṭau yavā vā vrīhayastrayaḥ || pramāṇamaṃgulaṃ proktametadaṃgulalakṣaṇam || 12 || ṣaḍaṃgulaṃ tu vistīrṇaṃ dvādaśāṃgulamāyatam || prasthasya mānamityuktaṃ vaidyaśāstraviśāradaiḥ || 13 || puruṣasya pānīyamagnānmadhyamāṃguliparvaṇaḥ patitāḥ ṣoḍaśa biṃdavo uḍurekaḥ(,) uḍudvayaṃ śuktirekā(,) śuktidvayaṃ talamekaṃ(,) taladvayaṃ prakuṃcamekaṃ(,) prakuṃcadvayāt praśutaṃ(,) praśutadvayāt kuḍavamekaṃ(,) kuḍavadvayādekā mānikā(,) mānikādvayādekaṃ prasthaṃ(,) prasthadvayādardhamāḍhakaṃ(,) ardhāḍhakadvayādekamāḍhakaṃ(,) āḍhakadvayācchivamekaṃ(,) śivadvayāt droṇamekaṃ(,) droṇadvayāt ardhavahaṃ ardhavahadvayaṃ bhāratiḥ(,) iti mānalakṣaṇam || kalaśasya mukhe rudraḥ kaṃṭhe viṣṇuḥ samāśritaḥ || mūle tatra sthito brahmā madhye mātṛgaṇāḥ smṛtāḥ || 14 || kukṣau tu sāgarāḥ sarve saptadvīpā vasuṃdharā ||
śivapūjārthaṃ jalaśuddhyādikathanam
śeṣāstu devatāḥ sarvāḥ kalaśaṃ tu samāśritāḥ || 15 || ṛgvedo'tha yajurvedaḥ sāmavedo hyatharvaṇaḥ || aṃgaiśca saṃyutāḥ sarve kalaśaṃ tu samāśritāḥ || 16 || savitsamudrasalilatīrthāni śubhadāni ca || gaṃge ca yamune caiva godāvari sarasvati || 17 || narmade siṃdhu kāveri jale'sminsaṃnidhiṃ kuru || 18 || atha śrutiḥ || oṃ āpo vā idamā (?) sarvaṃ viśvābhūtānyāpaḥ prāṇā vāpaḥ paśava āpo'nnamāpomṛtamāpaḥ samrāḍāpo virāḍāpaḥ svarāḍāpaḥ chaṃdāṃ (?) syāpo joti (?) ṣyāpo yajū (?) ṣyāpaḥ satyamāpaḥ sarvā devatā āpaḥ oṃ bhūrbhuvaḥ svāhā iti jalaśuddhiḥ || jalaṃ bhāṃḍe pavitre ca maṃtraistoyaṃ kṣipettataḥ || suvarṇakalaśenātha tathā vai rājatena ca || 19 || tāmreṇa padmapātreṇa pālāśena dalena vā || śuddhena mṛṇmayenāpi śodhitena śubhena ca || 20 || kalaśenātha śaṃkhena vardhanyā pāṇinātha vā || sakūrcena sapuṣpeṇa snāpayenmaṃtrapūrvakam || 21 || payomadhughṛtādīnāṃ dvisahasraphalairapi || mahābhiṣekaṃ kuryādvai phalaistatsamamucyaṃte || 22 || kaṃkolajātipunnāgatriphalānāṃ tathaiva ca || mahāvartidvayenāpi śivasyāgre prakalpayet || 23 || (laiṃge) snāpya liṃgaṃ madīyaṃ ca gavyenaiva ghṛtena ca || viśodhya sarvadravyāṇi tathādbhirabhiṣecayet || 24 || bherīmṛdaṃgapaṭahamurajādibhirapyatha || vāditrairvividhairanyairnṛtyaśca vividhairapi || 25 || jāgaraṃ kārayettatra prārthayecca yathākramam ||
dravyahīnaiḥ kriyāhīnaiḥ śraddhāhīnairmaheśvara || 26 || kṛtaṃ vāpyakṛtaṃ vāpi kṣaṃtumarhasi śaṃkara || paṃcākṣaraṃ japedbhaktyā devadevasya saṃnidhau || 27 || evaṃ yaḥ kurute snānaṃ śivasya paramātmanaḥ || sa eva sarvatīrtheṣu sarvayajñeṣu yatphalam || 28 || tatphalaṃ sakalaṃ prāpya vārāṇasyāṃ yathā mṛtaḥ || tathaiva mama sāyujyaṃ labhate nātra saṃśayaḥ || 29 || matprītyarthamidaṃ kāryaṃ madbhaktairvidhipūrvakam || mahāsnāne tvaśaktaścet snānamaṣṭaguṇaṃ smṛtam || 30 || jalena kevalenaiva gaṃdhatoyena bhaktitaḥ || ālepanaṃ ca tatsarvaṃ paṃcaviṃśatpalena vai || 31 || śatadroṇairmahādevamaṣṭa droṇaistathāpi vā || śatadroṇasamaṃ puṇyamāḍhake'pi vidhīyate || 32 ||
(śaivadharmasaṃhitāyāṃ) sanatkumāra uvāca || bhagavan sarvadharmajña naṃdīśvara gaṇeśvara || vaktumarhasi deveśa snānapuṇyaphalaṃ mama || 33 ||
naṃdikeśvara uvāca || vṛttam || vadāmi sarvaṃ śṛṇu devadevaṃ maheśamīśānamumeśamīśaṃ || jalādibhiḥ snāpya phalaṃ pavitraṃ yathākramaṃ saṃprati vistareṇa || 34 || nadyāḥ samudragāminyāstaḍāgādvā samāhṛtam ||
śivābhiṣekamahimāvarṇanam
vastrapūtaṃ ca śītaṃ ca viśiṣṭaṃ snānapānayoḥ || 35 || pāṭalotpalapadmāni karavīraṃ ca sarvadā || snānatoyeṣu yojyāni satataṃ surabhīṇi ca || 36 || liṃgaṃ śītāṃbunā snāpya gokṣīreṇa ca bhaktitaḥ || snāpayitvā punardadhnā ghṛtasnānaṃ tataḥ param || 37 || evaṃ snānatrayaṃ kṛtvā pūjayitvā tu bhaktitaḥ || aśvamedhasahasrāṇāṃ phalaṃ prāpnoti mānavaḥ || 38 || ayutaṃ yo gavāṃ dadyāddogdhrīṇāṃ vedapārage || vastrālaṃkārayuktānāṃ kṣīrasnānena yatphalam || 39 || saptajanmakṛtaṃ pāpaṃ ghṛtasnānena dehināṃ || nāśayecchaṃkaro yasmāttasmātsnānaṃ samācaret || 40 || kapilāyā ghṛtenaiva liṃgaṃ yaḥ snāpayetsakṛt || sarvapāpavinirmuktaḥ śivaloke mahīyate || 41 || kalaśenājyapūrṇena rātrau yaḥ snāpayennaraḥ || śuddhasphaṭikasaṃkāśo gaṇo bhavati śūladhṛt || 42 || nairaṃtaryeṇa yo yāmaṃ ghṛtasnānaṃ samācaret || svakulenaikaviṃśatyā vasecchivapade sadā || 43 || mune palaśatājyena snāpayitvā sadāśivam || sa yāti śivasāyujyaṃ nātra kāryā vicāraṇā || 44 || aṣṭottaraśataṃ japtvā vimalenāṃbhasā śivam || snāpayitvā sakṛdbhaktyā śivaloke mahīyate || 45 ||
sakṛnnamaḥ śivāyeti maṃtreṇānena suvrata || sahasrakalaśeneśaṃ snāpayitvā yathāvidhi || 46 || brahmaghno'pi muniśreṣṭha sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate || mune namaḥ śivāyeti maṃtreṇānena yaḥ sakṛt || 47 || śatena kalaśānāṃ ca snāpya devaṃ sadāśivam || śatarudrabalaṃ prāpya rudraloke mahīyate || 48 || pitṛrnuddiśya yo liṃgaṃ snāpayecchītavāriṇā || sadyaḥ svargaṃ gamiṣyaṃti pitaro narakādapi || 49 || kuṃkumāṃbhobhirapyevaṃ snāpayedīśvaraṃ sakṛt || sarvapāpavinirmuktaḥ śivaloke mahīyate || 50 || sitena bhasmanā snāpya sakṛlliṃgaṃ pramodate || caṃdrāṃśunirmalo bhūtvā śobhate caṃdramaṃḍale || 51 || ekāhamapi yo liṃgaṃ bhasmasnānaṃ samācaret || vidhūya sarvapāpāni śivaloke mahīyate || 52 || eṣāmekatamaṃ snānaṃ yaḥ kuryādbhaktitaḥ śivam || vidhūya sarvapāpāni śivena saha modate || 53 || yena kena śivaṃ snāpya sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate || etaddhi kathitaṃ sarvaṃ mune padmajasaṃbhava || na śakyaṃ bahudhā vaktuṃ yugakoṭiśatairapi || 54 ||
[iti śrīvīraśaivācārapradīpikāyāṃ snānamāhātmyaṃ nāma trayoviṃśatitamo'dhyāyaḥ] || 23 ||
[atha caturviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ] |
śrīgurubhyo namaḥ |
atha pūjāsādhanadravyanirṇayaṃ liṃgasya vibhūtidhāraṇaṃ gaṃdhākṣatatilapradhānopavītādyābharaṇadhāraṇaṃ vastrachatracāmaravyajanadhāraṇaṃ tanmāhātmyaṃ kramaśo vakṣyāmi || vṛttam || sitena vastreṇa ca dehaśītaṃ vimṛjya bhūtiṃ vidhivadvilepya || puṣpaṃ ca dhūpaṃ ca sudīpameva datvā ca vastreṇa ca pūjayecca || 1 || prāraṃbhādyavasānāṃtaṃ pratikarma punaḥ punaḥ|| jalapūritapātraṃ tu saṃspṛṣṭvātha samarpayet || 2 || oṃ hraiṃ tatpuruṣāya namaḥ vibhūtiṃ svāhā || (kriyāsāre) gaṃdhaśītodake śuddhe gaṃdhaṃ kṛtvā samarpayet || caṃdanāgarukarpūrakuṃkumādyanulepayet || 3 || śastānyamūni dravyāṇi na yogyānītarāṇyapi || gaṃdhānulepanātpuṇyaṃ dviguṇaṃ caṃdanasya tu || 4 || caṃdanādagarorjñeyaṃ puṇyamaṣṭaguṇādhikaṃ || kṛṣṇāgarorviśeṣeṇa dviguṇaṃ phalamiṣyate || 5 || tasmācchataguṇaṃ puṇyaṃ kuṃkumasya vidhīyate || caṃdanāgarukarpūraiḥ sūkṣmapiṣṭaiḥ sakuṃkumaiḥ || liṃgaṃ paryāptamālipya śivaloke mahīyate || śaivapurāṇe || 6 || caṃdanāgarukarpūrakuṃkumādyaiśca puṇyakṛt || 7 || liṃgamālepayedyastu manovākkāyakarmabhiḥ || sarvapāpavinirmuktaḥ śivaloke mahīyate || 8 ||
bilvakāṣṭhodbhavenāpi gaṃdhenaiva hi sarvadā || śivaliṃgaṃ lepayitvā śivaloke vasetsudhīḥ || 9 || gaṃdhaṃ sucaṃdanaṃ caiva devadevāya śaṃbhave || datvā vijayamāpnoti śivasāyujyamāpnuyāt || 10 || caṃdanāgarukarpūratamāladalakuṃkumam || uśīraṃ koṣṭhakaṃ nābhiḥ śivagaṃdhāṣṭakaṃ smṛtam || 11 || oṃ hrīṃ vāmadevāya namaḥ gaṃdhaṃ samarpayāmi || kriyāsāre || abhinnāḥ śaṃkhavacchvetāḥ susnigdhā vrīhitaṃḍulāḥ || smṛtāḥ śivārcane yogyā netarāścaturānana || 12 || laiṃge || muktāphalasamānābhāndāḍimībījavacchubhān || akṣayaṃ padamāpnoti yo'kṣatānarpayetsudhīḥ || 13 || śuddhaśālyakṣataiḥ śubhraiḥ kuśapuṣpaiḥ prayatnataḥ || śivaṃ yaḥ pūjayedbhaktyā śivalokamavāpnuyāt || 14 || raktāḥ pītāstathā śuklāḥ kapilāḥ kṛṣṇavarṇakāḥ || sahasraphaladāḥ proktāḥ śaṃbhorārādhane tilāḥ || tilākṣatāśca ratnāni mauktikāni samarpayet || 15 || oṃ hrāṃ astrāya phaṭ iti akṣatān samarpayet || kriyāsāre || kṛtaṃ śāstroktavidhinā sauvarṇaṃ devamānataḥ || kaladhautaṃ ca vaikakṣyamupavītamiti smṛtaṃ || 16 || mṛdu śuklaṃ sūkṣmameva paṭusūtrādinirmitam ||
śivārpitavastūnāṃ phalam
datvottarīyaṃ rudrāya bhavedvedāṃtapāragaḥ || 17 || sauvarṇaṃ rājataṃ vāpi cottarīyaṃ vidhānataḥ || kṛtvā yo vidhivaddadyāt śivāya sa śivo bhavet || oṃ hreṃ kavacāya huṃ iti uttarīyaṃ samarpayet || 18 || hemaratnāni cānyāni dhāryāṇyābharaṇāni ca || kartavyā golakā hemnā śuddhena rajatena vā || 19 || kartavyaṃ pṛṣṭhapīṭhaṃ tu liṃgasyaiva pramāṇataḥ || svachaṃdenāsya vistāro hemno vā rājatasya vā || 20 || madhye mṛṇālasahitaṃ padmaṃ kāryaṃ śivāya vai || nālaṃ sakuṃḍalaṃ kṛtvā maṇiratnādibhiḥ sudhīḥ || 21 || rudrākṣamālikādyaiśca devadevāya śaṃbhave || samarpya dīptimāpnoti śivalokaṃ gamiṣyati || 22 || oṃ hrāḥ hrauṃ haṃ hāṃ haṃ sarvabhūṣaṇāni svāhā || kriyāsāre || paṭudevāṃgacīnāni vicitrāṇītarāṇi vā || śitāni sūkṣmavāsāṃsi praśastāni pitāmaha || 23 || nyāyāgatāni navyāni dṛkpriyāṇi dṛḍhāni ca || aṃśukāni viśuddhāni praśastānyuttamāni tu || jīrṇaṃ dagdhaṃ dhṛtaṃ śūlamākhudaṣṭaṃ saraṃdhrakam || 24 || devasvaṃ duṣkriyāyuktaṃ vastramevaṃvidhaṃ tyajet || vāsāṃsi suvicitrāṇi sāravaṃti mṛdūni vai || 25 ||
dhūpitāni navīnāni śivāya parikalpayet || yāvattadvastrataṃtūnāṃ parisaṃkhyā samaṃtataḥ || tāvadvarṣasahasrāṇi śivaloke mahīyate || oṃ hrāṃ hṛdayāya namaḥ vastraṃ svāhā || 26 || śivadharme || śaraccaṃdrāṃśuvimalaṃ muktādāmopaśobhitam || maṇidaṃḍamayaṃ chatraṃ yo dadyātkāṃcanāvṛtam || 27 || chatreṇātivicitreṇa bhūṣayedyaḥ pumānbhuvi || vimānaśatamāruhya sa gacchecchivamaṃdiram || 28 || śaivadharmasaṃhitāyāṃ || śuddhamuktāphalamayaṃ hemadaṃḍasuśobhitam || chatraṃ datvā śivāyaiva naṃdīśvarasamo bhavet || 29 || oṃ namaḥ śivāya chatraṃ svāhā || kriyāsāre || mayūrapakṣadaṃḍaiśca valkalairatipāṃḍuraiḥ || sauvarṇai rājatairdaṃḍaiḥ kiṃkiṇījālabhūṣitaiḥ || 30 || hastamātrapramāṇaiśca nirmitānnetravallabhān || cāmarāṃśca śiyāyaiva dvaṃdvaśaḥ pratiyojayet || 31 || camarībālakeśaiśca tathā kurvīta pāṃḍuraiḥ || cāmaraṃ dvividhaṃ proktaṃ svarṇaratnasamāyutam || 32 || śivadharme || śivāya cāmaraṃ datvā maṇiratnavibhūṣitam || hemadaṃḍaṃ raupyadaṃḍaṃ tasya puṇyaphalaṃ śṛṇu || 33 || cāmarāsaktahastāgradivyastrīparivāritaḥ || vimānastho mahābhogī ciraṃ śivapure vaset || 34 ||
śivārpitavyajanacāmarādīnāṃphalam
yāvatī romasaṃkhyā syāccāmare'tīva śobhane || tāvatkalpāyutaṃ divyaṃ śivaloke mahīyate || oṃ namaḥ śivāya iti cāmaraṃ || 35 || vṛttaṃ dvitālavistāraṃ pūrvoktāṃśukanirmitaṃ || pūrvoktadaṃḍasaṃproktaṃ catustālāyutaṃ śubhaṃ || 36 || tālavṛṃtamiti khyātaṃ citrairanyairvibhūṣitaṃ || etadapyarpayedyugmaṃ sadbhaktyātha vicakṣaṇaḥ || 37 || bhaktyā nivedya rudrāya tālavṛṃtaṃ suśobhitaṃ || daśavarṣasahasrāṇi rudraloke mahīyate || 38 || mayūravyajanaṃ datvā śivāyātīvaśobhanam || varṣakoṭiśataṃ kālaṃ rudraloke vasennaraḥ || oṃ namaḥ śivāya iti vyajanaṃ || 39 ||
[iti śrīvīraśaivācārapradīpikāyāṃ pūjālaṃkārasnānavibhūtidhāraṇādi lakṣaṇaṃ nāma caturviṃśodhyāyaḥ] || 24 ||
[atha paṃcaviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ] |
|| śrīgurubhyo namaḥ||
|| kālottare || īśvara uvāca || puṣpādhyāyaṃ pravakṣyāmi yathāvadanupūrvaśaḥ || hitāya sādhakānāṃ ca sarvakarmaphalāptaye || 1 || ekapuṣpaphalaṃ tāvadvakṣyāmi śṛṇu ṣaṇmukha || tapaḥśīlaguṇopete supātre vedapārage || 2 || suvarṇakoṭiṃ yaddatvā tatphalaṃ kusumena vai || datvā daṃtisahasrāṇi vājipeyaśatāni ca || 3 || koṭikanyāśca yatpuṇyamekapuṣpaṃ śivārcane || 4 || ekasyāpi ca puṣpasya pradānena maheśvare || trailokyaṃ vaśamāyāti svecchayā ca na saṃśayaḥ || 5 || āṃdolikādiyāneṣu datteṣu parameśvare || trailokyaṃ vaśamāyāti nātra kāryā vicāraṇā || 6 || yo dadyātkāṃcanaṃ merutulyaṃ vatsa vasuṃdharāṃ || liṃge nyastaikapuṣpasya sahasrāṃśaṃ na pūrayet || yajñakoṭisahasreṣu vratakoṭiṣu yatphalaṃ || 7 || liṃganyastaikapuṣpasya sahasrāṃśena no samaṃ || agniṣṭomasahasrāṇi vājapeyaśatāni vai || 8 || liṃge puṣpārpaṇasyaiva kalāṃ nārhaṃti ṣoḍaśīm || 9 ||
śivārpaṇīyapatrapuṣpāṇāṃ tāratamyakathanam
liṃgapurāṇe || gavāṃ koṭipradānena vidhivattena yatphalaṃ || liṃge nyastaikapuṣpasya sahasrāṃśaṃ na pūrayet || 10 || mātṛviprasatīmitrabhrātṛgovadhasaṃbhavam || pātakaṃ vilayaṃ yāti puṣpapūjāphalena vai || 11 || jalaṃ vā puṣpamekaṃ vā liṃgasyopari nikṣipet || amaṃtraṃ vā samaṃtraṃ vā kulakoṭiṃ samuddharet || 12 || kriyāsāre || arkāragvadhapuṣpāṇi naṃdyāvartakajātayaḥ || karavīrabakadroṇabṛhatīnavamallikāḥ || 13 || kamalotpalapunnāgakadaṃbāśokacaṃpakāḥ || sevaṃti karṇikārākhyatrisaṃdhyāraktakesarāḥ || 14 || asitotpaladhattūrarohitotpalakāṃcanāḥ || palāśapāṭalītālaprasūnāni varāṇi vai || 15 || damanaṃ bakulaṃ caiva droṇakaṃ pāṭaladvayam || 16 || skāṃde || palāśasvarṇapuṣpaiśca tathā bilvadalena ca || pūjayeddevadeveśaṃ cābhiṣicya punaḥ punaḥ || 17 || mārkaṃḍeyapurāṇe || tvayoditāni patrāṇi prasūnāni priyāṇi vai || eteṣāmadhikaṃ brahmankathayasva vidhānataḥ || 18 || mārkaṃḍeya uvāca || karavīrācchubhaṃ puṇyaṃ kāṃsyapuṣpaṃ samarpaṇe ||
kāṃsyapuṣpācchubhaṃ puṇyaṃ śatapatraṃ śivārcane || 19 || śatapatrācchubhaṃ puṇyaṃ kamalaṃ devatārcane || padmācchataguṇaṃ puṇyaṃ jātībakulamīritama || 20 || tābhyāṃ śataguṇaṃ puṇyaṃ mallikācampakārcane || tābhyāṃ śataguṇaṃ puṇyaṃ bilvamaṃdārapūjane || 21 || tābhyāṃ śataguṇaṃ puṇyaṃ kusuṃbhasyārcane'nagha || puṣpāṇāṃ lakṣaṇaṃ rājan te sarvaṃ kathitaṃ mayā || 22 || puṣpadvādaśakoṭibhyaḥ svarṇapuṣpaṃ viśiṣyate || tatphalaṃ koṭiguṇitamekabilvadalārcanāt || 23 || śivadharme || naṃdikeśvara uvāca || evaṃ puṣpaviśeṣāṇāṃ phalaṃ cottarato'dhikaṃ || jñeyaṃ puṣpāntaraṃ tasmādyathājñātaṃ nibodhitaṃ || 24 || arkapuṣpasahasrebhyaḥ karavīraṃ viśiṣyate || karavīrasahasrebhyo bilvapatraṃ viśiṣyate || 25 || bilvapatrasahasrebhyaḥ padmamekaṃ viśiṣyate || padmapuṣpādvaraṃ caitatpuṃḍarīkamiti smṛtaṃ || 26 || puṃḍarīkasahasrebhyaḥ śatapatraṃ viśiṣyate || śatapatrasahasrāttu sahasrāraṃ viśiṣyate || 27 || sahasrārasahasrebhyo bakapuṣpaṃ viśiṣyate || bakapuṣpasahasrebhyo dhattūraṃ ca viśiṣyate || 28 || dhattūrakasahastrebhyo bṛhatī vai viśiṣyate || sahasrabṛhatīpuṣpācchvetamaṃdārakaṃ smṛtam || 29 || maṃdārakasahasrebhyo droṇapuṣpaṃ viśiṣyate ||
śivārpaṇīyapatrapuṣpāṇāṃ tāratamyakathanam |
droṇapuṣpasahasrāttu cāpāmārgaṃ viśiṣyate || 30 || apāmārgasahasrebhyaḥ kuśapatraṃ viśiṣyate || kuśapatrasahasrāttu śamīpatraṃ viśiṣyate || 31 || śamīpatrasahasrāttu vyāghātaṃ ca viśiṣyate || vyāghātakasahastrāttu śaṃkhapuṣpaṃ viśiṣyate || 32 || śaṃkhapuṣpasahasrāttu vyāghrapuṣpaṃ viśiṣyate || vyāghrapuṣpasahasrāttu sadābhadrī viśiṣyate || 33 || sadābhadrīsahasrebhyaḥ kṛṣṇanirguṃḍikā smṛtā || kṛṣṇanirguṃḍikāyāśca bṛhatpuṣpaṃ viśiṣyate || 34 || bṛhatpuṣpasahasrāttu śvetārkaṃ ca viśiṣyate || arkapuṣpasahasrāttu bṛhaddroṇaṃ viśiṣyate || 35 || bṛhaddroṇasahasrāttu nīlotpalasumaṃ varam || nīlotpalasahasrācca svarṇapuṣpaṃ viśiṣyate || 36 || sarveṣāṃ puṣpajātīnāṃ pravaraṃ nīlamutpalaṃ || bṛhatpuṣpasamaṃ jñeyaṃ nirguṃḍasya prasūnakam || 37 || arkapuṣpasamaṃ jñeyaṃ mallikājātipuṣpakaṃ || dhattūrakasamaṃ jñeyaṃ caṃpakākarṇikārakaṃ || 38 || bilvapatrasamaṃ jñeyaṃ vijayasya prasūnakam || mālatīkubjakaṃ caiva karavīrasamaṃ smṛtaṃ || 39 || padmapuṣpasamaṃ jñeyaṃ pāṭalībakulaṃ tathā || puṣpāṇi rucirāṇyeva patrāṇi ca śivārthibhiḥ || 40 || nirgaṃdhānyugragaṃdhāni dūṣitānyaśivāni ca || avaghrātāni puṣpāṇi na grāhyāṇi śivārcane || 41 ||
patitairvikalairmlānairvikṛtairjaṃtudūṣitaiḥ || āghrātairaṃgasaṃspṛṣṭaiḥ puṣpairetairna pūjayet || 42 || keśakīṭāpaviddhāni śīrṇaparyuṣitānyapi || svayaṃ patitapuṣpāṇi tyajetpūjārataiḥ sadā || 43 || sanālaiḥ sadalaiḥ pakṣaiḥ pratyagrairnetravallabhaiḥ || puṣpairyathocitairevaṃvidhairārādhayecchivam || 44 ||
[iti śrīvīraśaivācārapradīpikāyāṃ pūjāprakaraṇe puṣpamāhātmyaṃ nāma paṃcaviṃśodhyāyaḥ] ||
[atha ṣaḍviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ] |
|| śrīgurubhyo namaḥ ||
atha dhūpapātralakṣaṇaṃ dhūpalakṣaṇaṃ tanmāhātmyaṃ ca vakṣyāmi (kriyāsāre) (īśvara uvāca) hemnā raupyeṇa tāmreṇa rītyā lohena vāpi ca || dhūpadīpasya pātre dve kārayetsaha lakṣaṇaiḥ || 1 || dhūpapātrasya dairghyaṃ tu sārdhāṣṭāṃgulakaṃ smṛtam || pātraṃ ḍamaruvatkāryaṃ sapidhānaṃ sanālakam || 2 || pātrapādaṃ mukhavyāsasamānaṃ caturaṃgulaṃ || dvyaṃgulaṃ tu dvayostuṃgaṃ tanmadhye grīvamaṃgulaṃ || 3 || evaṃ ḍamarukākāraṃ grīve nālaṃ prakalpayet || nālasya paritaḥ samyaṅamaṇibhirbhūṣayetsudhīḥ || 4 || ṛju vā kuṭilaṃ vāpi yathāśobhaṃ ca kārayet || vyāsaunnatye pidhānasya pātravatparikalpayet || 5 || ghanaṃ tasya samastasya yavamātraṃ prakīrtitam || pidhāne dhūmanirgatyai raṃdhrāṇi vidadhīta ṣaṭ || 6 || lakṣaṇaṃ dhūpapātrasya samākhyātaṃ caturmukha || sārdhatryaṃgulavyāsaṃ tu pātraṃ tat dvyaṃgulonnatam || 7 || tasyāṃghrivistarotsedhaṃ tadvadekāṃgulaṃ galaṃ ||
pidhānaṃ śṛṃgavannālaṃ ghanaṃ raṃdhrāṇi pūrvavat || 8 || evaṃ vā kārayedbhaktyā dhūpapātraṃ manoharam || pātrasyāpi vidhānaṃ syādalābhe mṛṇmayaṃ tu vā || 9 || kālāgarurgaṃdhasāro guggulaśca sitāgaruḥ || lākṣā bilvaphalaṃ sarpirmadhu sarjarasaṃ śaśī || sādhanāni daśaitāni dhūpasya caturānana || 10 || (vīrataṃtre) dhūpaṃ dadyāttu vipreṃda dhūpapātre viśeṣataḥ || dhūpaṃ cātha vinikṣipya yathā vittānusārataḥ || 11 || nirgaṃdhamaśubhaṃ dhūpaṃ durgaṃdhaṃ jaṃtubhiryutam || na dahetkvāpi niryāsaṃ mamāgre vṛkṣajaṃ sudhīḥ || 12 || (kriyāsāre) caṃdanāgarukoṣṭhāni nakhaḥ sarjaḥ kacorakaḥ || ete guḍena yuktāśca dhūpo bhavati cottamaḥ || 13 || śarkarānakhagaṃdhāśca jaṭāmāṃsī sugaṃdhinaḥ || ete kṣaudreṇa yuktāśceddhūpo bhavati cottamaḥ || 14 || vṛttam || agarutagarakoṣṭhaṃ śailapuṣpaṃ sitāśca hyabhayasukhakarāste caṃdanailāḥ salākṣāḥ || tvacanasvakhadirāḥ syurgaṃdhasārākhyameva pracurajalakacorau jātiyugdhūparājaḥ || 15 || karpūramekabhāgaṃ syāllohabhāgacatuṣṭayam || ṣaḍbhāgaṃ caṃdanaṃ caiva vānaraṃ saptabhāgakam || madhunā secayettacca dhūpapātre vinikṣipet || 16 || devadārunamerūca sarjaḥ śrīvāsakuṃdarū ||
dhūpasvarūpaṃ tanmāhātmyaṃ ca
śrīphalaṃ cājyayuktaṃ taddhūpaṃ dadyācchivāya vai || 17 || (pārameśvarataṃtre) caṃdanāgarukarpūrakoṣṭhaguggulacūrṇakaiḥ || ghṛtena madhunā caiva siddho dhūpaḥ praśasyate || 18 || vṛttam|| paṃcāṃgadhūpamathavāpi daśāṃgadhūpaṃ datvā ghṛtāktamatha guggulamīśvarāgre || sarvāmimāṃ vasumatīṃ dhanadhānyapūrṇāṃ datvā phalaṃ bhavati yattadavāpyate ca || 19 || kṛṣṇāgarusamudbhūtaṃ sarvapāpanikṛṃtanaṃ || guggulaprabhṛtīnāṃ hi dhūpānāṃ ca nivedane || 20 || sarvarogakṣayaścaiva caṃdanaṃ sarvasiddhidam || saugaṃdhikaṃ tathā dhūpaṃ sarvakāmārthasādhakam || 21 || kṛṣṇāgarusamadbhūtastathā śvetāgarūdbhavaḥ || sitārkasya ca dhūpaśca sākṣānnirvāṇasiddhidaḥ || 22 || kṛṣṇāgarurmuktido hi śvetaḥ puṣṭivivardhanaḥ || caṃdanaṃ sarvadaṃ proktaṃ karpūraṃ vṛddhidāyakam || 23 || anye'pi ca sugaṃdhā ye śrīkhaṃḍāgarusaṃjñakāḥ || dhūpāḥ saśarkarāścaite vaśīkurvaṃti śaṃkaram || 24 || (śivadharme) agaruṃ devadāruṃ ca sarjaśrīvāsakuṃdarūn || śrīphalaṃ cājyamiśraṃ vai dagdhvā yāti parāṃ śriyam || 25 || ebhyaḥ saugaṃdhikaṃ dhūpaṃ ṣaṭsahasraguṇādhikam || agarordaśasāhasraṃ dviguṇaśca sitāgaruḥ || 26
guggulordaśasāhasraṃ sājyaṃ tadviguṇaṃ bhavet || priyaśca guggulurnityamājyayukto viśeṣataḥ || 27 || dvisahasraphalaṃ proktaṃ māhiṣākṣaṃ tu guggulam || varṣamekaṃ nirdaheccecchivatulyaḥ prajāyate || 28 || guggulaṃ ghṛtasaṃyuktaṃ sākṣādgṛhṇāti śaṃkaraḥ || māsārdhamātraṃ dānena śivaloke mahīyate || 29 || kṛṣṇapakṣacaturdaśyāṃ yaḥ sājyaṃ guggulaṃ dahet || aparādhasahasraṃ tadihāmutrakṛtaṃ kṣamet || 30 || dhūpānāṃ guggulaḥ śreṣṭhaḥ sadyo bhavati kāmadaḥ || prītyarthaṃ devi tasmānme saghṛtaṃ guggulaṃ dahet || 31 || (ekapādapurāṇe) guggulaṃ ghṛtasaṃyuktaṃ liṃgamabhyarcya yo dahet || koṭivarṣasahasraṃ vai rudraloke mahīyate || 32 || māhiṣākṣaṃ ghṛtayutaṃ liṃgamabhyarcya yo dahet || sagaṇaḥ śivaloke vai pūjyate gaṇakoṭibhiḥ || 33 || bilvaṃ tu ghṛtasaṃyuktaṃ dhūpaṃ dadyānmaheśvare || pūjite'pi mahādevi śṛṇu tasyāpi yatphalam || gavāṃ koṭisahasrāṇāṃ dānasya labhate phalam || 34 || (ādityapurāṇe) saghṛtaṃ sarjadhūpaṃ vai liṃgamabhyarcya yo dahet || saptajanmakṛtaṃ pāpaṃ bhasmībhavati tatkṣaṇāt || 35 || agaruṃ ghṛtasaṃyuktaṃ liṃgamabhyarcya yo dahet || sagaṇaḥ śivaloke tu pūjyate gaṇakoṭibhiḥ || 36 ||
(śivadharme) agaruṃ ghṛtasaṃyuktaṃ dadyādbilvamathāpi vā || agniṣṭomasya yajñasya phalaṃ prāpnoti mānavaḥ || 37 ||
[iti śrīvīraśaivācārapradīpikāyāṃ dhūpalakṣaṇaṃ nāma ṣaḍviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ] ||
[atha saptaviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ] |
|| śrīgurubhyo namaḥ ||
atha dīpapātralakṣaṇaṃ dīpalakṣaṇaṃ tanmāhātmyaṃ ca vakṣyāmi || dīpapātrasya dairghyaṃ tu samastaṃ syātṣaḍaṃgulam || sārdhāṃgulonnataṃ pīṭhaṃ nālaṃ sārdhāṃguladvayam || 1 || śikharaṃ dvyaṃgulaṃ proktaṃ connataṃ syātṣaḍaṃgulam || tatpādapīṭhavistāraṃ coditaṃ caturaṃgulam || 2 || snigdhaṃ maṇimayaṃ vāpi tryaṃgulaṃ tasya nālakam || pātraṃ paṃcāṃgulavyāsaṃ taddhanaṃ yavamātrakam || 3 || pātrasya paritaḥ sthānānyaṣṭau dīpasya kalpayet || śikhare'pi tathaivaikaṃ dīpasthānaṃ prakalpayet || 4 || pīṭhanālāṃtare daṃḍaṃ dhūpapātravadācaret || evaṃ pramāṇataḥ kuryāddīpapātraṃ manoharam || 5 || pūrvoditapramāṇena dīpapātraṃ prakalpya vai || pātraśṛṃge caturdikṣu dīpasthānāni kalpayet || 6 || dīpapaṃcakapātraṃ tadidamanyadihocyate || caturaṃgulamutsedhaṃ nāhaṃ sārdhāṃgulaṃ smṛtaṃ || 7 || kaladhautādibhiḥ kuryādyathāvittānusārataḥ || alābhe vrīhipiṣṭasya paṃcārtikyaṃ prakalpayet || 8 || evaṃ yathāvatkathitaṃ dīpapātrasya lakṣaṇaṃ | karpūraghṛtavartīnāṃ dīpaṃ dadyācchivāya vai || 9 ||
dīpamāhātmyam
(ādityapurāṇe) jñānadā paṭṭavartiḥ syātkārpāsaṃ sarvasiddhidaṃ || karpūraṃ phaladaṃ proktaṃ kapilājyena saṃyutaḥ || 10 || dīpaḥ koṭiguṇo jñeya itarasmānna saṃśayaḥ || kapilāsaṃbhavenaiva ghṛtenāpi sugaṃdhinā || nityaṃ pradīpitā dīpāḥ śastāḥ karpūravartayaḥ || 11 || ghṛtadīpapradānena phalaṃ śṛṇu vadāmi te || kapilāyā ghṛtasyātha dīpaḥ sātvika ucyate || 12 || rājasastilatailena miśritaścājyadīpakaḥ || tāmasastu bhaveddīpo māhiṣājādisarpiṣaḥ || 13 || vṛkṣabījodbhavaiḥ snehairdīpaḥ paiśāca ucyate || tāmasastu piśācānāṃ dīpo yogya iti smṛtaḥ || 14 || ekādiśataparyaṃtaṃ dīpāḥ syuradhamādhamāḥ || śatādyāḥ syuḥ sahastrāntā ayutā lakṣasīmagāḥ || 15 || dīpāḥ syurevaṃ saṃkhyātā rātrau tadviguṇaṃ bhavet || ekadvitryaṃgulajvālāḥ kaniṣṭhamadhyamottamāḥ || 16 || yaḥ kuryātkārtike māse śobhanāṃ dīpamālikām || ghṛtena ca caturdaśyāṃ paurṇimāsyāmathāpi vā || 17 || sūryāyutapratīkāśastejasā bhāsayandiśaḥ || sa mānavo vimānasthaḥ kulamuddhṛtya sarvataḥ || 18 ||
yāvatpradīpapātreṇa dattā dīpāḥ śivāya vai || tāvadyugasahasrāṇi rudraloke mahīyate || 19 || śirasā dhārayeddīpaṃ śivarātrau śivāgrataḥ || lalāṭe caiva hastābhyāṃ dhārayecca tathorasi || 20 || sūryāyutapratīkāśairvimānaiḥ sarvakāmadaiḥ || kalpāyutaśataṃ divyaṃ śivaloke mahīyate || 21 || ghṛtadīpapradānena vimānaṃ sarvasādhakam || āruhya śivasāṃnidhyaṃ gacchatyeva na saṃśayaḥ || 22 || nimiṣaṃ nimiṣārdhaṃ vā ghṛtadīpaprado naraḥ || varṣakoṭiśataṃ divye rudraloke mahīyate || 23 || (skāṃde) yo dadyādghṛtadīpaṃ ca tilatailena vā vibho || sa tāṃ gatimavāpnoti durlabhāmātmavedināṃ || 24 || (śivadharme) madhūkabījatailena dīpaṃ dadyātsakṛnnaraḥ || mahāpātakadoṣādvai sadyo mucyenna saṃśayaḥ || 25 ||
[iti śrīvīraśaivācārapradīpikāyāṃ dīpalakṣaṇaṃ nāma saptaviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ] ||
[athāṣṭaviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ] |
śrīgurubhyo namaḥ |
atha naivedyalakṣaṇaṃ tanmāhātmyaṃ ca vakṣyāmi ||
pitāmaha uvāca ||
bhagavan devadeveśa lokanātha jagatpate || naivedyasya vidhānaṃ kiṃ brūhi me parameśvara || 1 ||
īśvara uvāca ||
sādhu sādhu mahāprājña yattvayā paricoditam || tattubhyamakhilaṃ vakṣye śṛṇuṣva kamalāsana || 2 || śvetaśālirmahāśālīraktaśālistathaiva ca || kṛṣṇaśāliśca nīvāraṃ vrīhirgodhūmameva ca || 3 || yavapriyaṃgavaścaite navadhānyāḥ prakīrtitāḥ || tuṣānapohya caiteṣāṃ śūrpeṇa kaṇacūrṇakān || nirdoṣāṃstaṃḍulāṃścaiva gṛhītvānnaṃ samācaret || 4 || śivadharmottare || ṣaṣṭhikaudananaivedyaṃ sahasraguṇitaṃ phalaṃ || sugaṃdhiśālinaivedyaṃ vijñeyamayutādhikam || 5 || raktaśālyāśca naivedyaṃ phalaṃ syādayutādhikam || kṛṣṇaśālyāśca naivedyaṃ daśalakṣādhikaṃ bhavet || evaṃ śāliviśeṣeṇa phalaṃ syāduttarottaram || 6 || kriyāsāre || nīvārataṃḍulebhyaśca śreṣṭhā vai vrīhitaṃḍulāḥ || homoktadhānyajātīyāḥ taṃḍulā madhyamāḥ smṛtāḥ || 7 || mlānān bhinnānkaṇayutāndurgaṃdhānkaṭhināśanān || pācitavrīhijāṃścaitāṃstaṃḍulānsapta varjayet || 8 ||
abhinnā dhavalāḥ snigdhā viśuddhā nirmalāḥ śubhāḥ || taṃḍulāḥ syuramī śreṣṭhā naivedyāyeśvarasya ca || 9 || udake plāvayitvā tānkṣālayecca punaḥ punaḥ || phūtkārarahitānkāṣṭhānprajvālyopari pātrakam || sataṃḍulaṃ ca nikṣipya pācayedbhaktisaṃyutaḥ || 10 || paramānnaṃ haridrānnaṃ dadhyannaṃ śarkarodanam || guḍodanaṃ ca mudgānamityevaṃ ṣaḍvidhaṃ smṛtam || 11 || taṃḍulatriguṇaṃ dugdhaṃ dugdhārdhaṃ jīvanaṃ tathā || tadardhā mudgadālī vai paramānnamidaṃ smṛtam || 12 || taṃdulārdhā mudgadālī vāriṇā saha pācitā || īṣaddharidrayā yuktā marīcījājisaṃyutā || 13 || etaduktaṃ haridrānnaṃ supakvaṃ pācitaṃ tathā || madhurāmlena godadhnā marīcyā ca vimiśritam || 14 || taṃḍulānnaṃ cārdrakeṇa lavaṇena ca saṃyutam || sadbhaktena kṛtaṃ taddhi dadhyodanamiti smṛtam || 15 || śarkarāpākasaṃyuktaṃ keśareṇa vimiśritam || drākṣābhiryuktamevānnaṃ śarkarānnamiti smṛtam || 16 || pūrvoktapāyase yuṃjyāddugdhārdhaṃ guḍakhaṃḍakam || tadardhamājyaṃ kadalīphalamiśraṃ guḍodanam || 17 || taṃḍulasya tribhāgena mudgakhaṃḍena miśritam || bhaktena pācitaṃ tvetanmudgānnamabhidhīyate || 18 ||
naivedyārthaṃ mudgānnaśākavyaṃjanādivarṇanam
viśuddhabhāṃḍasaṃsiddhaṃ prayataṃ snigdhamujvalam || odanaṃ paramotkṛṣṭaṃ naivedyaṃ dāpayetsudhīḥ || 19 || catvāri śiṃbādhānyāni gṛhṇīyātsūpakarmaṇi || mudgāḍhakīkalāyākhyamāṣāścānyāni varjayet || 20 || teṣveva vituṣāḥ śreṣṭhāḥ satuṣā madhyamāḥ smṛtāḥ || krimiyuktāḥ kaniṣṭhāstu sarvadaitān parityajet || 21 || panasaḥ kadalī cūto dāḍimo nārikelakaḥ || nāriṃgo mātuluṃgaśca phalānyetāni caiva hi || 22 || sūraṇaḥ sūkṣmakaṃdaśca piṃḍālaḥ śṛṃgiveṇukaḥ || catvāro'mī praśastā vai śākāste pākakarmaṇi || 23 || kūṣmāṃḍaṃ kāravallī ca paṭolaṃ bṛhatī balā || alābūḥ sūkṣmabṛhatī tathā kośātakīdvayam || 24 || urvāruścetyamūstāsāṃ phalāni pravarāṇi vai || svādūni cāniṣiddhāni phalānyānyāni vā budhaḥ || 25 || marīcijājikāsarpirlavaṇāmlakasarṣapaiḥ || upadaṃśānyathāyogyaṃ pacedapi ca hiṃgunā || 26 || pātropadaṃśā ye sarve tānniṣiddhānvivarjayet || uttamaṃ kapilāsarpirmadhyamaṃ śvetagoghṛtam || 27 || anyāsāmadhamaṃ proktamiti trividhamīritam || sadyaḥ pakvaṃ sugaṃdhāḍhyaṃ viśuddhaṃ sumanoharam ||
śuddhabhāṃḍasthitaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ śuddhaṃ sarpiḥ śubhaṃ smṛtaṃ || 28 || sakeśakalkapulakaṃ durgaṃdhaṃ ca purātanam || ayogyapāṇinā spṛṣṭaṃ durbhāṃḍasthaṃ ghṛtaṃ tyajet || 29 || cāṃḍālaḥ patito rogī pāpīyāndevaloṃ'tyajaḥ || gaṇikā sūtikodakyā vratabhraṣṭaśca kukkuraḥ || 30 || otuḥ sarpaḥ kharaḥ kākaḥ ṣaṃḍo vā'bhakṣyabhakṣakaḥ || svādhyāyavikrayītyete cāspṛśyā vai suniṃditāḥ || 31 || evaṃ jñātvā dadhi kṣīraṃ gṛhṇīyātsnānakarmaṇi || naivedyasyāpi bhaktena parīkṣya ca punaḥ punaḥ || 32 || śreṣṭhaṃ syātkarṣakāṣṭaṃ vai ghṛtaṃ madhyaṃ tadardhakam || kaniṣṭhaṃ ca tadardhaṃ tu yathālabdhamalābhataḥ || 33 || iti proktānnapānānāṃ vyaṃjanānāmabhāvataḥ || daridraścetsvabhojyaṃ yattattadīśāya kalpayet || 34 || (kāmike) manaḥpūtaṃ ca naivedyaṃ kārayetsumanoharam || bhavidṛṣṭinivṛtyai ca paṭenācchādayetsadā || 35 || abhaktajanasaṃspṛṣṭapadārthāniha varjayet || abhaktālokitaṃ sarvaṃ varjayedodanādikam || 36 || (laiṃge) naivedyaṃ saghṛtaṃ śuddhaṃ śuklaṃ śālyodanaṃ śubham || saguḍaṃ śubhapātrasthaṃ pradeyaṃ himasaṃnibham || 37 ||
naivedyārthaṃ drākṣādiphalapāyasādivarṇanam
pāyasaṃ kṛsaraṃ cātha śākāni vividhāni vai || vyaṃjanāni vicitrāṇi pātreṣu vinivedayet || 38 || pakvāṃśca modakāṃścaiva ghṛtapakvānkaraṃjakān || polikāścaiva sūpaṃ ca mākṣikāni śubhāni ca || 39 || vyaṃjanāni vicitrāṇi ṣaḍrasāni śubhāni vai || pāvanāni manojñāni deyāni mama suṃdari || 40 || (lalite) mātuluṃgaphalādīni supakkāni nivedayet || ikṣuraṃbhāphalādīni sakhaṃḍāni nivedayet || drākṣākharjūracūtādīnyakhaṃḍāni nivedayet || 41 || (śivadharme) nālikerāṇi śuddhāni phalāni vividhāni vai || nityaṃ deyāni madbhaktairloke māheśvarairjanaiḥ || 42 || (śaive) haviśca ṣaḍvidhaṃ jñeyaṃ śuddhaṃ mudgānnameva ca || pāyasaṃ dadhibhaktaṃ vai gauḍaṃ ca madhunā yutaṃ || 43 || bhakṣyairbhojyalehyapeyaiścoṣyaiḥ svādutaraistathā || eteṣvekamanekaṃ vā śivāya vinivedayet || 44 || kapitthaphalasārasya pānakaṃ surabhīkṛtam || puṣpamālāyutaṃ caiva grīṣmakāle nivedayat || gavāṃ koṭiphalaṃ labdhvā śivaloke mahīyate || 45 || śītaṃ jalaṃ ca yo bhaktyā takraṃ ca dhanavarjitaḥ || śivāya dadyātsa pumān dhanyo bhavati bhūtale || 46 || datvā takraṃ maheśāya guḍakhaṃḍavimiśritam ||
kṣīraṃ kṣīrārṇave bhogān labhate viṣṇunārcitaḥ || 47 || hemapātre tu nikṣipya dadhyodanamanuttamam || guḍakhaṃḍairalaṃkṛtya bhakṣyādyaiśca sugaṃdhibhiḥ || 48 || ārdropadaṃśaiśca tathā śītavastreṇa veṣṭya ca || dadyādrātrau tu māṃ bhaktyā śivatulyaḥ prajāyate || 49 || datvā cācamanīyaṃ vai karodvartanakaṃ tathā || sakarpūraṃ satāṃbūlaṃ kuryānnīrājanaṃ tathā || 50 || naivedyasya phalaṃ vakṣye śṛṇu saṃprati suvrate || hāridraṃ kṛsaraṃ śuklaṃ pāyasaṃ vāpi yāvakam || 51 || nivedya bhaktyā śarvāya śāśvatīṃ gatimāpnuyāt || bhaktyā vittānusāreṇa datvālpaṃ yadi vā bahu || naivedyaṃ rudralokādilokeṣveva pramodate || 52 || (vīrataṃtre) śuddhodanasahasrebhyo pāyasānnaṃ viśiṣyate || pāyasānnasahasrebhyo kṛsarānnaṃ viśiṣyate || 53 || kṛsarānnasahasrebhyo gauḍamannaṃ viśiṣyate || sugauḍānnasahasrebhyo mudgānnaṃ tu viśiṣyate || 54 || evameva krameṇaiva sahasraguṇitaṃ phalam || yāvaṃtastaṃḍulāstasminnaivedye parisaṃkhyayā || tāvadyugasahasrāṇi rudraloke mahīyate || 55 || (śaive) siddhamannaṃ śivāyātha datvā bhaktyā sakṛnmune || saghṛtaṃ śivaloke vai kalpamekaṃ tu modate || 56 ||
śivārpitanaivedyasya phalatāratamyakathanam
savyaṃjanaṃ ca dviguṇaṃ saghṛtaṃ cecchatādhikam || annātkoṭiguṇaṃ puṇyaṃ datvā bhakṣyaṃ śivāya vai || 57 || (kāmike) guḍakhaṃḍakṛtānāṃ ca bhakṣyāṇāṃ ca nivedane || ghṛtena pācitānāṃ ca tatkoṭiguṇataḥ phalaṃ || 58 || kṣīrānnaṃ pāyasaṃ caiva modakānvividhānapi || nivedayetkurukṣetre hemadānaphalaṃ labhet || 59 || takrapānakakhādyānāṃ bhakṣyārdhaphalamucyate || tadardhaṃ satilasyaiva phalametatsmṛtaṃ ca vai || 60 || sarvayajñopavāseṣu sarvatīrtheṣu yatphalaṃ || stutijāpyopahāreṣu tile tatphalamāpnuyāt || 61 || yena kenāpi vā bhaktyā śivāyānnaṃ sakṛnmune || datvā muṃcati saṃsāraduḥkhaṃ śāṃto labhetsukham || 62 || adatvā tu yadaśnāti gṛhe gṛhapatiḥ svayam || pacyate raurave ghore narake kālamakṣayaṃ || 63 || (vīrataṃtre) tasmātsarvaprayatnena naivedyaṃ caiva kārayet || evaṃ yaḥ kurute martyaḥ sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate || 64 || (kāmike) amṛtīkṛtya gokṣīranaivedye bhasitaṃ kṣipet ||
patākamudrayā caiva prādakṣiṇyakrameṇa ca || 65 || trivāraṃ paṃcavāraṃ vā saptavāramathāpi vā || nivedayecchuddhabhaktyā tadvatpānīyamuttamam || 66 ||
[iti śrīvīraśaivācārapradīpikāyāṃ naivedyalakṣaṇamāhātmyaṃ nāma aṣṭāviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ] || 28 ||
[athaikonatriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ] |
|| śrīgurubhyo namaḥ ||
atha tāṃbūlavidhiṃ tanmāhātmyaṃ nīrājanavidhiṃ tanmāhātmyaṃ ca vakṣyāmi || lavaṃgatṛṭijātīnāṃ cūrṇaṃ takkolajaṃ tathā || karpūreṇa samāyuktaṃ paṃcasaugaṃdhikaṃ kṛtam || 1 || mukhavāsaṃ tvidaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ karpūreṇaiva madhyamam || lavaṃgenādhamaṃ proktaṃ devasaugaṃdhikaṃ smṛtam || 2 || (lalite) lavaṃgatailakarpūraphalapatrasamanvitam || cūrṇaṃ kṛtvā mahādevi caṃdanaiśca samanvitam || 3 || oṃ hrāṃ hṛdayāya namaḥ oṃ namaḥ śivāya mukhavāsanaṃ samarpayāmi || ajitāgame || hemādipātre nikṣipya vimalaṃ tacca paṃcakam || yathāśaktyā ca bhaktyā ca tāṃbūlaṃ vinivedayet || 4 || (kriyāsāre) nāgavallīdalaṃ caiva kramukasya phalena vai || yuktaṃ karpūrasudhayā tāṃbūlamiti saṃsmṛtam || 5 || sugaṃdhapaṃcakopetaṃ yastāṃbūlaṃ nivedayet || śivāya gurave caiva tasya puṇyaphalaṃ śṛṇu || 6 || sugaṃdhadehastejasvī sarvāvayavasuṃdaraḥ || yugakoṭiṃ mahābhogaiḥ śivaloke mahīyate || 7 || (śaivapurāṇe) evaṃ saugaṃdhikopetaṃ tāṃbūlaṃ garuḍaḥ purā || datvā sāṃbāya rudrākṣaṃ labdhavānparamaṃ padam || 8 || tasmātsaugaṃdhikopetaṃ tāṃbūlaṃ vinivedayet ||
śivāya muniśārdūla somāya gaṇarāḍbhavet || 9 || oṃ hreṃ tatpuruṣāya namaḥ tāṃbūlaṃ svāhā || nīrājanavidhiṃ vaktumihārhasi gaṇeśvara || tasya tadvacanaṃ śrutvā sarvabhūtagaṇāgraṇīḥ || nīrājanavidhiṃ vaktuṃ matiṃ cakre mahāmatiḥ || 10 ||
naṃdyuvāca ||
rudrabhaktosi bhadraṃ te brahmaputra mahāmate || śṛṇu vakṣyāmi saṃkṣepānnīrājanavidhikramam || 11 || sarvapāpaharaṃ puṇyaṃ sarvavyādhivināśanam || sarvairanuṣṭhitaṃ pūrvaṃ sarvavidhyarthamuttamam || 12 || hemapātraṃ mune kuryātsaptakaṃ tvekameva vā || rājataṃ vāpi tāmraṃ vā lauhaṃ vāpi prakalpayet || 13 || madhye padmasamāyuktaṃ śivaśāstroktalakṣaṇaiḥ || jalena kṣālayetpātraṃ saptakaṃ tatra kārayet || 14 || triśūlaṃ śaṃkhayugmaṃ ca vajraṃ kamalameva ca || śrīvatsaṃ svastikaṃ vipra darpaṇaṃ ca yathākramam || 15 || piṣṭena vā mune tatra gomayenāpi vā punaḥ || śūlādīnlekhayedbhaktyā caturaṃgulamānataḥ || 16 || nānāvarṇasamāyuktairakṣataistilataṃḍulaiḥ || siddhārthairdadhisaṃmiśraiścūtāśvatthādipallavaiḥ || 17 || auṣadhībhiśca saddhānyaiḥ sarvabījairyavāṃkuraiḥ || alaṃkṛtya yathānyāyaṃ navadīpāṃśca kārayet || 18 ||
nīrājanamahātmyakathanam
pādyamācamanaṃ cārghyaṃ gaṃdhaṃ puṣpaṃ ca dāpayet || mune namaḥ śivāyeti bhasitaṃ ca pradāpayet || 19 || maṃgalaṃ matimānkuryānnīrājanamamuṃ tataḥ || aṣṭamyādiṣu sarveṣu divaseṣu yathāvidhi || puṣyabhena yutāyāṃ tu paurṇimāsyāṃ ca kārayet || 20 || śaṃkhabheryādinirghoṣairmahadbhirgāyanaiḥ śubhaiḥ || kuryānnīrājanaṃ liṃge śubhamuddiśya maṃgalaiḥ || 21 || yāvatsarvāṇi vidhivatkuryānnīrājanaṃ mune || tāvadvarṣasahasrāṇi rudraloke mahīyate || 22 || śivadharmasaṃhitāyāṃ || dadhīciścetthamīśāya datvā nīrājanaṃ purā || labdhavānparamaiśvaryaṃ cāvadhyatvaṃ ca śatrubhiḥ || 23 || akāmataḥ śive datvā bhaktyā nīrājanaṃ śubham || śivalokamavāpnoti nātra kāryā vicāraṇā || etatte kathitaṃ sarvaṃ nīrājanavidhikramam || 24 ||
[iti śrīvīraśaivācārapradīpikāyāṃ tāṃbūlanīrājanavidhirnāma ekonatriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ] ||
[atha triṃśo'dhyāyaḥ] |
|| śrīgurubhyo namaḥ ||
atha saṃgītanartanapurāṇaśravaṇapaṭhanapradakṣiṇanamaskāravidhimeteṣāṃ māhātmyaṃ ca vakṣyāmi || vakṣyāmi gītaṃ nṛtyaṃ ca śṛṇu pārvati yatnataḥ || nāhaṃ vasāmi kailāse na merau na ca maṃdare || yatra gāyaṃti madbhaktāstatra tiṣṭhāmi pārvati || 1 || ghṛtena tādṛśī tṛptirna kṣīreṇa ca guggulaiḥ || yādṛśī gāyanenātha mama tṛptirvarānane || 2 || nodakena na bilvena na tu padmaiḥ sugaṃdhibhiḥ || gāyanenaiva tṛpyāmi satālena śubhānane || 3 || prītiyuktena manasā yo gāyati mamāgrataḥ || sa ca varṣasahasraṃ tu gaṇo bhūtvā sukhī bhavet || 4 || yo'pi gāyati śāṭhyena parārthaṃ tu śivālaye || so'pi kratusahasrasya phalaṃ prāpnoti mānavaḥ || 5 || śuddhaṃ vā svarahīnaṃ vā yo gāyati śivālaye || saptakratuśatasyātha gāyako labhate phalam || 6 || pūjākāle trisaṃdhyāyāṃ yaḥ kuryādgānavādanam || nartanaṃ mukhavādyaṃ vā so'pīśvarapadaṃ labhet || 7 || kāmike || vādakāśca caturviṃśacchubhavādyasamanvitāḥ || gaṇikāśca caturviṃśattrayoviṃśacca vā daśa || 8 || rūpayauvanayuktāśca trikālaṃ nartayaṃti cet ||
śivastutivarṇanam
nṛtyagānaprabhāveṇa pūjyaṃte śivamaṃdire || 9 || śivadharmasaṃhitāyām || kārayaṃti ca ye saṃto nāṭakaṃ vā śivālaye || śataṃ kulāni coddhṛtya gacchaṃti śivamaṃdiram || 10 || nṛtyaṃ gītaṃ ca vādyaṃ ca pūjākāle karoti yaḥ || tuṣyate tena sadyo vai devadevo maheśvaraḥ || 11 || tasmātsarvaprayatnena śivasya paramātmanaḥ || pūjādikarma kartavyaṃ nṛtyagītādikaṃ tathā || 12 || śrāvayedyaḥ purāṇāni devadevaṃ trilocanam || sarvapāpavinirmukto vasecchivapure kṛtī || 13 || bhaktyā stoṣyati yo devi liṃgaṃ tribhuvaneśvaram || so'pīśvaraprasādena gāṇapatyamavāpnuyāt || 14 || (brahmottarakhaṃḍe) jaya deva jayājeya jaya śaṃkara śāśvata || jaya sarvasurādhyakṣa jaya sarvasurārcita || 15 || jaya sarvaguṇātīta jaya sarvavaraprada || jaya nitya nirādhāra jaya viśvaṃbharāvyaya || 16 || jaya viśvaikavaṃdyeśa jaya nāgeṃdrabhūṣaṇa || jaya gaurīpate śaṃbho jaya caṃdrārdhaśekhara || 17 || jaya koṭyarkasaṃkāśa jayānaṃtaguṇālaya || jaya rudra virūpākṣa jaya nityaniraṃjana || 18 || jaya nātha kṛpāsiṃdho jaya bhaktārtibhaṃjana || jaya dustarasaṃsārasāgarottaraṇa prabho || 19 || prasīda me mahābhāga saṃsārārtasya khidyataḥ ||
sarvapāpakṣayaṃ kṛtvā rakṣa māṃ parameśvara || 20 || vṛttam || sarveṃdriyāṇāṃ nayanaṃ pradhānaṃ sarveṣu gātreṣu śiraḥ pradhānam || tasmātpradhānaṃ divi devatānāṃ śivaṃ paraṃ taṃ praṇamecca paśyet || 21 || sarveṣāmupacārāṇāṃ praṇāmo'tyaṃtamuttamaḥ || taṃ vināpyupacārā ye kṛtāste niṣphalāḥ smṛtāḥ || tasmātpraṇāmaṃ kurvīta satataṃ gurudevayoḥ || 22 || (śaive) prātaḥ praṇamya deveśamagniṣṭomaphalaṃ labhet || mādhyāhne cāśvamedhasya sautrāmaṇyā niśāsu ca || 23 || ye namaṃti virūpākṣamīśānaṃ kṛttivāsasam || saṃpannacetaso rudraṃ yāṃti tatsaṃnidhau sadā || 24 || sarvāvasthāṃ gato vāpi sarvapāpayuto'pi vā || śivaliṃgaṃ namaskṛtya so'pi yāti parāṃ gatiṃ || 25 || (bhārate) umāmaheśvarasaṃvāde || iṣṭaṃ dattamadhītaṃ ca yajñāśca bahudakṣiṇāḥ || śivaliṃgapraṇāmasya kalāṃ nārhaṃti ṣoḍaśīm || 26 || (śivadharme) ye kurvaṃti namaskāraṃ ceśvarāya kvacitkvacit || tatsaṃparkācca tallobhādvimānaṃ te labhaṃti hi || 27 || anādareṇa śāṭhyena parihāsena māyayā || namaskurvaṃti ye liṃgaṃ teṣāṃ pāpakṣayo bhavet || 28 || pramādenāpi yaiḥ kvāpi praṇāmaḥ śūline kṛtaḥ || saṃsārasāgarānmuktā na te gṛhṇaṃti janma vai || 29 || śāṭhyenāpi namaskāraṃ yaḥ karoti śivāya vai ||
śivaśuśrūṣāphalavarṇanam
sa vai saṃsāramukto'tha na gṛhṇāti ca janma vai || 30 || evaṃvidhe kaliyuge sadā dhyeyaḥ sadāśivaḥ || namaskāryaḥ sa evātra vadatyeṣā śrutiḥ sadā || 31 || sarvayajñātparaḥ śuddho namaskāro vidhīyate || namaskārākhyayajñena saṃpūjaya śivaṃ sadā || 32 || karacaraṇakṛtaṃ vākkāyajaṃ karmajaṃ vā śravaṇanayanajaṃ vā mānasaṃ vāparādham || vihitamavihitaṃ vā sarvametatkṣamasva jaya jaya karuṇābdhe śrīmahādeva śaṃbho || 33 || maṃtrahīnaṃ kriyāhīnaṃ dravyahīnaṃ yadarcanam || bhāvahīnamidaṃ śaṃbho tatsarvaṃ paripūraya || 34 || maṃtrapuṣpāṃjalisamarpaṇaṃ || śivāya namaḥ || rudrāya namaḥ || paśupataye namaḥ nīlakaṃṭhāya namaḥ || maheśvarāya namaḥ || harikeśāya namaḥ || virūpākṣāya namaḥ || pinākine namaḥ || tripurāṃtakāya namaḥ || śaṃbhave namaḥ || śūline namaḥ || mahādevāya namaḥ || triyaṃbakaṃ yajāmahe sugaṃdhiṃ puṣṭivardhanaṃ || urvārukamiva baṃdhanānmṛtyormukṣīya māmṛtāt || pūjāphalaṃ tapaḥ sarvamudakena pradāpayet | dakṣiṇāṃjalinā dadyādudakaṃ śivapādayoḥ || 35 || sapuṣpaṃ vāri saṃgṛhya kaniṣṭhāṃgulinā naraḥ || culukodakamevaṃ syāddadyācchivapadābjayoḥ || 36 ||
[itiśrī vīraśaivācārapradīpikāyāṃ nartanagāyanādimāhātmyakathanaṃ nāma triṃśo'dhyāyaḥ] || 30 ||
[atha ekatriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ] |
śrīsāṃbāya namaḥ ||
akārādi kṣakārāṃtavarṇarūpaṃ namāmyaham || sabīja mūlamaṃtreṇa praṇamenmokṣadaṃ (prajapenmokṣadaṃ śivam) śivam || 1 ||
atha japaprakaraṇe || paṃcākṣarī māhātmyaṃ vakṣyāmi tadyathā || śaivasaṃhitāyām || kṛṣṇa uvāca || maharṣivara sarvajña sarvajñānamahodadhe || paṃcākṣarasya māhātmyaṃ śrotumicchāmi tatvataḥ || 2 ||
upamanyuruvāca ||
paṃcākṣarasya māhātmyaṃ varṣakoṭiśatairapi || na śakyaṃ vistarādvaktuṃ tasmātsaṃkṣepataḥ śṛṇu || 3 || vede śivāgame cāyamubhayatra ṣaḍakṣaraḥ || maṃtraḥ sthitaḥ sadā mukhyo loke paṃcākṣaraḥ smṛtaḥ || 4 || sarvamaṃtrādhikaścāyamoṃkārādyaḥ ṣaḍakṣaraḥ || sarveṣāṃ śivabhaktānāmaśeṣārthaprasādhakaḥ || 5 || tadalpākṣaramarthāḍhyaṃ vedasāraṃ vimuktidam || ājñāsiddhamasaṃdigdhaṃ vākyametacchivātmakam || 6 || nānāsiddhiyutaṃ divyaṃ lokacittānuraṃjakam ||
ṣaḍakṣaramaṃtrasvarūpakathanam
suniścitārthagaṃbhīraṃ vākyaṃ tatpārameśvaram || 7 || maṃtraṃ sukhamukhoccāryamaśeṣārthaprasiddhaye || prāhoṃnamaḥ śivāyeti sarvajñaḥ sarvadehinām || 8 || tadbījaṃ sarvavidyānāṃ maṃtramādyaṃ ṣaḍakṣaram || atisūkṣmaṃ mahārthaṃ ca jñeyaṃ tadvaṭabījavat || 9 || devo guṇatrayātītaḥ sarvajñaḥ sarvakṛtprabhuḥ || omityekākṣare maṃtre sthitaḥ sarvagataḥ śivaḥ || 10 || īśānādyāni sūkṣmāṇi brahmāṇyekākṣarāṇi tu || maṃtre namaḥ śivāyeti saṃsthitāni yathākramam || 11 || maṃtre ṣaḍakṣare sūkṣme paṃcabrahmatanuḥ śivaḥ || vācyavācakabhāvena sthitaḥ sākṣātsvabhāvataḥ || 12 || vācyaḥ śivaḥ prameyatvānmaṃtrastadvācakaḥ smṛtaḥ || vācyavācakabhāvo'yamanādiḥ saṃsthitastayoḥ || 13 || yaḥ sarvajñaḥ susaṃpūrṇaḥ svabhāvavimalaḥ śivaḥ || tasyābhidhānamaṃtro'yamabhidheyaśca saṃsmṛtaḥ || 14 || abhidhānābhidheyatvānmaṃtraḥ siddhaḥ paraḥ śivaḥ ||
etāvattu śivajñānametāvatparamaṃ padam || 15 || yadoṃnamaḥ śivāyeti śivavākyaṃ ṣaḍakṣaram || vidhivākyamidaṃ śaivaṃ nārthavādaṃ śivātmakam || 16 || bahutve'pi hi maṃtrāṇāṃ sarvajñena śivena yat || praṇītamamalaṃ maṃtraṃ na tena sadṛśaṃ kvacit || 17 || sāṃgāni vedaśāstrāṇi saṃsthitāni ṣaḍakṣare || na tena sadṛśaṃ tasmānmaṃtro'nyo'sti paraḥ kvacit || ṣaḍakṣarasya sūtrasya tāni bhāṣyaṃ samāsataḥ || 18 || kiṃ tasya bahubhirmaṃtraiḥ śāstrairvā bahuvistaraiḥ || yasyoṃnamaḥ śivāyeti maṃtro'yaṃ hṛdi saṃsthitaḥ || 19 || tenādhītaṃ śrutaṃ tena kṛtaṃ sarvamanuṣṭhitam || yenoṃnamaḥ śivāyeti maṃtrābhyāsaḥ sthirīkṛtaḥ || 20 || namaskārādisaṃyuktaṃ śivāyetyakṣaratrayam || jihvāgre vartate yasya saphalaṃ tasya jīvitam || 21 || aṃtyajo vādhamo vāpi mūrkho vā paṃḍito'pi vā || paṃcākṣarajape niṣṭho mucyate pāpapaṃjarāt || 22 || ityuktaṃ parameśena devyā pṛṣṭena śūlinā || hitāya sarvamartyānāṃ tiṣyajānāṃ viśeṣataḥ || 23 || devyuvāca ||
śivapārvatīpraśnottaravarṇanam
kalau kaluṣite kāle durjaye duratikrame || apuṇyatamasā channe loke dharmaparāṅmukhe || 24 || kṣīṇe varṇāśramācāre saṃkare samupasthitau || sarvādhikāre saṃdigdhe niścite vā viparyaye || kenopāyena mucyaṃte bhaktāstava maheśvara || 25 ||
maheśvara uvāca ||
āśritya paramāṃ vidyāṃ hṛdyāṃ paṃcākṣarīṃ mama || bhaktyā ca bhāvitātmāno mucyaṃte kalijā narāḥ || manovākkāyajairdoṣairvaktuṃ smartumagocaraiḥ || 26 || dūṣitānāṃ kṛtaghnānāṃ nirdayānāṃ khalātmanām || lubdhānāṃ vakramanasāmapi matpravaṇātmanām || mama paṃcākṣarī vidyā saṃsārabhayatāriṇī || 27 || mayaiva masakṛddevi pratijñātaṃ dharātale || patito'pi vimucyeta madbhakto vidyayā'nayā || 28 ||
devyuvāca || karmāyogyo bhavenmartyaḥ patito yadi sarvathā || karmāyogyena yatkarma kṛtaṃ ca narakāya hi ||
tataḥ kathaṃ vimucyeta patito vidyayānayā || 29 ||
īśvara uvāca ||
tathyametattvayā proktaṃ tathāhi śṛṇu suṃdari || rahasyamiti matvaitadgopitaṃ yanmayā purā || 30 || samaṃtrakaṃ māṃ patitaḥ pūjayedyadi mohitaḥ || nārakī syānna saṃdeho mama paṃcākṣaraṃ vinā || 31 || abbhakṣā vāyubhakṣāśca ye cānye vratakarśitāḥ || teṣāmetairvratairnāsti mama lokasamāgamaḥ || 32 || bhaktyā paṃcākṣareṇaiva yohi māṃ sakṛdarcayet || so'pi gacchenmama sthānaṃ maṃtrasyāsyaiva gauravāt || 33 || tasmāttapāṃsi yajñāśca vratāni niyamāstathā || paṃcākṣarārcanasyaite koṭyaṃśenāpi no samāḥ || 34 || tasmādanena maṃtreṇa manovākkāyabhedataḥ || yathāprajñaṃ yathāśraddhaṃ yathākālaṃ yathāmati || 35 || yathāśakti yathāsaṃpadyathāyogaṃ yathārati || yadā kadāpi vā bhaktyā yatra kutrāpi vā kṛtā || yena kenāpi vā devi prajā muktiṃ nayiṣyati || 36 || aśuddho vā viśuddho vā sakṛtpaṃcākṣareṇa yaḥ || pūjayetpatito vāpi mucyate nātra saṃśayaḥ || 37 || kimatra bahunoktena bhaktāḥ sarvādhikāriṇaḥ ||
paṃcākṣarīmahatvakathanam
mama paṃcākṣarīmaṃtrastasmācchreṣṭhataro hi saḥ || 38 || paṃcākṣaraprabhāvācca lokā devā maharṣayaḥ || tiṣṭhaṃti śāśvatā dharmā vedāḥ sarvamidaṃ jagat || 39 || ādau namaḥ pravaktavyaṃ śivāyeti tataḥparam || saiṣā paṃcākṣarī vidyā sarvaśrutiśirogatā || 40 || śabdajālasya sarvasya bījabhūtā samāsataḥ || prathamaṃ manmukhodgīrṇā sā mamaivātmavācikā || 41 || rahasyamanyadvakṣyāmi gopanīyamidaṃ priye || na vācyaṃ yasya kasyāpi nāstikasyāthavā paśoḥ || 42 || sadācāravihīnasya patitasyāṃtyajasya vā || paṃcākṣarātparaṃ nāsti paritrāṇaṃ kalau yuge || 43 || gacchata'stiṣṭhato vāpi svecchayā karma kurvataḥ || aśucervā śucervāpi maṃtro'yaṃ na ca niṣphalaḥ || 44 || aṃtyajasyāpi mūrkhasya mūḍhasya patitasya ca || nirmaryādasya nīcasya maṃtro'yaṃ na ca niṣphalaḥ || 45 || sarvāvasthāṃ gatasyāpi mayi bhaktimataḥ param || sidhyatyeva na saṃdeho nāparasya tu kasyacit || 46 ||
maṃtrāṃtareṣu siddheṣu maṃtra eṣa na sidhyati || siddhe tvasminmahāmaṃtre teca siddhā bhavaṃtyuta || 47 || yathā deveṣvalabdho'smi labdheṣvapi maheśvarī || mayi labdhe tu te labdhā maṃtreṣveṣa samovidhiḥ || 48 || tathāpi naiva kṣudreṣu phaleṣu pratiyogiṣu || sahasā viniyuṃjīta yasmādeṣa mahāphalaḥ || 49 || tasmānmaṃtrāṃtarān tyaktvā bhinnamārgān pratiṣṭhitān || āśrayetparamāṃ vidyāṃ hṛdyāṃ paṃcākṣarī budhaḥ || 50 ||
upamanyuruvāca ||
evaṃ sākṣānmahādevyai mahādevena śūlinā || hitāya jagatāmukto paṃcākṣaravidhikramaḥ || 51 || sanatkumāranaṃdīśvarasaṃvāde || paṃcākṣarasamo maṃtro nāsti nāsti mahāmune || mahādevasamo nāsti yathā devo jagatraye || 52 || umāsamā yathā nārī yathā gaṃgāsamā nadī || yathā merusamo bhūbhṛtsāgareṇa samaṃ saraḥ || 53 || śivabhaktisamo nāsti yathā muktividhāyinī || śaṃbhordayāsamā nāsti naurbhavāṃbudhitāriṇī ||
paṃcākṣarīmahatvakathanam |
tathaiva śivamaṃtrasya tulyo nāstyadhikopi vā || 54 || vṛttam || vedeṣu śāstreṣu ca cāgameṣu sāraṃ samutdhṛtya jagaddhitāya || bhaktipriyaḥ pārvativallabhaśca (parvatarājakanyāṃ) paṃcākṣaraṃ prāha paraḥ śivo'sau || 55 || kṛtvā sarvāṇi pāpāni hatvā ca bhuvanatrayam || sakṛtpaṃcākṣaraṃ japtvā sarvapāpairna lipyate || 56 || namaḥśivāyetyastyeva maṃtro'yaṃ vaśagā ca vāk || narakeṣu narāḥ kecitpacyaṃte ca tadadbhutam || 57 || purā sānaṃdadevo'sau śivabhakto gaṇeśvaraḥ || paṃcākṣareṇa narakātsarvāṃstāritavāna ho || 58 || narakeṣveṣu sarveṣu pātyamānānsuduḥkhitān || śivamaṃtraprabhāvena mocayiṣyaṃtyayatnataḥ || 59 || vṛttam namaḥśivāyeti punaḥ punarmuhurnamaḥ śivāyeti punaḥ punarmuhuḥ || namaḥśivāyeti punaḥ punarmuhurgaṇeśvaro maṃtramathopaṭhatsadā || 60 || paṭhitaṃ śivamaṃtraṃ taṃ śratvā narakavāsinaḥ || samutteruḥ kṣaṇāttasmānnarakānnārakā janāḥ || 61 || kṣudrapāpayutāḥ kṣudrā mahāpāpayutāśca ye || anācārā durācārāḥ sadācāravivarjitāḥ || 62 ||
avicārapracārāśca śivācārabahiṣkṛtāḥ || vedaniṃdāparā ye ca devaniṃdāparāśca ye || 63 || brahmahatyādibhiḥ pāpairakhilairapi saṃyutāḥ || aṣṭāviṃśati koṭīṣu narakeṣu narādhamāḥ || 64 || pātyamānāḥ suduḥkhārtā mocitāstena tatkṣaṇāt || śivamaṃtraprabhāvena yamasyāpyasya sannidhau || 65 || narakasthā vimānasthā sarve saṃdīptatejasaḥ || 66 || vṛttam || sarve narā narakayātanayā kṛśāṃgāḥ śuddhā viśuddhatanavaḥ śubhatejasaśca || śūnyaṃ kṛtaṃ narakamaṃḍalamāśu sarvaṃ śaivaprabhāvavilasadgaṇapuṃgavena
[iti śrīmadvīraśaivācārapradīpikāyāṃ japaprakaraṇe paṃcākṣarīmaṃtravarṇanam nāma prathamopadeśaḥ || śivārpaṇamastu || 31 adhyāyaḥ] ||
[atha dvātriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ] |
|| śrīgurubhyo namaḥ ||
atha japalakṣaṇam vakṣyāmi tadyathā || cinmayaṃ śāśvataṃ śāṃtaṃ nirmalaṃ mokṣadāyakam || vaṃde tripurasaṃhāraṃ bhūtibhūṣaṇavigraham || 1 || ataḥ paraṃ pravakṣyāmi japayajñavidhiṃ param || samastayajñaphaladaṃ sarvapāpapraṇāśanam || 2 ||
śivajñānavidyāyām || athābhyarcya maheśānaṃ sādhyamaṃtraṃ yajeddvijaiḥ || sarvathā sarvadāgrasthaṃ sādhyako (sādhako) vakṣyamāṇavat || 3 || śāradātilake || pūjanātprākkṛtaṃ devi japasya phalamīdṛśam || vakṣyāmi paścājjāpyasya phalaṃ vaktuṃ na vidmahe || 4 || asaṃpūjya śivaṃ stotrajapātphalamudīritam || saṃpūjya ca śivaṃ paścātphalaṃ vaktuṃ na śakyate || 5 || paṃcākṣarīmimāṃ vidyāṃ praṇavena ṣaḍakṣarīm || japennityaṃ ca saṃkalpyaṃ puraścaraṇameva ca || 6 || yāvajjīvaṃ japennityamaṣṭottarasahasrakam ||
anaśnan tatparo bhūtvā nityajāpī sa ucyate || 7 || japedakṣaralakṣaṃ vai caturguṇitamādarāt || pratyāśī saṃyamī yaśca pauraścaraṇikaḥ smṛtaḥ || 8 || graṃthāṃtare || kṛte lakṣajapaṃ kuryāttretāyāṃ dviguṇaṃ bhavet || dvāpare triguṇaṃ proktaṃ kalau lakṣacatuṣṭayam || 9 || śākakaṃdaphalāhārī payobhikṣābhugeva vā || ekāhārayuto naktaḥ strīsaṃparkavivarjitaḥ || puraścaraṇajāpī syādatha vā nityajāpakaḥ || 10 || yaḥ puraścaraṇaṃ kṛtvā nityajāpī bhavetpunaḥ || tasya nāsti samo loke sa śuddhaḥ siddhido vaśī || 11 || japārthamakṣamālāyā lakṣaṇaṃ tvabhidhāsmahe || taddravyāṇi phalānyādau vakṣye'haṃ (vakṣyetān) śāstravartmanā || 12 || dakṣahastasyāṃgulīnāṃ teṣāṃ parvāṇyataḥ param || kuśagraṃthirariṣṭaṃ ca niṃbabījaṃ tataḥ param || 13 || pūtikāvṛkṣabījāni padmeṃdrākṣāṇi caiva hi || śaṃkharaupyasuvarṇāni sphaṭikaṃ vidrumastathā || 14 || mauktikaṃ padmarāgaṃ ca rudrākṣāṇi tataḥ param ||
japalakṣaṇanirṇayaḥ
aṃgulyaśca hi saṃkhyātā ekaikādadhikaṃ phalaṃ || 15 || madhyāṃgulyagraparvādi prādakṣiṇyakrameṇa tu || tatparvabhiḥ śataguṇaṃ phalaṃ syāttadariṣṭakaiḥ || 16 || niṃbabījairbhavellakṣaṃ pūtajairdaśalakṣakam || padmajaiḥ koṭiguṇitaṃ phalaṃ bhavati vai japāt || 17 || iṃdrajaistaddaśaguṇaṃ sahasraṃ śaṃkhamālayā || tato raupyaiḥ śataguṇaṃ tasmātsauvarṇato'dhikam || 18 || tato'dhikaṃ ca sphaṭikairvidrumaiśca tato'dhikam || mauktikairadhikaṃ tasmāttato māṇikyamālayā || 19 || sarvebhyo hyadhikā proktā rudrākṣajapamālikā || tatkṛtānāṃ japānāṃ tu phalasyāṃto na vidyate || 20 || lakṣakoṭisahasrasya lakṣakoṭiśatasya ca || japasya labhate puṇyaṃ rudrākṣaparisaṃkhyayā || 21 || babhūvuste ca rudrākṣā hyaṣṭatriṃśatprabhedataḥ || sūryanetrasamudbhūtāḥ kapilā dvādaśa smṛtāḥ || 22 || somanetrotthitāḥ śvetāste ṣoḍaśavidhāḥ smṛtāḥ || vahninetrotthitāḥ kṛṣṇā daśabhedā bhavaṃti hi || 23 || brāhmaṇaḥ kṣatriyo vaiśyaḥ śūdraśceti caturvidhaḥ || śveto raktaḥ pītavarṇaḥ kṛṣṇavarṇaḥ kramādbhavet || 24 ||
teṣāṃ tu brāhmaṇāḥ śreṣṭhāstaiśca (japamālā kṛtā bhṛśam) mālāṃ ca kārayet || alābhe tu dvijātīnāmapi vā cānyajātayaḥ || 25 || caṇakena mitokṣastu kanīyānparikīrtitaḥ || badarīphalamātrastu madhyamaḥ parikīrtitaḥ || 26 || dhātrīphalapramāṇo'kṣa uttamaḥ parikīrtitaḥ || atisthūlo'tisūkṣmaśca sphuṭito bhaṃguro laghuḥ || 27 || bhinnaḥ purā dhṛto jīrṇo rudrākṣo na varaḥ smṛtaḥ || etāṃstyakvā pragṛhṇīyādakṣamālārthamuttamam || 28 || avraṇān kaṃṭakairbhinnānsudṛḍhān tāmravarṇakān || samavaktrān pragṛhṇīyādakṣamālārthamādarāt || 29 || dṛḍhā dṛṣṭipriyāḥ snigdhā vṛttāḥ śreṣṭhā iti smṛtāḥ || svahastakṛtaraṃdhrāśca rudrākṣā japakarmaṇi || 30 || maṃtrāraṃbhastu caitre ca bahuduḥkhaphalapradaḥ || vaiśākhe ratnalābhaḥ syājjyeṣṭhe ca maraṇaṃ dhruvam || 31 || āṣāḍhe baṃdhunāśaḥ syātpūrṇāyuḥśrāvaṇe bhavet || prajānāśo bhādrapade sarvataḥ śubhamāśvije || 32 ||
kārtike maṃtrasiddhiḥ syānmārgaśīrṣe śubhāvahā || puṣye tu maṃtrahāniḥ syānmāghe medhāvivardhanam || 33 || phālgune sarvasiddhiḥ syāditi maṃtravido viduḥ || śuklapakṣe bubhukṣūṇāṃ kṛṣṇapakṣe mumukṣubhiḥ (mumukṣūṇāṃ)|| 34 || caturthīṃ navamīṃ ṣaṣṭhīmaṣṭamīṃ ca caturdaśīṃ || paurṇamāsīṃ vinā śeṣā hitāstu tithayo matāḥ || 35 || ravimaṃgalasaurāstu tyājyā hyanye śubhāvahāḥ || rohiṇī mṛgaśīrṣaṃ ca maghā puṣyapunarvasū || 36 || hastā svātī hyanūrādhā śravaṇā revatī tathā || trīṇyuttarāṇi mūlā ca nakṣatrāṇi caturdaśa || 37 || jyotiḥśāstravicāreṇa (jyotiḥśāstravicārādvai) dīkṣāṃ kuryādbubhukṣuṣu || mumukṣoḥ sarvadā dīkṣā kālādiniyamo na hi || 38 || gṛhe śataṃ japaṃ viṃdyādgoṣṭhe śataguṇaṃ bhavet || nadyāṃ śatasahasraṃ syādanaṃtaṃ śivasannidhau || 39 || tatpūrvābhimukhaṃ vaśyaṃ dakṣiṇaṃ cābhicārikam || paścimaṃ dhanadaṃ viṃdyāduttaraṃ śāṃtikaṃ bhavet || 40 || āgneyyāṃ (vahnau diśi) vyādhipīḍā ca nairṛtyāṃ dveṣasaṃbhavaḥ || vāyavyāṃ karṣaṇaṃ caiva īśāne mokṣasaṃpadaḥ || 41 ||
āsanastho japetsamyaṅmaṃtrārthagatamānasaḥ || vaṃśāsane daridrī syātpāṣāṇe vyādhisaṃbhavaḥ || 42 || dharaṇyāṃ duḥkhasaṃbhūtirdaurbhāgyaṃ dārukāsane || tṛṇāsane yaśohāniḥ pallave cittavibhramaḥ || 43 || yathociteṣvāsaneṣu niṣiddhāni parityajet || kṛṣṇājine jñānasiddhirmokṣaśrīrvyāghracarmaṇi || syātpauṣṭikādi kauśeye śāṃtikaṃ vetraviṣṭare || 44 || vastrāsane vyādhināśaḥ kaṃbale duḥkhamocanam || abhicārādikaṃ nīle rakte vaśyādikaṃ bhavet || 45 || dhavale śāṃtikaṃ mokṣaṃ sarvārthaścitrakaṃbale || 46 || svastikaṃ gomukhaṃ padmamardhacaṃdrābhidhānakam || caturvidhamidaṃ (catuḥprakāramudita) jñeyaṃ pūjakasyāsanaṃ śubham || 47 || vāmapādopari nyastaṃ dakṣiṇaṃ jānumaṃḍalam || ūrujaṃghāntare nyastaṃ svastikaṃ syātpadadvayam || 48 || vāmajānūpari nyastaṃ dakṣiṇaṃ jānumaṃḍalam || pārśvadvaye padadvaṃdvaṃ nyastaṃ tadgomukhāsanam || 49 || ūrudvayopariṣṭhācca saṃnyastacaraṇadvayam || ūrdhvasthaṃ dakṣiṇaṃ pādaṃ yattatpadmāsanaṃ smṛtam || 50 || ardhacaṃdraṃ yadanyonyacaraṇadvitayaṃ kṛtam || ūrdhvaṃ tu dakṣiṇe pāde yattatsyādardhacaṃdrakam || 51 ||
paṃcaviṃśatisaṃkhyātairmadhyamā parikīrtitā || aṣṭottaraśataiścākṣairuttamā hyakṣamālikā || 52 || tadardhaṃ vā prakurvīta tasyāpyardhamathāpi vā || triṃśadakṣaiḥ kṛtā mālā dhanadā japakarmaṇi || 53 || saptaviṃśatisaṃkhyākairakṣaiḥ puṣṭipradā bhavet || akṣaistu paṃcadaśabhirabhicāraphalapradā || 54 || śatāṣṭākṣā ca sālokyaṃ paṃcāśatpāpanāśanam || dvātriṃśatkīrtidaṃ caiva hyaṣṭāviṃśatsukhāvaham || 55 || śrīkaraṃ saptaviṃśatsyātpaṃcaviṃśacca mokṣadam || nūnaṃ nābhyadhikaṃ cātra grāhyamīśvarabodhanāt || 56 || kārpāsaṃ kṣaumajaṃ vāpi paṃcavarṇasamanvitam || ayaḥsīsaṃ ca tāmraṃ ca rajataṃ svarṇasūtrakam || 57 || trivṛtkṛtvā śuddhasūtraṃ kārpāsaṃ kṣaumajaṃ tu vā || 58 || triguṇaṃ triguṇe sūtre kartavye dvijakanyayā || sūtraṃ kuryāttrivṛtsūkṣmaṃ saptaviṃśatitaṃtubhiḥ || 59 || ghaṭayedvaktravaktraṃ ca pṛṣṭhaṃ pṛṣṭhaṃ salakṣaṇam || 60 || graṃthāṃtare || ghaṭayedekadigvaktrān maṇīn saddaṃtapaṃktivat || 61 ||
sthūlānniyojayenmūle sūtrasyāgre yathā tathā || gopucchavalayākārāmakṣamālāṃ prakalpayet || 62 || sarveṣāmaṃtare graṃthīn kartavyāvartanadvayān || anyonyāsparśasiddhyarthaṃ sparśo japavināśakṛt || 63 || mervākhyaṃ yojayedakṣamekaṃ mūlāgrasūtrake || graṃthiṃ kuryāttadagre ca kīrtitā cākṣamālikā || 64 || meruṃ na laṃghayeddhīmān sṛṣṭisaṃhārakāraṇam || laṃghitā'pi na doṣāya meruhīnākṣamālikā || 65 || śikhāmaṇiriyaṃ brahyan sīmābhūtānna saṃkhyayā || evaṃ kṛtvā'kṣamālāṃ ca saṃskāryā śivamaṃtrataḥ || prakṣālya paṃcagavyena tathā paṃcāmṛtena ca || 66 || saṃsnāpya tīrthatoyena śivakuṃbhasthitena ca || sakūrcaṃ mūlamaṃtreṇa gaṃdhapuṣpākṣatādikam || dhūpadīpau ca naivedyaṃ datvā cāṣṭaśataṃ spṛśet || 67 || evaṃ yā saṃskṛtā mālā sarvakarmasu sarvadā || abhīṣṭapadaprāptyarthaṃ sā sarvāghavināśinī || 68 || madhyamānāmikāṃguṣṭhairakṣamālāmaṇīn spṛśan | akṣarākṣarasaṃdhānaṃ na drutaṃ na vilaṃbitam || 69 ||
maṃtramuccārayannakṣamekaikaṃ karṣayecchanaiḥ || 70 || bhuktaye śreṣṭhavargeṇa karṣayedakṣasūtrakam || ūrdhvamārgeṇa muktyarthaṃ sūkṣmeṇa ca śanaiḥ śanaiḥ || 71 || madhyamānāmikāṃguṣṭhairakṣamālāmaṇiṃ spṛśan || evaṃ japasya caikasya kramo'yaṃ paricālane || 72 || japtvākṣamālāṃ sakalāṃ bhramayedāśikhāmaṇi || pradakṣiṇaṃ punarvaktraṃ prārabhyaivaṃ samācaret || 73 || sahasraṃ vā tadardhaṃ vā tadardhaṃ vā śatāṣṭakam || aṣṭottarasahasraṃ vā japaṃ kuryādataṃdradhīḥ || 74 || brahmacārī gṛhasthaśca śatamaṣṭottaraṃ japet || vānaprastho yatiścaiva sahasrādadhikaṃ japet || 75 || yadāpatsu japedekamaṣṭaviṃśatimaṣṭa vā || 76 || saṃkhyāhīnakṛtaṃ sarvaṃ rakṣobhyastanmayārpitam || ataśca saṃkhyayā vidvān japetsa phalasiddhaye || 77 || aṃguṣṭhānāmikābhyāṃ vā madhyamānāmikāsthitam || aṃguṣṭhena japedvāpi madhyamāṃgulibhiḥ saha || aṃguṣṭhena vinā karma kṛtaṃ tadviphalaṃ yataḥ || 78 || aṃguṣṭhena tu mokṣāya tarjanī śatrunāśinī || madhyamā dhanadā śāṃtiṃ karotyeṣā hyanāmikā ||
kaniṣṭhā rakṣaṇe śastā japakarmaṇi śobhane || 79 || kaniṣṭhāṃguṣṭhayogena kaniṣṭhā siddhirīritā || aṃguṣṭhatarjanībhyāṃ syānmālākarṣaṃ ca madhyamā || 80 || madhyamānāmikāṃguṣṭhairuttamā parikīrtitā || 81 || madhyamāṃguṣṭhayogena japaṃ bhāṣyaṃ prakalpayet || aṃguṣṭhatarjanībhyāṃ tu japaṃ kuryādupāṃśukam || 82 || anāmyaṃguṣṭhamadhyābhirjapaṃ kuryāttu mānasam || 83 || japasya trividhopāyaṃ vājikopāṃśumānasāḥ || punaśca dvividhopāyaṃ hyagarbhaśca sagarbhakaḥ || 84 || uccaistu vācikajapaḥ padaśravaṇagocaraḥ || upāṃśuroṣṭhasaṃspaṃdamānaṃ tacchrutigocaram || 85 || mānaso manasā kāryaṃ maṃtravākyārthaciṃtakam || 86 || bhāṣyo japaḥ kṣudrakāryastūpāṃśuḥ sarvasiddhidaḥ || muktido mānaso jñeya ityuktastrividho japaḥ || 87 || agarbho dhyānarahitaḥ sagarbho dhyānasaṃyutaḥ || agarbhāttu sagarbhasya phalaṃ śataguṇottaram || 88 || itthaṃ viditvā yatnena japaṃ kuryāttu sādhakaḥ || 89 ||
rudrākṣavṛkṣabījāya bhūtisaṃbhūtihetave || netratrayāya rudrāya namo lokahitārthine || 90 || japaṃ kurvīta matimān tadrakṣā'pyadhunocyate || ubhayoścaṃdrayormadhye tejoliṃgamanusmaran || tadeva bhāvayenniṣṭhaṃ liṃgaṃ samavalokayan || 91 || mūrtidhyānam || vṛttaṃ || kuṃdaglauśaṃkhavarṇaprahasitavadanaṃ caṃdramauliṃ trinetraṃ somaṃ sarpāvṛtāṃgaṃ sitabhasitatanuṃ śāmalaṃ nāgahāram || haste nyastatriśūlābhayaḍamaruvaraṃ dvādaśādityabhāsaṃ śrīmaddevādhidevaṃ suragaṇanamitaṃ śaṃkaraṃ ciṃtayāmi || 92 || vedādimūlaṃ prathamaṃ svarāṇāṃ trayodaśasthaṃ śaśisūryabiṃbam || nādātmakaṃ suptabhujaṃgarūpaṃ tritatvabījaṃ praṇavaṃ namāmi || 93 || ṛgyajuḥ sāmavedānāṃ śatarudrīyamuttamam || ekādaśānuvākānāmaṣṭamaṃ ceṣṭadaṃ bhavet || 94 || eṣā paṃcākṣarī vidyā śatarudrīyamadhyagā ||
paṃcākṣare mahādevaḥ sarvadā supratiṣṭhitaḥ || 95 || mūlamaṃtraṃ japedbhaktyā daṃḍavatpraṇamedbudhaḥ || 96 || evaṃ labdhvā paraṃ maṃtramājñayā ca gurostathā || japennityaṃ ca saṃkalpya puraścaraṇapūrvakam || 97 || vinā praṇavakaṃ maṃtraṃ strīśūdrāṇāṃ prasādakam || praṇavena samāyuktaṃ tayordevi viṣopamam || strīśūdrayoḥ pradātavyaṃ namontaṃ praṇavaṃ vinā || 98 || priye vāmena hastena japamālāṃ na saṃspṛśet || adīkṣito dvijo vā'pi spṛśettacchuddhimācaret || 99 || paradṛṣṭigatā mālā yadi syānniṣphalo japaḥ || tasmājjapasya velāyāṃ vastramācchādayejjapī || samaṃtramakṣamālāṃ ca gurorapi na darśayet || 100 || yo japejjīrṇayāṃdolamālayā bhinnakaṃṭhayā || tathā viṣamamukhyā ca naiva siddhimavāpnuyāt || 101 || mano'nyatra śivadhyānaṃ dṛṣṭiranyatra mārutaḥ || na sidhyaṃti varārohe kalpakoṭiśatairapi || 102 || uṣṇīṣī kaṃcukī nagno muktakeśo bhavedyadi || siddhihānirataḥ kuryātprayoge yatnapūrvakam || 103 ||
apavitrakaraḥ śuddhaḥ prajapanna japetkvacit || 104 || krodhaṃ madaṃ kṣutaṃ taṃdrīṃ niṣṭhīvanavijṛṃbhaṇe || darśanaṃ ca śvanīcānāṃ varjayejjapakarmaṇi || 105 || prasārya pādau na japetkukkuṭāsanasaṃsthitaḥ || nāsīnaḥ śapito vā'pi rathyāyāṃ śūdrasannidhau || riktabhūmyāṃ ca khaṭvāyāṃ na japejjāpakaḥ sthitaḥ || 106 || mṛgeṃdrottare || calite kaṃpite haste muktahastātparicyute || siddhihānirataḥ kuryātprayogairyatnamuttamam || 107 || ādyaṃtayorjapasyāśu kuryācchrīprāṇasaṃyamam || recakaḥ pūrakaḥ kuṃbhastrividhaḥ saṃprakīrtitaḥ || 108 || nāsikāpuṭamaṃgulyā pīḍyaikamapareṇa tu || udare recayedvāyuṃ recanādrecakaḥ smṛtaḥ || 109 || pūrakaṃ kuṃbhakaṃ jñātvā recakaṃ japamokṣadam || yāvacchvāsāvasānaṃ syāttāvattāraṃ samuccaret || tato maṃtraṃ samuccārya labhate siddhimīpsitām || 110 || itthaṃ viditvā yatnena japaṃ kuryāttu sādhakaḥ ||
ekena ruddhavātena japamaṣṭottaraṃ śatam || 111 || paṃcākṣaraṃ tu yaḥ kuryāttasya hṛtsadanaṃ mama || 112 || madhye rātrau nivāte tu japedayutamādarāt || nādasiddhimavāpnoti dinenaikena suṃdari || 113 || japellakṣamanālasyo nivāte dhvanivarjite || madhyarātrau śivajyotirbiṃdurūpasamanvitaḥ || 114 || aṃdhakāraṃ vinā tasya dīpasyaikaprakāśanāt || hṛdayāṃtarbahirvyāptaṃ bhaviṣyati na saṃśayaḥ || 115 || paṃcākṣarajapaṃ bhasmasnānaṃ liṃgārcanatrayam || kadācidapi na tyājyaṃ yathāśaktyā samācaret || 116 || rātrau caṃdrodaye maṃtraṃ bhuktikāmo japetsadā || divā sūryodaye maṃtraṃ muktikāmo japetsadā || 117 || suṣumnasthena marutā japaḥ sarvārthasiddhidaḥ || 118 || nāsaṃkhyaṃ nāparibhrāṃtaṃ japaṃ kuryātkadācana || pradakṣiṇanamaskārau japaśca trivṛtaṃ sadā || 119 || itthaṃ kṛtvā japaṃ maṃtrī śivasāyujyakāraṇam || akṣamālāṃ yathāṃguṣṭhe nyaseddakṣakarodare || 120 || culakena gṛhītvārghyaṃ dakṣapāṇitalodare || vāmapāṇitalaṃ kṛtvā saṃghaṭīkṛtya tau yadi || 121 || guhyātiguhyagoptā tvaṃ gṛhāṇāsmatkṛtaṃ japam ||
siddhirbhavatu me yena tvatprasādaḥ sthite mayi || 122 || jāpakaḥ parayā bhaktyā vākyametadudīrayet || mūlamaṃtraṃ samuccārya śivaṃ dhyātvā yathoditam || 123 || tataḥ puṣpāṃjaliṃ datvā kṛtvāṃ'jalipuṭaḥ paṭhet || gadyapadyamayaṃ stotraṃ bhaktyā paurāṇikoditam || 124 || na dhārayetkare mūrdhri kaṃṭhe ca japamālikām || japakāle japaṃ kṛtvā sadā śuddhasthale kṣipet || 125 || prāṇaliṃgamātṛkāmālāsvarūpavidhiḥ || atharvaṇaśirasi || prāṇeṣvaṃtarmanaso liṃgamāhuḥ || tathā ca vātulataṃtre || prāṇaliṃgaṃ manogrāhyaṃ bhavetsakalaniṣkalam || tatprāṇeṣvaṃtarmanaso liṃgamāhuriti śrutiḥ || śāradātilake || vṛttaṃ || aṃtarvidrumabhāsamānabhujagīṃ sūtrotthavarṇojvalāmārohādavarohataḥ śatamayīṃ vargāṣṭakāṣṭottarām || haṃsabrahmavidheyameruśikharāṃ śrīmātṛkākṣāvatīṃ vidyāṃ naumi vicitramaṃtra jananīṃ jñānaikadīpāṃkurām || 126 || vātulataṃtre || iṣṭaliṃgaṃ prāṇaliṃgamekīkṛtya yajedyamī ||
maṇimālāṃ mātṛmālāmekīkṛtya japetsadā || 127 || śṛṇudhvaṃ sarvayajñebhyo japayajño viśiṣyate || hiṃsayā'tra pravartaṃte japayajño na saṃśayaḥ || 128 || yāvaṃtaḥ karmayajñāśca vratadānatapāṃsi ca || sarve ca japayajñasya kalāṃ nārhaṃti ṣoḍaśīm || 129 || agnihotraṃ trayo vedā yajñāśca bahudakṣiṇāḥ || paṃcākṣarajapasyaite koṭyaṃśenāpi no samāḥ || 130 || māhātmyaṃ vācikasyaiva japayajñasya kīrtitam || tasmācchataguṇopāṃśuḥ sahasro mānaso japaḥ || 131 || rakṣoyakṣapiśācādyā grahasarpādibhīṣaṇāḥ || jāpyaṃ ca nopasarpaṃti bhayādbhītāḥ samaṃ tathā || 132 || laiṃge || vṛttaṃ || japena pāpaṃ kṣapayedaśeṣaṃ yattatkṛtaṃ janmaparaṃparāsu || japena rogān jayate ca mṛtyuṃ japena siddhiṃ labhate ca mokṣam || 133 || vṛttaṃ || kimiha bahubhiruktairmaṃtramenaṃ mahātmā praṇavasahitamādau yastu paṃcākṣarākhyam || japati paramabhaktyā pūjayan devadevaṃ sa gataduritabaṃdho mokṣalakṣmīṃ prayāti || 134 ||
ratnatrayamidaṃ proktaṃ sadbhiḥ śāstrārthapāragaiḥ || dīkṣāpūjājapavidhiḥ sarveṣāṃ mokṣagāminām || 135 ||
[iti śrīmadvīraśaivācārapradīpikāyāṃ japaprakaraṇe japalakṣaṇanirṇayo nāmadvātriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ] || 32 ||
[atha trayastriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ] |
śrīgurubhyo namaḥ
śrīsāṃbāya namaḥ || apavargapradātāraṃ namāmi śivamavyayam || atha śrītrividhapādodakaṃ yaḥ pibati tasya mahāmateḥ trividhapādodakamāhātmyaṃ vakṣyāmi tadyathā || bodhāyanaśākhāyāṃ || athāto mahādevasya pādodakavidhiṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ || śrutiḥ || śrīrudreṇa pavitreṇa śatadhāreṇāchidramaparimitamavighnamakṣatamabhīṣṭadamacyutam || paramaṃ pavitraṃ bhagavaṃtamevaṃ mahādevaṃ snāpayitvā sarvo vai rudra iti dvābhyāṃ ṛtaṃ satyaṃ paraṃ brahmeti vā prāśayet || tathā jābālaśākhāyām || bhagavataḥ pādau prakṣālya śaṃkhaṃ prapūrya gaṃdhapuṣpākṣatādibhirabhyarcya caruṃ nivedya imaṃ me gaṃge yamunetyabhimaṃtrya kadrudrāyeti matvā rudreti saṃmārjanaṃ kṛtvā ṛtaṃ satyaṃ paraṃ brahmeti prāśayet ||
pādodakamāhātmyakathanam
sakulajān daśapūrvān daśottarānātmānaṃ tārayet || asminnarthe śivajñānasaṃgrahe || ślokaḥ || yacca vākyaṃ bhagavataḥ pādāvityetadādikaṃ || asti jābālaśākhāyāṃ rudrapādodakasya ca || jābālaśākhāyāṃ || sevāvidhānakathanaṃ tadvākyamapi viśrutaṃ || śaṃkhaṃ pātraṃ pratiṣṭhāpya pādodakasamanvitaṃ || arcayedgaṃdhapuṣpādyairupacārairanekadhā || tatpātraṃ śirasā dhṛtvā dhanyo'hamiti saṃsmaret || iyaṃ me gaṃgāyamunetyabhimanbhyati || śitudristomaṃ (sutudri) sacatā paruṣṇyā || asikniyāmarudvṛdhe (asiknyāmaṃ) vitastayā jīkīye (jīkīyo) śṛṇuhyā (śṛṇuhya) suṣomayā (saṣomayā) || matvā rudracakradhāmānamobhirprāduṣṇuti vṛṣabhamāpahuti || sarvo vai rudrastasmai rudrāya namo astu || puruṣo vai rudrastanmaho namo namaḥ || viśvaṃ bhūtaṃ bhuvanaṃ citraṃ bahudhā jātaṃ jāyamānaṃ ca yat || sarvo hyeṣa rudrastasmai rudrāya namo astu || ṛtaṃ satyaṃ paraṃ brahma puruṣaṃ kṛṣṇapiṃgalam || ūrdhvaretaṃ virūpākṣaṃ viśvarūpāya vai namaḥ || maṃtraḥ || caraṇaṃ pavitraṃ vitataṃ purāṇaṃ yena pūtastarati duṣkṛtāni || tena pavitreṇa śuddhena devā atipāpmānamaṃtarātmā || śuṃdhadhvaṃ daivyāya karmaṇe devayajyāya mātariśvano dharmo'si dyaurasi pṛthivyasi viśvadāyāsi parameṇa dharmā dṛgaṃhasva māṃ vā vasūnāṃ pavitramasi śatadhāraṃ vasudānāṃ (vasurānāṃ) pavitramasi sahasradhāraṃ hutastoko huto dṛṣṭvo ye bṛhate nākāya svāhā dhyātvā pṛthvībhyāṃ sāviśvāya sāviśvavyecā sāviśvakarmā saṃpratyedvarmutāvarirurmīṇi madhumattamā maṃdrā dhanasya sātaye somena tvātanati cvidrāya dadhiviṣṇo havyaṃ rakṣe svāhā evaṃ yaḥ kuryātsakulajān daśa pūrvān daśāparān ātmānaṃ ca tārayet ||
ādityapurāṇe || pādau prakṣālya devasya karābhyāṃ kamalekṣaṇa || abhyukṣya cātmano mūrdhni hyatitheśca gurostathā || 5 || śoṣaṇaṃ pāpapaṃkasya dīpanaṃ jñānatejasaḥ || guroḥ pādodakaṃ citraṃ saṃsāradrumanāśanam || 6 || śivarahasye || sarvatīrthābhiṣeke yā śuddhirmanasi jāyate || guroraṃghrisparśajalaṃ śirasā dhārayetsakṛt || 7 || saptasāgaraparyaṃtaṃ tīrthasnānaphalaṃ sadā || guroraṃghripayobiṃdusahasrāṃśaṃ na pūrayet (guroṃraṃdhrikaṇasyaite sahasrāṃśaṃ vahaṃti na || 8 ||)|| 8 || pādodakaṃ dadhedyastu liṃgamūrteḥ śivasya tu || prakṣālayati tattoyaṃ brahmahatyādipātakān || 9 || brahmāṃḍapurāṇe || śaṃbhoḥ pādodakaṃ pītvā paścādaśuciśaṃkayā || ācamedatimohena (ya ācamati mohe na) taṃ viṃdyādbrahmaghātakam || 10 || vīrataṃtre || liṃgodakaṃ ca pādāṃbu prasādāṃbviti yattridhā || namaskāryaṃ hi śirasā dhāryaṃ peyaṃ śivārthibhiḥ || 11 || liṃgābhiṣekatoyena śucirbhūtvā haraṃ smaret || mārjanaṃ mūrdhni gātre ca nirmalaṃ snānamīritam || 12 || vidhiḥ paramaśaivānāṃ nirmalaḥ snānamīritam ||
nānyeṣāmiti kartavyaṃ śaṃkareṇa subhāṣitam || 13 || snānānāṃ caivasarveṣāṃ rahasyamatidurlabham || yena snānena sā gaurī rudraṃ bhartārameti ca || 14 || himodakaṃ mahātīrthaṃ gaṃgā ca yamunā nadī || narmadā sarayūḥ kṣiprā tathā godāvarī nadī || sadā sannihitāstvetāḥ śaṃbhoḥ pādodake mune || 15 || vaidyaśāstre || liṃgābhiṣekaṃ kurvīta talliṃgodakamucyate || tatra snātvā ca pītvā ca nāśayedakhilāmayam || 16 || abhiṣiktajalaṃ prātaḥ pibennityaṃ dine dine || śūlakuṣṭhādyapasmārajvarāṇāṃ bheṣajaṃ priye || 17 || vīrabhadrīye || snānodake bhavetsnānaṃ gaṃḍūṣe pānameva ca || liṃgagrāhyaṃ manogrāhyamanyadgrāhyaṃ vivarjayet || 18 || liṃgasāre || liṃgābhiṣekajaṃ toyaṃ yattu liṃgodakaṃ bhavet || tatpibelliṃgaśaraṇo hyanyaccenmadyamāṃsavat || 19 || liṃgasnātaṃ liṃgatoyaṃ liṃgapītaṃ tathaiva ca || tatpibelliṃgaśaraṇaścānyanmadyaśvamūtravat || 20 || liṃgāvagāhanaṃ caiva liṃgāṃbu śuci tadbhavet || tena snānaṃ ca pānaṃ ca hyanyaccāṃḍālatoyavat || 21 ||
liṃgaprakṣālanaṃ toyaṃ liṃgatoyaṃ tathaiva ca || tattoyaṃ sarvadā grāhyamanyaccāṃḍālatoyavat || 22 || vīrataṃtre || sarvavyādhiharaṃ puṇyaṃ śaṃbhorvaktrādvinirgatam || tatprasādodakaṃ viṃdyātskaṃdādyairapi sevitam || 23 || vaidyaśāstre || nirmālyasalilaṃ prāśya devadevasya śūlinaḥ || kṣayakuṣṭhajvarāyāsairmucyate kilbiṣairapi || 24 || prasāditaṃ tu salilaṃ prasādasalilaṃ bhavet || gṛhītaṃ pāvanaṃ hyetadanyadviṭsalilaṃ bhavet || 25 || ādityapurāṇe || yatprasādodakaṃ pītvā paścādaśuciśaṃkayā || ya ācamati mohena taṃ viṃdyādbrahmaghātakam || 26 || śivarahasye || matprasādodakaṃ puṣpaṃ sadā dhāryaṃ madāśritaiḥ || tryakṣā daśabhujāḥ sarve mama tulyaparākramāḥ || 27 || gaṃgodakaṃ pavitraṃ tu śivapādodakādikam || pītaṃ ca vāmahastasthaṃ nṛṇāṃ pāpaharaṃ bhavet || 28 || brahmāṃḍapurāṇe || sanatkumāra uvāca || māhātmyaṃ śrotumicchāmi śaṃbhoḥ pādodakasya vai || kiṃ phalaṃ kaḥ prabhāvo vā guṇāḥ kevāsya kīrtitāḥ || 29 ||
taddhārayati yo nityaṃ śirasā śivatatparaḥ || prāśanaṃ niyamenaiva prayatnena dine dine || kurute yo naro brahman prabhāvaṃ tasya me vada || 30 || brahmovāca || sādhu sādhu tvayā vatsa praśno'yaṃ pāpanāśanaḥ || kṛtaḥ pādodakasyādya śṛṇu māhātmyamuttamam || 31 || kathayāmi hi taṃ vatsa yogyastvaṃ śravaṇe hyasi (śrutavānasi)|| pādyaṃ datvā vibhostasya gṛhṇīyātpādato jalam || 32 || śatadhāreṇa maṃtreṇa paṃcākṣarayutena ca || dhṛtvā śirasi pādāṃbu mahatphalamavāpnuyāt || 33 || akālamṛtyumathanaṃ sarvavyādhivināśanam || sarvapāpopaśamanaṃ śaṃbhoḥ pādodakaṃ śubham || 34 || sadyaḥ phalapradaṃ puṇyaṃ sarvapātakanāśanam || maṃgalaṃ sarvamāṃgalyam sarvapāvanapāvanam || 35 || duṣṭagrahopaśamanamiṣṭasiddhipradāyakam || sarvaduḥkhapraśamanaṃ sarvavyādhivināśanam || 36 || sarvotpātapraśamanaṃ sarvarogaprabhedanam || sarvakalyāṇakṛttoyaṃ sarvakāmaphalapradam || 37 || sarvasiddhipradaṃ sadyaḥ sarveṣāṃ muktidāyakam ||
