puṇyaṃ puṇyatamaṃ śaivaṃ sarvadoṣanivāraṇam || sarvatīrthaphalaṃ samyak prāpnuyānmūrdhni dhāraṇāt || 38 || nārāyaṇaśilāṃ gatvā tatpṛṣṭhe śrāddhakṛnnaraḥ || yadāpnoti tadāpnoti mūrdhni pādāṃbudhāraṇāt || 39 || tathaiva pitarastasya nṛtyaṃti divi harṣitāḥ || 40 || mahānadyāṃ tu godāyāṃ vairāje yā mune jape || brahmavarte ca kedāre tathā kanakhale'pi ca || 41 || gaṃgāyāṃ ca kuśāvarte bilvake nīlaparvate || daśāśvamedhe yaddatvā tathā kūrmaśilāsu ca || eṣu tīrtheṣu yatpuṇyaṃ tadvai pādāṃbudhāraṇāt || 42 || prayāgasya prabhāsasya puṣkarasya ca sevanāt || pṛthūdakasya śuklasya sānnidhyādyatphalaṃ labhet || 43 || prayāge ca mṛtiryeṣāṃ vārāṇasyāṃ mṛtasya ca || kurukṣetre mṛtānāṃ ca gatirbhavati yā nṛṇām || 44 || sarvaṃ bhavati vai vatsa śivapādāṃbudhāraṇāt || 45 || kurukṣetre naimiṣe ca bhūmibhāgāśca ye śubhāḥ || sarvatīrthodakā hyete (sarvatīrthodakasyaite) kalāṃ nārhaṃti ṣoḍaśīm || 46 || maunavān yastu gaṃgāyāṃ snānadharmarato naraḥ || tasya yādṛgbhavetpuṇyaṃ tādṛk pādāṃbudhāraṇāt || 47 || nadaṃ nadīṃ vedavatīṃ liṃgakāṃ ca mahānadīm || nadīmirāvatīṃ caiva tāpikāṃ vaḍavāmukhīm || 48 ||
godāvarīṃ caṃdrabhāgāṃ tathā vetravatīṃ suta || śraddhāṃ sarasvatīṃ gatvā tathā vaitariṇīṃ mune || yatprāpyate phalaṃ snātvā tadvai pādāṃbudhāraṇāt || 49 || vṛttaṃ || gaṃgāpuṣkaranarmade ca yamunā godāvarī gomatī gaṃgādvāragayā prayāgabadarī vārāṇasī saiṃdhavī || kanyāsetusarasvatī prabhṛtayo brahmāṃḍamadhye'khile tīrthasnānasahasrakoṭiphaladaṃ śrīśaṃbhupādodakam || 50 || śravaṇātsarvaśāstrāṇāṃ vedavedāṃtadhāraṇāt || sarvavratānāṃ caraṇāttapasā yatphalaṃ mune || tatphalaṃ labhate sadyo mūrdhni pādāṃbudhāraṇāt || 51 || agniṣṭomādgosahastrātpuṃḍarīkānmahāmune || vājapeyādrājasūyānnaramedhācca yatphalam || 52 || tathā bahusuvarṇasya sarvamedhasya yatphalam || tatphalaṃ labhate sadyo mūrdhni pādāṃbudhāraṇāt || 53 || godānena ca yatproktaṃ kanyādānena yadbhavet || bhūmidānena yatproktaṃ suvarṇamaṇibhūṣaṇe || 54 || vidyādānena yatproktaṃ śaraṇāgatapālanāt || tatphalaṃ labhate sadyo mūrdhni pādāṃbudhāraṇāt || 55 || gṛhe yasmin prasūtā strī sūtakaṃ nātra vidyate || śivapādāṃbusaṃsparśātsarvapāpaṃ praṇaśyati || 56 || durjanaścāpi pādāṃbu bibhrāṇaḥ śuddhimāpnuyāt || 57 ||
aṃtyakāle'pi yatsarvaṃ dhriyate pādayorjalam || so'pi sadgatimāpnoti vidyācārabahiṣkṛtaḥ || 58 || agamyagamanaṃ yeṣāṃ pāpācārāśca ye narāḥ || te'pi pūtā bhavaṃtyāśu śaṃbhoḥ pādāṃbudhāraṇāt || 59 || dṛṣṭipūtaṃ pibetsarvaṃ śivasya parameṣṭhinaḥ || tadvai pāpaharaṃ putra kiṃ punaḥ pādayorjalam || 60 || yathā pādodakaṃ putra patraṃ puṣpaṃ sukhāvaham || tathaiva dhūpaśeṣaśca dīpaśeṣo na saṃśayaḥ || 61 || ahamanyadrahasyaṃ te kathayāmi śṛṇuṣva tat || tatpādodakasaṃsparśātpuṇyamanyanna vidyate || 62 || bhūtapretapiśācānāṃ ḍākinīnāṃ vināśanam || jarāvyāptaśarīrāṇāṃ rogākrāṃtaśarīriṇām || 63 || rogairāhatadehānāṃ viṣaśastrahatātmanām || vātapittakaphodbhūtasarvavyādhivināśanam || 64 || agnicorabhayaṃ putra puruṣasya na vidyate || apamṛtyubhayaṃ nāsti siṃhavyāghrakṛtaṃ tathā || 65 || satyaṃ sarvabhayaṃ nāsti prasādodakadarśanāt ||
rāgāḥ sarve praṇaśyaṃti tejo vīryaṃ ca vardhate || 66 || utsāhaṃ pauruṣaṃ śauryaṃ saṃtatiḥ sukhamuttamam || vidhīyate kāyaśuddhiḥ pīte vaktrādvinirgate || 67 || prāyaścittaṃ yadi prāptaṃ kṛcchraṃ vāpyaghamarṣaṇam || sa prasādodakaṃ pītvā śuddhimāpnoti tatkṣaṇāt || 68 || aśaucaṃ naiva vidyeta jātakaṃ mṛtakaṃ tathā || teṣāṃ prasādajaṃ toyaṃ pānaṃ kurvaṃti ye narāḥ || 69 || etatpādodakasyāsya māhātmyaṃ kathitaṃ mayā || dhārayasva sadā mūrdhni prāśanaṃ kuru nityaśaḥ || 70 || janmamṛtyujarāmukto mokṣaṃ prāpsyasi putraka || tadrahasyaṃ na vaktavyaṃ mūrkhāṇāṃ ca tvayā'nagha || 71 || kṛtaghnāya na vaktavyaṃ na ca hiṃsāratāya ca || abhaktāya tvarudrāya na ca pāṣaṃḍināṃ suta || 72 || śāṃtāya śuddhabhāvāya dāṃtāya śubhacāriṇe || tīrthasnānaratāyaivaṃ deyaṃ dharmaratāya vai || 73 || pādodakādimāhātmyaṃ satataṃ yaḥ paṭhennaraḥ || kīrtayecchrāvayedyastu mucyate sarvakilbiṣaiḥ || 74 || śrutvā pāpāni saṃtyajya prāpnuyācca mahatphalam || 75 ||
ekamūrtestrayo bhāgā gururliṃgaṃ tu jaṃgamaḥ || jaṃgamaṃ ca gururliṃgaṃ trividhaṃ liṃgamucyate || 76 ||
[iti śrīmadvīraśaivācārapradīpikāyāṃ trividhapādodakamāhātmyakathanaṃ nāma trayastriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ] ||
[atha catustriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ] |
|| śrīgurubhyo namaḥ ||
śrīsāṃbāya namaḥ || gauravaṃ laiṃgikācāraṃ prasādaṃ yastu bhuṃjate || tasya mokṣapradaṃ śarvaṃ namāmi girijāpatim || 1 || atha trividhaprasādamāhātmyaṃ vakṣyāmi tadyathā || vyāsaṃ sarvāgamāvāsaṃ muniṃ munigaṇāvṛtam || kṛtapaurvāhṇikācāraṃ kṛtāsanaparigraham || prasannaṃ prāṃjaliḥ prāha praṇamya kila jaiminiḥ || 2 ||
jaiminiruvāca ||
anarhaṃ mama naivedyaṃ pādāṃbukusumaṃ dalam || itīśvareṇa kathitamiti kecinmaharṣayaḥ || 3 || vadaṃti tatkathaṃ svāmin yathārthaṃ kathayasva me || 4 ||
vyāsa uvāca ||
devadevasya vacaso viṣayo'yaṃ hi jaimine || ye vīrabhadraśapitāḥ śivabhaktiparāṅmukhāḥ || 5 || śaṃbhoranyatra deveṣu ye bhaktā ye na dīkṣitāḥ || ye'śuddhakarmiṇaḥ śaṃbhoranyatrāsaktabuddhayaḥ || 6 || teṣāmanarhamīśasya tatprasādacatuṣṭayam || 7 || nirmālyaṃ nirmalaṃ śuddhaṃ nirmalatvādaniṃditam ||
tasmādabhojyaṃ nirmālyaṃ prākṛtairaśivātmabhiḥ || 8 || jihvācapalasaṃyuktaḥ śivasaṃskāravarjitaḥ || śivanirmālyabhogī ca rauravaṃ narakaṃ vrajet || 9 || śaive || īśvara uvāca || malliṃgadhāriṇo loke deśikā matparāyaṇāḥ || madekaśaraṇāsteṣu yogyaṃ naivānyajaṃtuṣu || 10 || kālikākhaṃḍe || prasādaṃ trividhaṃ proktaṃ śuddhaṃ siddhaṃ prasiddhakam || śuddhaṃ liṃgamukhāttyaktaṃ siddhaṃ caravivarjitam || 11 || prasiddhaṃ guruṇā tyaktamityetattrividhaṃ smṛtam || 12 || skāṃde || liṃgārpaṇaṃ tu sarvatra bāhyābhyaṃtarato bhavet || rūpaṃ dravyasya bāhye tu nirūpaṃ cāṃtare punaḥ || 13 || samāghrātaṃ parispṛṣṭaṃ yathā dṛṣṭamanicchayā || śivāya kalpitaṃ vastu na kiṃcidapi dūṣyati || 14 || bṛhatkālottare || saṃyogeṣu viyogeṣu cāṇumātrasukhāni ca || yaḥ kuryādiṣṭaliṃge tu sāvadhānī niraṃtaram || 15 || śaive || śivasvāmikamevānnaṃ śivāya vinivedayet ||
prasādamāhātmyakathanam
viniyogopacāreṇa saṃtuṣyati sadāśivaḥ || 16 || brahmāṃḍapurāṇe || sarvalokaikanāthasya śaṃbhoḥ kaḥ kiṃ prayacchati || upacārapriyaḥ śaṃbhustenaivāyaṃ prasīdati || 17 || graṃthāṃtare || śivopabhuktaṃ puṣpaṃ ca gaṃdhaṃ pānādikaṃ tathā || niveditamiti proktaṃ sarvapāpaharaṃ param || 18 || laiṃge || khādyāni cādanīyāni pāyasādīni yāni vai || tāni deyāni śaṃbhośca tadaśnīyācca bhāvataḥ || 19 || sūtasaṃhitāyām || sveṣṭaliṃgāya yaddattaṃ carukaṃ tanna saṃśayaḥ || tadaśnīyātsvayaṃ prājño nānyasmai tacca dāpayet || 20 || na dadyādgojalādibhyo dadyāccennarakaṃ vrajet || 21 || kriyātilake || śuddhe śivaprasāde ca śucitvaṃ yo na bhāvayet || so'pi yāti naro ghoraṃ narakaṃ kālamakṣayam || 22 || supratiṣṭhitaliṃge tu na yathā pūrvabhāvanā || tathā śivaprasādasya pūrvanāma na saṃsmaret || 23 || laiṃge || patraṃ puṣpaṃ phalaṃ toyamannapānādyamauṣadham || anivedya na bhuṃjīta yadāhārāya kalpitam || 24 ||
ikṣudaṃḍaṃ phalaṃ puṣpaṃ khādyāni vyaṃjanāni ca || prasādānnaiva bhoktavyamanyadgomāṃsaviṭsamam || 25 || sarvaṃ ca tṛṇakāṣṭhaṃ ca bhakṣyaṃ caivānulepanam || gaṃdho mṛgamadaścaiva karpūraṃ tailamaṃjanam || 26 || karmaṇā manasā vācā trividhaṃ cārpitaṃ śubham || nocedanarpitaṃ bhuṃkte prasādaṃ niṣphalaṃ bhavet || 27 || graṃthāṃtare || rūpaṃ samarpya dravyasya rucimapyarpayettataḥ || ubhayārpaṇahīnaṃ cetprasādaṃ niṣphalaṃ bhavet || 28 || dīpāṃtamupacāraṃ syānnaivedyāṃtaṃ ca pūjanam || tasmānnaivedyahīnaṃ cetpūjālopo bhavetsadā || 29 || tattatprasādabhogāṃtaṃ naivedyārpaṇamucyate || prasādadānahīnaṃ cedarpitaṃ cāpi niṣphalam || 30 || vratopavāsaniyamairyena kenāpi hetunā || pūjāprasādalopaścennāsāvāpnoti tatphalam || 31 || upavāsasahasrāṇi prājāpatyāyutāni ca || śivaprasādasikthasya koṭyaṃśenāpi no samāḥ || 32 || nirmālyaṃ paramānaṃdaṃ nirmālyaṃ śuddhaśaivadam || nirmālyaṃ paramaṃ jñānaṃ nirmālyaṃ paramāmṛtam || 33 ||
nirmalatvācca nirmālyaṃ nṛṇāṃ nairmalyakāraṇam || nirmālyadhāraṇaṃ śaṃbhoḥ prasādodakasevanam || 34 || prasādabhojanaṃ ceti pratyekaṃ pātakāpaham || 35 || śirasā śivanirmālyaṃ bhaktyā yo dhārayedyadi || aśucirbhinnamaryādaḥ sarvāvasthāṃgato'pi vā || 36 || tasya pāpāni ghorāṇi nāśayatyeva śaṃkaraḥ || tilaṣoḍaśabhāgaṃ ca tṛṇāgrāṃbukaṇopamam || pādodakaprasādānnasevayā mokṣamāpnuyāt || 37 || īśānasaṃhitāyāṃ || kiṃ dīkṣiyā kiṃ tapasā kiṃ dhyānaṃ ca japena kim || śṛṇu devi varārohe madbhuktaṃ yadi bhuṃjate || 38 || śirasā dhārayedbhaktyā yo nirmālyamalobhataḥ || ahameva na saṃdehaḥ somaḥ (ahameva dhṛtastena sāmeḥ ||) somakalādharaḥ || 39 || svacchaṃdalalitabhairavīye || īśvara uvāca || nirmālyadhāraṇātputra sālokyaṃ labhate naraḥ || pādodakasya pānena sāmīpyaṃ labhate sadā || 40 || matprasādopabhogena sārūpyaṃ pratipadyate || 41 || śivadharme || nirmālyaṃ dhārayan mūrdhri naivedyaṃ cāpi bhakṣayet || tatprasādodakaṃ pītvā gāṇapatyamavāpnuyāt (gāṇāpatya)|| 42 ||
brahmāṃḍapurāṇe ||
vyāsa uvāca || imaṃ prasādaṃ bhuṃjāno viriṃciḥ kila jaimine || aṣṭādaśamahāvidyāsthānavārāśi pāragaḥ || 43 || kaṃṭharaṃgasthale nṛtyadbhāratībhāsurānanaḥ || surāsuraśiroratnavirājitapadāṃbujaḥ || 44 || siddhavidyādharādhīśaḥ karakaṃcukitāṃghrikaḥ || yakṣakinnaragaṃdharvasaṃtatārādhanocitaḥ || 45 || aṇimādimahāsiddhi janmabhūmirudāhṛtaḥ || anugrahītuṃ sakalaṃ nigrahītuṃ ca līlayā || 46 || jagajjanayituṃ śaktaḥ prasādānubhavādabhūt || 47 || viṣṇuḥ paraśurāmo'pi śivena paridīkṣitau || pādodakaprasādānnanirmālyānāṃ niṣevakau || 48 || vasiṣṭho'pi gariṣṭho'bhūtprasādasya prabhāvataḥ || prasādasevanājjāto viśvāmitro mahāmuniḥ || 49 || pāṇiniśca kaṇādaśca kapilo gautamādayaḥ || prasādasevanāddhyānādarcanāddhāraṇādapi || 50 || jātā darśanakartāraḥ śrāvayaṃti jagatrayam || tasmātpādodakaṃ peyaṃ prasādānnaṃ ca bhojayet || 51 || harivaṃśe ||
puruhūtanāradasaṃvāde || kadāpīśasya pādāṃbunirmālyaparimelitaḥ(lanāt) || pavanaḥ pannageśena nipītaḥ puṇyakāriṇā || 52 || tena viśvaṃbharābhāradhurīṇatvamavāpya ca || bhogīśvaratvamapi ca hīśabhūṣaṇatāmapi || 53 || sarvajñatā ca saṃjātā deveṃdra na hi saṃśayaḥ || 54 || sākṣātprasādabhogena bhakto'yaṃ labhate phalam || tadvaktuṃ na hi me śaktirna giraśca girāṃ pateḥ || 55 || śivopabhuktaṃ nirmālyaṃ pavitraṃ pāpanāśanam || tasmādbhuktvā ca pītvā ca śivena saha modate || 56 || śivarahasye || prāṇaprasādamavyaktaṃ pītaṃ liṃgaprasādakam || liṃgajaṃgamasaṃyuktaṃ prasādaṃ cetyakhaṃḍakam || 57 || graṃthāṃtare || liṃgadvayaprasādaṃ ca yo bhuṃkte śraddhayānvitaḥ || tadīyocchiṣṭamāsādya sa vai yāti parāṃ gatim || 58 || carācaraprasādānnabhoktā taccheṣadhāraṇāt || carācarāṇāṃ bhūtānāmapi muktirbhavetpriye || 59 || sarvabhaktagaṇaprītibhuktiśiṣṭaprasādakam ||
gaṇaprasādī yaḥ so'yaṃ bhuṃjīta sukhalīlayā || 60 || sakṛlliṃgārcakocchiṣṭaṃ svadehaṃ yastu lepayet || vajrakāyaḥ sa bhavati śivena saha modate || 61 || mahābhārate ānuśāsanike parvaṇi || dūrvāsabhuktocchiṣṭena (dūrvāsocchiṣṭabhuktena) pādabāhyāṃgalepanāt || sahasā vajrakāyatvaṃ prāptavān viṣṇuravyayaḥ || 62 || muṃḍakopaniṣadi || tena saha bhuṃjīta tena saha bhuṃjīteti śivānubhūtamakhilaṃ nirmālyaṃ bhojyaṃ dhāryamiti dvedhā ṣaḍvidhaṃ kaiścidiṣyate || devasvaṃ devatādravyaṃ naivedyaṃ ca niveditam || caṃḍadravyaṃ bahiḥ kṣiptaṃ nirmālyaṃ ṣaḍvidhaṃ tathā || 63 || devasvaṃ grāmabhūmyādi dāsīdāsacatuṣṭayam || hemaraupyādiratnāni devadravyamiti smṛtam || 64 || yatsaṃkalpya tu devāya patraṃ puṣpaṃ phalaṃ jalam || annapānādi tatsarvaṃ naivedyamiti kīrtitam || 65 || etattrividhanirmālyamanarhamiti kathyate || pramādādbhojanaṃ kuryādbhūmerapyekamaṃgulam || 66 || kiṃciddravyāpahāreṇa rauravaṃ narakaṃ vrajet || 67 || śivopabhuktasraggaṃdhamannapānādikaṃ tathā || niveditamiti proktaṃ sarvapāpaharaṃ param || 68 ||
bāṇaliṃge care lohe ratnaliṃge svayaṃbhuvi || pratimāsu ca sarvāsu na caṃḍodhikṛto bhavet || 69 || vidhinā sthāpite liṃge sarvadevāsurairnaraiḥ || etattrividhanirmālyaṃ caṃḍeśodhikṛte śive || 70 || bahiḥkṣiptamanarhaṃ hi cānyadravyatvakāraṇāt || piśācānāṃ ca sarveṣāmadhikāro hi sarvadā || 71 || vākyaṃ || iti ṣaḍvidhaprasādeṣu niveditaprasādameva prasādabhoktṛrṇāmarhaṃ bhavati || bahvannaṃ bhuktamevāpi śiṣṭānnena vimiśritam || anarpitaṃ ca bhuṃjānastadevonnatakilbiṣam || 72 || bodhāyanasmṛtau || pādodakaṃ pāpaharaṃ (pāśaharaṃ) nirmālyaṃ caihikapradam || gurorbhuktaṃ sadākālamāmuṣmikaphalapradam || 73 || laukikānāṃ tathānyeṣāṃ teṣāṃ muktirna vidyate || pāṣaṃḍino'pi mucyaṃte guroreva prasādataḥ || 74 || śivarahasye || gurujaṃgamaliṃgānāṃ nirmālyaṃ bhuktiśiṣṭakam || sadaivānubhaveddevi prasādavratamuttamam || 75 || ādityapurāṇe || pūjakā bahavaḥ saṃti bhaktāḥ śatasahasraśaḥ || tatra prasādapātraṃ tu dvau trayo naiva paṃca ṣaṭ || 76 || prasādabhoktṛrnniṃdaṃti ye janā bhaktisaṃyutān ||
te yāṃti pitṛbhiḥ sārdhaṃ narakaṃ nātra saṃśayaḥ || 77 || sādaṃ śṛṇu kalyāṇi brahmādīnāṃ mahātmanām || viṣṇupramukhadevānāmapyagamyamagocaram || 78 || brahmāṃḍapurāṇe || prasādānubhavasyaiva māhātmyaṃ pratipāditam || idaṃ pavitraṃ paramamakhilāgamacoditam || 79 || vedavedāṃtatatvajñaiḥ pavitraṃ paribhāṣitam || itihāsaśivācārasārabhūtamudāhṛtama || 80 || nānāpurāṇavedeṣu rahasyaṃ paribhāṣitam || tasmātsarvaprayatnena gopanīyamidaṃ tvayā || 81 || mahatā liṃgarūpeṇa mahatā jaṃgamena ca || dvividhena samudbhūtaṃ prasādāya namo namaḥ || 82 ||
[iti śrīmadvīraśaivācārapradīpikāyāṃ trividhaprasādakaraṇaṃ nāma catustriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ] || 34 ||
[atha paṃcatriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ] |
śrīsāṃbāya namaḥ || yo bhakto vartate loke tasya mokṣapradāyakam || namāmi śarvaṃ sarvajñaṃ sarvalokamaheśvaram || 1 || atha bhaktādhikyaprakaraṇe bhavipākanirasanaṃ vakṣyāmi tadyathā || bhavināmāsane yāne saṃparke sahabhojane || saṃcaraṃti mahāghore narake kālamakṣayam || 2 || vīrāgame || liṃgadhāraṇabhaktānāṃ liṃgabāhyanṛpadvijaiḥ || sevāraṃbhanamaskāraṃ rauravaṃ narakaṃ vrajet || 3 || graṃthāṃtare || liṃgadhāraṇabhaktānāṃ liṃgabāhyasatīsutaiḥ || āliṃganāccuṃbanācca rauravaṃ narakaṃ vrajet || 4 || ekā munivaraṃ tyaktvā patiṃ mitraṃ pativratā || kṛtakṛtyā bhavatpūrvaṃ tapasā pūjya śaṃkaram || 5 || yadgṛheṣvanyadevo'sti tadgṛhāṇi parityajet || yadgṛheṣu bhaviprāptistadgṛhāṇi parityajet || 6 || liṃgena saha dehī ca liṃgabāhyā tviyaṃ satī || sahaśaktiśca saṃyogo kiṃ phalaṃ kiṃ śrutaṃ bhavet || kiṃ bhāṃḍaṃ kṣīrabhāṃḍaṃ ca sūkarasparśi cedbhavet || 7 || graṃthāṃtare || bhavisaṃgāllabhejjaṃtuḥ koṭijanmatapaḥkṣayam ||
aihike niṃditaścaiva paratre (pare ca) narakaṃ vrajet || 8 || śivajñānaṃ śivadhyānaṃ śivapūjā tapaḥphalam || niṣphalaṃ yāti deveśi bhavisaṃsargakāraṇāt || 9 || duḥsaṃgaṃ ca duruktaṃ ca duḥśīlaṃ durguṇaṃ tathā || durvākyaṃ duścaritraṃ ca dūraḥ syādguruliṃgayoḥ || 10 || bhavilakṣaṇam || madyapānī māṃsabhakṣī anyadevasya pūjakaḥ (vācakaḥ) || saṃsargī ca mahādrohī na liṃgī bhavinaḥ smṛtāḥ || 11 || bhavijanmakṛtaṃ pāpaṃ bhaktajanmavivarjitam || bhaktajanma kriyāhīnaṃ cedbhavedghorakilbiṣam || 12 || taskaraṃ paradāraṃ ca anyadevasya pūjanam || anṛtaṃ niṣṭhuraṃ niṃdā iti cāṃḍālalakṣaṇam || 13 || agnidagdho ghaṭo yadvanna bhūyo mṛttikā bhavet || sa śivācārasaṃgena na punarmānuṣo bhavet || 14 || asaṃskārikṛtaṃ pākaṃ śaṃbhornaivedyameva ca || naivedyamannaṃ bhuṃjīyānnarake kālamakṣayam || 15 || bhavipākaṃ na kartavyaṃ liṃge naivedyakilbiṣam || svayaṃpākaṃ pavitrānnaṃ liṃganaivedyamuttamam || 16 || bhaktānāṃ sadanaṃ gatvā bhuṃjīyādbhaktisaṃyutaḥ ||
bhavisaṃgabhavipākanirasananirṇayaḥ
varṇānāmaṣṭadaśakaṃ cāṃḍālamiva varjayet || 17 || śaṃkarasaṃhitāyām || anyadṛṣṭinipātaṃ taddravyaṃ tu parivarjayet || śuddhadravyaṃ samāsādya liṃge ca prasamarpayet || 18 ||
[iti śrīmadvīraśaivācārapradīpikāyāṃ bhaktādhikyaprakaraṇe bhavisaṃgabhavipākanirasananirṇayo nāma paṃcatriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ] || 35 ||
[atha paṭtriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ] |
atha bhaktamāhātmyaṃ vakṣmāmi tadyathā || śrutiḥ || namaste astu rudrarūpebhyaḥ śivebhyaḥ || ślokaḥ || ye rudralokādavatīrya rudrā mānuṣyamāśritya jagaddhitāya || kurvaṃti nānāvidhacāruceṣṭāstebhyo namastryaṃbakapūjakebhyaḥ || 1 || śivarahasye || bhaktaprāṇo hyahaṃ devi bhaktaprāṇo mamaiva tu || matto'dhiko hi bhaktastu tasmādbhaktānnamāmyaham || 2 || bhaktān svalābhasaṃtuṣṭān sādhūn bhūtasuhṛttamām || nirahaṃkāriṇaḥ śāṃtānnamasyāmi suhṛttamān (śāṃtānnamaste śirasā sakṛt)|| 3 || nirapekṣaṃ muniṃ śāṃtaṃ nirvairaṃ samadarśinam || anuvrajāmyahaṃ nityaṃ pūjayaṃtyaṃghnireṇubhiḥ || 4 || paramādvaitavijñānaniṣṭhasyāsya mahātmanaḥ || śuśrūṣā kriyate yena tatpādau mama mastake || 5 || padmapurāṇe || mukhe paṃcākṣarī yasya bhāle yasya tripuṃḍrakam || citte śivānusaṃdhānaṃ tasya pādarajo'smyaham || 6 || brahmovāca || tatpādabhṛtyabhṛtyānāṃ bhṛtyabhṛtyatvamuttamam || madīśadevadeveśa devānāmapi durlabham || 7 ||
śivabhaktamāhātmyavarṇanam
karmāvalaṃbakāḥ kecitkecitjñānāvalaṃbakāḥ || vayaṃ tu śivabhaktānāṃ pādarakṣāvalaṃbakāḥ || 8 || śrutiḥ || yā te rudra'śivā tanūraghorā'pāpakāśinī || tayā nastanuvā śaṃtamayā giriśaṃ tābhicākaśīhi || asminnarthe kāraṇāgame || apāpakāśīti vapuḥ śrutaṃ te śiṣṭāḥ prasiddhā bhagavannapāpāḥ || atastvadīyānapahāya bhaktānanyānaśiṣṭaiti niścinomi || 9 || (laiṃge) śvapacaḥ śivabhaktaścetsa eva kulajādhikaḥ || 10 || na liṃgī sarvadaivajño yastu cāṃḍālavadbhuvi || liṃgārcakastu śvapaco dvijakoṭyāṃ viśiṣyate || 11 || muṃḍakopaniṣadi || nirmālyameva sadā bhakṣayet || cāṃḍālo naiva cāṃḍālaḥ pulkaso naiva pulkasaḥ || api vā yaścāṃḍālaḥ śiveti vācaṃ vadettena saha bhuṃjīta tena saha bhuṃjīteti || asminnarthe vāyavīyasaṃhitāyām || śiveti vācaṃ yo nityaṃ cāṃḍālo'pi vadenmudā || saha tena vadedvācaṃ saha tena vasetsadā || vadettena vasettena viśettena punaḥ punaḥ || bhuṃjīta sākaṃ muṃjītetyāha sāmaśrutiḥ khalu || 12 ||
śivabhaktiyuto martyaścāṃḍālaḥ pulkaso'pi vā || nārī naro vā ṣaṃḍho vā sadyo mucyeta saṃsṛteḥ || 13 || mārgastho vāpyamārgastho murkho vā paṃḍito'pi vā || mama bhakto yadi bhavetsarvasmādadhiko hi saḥ || 24 || kiṃ kulena kimācāraiḥ kiṃ śīlena guṇena vā || bhaktileśayutaḥ śaṃbhoḥ sa vaṃdyaḥ sarvadehinām || 15 || ādityapurāṇe || sadbhaktaḥ sarvadā skaṃda śvapaco'pi mama priyaḥ || na tasmādadhikaṃ kiṃcidvidyate pātramuttamam || 16 || yathā paṃke sarojaṃ syādyathā kāṣṭhe hutāśanaḥ || yathā suvarṇaṃ pāṣāṇe bhaktaścāṃḍālavaṃśajaḥ || 17 || sūktisudhārṇave || vṛttaṃ || puṃsaḥ svarūpavinirūpaṇameva kāryaṃ tajjanmabhūmiguṇadoṣakathā vṛthaiva || kaḥ kālakūṭamabhinaṃdati sāgarotthaṃ ko vāraviṃdamabhiniṃdati paṃkajātam || 18 || dārvaśmalohamṛdulaṃ jātaṃ liṃga pratiṣṭhitam || yathā pūjyaṃ tathaiva syādbhaktaścāṃḍālavaṃśajaḥ || 19 || kāṃcanaṃ rajataṃ tāmraṃ lohaṃ ceti catuṣṭayam || yadvadyāti suvarṇatvaṃ rasavedaprabhāvataḥ || 20 ||
tadvacchūdrādipātraṃ hi śivamaṃtrātmakatvataḥ || vidvadrasena mahatā paraṃ brahmatvametyalam || 21 || śivadīkṣābhijātasya pūrvajātiṃ na ciṃtayet || supratiṣṭhitaliṃge tu na yathā pūrvabhāvanā || 22 || śivasaṃskārasaṃpanno hyayaṃ śūdro hyayaṃ dvijaḥ || iti bhedaḥ kṛto yena rauravaṃ narakaṃ vrajet || 23 || yasya cittaṃ śive līnaṃ tasya jātyādikaṃ smaran || śivaliṃge śilābuddhiṃ kurvāṇa iva pātakī || 24 || vāsiṣṭhe || vālmīkaśca vasiṣṭhaśca gārgyamāṃḍavyagautamāḥ || pūrvāśrayaikaniṣṭhāḥ syurdīkṣayā munisattamāḥ || 25 || vākyaṃ || ityādivacanena mahātmanāṃ śivabhaktānāṃ jananādikamaprayojanamityuktaṃ bhavati || vāyavīyasaṃhitāyām || brāhmaṇo vāpi cāṃḍālo durguṇaḥ suguṇo'pi vā || bhasmarudrākṣadhārī yo dehāṃte tu śivaṃ vrajet || 26 || śivarahasye || grāme tu malinaṃ toyaṃ yathā gacchati sāgaram || śivasaṃskārasaṃpanne jātibhedaṃ na kārayet || 27 || dakṣādhvare || dadhīciruvāca || pāṣaṃḍācāraniratāḥ sarve nirayagāminaḥ || kalau yuge tu saṃprāpte daridrāḥ śūdrayācakāḥ || 28 ||
bahunoktena kiṃ sākṣācchive saṃsāramocake || tatsaṃbaṃdhiṣu sarveṣu śrutismṛtyādikeṣu ca || 29 || yuṣmākaṃ vaṃśajātānāṃ yuṣmākaṃ tu tathaiva ca || śraddhābhāvastathaivāstu śāpastīvraḥ kṛto mayā || 30 || skāṃde || caturvedadharo vipraḥ śivabhaktivivarjitaḥ || naro narakagāmī syāttasya saṃbhāṣaṇādapi || 31 || yaścaturvedanirataḥ śivabhaktivivarjitaḥ || tena saṃbhāṣaṇaṃ nityaṃ na kuryādupajīvanam || 32 || caturvedadharo vipraḥ śivabhaktivivarjitaḥ || vedabhārabharākrāṃtaḥ sa vai brāhmaṇagardabhaḥ || 33 || caturvedadharo vipraḥ śivabhaktivivarjitaḥ || tasya kāṃcanadānena dātā'pi narakaṃ vrajet || 34 || śvapaco'pi muniśreṣṭhaḥ śivabhaktyā dvijādhikaḥ || śivabhaktivihīnastu brāhmaṇaḥ śvapacādhamaḥ || 35 ||
[iti śrīmadvīraśaivācārapradīpikāyāṃ bhaktādhikyaprakaraṇe śivabhaktamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāma ṣaṭtriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ] || 36 ||
[atha saptatriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ] |
śrīsāṃbāya namaḥ || bhaktācāraṃ vakṣyāmi tadyathā || śivajñānavidyāyām || īśvara uvāca || sadācāraṃ pravakṣyāmi samyagjñānasya sādhanam || 1 || yasmādācārahīnasya jñānaṃ niṣphalatāṃ vrajet || sadācāreṇa devatvamṛṣitvaṃ ca varānane || upāgatāḥ kuyonitvaṃ manuṣyāstadviparyaye || 2 || ācārahīnaḥ puruṣo loke bhavati niṃditaḥ || tasmātsarvaprayatnena samyagācāravān bhavet || 3 || yaḥ śivācārasaṃpanno hyanācāreṇa miśritaḥ || na prasādī na cācārī sarvabhakṣīva vāyasaḥ || 4 || satī sutaśca bhṛtyaśca dāsī gopastathaiva ca || sarvaṃ liṃgārcakaṃ (liṃgāṃkitaṃ) śreṣṭhamanyaccāṃḍālavadbhavet || 5 || gṛhaṃ kṣetraṃ ca bījaṃ ca dhānyāni ca dhanāni gauḥ || etalliṃgāṃkitaṃ śuddhamanyathā narakaṃ vrajet || 6 || śivarahasye || bhaktahastagataṃ dravyaṃ dhanaṃ vastravibhūṣaṇam || naṃdimudrāṃkitaṃ grāhyaṃ dravyaśuddhirihocyate || 7 || naṃdimudrāṃkitaṃ kṣetraṃ yuktaṃ śivaśaraṇyakaiḥ || tadeva pāvanaṃ kṣetraṃ kṣetraśuddhirihocyate || 8 || bhaktena yatkṛtaṃ veśma liṃgamudrāsamanvitam ||
abhaktasparśanābhāvādveśmaśuddhirihocyate || 9 || bhaktena kṛtabhāṃḍāni liṃgamudrāṃkitāni ca || jalapākakriyāyāṃ ca bhāṃḍaśuddhirihocyate || 10 || vibhūtisaṃskṛtaṃ kāṣṭhaṃ bhaktānītaṃ ca suvrate || tadeva yogyaṃ kāṣṭheṣu kāṣṭhaśuddhirihocyate || 11 || tṛṇagulmalatādīni bhaktānītāni caiva hi || saṃskṛtya bhasmanā devi tṛṇaśuddhirihocyate || 12 || (bhaktārāme samutpannaṃ nāgavallidalairyutam || cūrṇaṃ svahakvvaṃcecchuddhistāṃbūlikā matā || 1 ||) bhaktadārusamutpannaṃ phalaṃ patrādikaṃ samam || atha svahastapakvaṃ ca śuddhistāṃbūlikā matā || 13 || abhaktasparśanābhāvātpakvamannaṃ varānane || śākaṃ tailādikaṃ sarvaṃ pākaśuddhirihocyate || 14 || ghṛtaṃ dadhi payastakraṃ mākṣikaṃ varjayettataḥ || tadvarjanaṃ ca vai devi rasaśuddhirihocyate || 15 || (gurusaṃskāramāhātmyaḥ saṃpradāyayuto bhavet || na bhavo bhavasaṃskāro bhavaśuddhirihocyate ||) gurusaṃskāramāhātmyasaṃpradāyayuto bhavet || athavā bhavasaṃskāre bhavaśuddhirihocyate || 16 || sarvabhūtadayā nityaṃ paṃcabhūteṣu saṃskriyā ||
bhaktācāravarṇanam
svābhūtapoṣaṇābhāvo bhūtaśuddhirihocyate || 17 || liṃgārcanavidhau bhaktaḥ kāṣṭhamaunaṃ samācaret || datvā ca bhāvanāṃ liṃge bhāvaśuddhirihocyate || 18 || samayārādhanaṃ nityaṃ dhanaprāṇābhimānakaiḥ || trisaṃdhyāṃ dhyānato devi mārgaśuddhirihocyate || 19 || rātrau madhyamayāme tu supteṣvakhilajaṃtuṣu || prauḍhaḥ prasādabhogaśca kālaśuddhirihocyate || 20 || vinayaḥ sarvabhaktānāṃ kriyate hitayā girā || tadvācaścānukūlyaṃ ca (priyatvānukūlyaṃ) nayaśuddhirihocyate || 21 || āsane śayane yāne gamanāgamane sthitau || bhaktena saha sāṃgatyaṃ janaśuddhirihocyate || 22 || saṃskārāḥ ṣaḍvidhāḥ proktā jalaṃ puṣpaṃ phalāni ca || patraṃ pātraṃ tathā gotraṃ bhaktānāṃ bhaktavatsale || 23 || bhaktahastabhave kūpe pratyahaṃ taruṇaṃ jalam || bhasmamaṃtrapavitraṃ ca gṛhītaṃ jalasaṃskṛtiḥ || 24 || nava kuṃbhagataṃ toyamadṛṣṭaṃ bhavināmapi (madvaiṣṭaṃ bhavināmapi) || tajjalaṃ liṃgayogyaṃ ca tathānyadvarjayetsudhīḥ || 25 || aduṣṭāṇi ca puṣpāṇi vimuktāni śilīmukhaiḥ || anyānyupahṛtānyevaṃ puṣpasaṃskārasaṃbhavaḥ || 26 || yāni kāni phalānyeva bhaktahastagatāni vai ||
abhaktadarśanābhāvātkathyate phalasaṃskṛtiḥ || 27 || patrāṇi cakravartyādi bhaktahastabhavāni vai || tatra śākhādipākoyaṃ kathyate patrasaṃskṛtiḥ || 28 || pātrāṇi jaṃgamādīni tatpādarajasā śive || tenaiva pāvitaṃ viśvaṃ kathyate pātrasaṃskṛtiḥ || 29 || gotrāṇi śivagotrāṇi tatra saṃbaṃdhakāraṇam || bhayabhaktiḥ parā tatra kathyate gotrasaṃskṛtiḥ || 30 || vātulataṃtre || dāsatvaṃ vīradāsatvaṃ bhṛtyatvaṃ vīrabhṛtyakam || samayaḥ sakalāvasthā sajjanaḥ ṣaḍvidhastathā || 31 || ādau niyamasaṃyukto gurupādāṃbujārcane || karmayogayutaḥ prokto dāsabhāvastu sajjanaḥ || 32 || svāmibhṛtyasamopetaṃ paradaivavivarjitam || madbhaktākāṃkṣitaṃ cittaṃ vīradāsatvasajjanaḥ || 33 || akulaṃ kulavaṃtaṃ vā namaskṛtya ca bhojayet || śeṣānnaṃ bhujyate devi bhṛtyabhāvastu sajjanaḥ || 34 || aṣṭasiddhiyutaṃ proktamīṣaṇatrayasaṃyutam || āsuraṃ karma yogena vīrabhṛtyatvasajjanaḥ || 35 || svagṛhaṃ svadhanaṃ caiva svadehaṃ bhaktisaṃyutaḥ || jaṃgame sthāvare dadyātsamayācārasajjanaḥ || 36 ||
dāsabhāvādyarcanākramavarṇanam
aṇimādiguṇaiśvaryamīṣaṇatrayavarjitam || nirmalaṃ nirahaṃkāraṃ sakalāvasthasajjanaḥ || 37 || gurau liṃge dṛḍhaṃ bhaktaḥ satyavādī jiteṃdriyaḥ || suvrataḥ sumatiścaiva dāsabhāvārcanākramaḥ || 38 || śuddhaliṃgārcanaṃ nityaṃ sajjanaḥ samayānvitaḥ || anyathā daivataṃ nāsti vīradāsārcanakramaḥ || 39 || puṣpānulepanaṃ vastraṃ pādyādyābharaṇānvitam || tāṃbūlāgarukarpūrasugaṃdhāmodapūritam || 40 || yo yajedgeyanṛttādidhavalachatracāmaraiḥ || natistotraṃ prakurvīta bhṛtyācārārcanakramaḥ || 41 || prāṇaliṃgavrate lupte hastakhaḍgādavaṃcayan || mukhaṃ paṃkajavacchiṃdyādvīrabhṛtyārcanākramaḥ || 42 || tailābhyaṃgaṃ ca vastraṃ ca miṣṭānnaṃ jaṃgamārpitam || sukhasaṃbhāṣaṇaṃ prītyā samayārādhanakramaḥ || 43 || cittaṃ samarasaṃ śāṃtaṃ bhāvapuṣpāṃbunirmalam || ātmaliṃgārcanaṃ nityaṃ sarvāvasthārcanakramaḥ || 44 || vāyavīyasaṃhitāyām || satyaṃ dayā kṣamā śaucaṃ niyamo mārdavaṃ tathā ||
tapastyāgo brahmacaryaṃ saṃtuṣṭiścārjavaṃ tathā || 45 || dharmā ekādaśa proktā bhaktānāṃ śubhalāṃchane || 46 || kāmaṃbhaktiratau kuryātkrodhaṃ cādharmakarmaṇi || lobhaṃ śivārcane kuryānmohaṃ bhaktajane priye || 47 || mātsaryaṃ karaṇeṣvevaṃ madaṃ māyāparābhave || 48 || carmapātre jalaṃ tailaṃ na grāhyaṃ bhaktavatsale (bhaktitatparaiḥ) || gṛhyate yadi bhaktena rauravaṃ narakaṃ vrajet || 49 || bṛhat kālottare || devārcanādikaṃ karma kāryaṃ dīkṣānvitaiḥ sadā || nāsti śāvaṃ tatasteṣāṃ sūtakaṃ vā yatātmanām || 50 || śivadharme || liṃgārthaṃ jaṃgamārthaṃ vā pacanaṃ nātmakāraṇāt (mokṣakāraṇaṃ)|| ātmārthaṃ yaḥ pacedannaṃ narakārthaṃ sa jīvati || 51 || brahmapurāṇe || anārādhya mahādevaṃ na bhuṃjīyātkadācana || eṣa dharmaḥ paro jñeyaḥ śeṣo bhavatu vā navā || 52 || saure || āropayaṃti ye karma śivāśramagamānuṣān || kuṃbhīpākāgninā dagdhā jāyaṃte nīcayoniṣu || 53 || sarvajñānottare || naca mukhyatayā skaṃda lokadharmaṃ samāśrayet || nānyaśāstrasamādhiṣṭhaṃ na cānyāṃ devatāṃ smaret || 54 || vīrabhadrīye || pativratāsvabhāvena vihāyānyattu daivatam ||
bhaktasyaśivetaradevatāpūjāniṣedhādikathanam
śivamekaṃ bhajedbhaktyā sarvaśāṃtikaraṃ parama || 55 || ādityapurāṇe || śivabhakto naro rājan bhakto'nyeṣu sureṣu yaḥ || svapatiṃ yuvatī tyaktvā yathaivānyeṣu sajjate (rajjate)|| 56 || brahmagītāyām || śivapūjāparo bhūtvā yo'nyaṃ daivamanusmaret || aṣṭāviṃśatikoṭīṣu narakeṣu patetdhruvam || 57 || vātulataṃtre || yatra cācāraniṃdāsti kadācittatra na vrajet || yadgṛhe śivaniṃdā'sti tadgṛhāṇi parityajet || 58 || skāṃde || yaḥ sarvabhūtādhipatiṃ viśveśānaṃ viniṃdati || na tasya niṣkṛtiḥ śakyā kartuṃ varṣaśatairapi || 59 || vṛttaṃ || jagatpatervedapurāṇavedibhirna tasya lokaikaguroḥ pinākinaḥ || śṛṇvaṃti niṃdāmanumodayaṃti vā gacchaṃti te'pyāśu sudāruṇāṃ gatim || 60 || śaive || śivaniṃdākaraṃ dṛṣṭvā ghātayedathavā śapet || sthānaṃ vā tatparityajya gacchedyadyakṣamo bhavet || 61 || śivaniṃdākarān haṃtumaśakto'pi svayaṃ hataḥ || sadya eva vimucyeta trisaptakulasaṃyutaḥ || 62 || śivadharme || evamādi samācāramanutiṣṭhecchivāśramī ||
aśeṣapāśanirmuktaḥ śivaloke mahīyate || 63 || ādityapurāṇe || nānyo vimuktaye paṃthāḥ sadācāramṛte nṛṇām || tasmātkuryātsadācāraṃ tuṣṭaye girijāpateḥ || 64 ||
[iti śrīmadvīraśaivācārapradīpikāyāṃ bhaktādhikyaprakaraṇe bhaktācāravarṇanaṃ nāma saptatriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ] || 37 ||
[athāṣṭatriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ] |
śrīsāṃbāya namaḥ || atha bhaktadānamāhātmyaṃ vakṣyāmi tadyathā || śaṃkarasaṃhitāyām || ṛṣaya ūcuḥ || sūta dharmavidāṃ śreṣṭha jñātamasmābhiruttamam || vīraśaivāśritaṃ dharmarahasyaṃ tvatprasādataḥ || 1 || idānīṃ śrotumicchāmo vīramāheśvarasya tu || kṛtadānaphalaṃ pūjāphalaṃ tvaṃ vaktumarhasi || 2 || sūtaḥ || vakṣye bhāgyavatāṃ śreṣṭhāḥ prāṇaliṃgāṃgasaṃginaḥ || kṛtadānaphalaṃ pūjāphalaṃ māheśvarasya tu || 3 || purā kumāraḥ papraccha śaṃkaraṃ śaśibhūṣaṇam || etamarthaṃ mahābhāgaḥ provācāsmai maheśvaraḥ || 4 ||
śaṃkara uvāca ||
vakṣyāmi śivabhaktasya dānamānārcanāphalam || saṃsārapāśabaṃdhaghnaṃ samyagjñānapradaṃ nṛṇām || 5 || vṛttaṃ || yo hastapīṭhe nijaliṃgamiṣṭaṃ vinyasya tallīnamanaḥ pracāraḥ || bāhyakriyāsaṃkulaniḥspṛhātmā saṃpūjayatyaṃga sa vīraśaivaḥ || 6 || durlabhāstriṣu lokeṣu prāṇaliṃgāṃgasaṃginaḥ || pūrvajanmakṛtātpuṇyātkeṣāṃ citsulabhā bhuvi || 7 || yaiḥ purā'rādhitaḥ śaṃbhurbhaktipraṇatamānasaiḥ || taireva labhyaḥ puṇyātmā śivaliṃgāṃgasaṃgabhāk || 8 || yatra tiṣṭhati liṃgāṃgasaṃbaṃdhīśaparāyaṇaḥ ||
nimiṣaṃ nimiṣārdhaṃ vā tacchivakṣetramucyate || 9 || liṃgāṃgasaṃginaḥ puṃso ye dṛgviṣayavartinaḥ || te sarve pāpanirmuktā yāsyaṃti paramāṃ gatim || 10 || prāṇaliṃgaikaniṣṭhasya dehaṃ spṛṣṭvā samīraṇaḥ || yatra gacchati tatrasthā martyā muktā na saṃśayaḥ || 11 || śivaliṃgāṃgasaṃbaṃdhabhājāṃ darśanamātrataḥ || muktiṃ gacchaṃti manujāḥ paśupakṣimṛgādayaḥ || 12 || liṃgāṃgasaṃginaṃ martyaṃ liṃgadhyānaparāyaṇam || anuvrajati yo martyaḥ so'pi muktimavāpnuyāt || 13 || yā pūjā mama bhaktasya kṛtā yena ṣaḍānana || sā mamaiva kṛtā pūjā tena nāstyatra saṃśayaḥ || 14 || vṛttaṃ || māheśvarasya hṛdayāṃbujakarṇikāyāṃ madhye vasāmi girirājasutāsahāyaḥ || taṃ pūjayedyadiha māṃ manujo'rcayedyastasmai dadāmi śikhivāhana vāṃchitārthān || 15 || bahisthāḥ sarvadā sarve tvaṃ naṃdī gaṇanāyakaḥ || mamātmā prāṇaliṃgaikyaḥ sa evāhaṃ na saṃśayaḥ || 16 || vīramāheśvaraṃ māṃ ca vibhinnaṃ pravadaṃti ye || te mūḍhā eva manujā nātra kāryā vicāraṇā || 17 || vṛttaṃ || ataḥ sukhārthī śivaliṃgapūjakaṃ samarcayennityamataṃdritaḥ sudhīḥ || samastasaṃsāranivṛttaye sadā jalānnavastrābharaṇāsanādibhiḥ (aṃganā)|| 18 ||
śivabhaktadānamāhātmyam
yugapacchivaliṃgaikyapādaspṛṣṭarajāṃsi ca (yugapacchivaliṃgaikyapādaṃ spṛṣṭvā rajāṃsi ca ||) || pataṃti mastake yasya sa mukto nātra saṃśayaḥ || 19 || pādaprakṣālanaṃ yastu kurute śītalodakaiḥ || vīramāheśvarasyāsau caturaṃbudhirāḍ bhavet || 20 || dhṛtaliṃgasya bhaktasya pādaprakṣālitaṃ jalam || pāpaśuddhyarthamajñānāṃ tattīrthaṃ śikhivāhana || 21 || prāṇaliṃgāṃgasaṃbaṃdhipādaprakṣālitaṃ jalam || liṃgāṃgasaṃgarahitaḥ pibettattasya puṇyadam || 22 || dadyānmṛdvāsanaṃ yastu śivabhaktasya sādaram || dhṛtaliṃgasya sa pumān saptadvīpādhipo bhavet || 23 || vastraṃ śītāpanodārthaṃ yo dadyācchivayogine || sa sarvabhogasaṃyuktaṃ labhate brahmaṇaḥ padam || 24 || chatraṃ copānahau yastu cāmaravyajanāni ca || dadyālliṃgārcakāyāsāvaiṃdraṃ padamavāpnuyāt || 25 || dhanaṃ dadyādyathāśakti yaḥ pumāṃcchivayogine || sa dhaneśatvamāpnoti sarvabhogasamanvitam || 26 || kārayitvā gṛhaṃ samyak sarvopakaraṇānvitam || liṃgāṃgasaṃgine dadyādyaḥ sa śaivaṃ padaṃ vrajet || 27 || dānānāṃ ca samastānāṃ catvāryetāni bhūtale || śreṣṭhāni kanyāgobhūmividyādānāni sarvadā || 28 || tasmātkanyāpradānena samaṃ dānaṃ na vidyate ||
saṃtatau saṃtatau tasyāṃ yānyapatyāni bhūtale || 29 || bhavaṃti teṣāṃ romāṇi yāvaṃtyaṃgeṣu saṃti vai || tāvaṃti varṣāṇi naro vimānaṃ sārvakāmikam || 30 || āruhya sarvalokeṣu bhraman kanyāpradaḥ sukham || sarvabhogān kramādbhuktvā tato gacchecchivaikyatām || 31 || payasvinīṃ savatsāṃ gāṃ sarvālaṃkārabhūṣitām || yo dadyācchivabhaktāya sa gacchecchivasannidhim || 32 || dattāyāṃ bhūmisaṃbhūtabījasaṃkhyātavatsarān || bhūmidaḥ śāṃbhave loke sarvānkāmānavāpnuyāt || 33 || yo dadyādīśabhaktāya vidyākośasya pustakam || sa sarvakarmanirmukto na pibejjananīstanam || 34 || vidyādānasamaṃ dānaṃ nāsti lokeṣu sarvadā || vidyayā prāṇināṃ muktistasmāddānamanuttamam || 35 || dadyādannaṃ mahādevabhaktāya śivayogine || sarvapāpavinirmuktaḥ śivaloke mahīyate || 36 || yāvaṃtyannasya siktthāni dattasya śivayogine || tāvaṃti varṣāṇi naro vasecchivapure sukhī || 37 || annaṃ vā jalamātraṃ vā yaddattaṃ liṃgadhāriṇe || tadannaṃ merusadṛśaṃ tajjalaṃ sāgaropamam || 38 || yatra māheśvaraḥ kuryācchivaliṃgārcanaṃ sakṛt ||
śivabhaktapūjāmahimāvarṇanam
vasaṃti tatra tīrthāni sarvāṇi satataṃ guha || 39 || ātmano yadabhīṣṭaṃ tu tena dravyeṇa pūjayet || yena kena prakāreṇa śivabhaktasya cetasaḥ || 40 || yastṛptiṃ kurute martyaḥ sa vai śivapuraṃ vrajet || 41 || saṃsārasāgare'gādhe duḥkhāvartaśatākule || majjatāṃ manujānāṃ vai pūjā māheśvarasya nauḥ || 42 || tasmātsarvaṃ parityajya vīramāheśvaraṃ janam || pūjayedādarādyastu sa samyagjñānavān bhavet || 43 || vṛttaṃ || na vīramāheśvarasevayā vinā śivasya bhaktirmanujasya vidyate || vināsti bhaktyā śivavedanaṃ nahi pradhānametacchivabhaktapūjanam || 44 || śaṃkaraḥ || atha coktaprakāreṇa śivabhaktāstapasvinaḥ || pūjayā'niśamavyagro vatsa liṃgāṃgasaṃginaḥ || 45 || asminnarthe svasaṃvedye śrutayaḥ sakalāgamāḥ || purāṇāni samastāni paryavasyaṃti yuktayaḥ || bahunoktena he vatsa sāra eṣa mayoditaḥ || 46 || sūtaḥ || ityuktaḥ śaṃkareṇa'sau śrīmāṃśca śikhivāhanaḥ || nanāma giriśaṃ bhaktyā sarvajñaṃ karuṇānidhim || 47 || yūyaṃ śraddhānvitā viprā dānamānārcanādibhiḥ || ṣaṭsthalajñānavaṃtaṃ ca vīramāheśvaraṃ janam || 48 || pūjayadhvaṃ mahābhāgāḥ pūjā sā puruṣārthadā || 49 || eṣa vaḥ kathito dharmaḥ sarvadharmottamottamaḥ ||
śivaprītikaro viprāḥ śivabhaktārcanāṃkitaḥ || nātaḥ parataro dharmastriṣu lokeṣu vidyate || 50 || vidyāyāṃ ramate yasyā(?)nmāyāṃ heyāṃ śvavadrahet || anenaiva niruktena vīramāheśvaraḥ smṛtaḥ || 51 || tasmātsarvaprayatnena vīramāheśvaraṃ janam || ārādhayatha vipreṃdrā yūyaṃ bhakti puraḥsarāḥ || 52 || ya idaṃ puṇyamākhyānaṃ śṛṇotyekāgramānasaḥ || śivaliṃgārcanākāle tasmai śaṃbhuḥ prasīdati || 53 || gṛhe yasyedamākhyānapurakaṃ tiṣṭhati dhruvam || tasyaiśvaryasamṛddhiḥ syānnāgnicorabhayaṃ bhavet || 54 || paṭhate śrāvayedyastu dharmākhyānamidaṃ naraḥ || sa trisaptakulopetaḥ śivaloka mahīyate || 55 || vṛttaṃ || bhūtiste paramaprakāśa uta bho rudrākṣamevaṃ śrīpaṃcākṣaramaṃtra eva bhavadīyaṃ divyanāmasphuṭam || liṃgaṃ mūrtirumāpate parānaṃdāmṛtaṃ codakaṃ prāsādatvamabhūtprasāda iti taṃ bhaktirbhajatyadya(?) || 56 || kāyo jaḍo hi jīvaḥ syājjaḍājaḍasamāhvayaḥ || ajaḍaḥ pa (* *)(?) śānastayoraikyaṃ jaḍaṃ vinā || 57 || vartiḥ kāyo dīpamūlo jīvo (*)(?) pāgra īśvaraḥ ||
dṛṣṭāṃto dṛśyate loke jīveśaikyapadaṃ prati || 58 || na bhedo vartisaṃtyāge dīpamūlāgrayoryathā || na jīveśvarayorbhedo dehatyāge tathaivahi || 59 ||
[iti śrīmadvīraśaivācārapradīpikāyāṃ bhaktādhikyaprakaraṇe śivabhakta dānapūjāmāhātmyakathanaṃnāma aṣṭatriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ] || 38 ||
